pmid-3308402.summary_ja: マウスEGF受容体に対するモノクローナル抗体とポリクローナル抗体を作製し、その性質を解析した。胚性癌細胞OC15の内胚葉分化過程におけるEGF受容体の誘導を検討し、無傷の細胞では反応しないが可溶化後にはEGF依存性自己リン酸化が検出されることから、潜在性のEGF受容体の存在を示唆した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍の治療を扱う研究ではなく、基礎発生学研究である。
pmid-3308402.summary_en: Monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies against mouse EGF receptor were prepared and characterized. Rabbit polyclonal antibodies blocked EGF binding and stimulated DNA synthesis at high concentrations, indicating binding near the EGF site. Using these tools, the authors examined EGF receptor induction when OC15 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate into endodermal derivatives. Intact EC cells did not bind or respond to EGF, but EGF-stimulated autophosphorylation was detectable in solubilized cells, suggesting cryptic EGF receptors in EC stem cells. The work is basic developmental biology and does not address clinical germ cell tumour treatment.

pmid-3308495.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株F9とPCC7を用い、N-mycとc-mycの発現制御機構を比較した。両遺伝子は主に転写後レベルで調節され、PCC7ではc-mycが転写レベルでも抑制されていた。血清やインスリン等によりc-mycのみが増加する。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的病態を扱うものではなく、分化と遺伝子発現制御の基礎研究である。
pmid-3308495.summary_en: This study compares regulation of N-myc and c-myc in murine embryonal carcinoma lines F9 and PCC7 under growth conditions and during differentiation. Both genes are mainly controlled post-transcriptionally, with c-myc additionally repressed transcriptionally in PCC7. Serum, insulin and transferrin raise c-myc but not N-myc mRNA, and the two genes differ in expression kinetics, protein-synthesis dependence and transcript half-lives. The EC lines serve as general models of differentiation and myc gene regulation rather than as models of clinical germ cell tumour disease.

pmid-3311384.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞と初期マウス胚の核ラミンを解析し、胚性癌細胞と8日齢以前の胚は、ラミンBに近い単一のラミンのみを発現することを示した。ラミンA/Cは受精卵に出現後消失し、着床後8日胚で再出現する。EC細胞は胚様のモデルとして用いられており、発生過程の核構造を扱う基礎研究である。
pmid-3311384.summary_en: The nuclear lamina of teratocarcinoma stem cells and early mouse embryos was examined. Embryos up to day 8 and embryonal carcinoma cells express only one lamin species closely resembling lamin B. Lamins A and C appear in fertilized eggs, disappear during early cleavage, and reappear at day 8 after implantation. EC cells lack lamins A and C, but some of their differentiated derivatives express them strongly. The work addresses nuclear organization during embryogenesis, using EC cells as embryonic-like models, and does not concern clinical germ cell tumour management.

pmid-3327864.summary_ja: 網膜酸で誘導した多能性ヒト奇形腫細胞株Tera-2 cl.13の分化過程において、c-myc mRNA量を測定した。曝露期間が長くなると細胞周期は延長し、細胞はほぼ静止状態となり分化マーカーを発現した。c-myc発現は未分化細胞に比べ最大1.6倍に増加した。サザンブロットでは、Tera-2においてc-mycの大きな再構成や増幅は認められなかった。
pmid-3327864.summary_en: The study measured c-myc mRNA during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of the pluripotent human teratoma cell line Tera-2 clone 13. With longer exposure, cell cycle duration increased until cells became effectively quiescent and expressed differentiation markers. Steady-state c-myc expression rose up to 1.6-fold relative to undifferentiated cells. Southern blotting showed no major rearrangement or amplification of the c-myc gene in Tera-2.

pmid-3443205.summary_ja: 13年間に眼窩類皮嚢腫の手術を受けた40例を検討している。3歳以降に発見された嚢腫は深部にあり、より大きかった。17歳以降に現れた類表皮嚢腫の多くは頭蓋内成分を伴っていた。組織学的には大半の嚢腫に漏出と炎症がみられた。嚢腫は徐々に増大し周囲組織に炎症と瘢痕を起こすため、全摘出が望ましいと著者らは述べている。
pmid-3443205.summary_en: Reviews 40 patients who underwent surgery for orbital dermoid cysts over 13 years. Cysts found after age three were deeper and larger, and epidermoid cysts appearing after age 17 often had an intracranial component. Most cysts showed leakage and inflammation on histology. The authors recommend total excision because the cysts enlarge gradually and cause inflammation and scarring in adjacent structures.

pmid-3569655.summary_ja: バッファローラット肝細胞の馴化培地に、マウス胎児性癌細胞および胚性幹細胞の自発的分化を抑える活性(DIA)があることを示した研究である。フィーダー細胞なしで未分化状態を維持できる可能性を示す。DIAは透析可能で酸に安定な、分子量約2〜3.5万の因子である。その作用はIGF-IIやTGF-βとは異なる。胎児性癌細胞は実験モデルとして用いられ、腫瘍の臨床的研究ではない。
pmid-3569655.summary_en: Buffalo rat liver (BRL) cell-conditioned medium is shown to prevent spontaneous differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cells, allowing feeder-free maintenance of undifferentiated cells. It also restricts embryoid body differentiation and partly inhibits retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The factor, DIA, is a dialysable, acid-stable molecule of 20–35 kDa, distinct from IGF-II and TGF-beta. EC cell lines are used as experimental models; the paper addresses stem cell culture biology rather than tumor clinical management.

pmid-3569663.summary_ja: H6胎児性癌細胞の凝集体において、ギャップ結合を介した代謝協同が起こるかを検討した基礎研究である。相補的な変異株を用い、3種の方法で相互供給を確認した。緩い凝集体より圧縮凝集体で、より大きなギャップ結合クラスターを介した供給が多いことを示した。腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、細胞の圧縮と分化に関する基礎生物学である。
pmid-3569663.summary_en: This study examines whether gap junctions in loose and compacted aggregates of H6 embryonal carcinoma (ECC) cells mediate metabolic cooperation. Using complementary mutant H6 cells and three crossfeeding assays (HAT medium, 6-thioguanine, and tritiated thymidine), the authors show that metabolic crossfeeding occurs through gap junctions in both aggregate types, and more extensively through larger gap junction clusters in compacted aggregates. The work is basic cell biology relating to compaction and differentiation.

pmid-3596087.summary_ja: 蛍光ラベルした胎児性癌細胞（ECa-247）をマウス胚盤胞に導入し、培養中の運命を追跡した研究。細胞は主に壁側栄養外胚葉に分布し、原始内胚葉には少数、内細胞塊にはまれにしか認められなかった。細胞は局在に応じて分化したことが電子顕微鏡で確認された。腫瘍生物学ではなく発生学の研究である。
pmid-3596087.summary_en: The authors injected or aggregated fluorescently labeled embryonal carcinoma (ECa-247) cells into mouse blastocysts and tracked them through culture. The cells localized mainly to mural trophectoderm, with fewer in primitive endoderm and rarely in the inner cell mass. Autoradiography and electron microscopy showed that the cancer-derived cells differentiated according to their position. The study addresses developmental fate of embryonal carcinoma cells rather than tumor biology or clinical care.

pmid-3624271.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを栄養膜細胞のモデルとして用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のαβサブユニットの会合機構を検討した基礎研究。βサブユニットの分子内ジスルフィド結合形成が二量体化の律速段階であり、正しく結合できないβ鎖は遊離型として分泌されると示唆された。
pmid-3624271.summary_en: Using the choriocarcinoma cell line JAR as a model of trophoblastic cells, the authors used pulse-chase labelling and immunoprecipitation to study how hCG alpha and beta subunits assemble. They identified a glycosylated beta-subunit precursor (pre-beta 1) that converts to a disulfide-bonded form able to bind the alpha subunit. Free beta subunits that fail to form correct disulfide bonds are secreted uncombined. The findings suggest that intramolecular disulfide bond formation in the beta subunit is the rate-limiting step in hCG dimer formation.

pmid-3664484.summary_ja: 奇形癌細胞株F9およびPC13を用いた基礎研究で、レチノイン酸が核内のcAMP依存性プロテインキナーゼに与える影響を検討した。レチノイン酸処理により両細胞で4時間以内に核内酵素活性とRI・RII調節サブユニットが急速に減少した。これは分化誘導の初期事象である可能性が示唆された。臨床的なGCTの治療を扱ったものではなく、胚性癌由来の細胞を用いた細胞モデル研究である。
pmid-3664484.summary_en: This basic cell biology study examined how retinoic acid affects cyclic AMP-dependent protein kinase in the nuclei of teratocarcinoma cell lines F9 and PC13. In both cell types, retinoic acid rapidly reduced nuclear PKA activity and the regulatory RI and RII subunits within four hours, in association with differentiation to parietal or visceral endoderm. The authors propose that this early nuclear decrease may be an initiating event in retinoid-driven differentiation. The work uses embryonal carcinoma-derived cells as a model rather than addressing clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-3671567.summary_ja: 同一部位の皮下類皮嚢腫を伴う片側乳頭欠損症の症例報告である。嚢胞壁の組織所見から乳輪乳頭複合体由来が示唆された。先天性乳房欠損症候群を概説し、乳頭欠損と類皮嚢腫の合併は過去に報告がないとしている。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学や治療を扱ったものではなく、形成外科・先天異常の報告である。
pmid-3671567.summary_en: This report describes a case of unilateral athelia, absence of the nipple, accompanied by a subcutaneous dermoid cyst in the same region. The histology of the cyst wall suggests derivation from the nipple-areola complex. The authors review congenital breast absence syndromes and note that the combination of athelia with a dermoid cyst has not been reported before. The paper is a plastic surgery and congenital anomaly report rather than a study of germ cell tumor biology or treatment.

pmid-3678613.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4および1009では、ストレス下で熱ショックタンパク質HSP68の転写が活性化されなかった。この欠損はDNAメチル化やクロマチン構造では説明できず、in vitro分化後にはストレス誘導性を獲得した。転写活性化因子の欠如またはリプレッサーの存在が示唆された。
pmid-3678613.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines PCC4 and 1009 failed to induce heat shock protein HSP68 mRNA or transcription under stress, and a heterologous heat shock promoter was also not activated. The defect is not explained by DNA methylation or chromatin structure, but became stress-inducible after in vitro differentiation. The authors suggest these cells lack an activating transcription factor or contain a repressor, possibly resembling very early embryonic cells.

pmid-3680397.summary_ja: 未分化の胎児性癌幹細胞株(F9、PCC4、PC13、P19)と分化誘導した細胞を用い、膜アデニル酸シクラーゼのホルモン応答性の変化を検討した基礎研究。未分化EC細胞はカルシトニンに主に応答し、壁側内胚葉への分化ではパラトルモンへの感受性が現れ、臓側内胚葉への分化では両方の応答が消失した。これらの変化は初期分化のマーカーになりうると提案している。臨床的な腫瘍治療の知見は含まない。
pmid-3680397.summary_en: This in vitro study examines hormone responsiveness of membrane adenylate cyclase in embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cell lines (F9, PCC4, PC13, P19) and their differentiated derivatives. Undifferentiated EC cells respond mainly to calcitonin. Differentiation toward parietal endoderm shifts sensitivity toward parathyroid hormone, while differentiation toward visceral endoderm abolishes both responses. The authors propose these changes as markers of early differentiation. The work is developmental biology using teratocarcinoma-derived cells rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-37281862.summary_ja: 1987年の電子顕微鏡による研究で、B242g胎児性癌細胞がキメラ胚盤胞形成の過程でマウス正常胚に取り込まれる様子を検討した。胚細胞が胎児性癌細胞を覆い、凝集体の発生に伴い内部に取り込まれた。胎児性癌細胞は内部へ分離され、内部細胞塊に組み込まれると結論づけた。腫瘍の臨床的側面ではなく、発生モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-37281862.summary_en: This 1987 electron microscopy study examined how B242g embryonal carcinoma cells are incorporated into normal mouse embryos during chimeric blastocyst formation. Embryonic cells spread over the EC cells, which became internalized as aggregates developed. When a single blastomere of an 8-cell embryo was aggregated with EC cells, it engulfed them. The authors conclude that EC cells are segregated to inside positions and incorporated into the inner cell mass. The work uses EC cells as a developmental model rather than addressing tumor clinical aspects.

pmid-37282067.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、B242g胎児性癌細胞とマウス胚からキメラを作成する際に、凝集法と注入法の効率を比較した。妊娠中期の胎児と生後マウスでキメラ形成を評価した。注入法の方が凝集法よりも効率よくキメラが得られた。B242g細胞は胚由来奇形癌から単離された細胞株である。腫瘍生物学ではなく発生学的手法に焦点を当てた研究である。
pmid-37282067.summary_en: This 1987 study compared aggregation and injection methods for producing chimeras between B242g embryonal carcinoma cells and mouse embryos. Chimerism was assessed in midgestation conceptuses and live-born mice. Injection produced chimeras more efficiently than aggregation. The EC cell line was originally isolated from embryo-derived teratocarcinomas and was among five lines pre-selected for chimera competence. The work focuses on developmental methodology rather than tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-3323503.summary_ja: 過剰卵巣は稀な婦人科奇形で、1890年以降13例が報告されている。そのうち3例では異所性卵巣組織に腫瘍が生じていた。本報告は過剰卵巣に由来した良性腫瘍の2症例を扱う。抄録には腫瘍の組織型の記載がなく、胚細胞腫瘍(奇形腫など)に該当するかは本文の確認が必要である。
pmid-3323503.summary_en: Supernumerary ovary is a rare gynecologic anomaly, with 13 cases reported since 1890. Three previous cases were associated with tumors arising in ectopic ovarian tissue. This report describes two cases of benign neoplasms that originated in supernumerary ovaries. The abstract does not specify the histologic types of these tumors, so whether they are germ cell tumors such as teratomas cannot be determined from the abstract alone.

pmid-3325192.summary_ja: 胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)のアイソザイム腫瘍マーカーとしての臨床的・生物学的意義を概説した総説である。現在の最大の有用性はセミノーマと卵巣癌にあると述べている。モノクローナル抗体による解析やPLAP遺伝子のクローニングにより、PLAPとPLAP様アイソザイムは異なる遺伝子にコードされると示唆される。
pmid-3325192.summary_en: This review traces the clinical and biological significance of placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as an isozyme tumor marker. It notes that the isozyme was first linked to lung cancer and that PLAP currently has its greatest utility in seminoma and ovarian cancer. Monoclonal antibody studies and cloning of the PLAP gene suggest that PLAP and PLAP-like isozymes are coded by different genes. The abstract is truncated.

pmid-2416888.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法中に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇した2例を報告している。両例とも肝機能障害があり、1例はB型肝炎の再活性化を伴った。腫瘍は著明に縮小していたため化学療法を中止し、肝機能の回復とともにAFPは正常化した。15か月および17か月の無病生存が確認され、治療中のAFP上昇は必ずしも腫瘍進行を示さないと結論づけている。
pmid-2416888.summary_en: The authors report two patients with advanced seminoma who developed substantial rises in serum AFP during chemotherapy. Both had hepatic dysfunction, and one had reactivation of hepatitis B. Despite the elevated AFP, marked tumor regression had occurred, so chemotherapy was stopped. AFP returned to normal as liver function recovered, and both patients remained disease-free for 15 and 17 months. The report shows that AFP elevation during treatment does not always indicate tumor progression, particularly when liver injury is present.

pmid-2417687.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマの3例を報告し、前立腺、腎臓、腰椎への転移・再発を示している。このような非典型的な部位への再発は、化学療法後の残存病変の管理に影響するため、その治療上の意義を論じている。日常的なフォローアップで見落とされうるため、臨床医はこれらの部位を認識しておくべきであることを示唆する。
pmid-2417687.summary_en: The authors present three patients with advanced seminoma whose disease metastasized to uncommon sites: the prostate, the kidney, and a lumbar vertebra. These atypical sites are relevant to the management of residual lesions after chemotherapy. The report discusses how such unusual metastases should influence decisions about residual mass evaluation and further treatment. Because these sites may be overlooked during routine follow-up, clinicians should be aware of them. The brief case series offers practical considerations for clinicians managing residual seminoma.

pmid-2417919.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告している。治療後に血清AFPは正常化したが、セカンドルック手術で顕微鏡的なリンパ節転移が見つかり、その後AFPが上昇して患者は死亡した。卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFPを産生しないことがあるため、リンパ節生検を伴うセカンドルック手術が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2417919.summary_en: This paper reports a patient with a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary containing endodermal sinus tumor. Serum AFP normalized after treatment, yet second-look surgery revealed microscopic lymph node metastases. The disease later progressed with rising AFP, and the patient died. The authors argue that second-look surgery with lymph node sampling is necessary, because endodermal sinus tumor may not always produce AFP, small tumor volumes may not elevate it, and some malignant elements are detectable only histologically. They suggest that further therapy might achieve cure if microscopic disease is treated.

pmid-2418789.summary_ja: 男性泌尿生殖器腫瘍の治療選択を病態生理学的観点から論じた総説で、精巣がんではセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に分けて放射線療法、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の位置づけを整理している。前立腺がんの病期別治療や陰茎がんへのブレオマイシン併用療法にも言及している。
pmid-2418789.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese review discusses treatment selection for male urogenital tumors from a pathophysiological standpoint. For testicular cancer, it contrasts radiotherapy for seminoma with chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, and it reports complete response rates of 70 to 90 percent. It also covers stage-based management of prostate cancer and bleomycin-based treatment of penile cancer.

pmid-2419524.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法反応に関する予後因子を、南東部がん研究グループの無作為化試験180例で検討した。インディアナ病期分類はMDアンダーソン分類より予後予測能に優れ、進行群では腫瘍マーカーの上昇数がさらに予後を層別化した。後続の試験で前向きに検証された。
pmid-2419524.summary_en: This 1986 study of 180 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors, from a Southeastern Cancer Study Group randomized trial, identified prognostic factors for favorable response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The Indiana staging system proved more prognostic than the MD Anderson system, separating patients into minimal, moderate, and advanced disease groups with favorable response rates of 99, 90, and 58 percent. Elevated tumor markers further stratified the advanced group, and the Indiana system was prospectively validated in a later trial.

pmid-2419526.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2を用いた基礎研究で、未分化細胞は主にサイトケラチンを発現し、レチノイン酸処理により3種類の神経フィラメントが誘導されることを示した。2週間後には神経フィラメント陽性細胞の多くがサイトケラチンを失い、神経様形態を示した。
pmid-2419526.summary_en: This 1986 basic study examined intermediate filament expression in NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells and in neurons derived from them by retinoic acid treatment. Undifferentiated cells expressed mainly cytokeratin, while neurofilament proteins appeared after retinoic acid exposure. Over two weeks, neurofilament-positive cells lost cytokeratin and acquired neuronal morphology, indicating that all three neurofilament subunits are induced during neuronal differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2419537.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍34例の検討で、臨床病期I卵黄嚢腫瘍は精巣摘除術とAFP監視による保存的管理が有効であることを示した。3年生存率は96%、無再発生存率は84%で、化学療法の有無による差はなかった。再発はAFP上昇で検出でき、厳格なフォローアップが重要とされた。
pmid-2419537.summary_en: This study of 34 children with testicular malignant germ cell tumors evaluated conservative management of clinical stage I yolk sac tumor after orchiectomy alone, with serial AFP monitoring. Three-year survival was 96 percent and relapse-free survival 84 percent, with no difference between patients who received adjuvant chemotherapy and those who did not. The authors conclude that most patients can avoid lymphadenectomy and chemotherapy, and that relapse detected by rising AFP is curable with strict follow-up.

pmid-2420062.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の形態学的・免疫組織化学的所見をヒト胚発生と比較し、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の多様なパターンの組織発生を検討した。腫瘍成分を胚発生の段階に対応させ、胚学的用語による命名を提案したが、新たな分類体系としての採用は推奨していない。
pmid-2420062.summary_en: This histogenetic study compares morphology and immunohistochemistry of human testicular germ cell tumors with normal human embryonic development. The authors propose that various embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor patterns correspond to stages of embryonic and extraembryonic differentiation, and can be arranged in embryological order. They suggest embryological terminology for tumor components, while noting that this is not recommended as a replacement classification system.

pmid-2420222.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を有する胚細胞腫瘍50例を検討し、肝様分化（22%）、腸管様腺管（34%）、壁側卵黄嚢構造（92%）を報告した。これらの所見は胎児性癌やジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）ではほとんど認められず、卵黄嚢腫瘍の鑑別に有用と考えられた。
pmid-2420222.summary_en: This morphologic study of 50 germ cell tumors with yolk sac tumor components describes hepatic-like, enteric-like, and parietal yolk sac differentiation. Hepatoid areas were found in 22 percent, enteric glands in 34 percent, and parietal yolk sac structures in 92 percent. These features were largely absent in embryonal carcinomas and germinomas, so the authors propose them as aids in distinguishing yolk sac tumors from those entities.

pmid-2420281.summary_ja: AFP産生ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍を標的とした抗AFP抗体-アルブミン-マイトマイシンC結合体の前臨床研究。in vitroでは遊離薬剤より21～38倍強い細胞傷害性を示し、ヌードマウスでも遊離薬剤より強く初期の腫瘍増殖を抑制した。
pmid-2420281.summary_en: This 1986 preclinical study conjugated mitomycin C to an anti-alpha-fetoprotein antibody via human serum albumin and tested it against AFP-producing human yolk sac tumor. In vitro, the conjugate was 21 to 38 times more cytotoxic than free drug or PBS. In nude mice bearing the tumor, it retarded early tumor growth at doses where free mitomycin C had only slight effects, suggesting that targeted antibody conjugates may improve efficacy.

pmid-2420282.summary_ja: 38歳男性の右精巣胎児性癌（肺転移あり）の症例報告。精巣摘除後、シスプラチンなどの併用化学療法で縮小したが病巣が残存したため、エトポシド投与により肺転移が完全寛解した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清後、2年4か月再発はない。
pmid-2420282.summary_en: This 1986 case report describes a 38-year-old man with embryonal carcinoma of the right testis and multiple pulmonary metastases, with elevated AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH. After orchiectomy and initial combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, vincristine, and peplomycin, residual lung lesions persisted. Etoposide given in repeated courses produced complete remission of the metastases, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, with no recurrence after 2 years and 4 months.

pmid-2421530.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌5例の病理研究で、血清AFPは高値だが典型的な卵黄嚢腫瘍の所見を示さない例に注目した。卵黄嚢の内胚葉細胞に似た細胞が、AFP陽性の好酸性硝子様小体を含むことを示した。電子顕微鏡では卵黄嚢腫瘍の構造に似た基底膜様物質が認められた。AFPの免疫染色は卵黄様成分の検出と予後推定に有用とされる。
pmid-2421530.summary_en: A 1986 Japanese pathology study of five testicular embryonal carcinomas with elevated serum AFP but no classic yolk sac tumor features. Distinct cells resembling human yolk sac endodermal cells contained PAS-positive hyaline globules that were AFP-positive. Similar AFP-positive cells appeared in embryoid bodies. Electron microscopy showed basement membrane-like material resembling yolk sac tumor organoid structures. The authors propose that a vitelline component within these tumors explains the elevated AFP, and that AFP immunostaining may help predict patient survival.

pmid-2421864.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移10例に対し、高用量メトトレキサートと髄注を含む逐次併用化学療法を施行した。10例中8例が無病で生存し、5例は18か月以上寛解を維持した。原発性頭蓋内非セミノーマ例2例も同様に治療され、1例は死亡、1例は無病生存した。化学療法が手術や放射線療法より優先されるとの結論である。
pmid-2421864.summary_en: A 1986 Cancer report describes ten patients with brain metastases from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, treated with sequential combination chemotherapy including high-dose methotrexate and intrathecal methotrexate. Eight of ten were alive without active disease, and five had been in remission for more than 18 months. Two primary intracranial nonseminomatous germ cell tumors were also treated; one patient died and the other remained disease-free. The authors conclude that chemotherapy is preferred over surgery or radiotherapy for primary or metastatic germ cell tumors of the brain.

pmid-2422801.summary_ja: 絨毛癌7例と胞状奇胎8例の計15例で甲状腺機能を測定し、健常妊婦と比較した。遊離T3・T4の上昇は少数にとどまり、β-hCGが陰性化すると正常化した。甲状腺機能低下症は1例のみであった。TBG以外に対照群との有意差は乏しく、ホルモン値はhCGのパターンと相関した。
pmid-2422801.summary_en: This study evaluated thyroid function in 15 women with gestational trophoblastic tumors (7 choriocarcinoma, 8 hydatidiform mole) by measuring free T3, free T4, TBG, TSH, and the TRH test response, compared with healthy pregnant controls. Thyroid hormones were elevated in only a small minority and normalized when beta-hCG became undetectable. One patient was hypothyroid. Differences from controls were minimal except for TBG, and hormone levels correlated with the hCG pattern.

pmid-2423223.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の境界的組織像を示す腫瘍を、ヌードマウスで20継代以上異種移植として維持した。セミノーマ様の硬い成分はマーカーを産生しなかったが、胎児性癌様の軟らかい成分は初期継代でβ-hCGとAFPを分泌した。染色体解析とフローサイトメトリーにより、両成分は遺伝的に異なるが共通の起源を持つと示された。
pmid-2423223.summary_en: This study characterized a human testicular germ cell tumor with borderline histology between seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor. Serum beta-hCG and AFP were normal, yet the xenografted soft component secreted both markers during early passages, while the firm seminoma-like component did not. Chromosomal and flow cytometric analyses revealed genetic differences between the stable variants, which share similar marker chromosomes suggesting a common origin.

pmid-2423336.summary_ja: ステージIIIの精巣腫瘍患者28例を解析し、診断と化学療法の遅延の影響を検討した。症状から診断までの期間と病変の進展度には有意な関連があった。症状出現から6か月以内に治療を開始した群の完全奏効率は67%、それ以上遅れた群では16%であった。遅延を減らすため、精巣自己検診の啓発が重要とされている。
pmid-2423336.summary_en: Twenty-eight patients with stage III testicular tumors were analyzed to determine how diagnostic and treatment delay affected disease extent, chemotherapy response, and prognosis. Disease extent correlated significantly with the symptom-to-diagnosis interval. Complete response was 67% when treatment began within six months of symptoms but only 16% after longer delays. The authors recommend testicular self-examination education to reduce delay.

pmid-2423374.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の患者40例に、Einhorn法を改変したシスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチンの化学療法を施行した。残存腫瘤を切除した14例中、活動性腫瘍が残ったのは2例のみであった。無病生存率は2年で85%、5年で77%であった。2年以降に再発が認められたため、長期のフォローアップが必要と結論された。
pmid-2423374.summary_en: Forty patients with metastatic testicular teratoma were treated with a modified Einhorn regimen of cisplatin, bleomycin, and vinblastine. Most achieved complete response, and only 2 of 14 patients with resected residual masses had active tumor. Two-year disease-free survival was 85%, falling to 77% at five years after late relapses at 34 to 37 months. Long-term follow-up is needed because relapses occur beyond two years.

pmid-2423499.summary_ja: 胎児性癌のモデルであるF9奇形癌細胞の分化に影響する条件を検討した。培養下の細胞は分化能が低下し、レチノイン酸によるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生も減少したが、腫瘍として継代すると反応が回復した。極低濃度のジブチリル環状AMPを添加すると、臓側内胚葉への分化が促進された。
pmid-2423499.summary_en: This study examined conditions affecting differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma. Cultured cells showed reduced differentiation capacity and decreased AFP production with retinoic acid, but responses were restored after passage as tumors. Adding low-dose dibutyryl cyclic AMP enhanced differentiation toward visceral endoderm. The work addresses the cellular biology of a germ-cell-derived tumor model.

pmid-2423708.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法後、残存奇形腫を切除された51例を検討した。61%は無再発で、胚細胞以外の成分を伴う未熟奇形腫、腫瘍量、縦隔原発が再発因子となった。多変量解析では縦隔原発が最大の不良因子であった。完全切除が最も有効で、高リスク例では慎重なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-2423708.summary_en: Fifty-one patients underwent resection of teratoma after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Relapse occurred in 20 patients. Immature teratoma with nongerm cell elements, large tumor burden, and mediastinal primary site predicted relapse, and mediastinal primary was the strongest adverse factor on multivariate analysis. Complete surgical excision remains the most effective treatment, with close follow-up recommended for high-risk patients.

pmid-2424104.summary_ja: 巨大な腹部性腺外セミノーマを有する41歳男性の症例報告である。唯一機能していた腎は水腎症を呈し、クレアチニンクリアランスは55 ml/minであった。シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を施行した。46か月のフォローアップ時点で腎機能は改善し、活動性疾患は認められなかった。
pmid-2424104.summary_en: A 41-year-old man presented with a massive abdominal extragonadal seminoma and hydronephrosis of his only functioning kidney, with creatinine clearance of 55 ml/min. He received cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. At 46 months of follow-up, renal function had improved and there was no evidence of active disease. The report documents successful systemic treatment despite compromised renal function.

pmid-2424170.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍170例を組織学的・免疫組織化学的に検討した報告である。悪性例の約67%が卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を有し、AFP陽性はほとんどの卵黄嚢腫瘍で確認された。卵黄嚢腫瘍51例の追跡では72.5%が無病生存で、多剤化学療法と手術の有効性が示された。
pmid-2424170.summary_en: This 1986 series reviewed 170 pediatric and adolescent germ cell tumors by light microscopy and immunohistochemistry. Half were malignant, and two-thirds of malignant cases had a yolk sac tumor component. Mature and immature teratomas, germinomas, and mixed tumors were characterized by location, age, and histology, with AFP demonstrated in most yolk sac tumors. Follow-up of 51 yolk sac tumor cases showed 72.5% disease-free survival, attributed to modern polychemotherapy combined with surgery.

pmid-2424354.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性4例が、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に心筋梗塞2例と脳血管障害2例を発症した報告である。全例30歳未満で動脈硬化の危険因子を有さず、血管造影を施行した3例では血管内の異常は認められなかった。化学療法が重篤な動脈閉塞イベントを誘発しうる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2424354.summary_en: This 1986 report describes four young men with testicular germ cell tumors who suffered acute arterial ischemic events, including two myocardial infarctions and two cerebrovascular accidents, after cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. All lacked conventional atherosclerotic risk factors, and angiography in three showed no endovascular abnormality. One patient had Raynaud's phenomenon preceding infarction with ergonovine-induced coronary spasm. The authors propose that cisplatin-based chemotherapy may provoke major arterial occlusive events.

pmid-2424586.summary_ja: 腎移植患者に発生した精巣の胎児性癌の症例報告である。後腹膜と肺に転移を有し、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる導入化学療法を施行した。移植腎を障害せず、1985年6月まで無病生存を維持した。白金製剤を用いた化学療法は移植患者にも安全に行え、転移性精巣がんの治癒に寄与しうると結論づけている。
pmid-2424586.summary_en: A 1986 case report describes a renal transplant recipient with primary testicular embryonal carcinoma that metastasized to the retroperitoneum and lungs. Induction chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin was delivered without damage to the transplanted kidney. The patient remained disease-free through June 1985 with the graft preserved, showing that platinum-based chemotherapy can be given safely to transplant recipients and can cure metastatic testicular cancer.

pmid-2424598.summary_ja: AFP産生ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍を対象に、抗AFP抗体とダウノルビシンをデキストランで結合させた複合体の効果を検討した前臨床研究である。in vitroで遊離薬剤の約2倍の細胞傷害性を示し、ヌードマウスでは有意な腫瘍増殖抑制を認めた。複合体はAFP産生腫瘍細胞に優先的に集積すると考えられた。
pmid-2424598.summary_en: This 1986 preclinical study tested an antibody-daunorubicin conjugate directed against AFP, built with a dextran bridge, on AFP-producing human yolk sac tumor cells. In vitro, the conjugate was twice as cytotoxic as free daunorubicin. In nude mice bearing the tumor, the conjugate significantly slowed tumor growth, while free anti-AFP antibody had little effect and high-dose free drug caused toxic deaths. The findings suggest preferential accumulation of the conjugate in AFP-producing tumor cells.

pmid-2424777.summary_ja: 奇形癌(胎児性癌)幹細胞株P19S1801A1をDMSOで分化誘導し、c-fos発現を解析した基礎研究である。c-fos発現は内胚葉分化マーカーAFPとほぼ同時期にピークに達した。一方、AFP陽性細胞はごく少数であり、c-fosは分化一般と相関するが内胚葉形成に特異的ではないと結論された。
pmid-2424777.summary_en: This 1986 study examined c-fos expression during dimethylsulfoxide-induced differentiation of the P19S1801A1 embryonal carcinoma stem cell line. c-fos expression rose sharply and peaked around day 12 of aggregate culture, near the peak of AFP, a visceral endoderm marker. However, most differentiated cells expressed c-fos while only a small minority expressed AFP. The authors conclude c-fos correlates with teratocarcinoma differentiation but is not specific to visceral endoderm formation.

pmid-2424862.summary_ja: 1979年から1984年に治療された病期III精巣腫瘍患者29例を対象に、診断と化学療法の遅延と予後の関係を解析した。症状出現から6か月以内に治療を開始した群の完全奏効率は40%、6か月を超えた群は26.3%であった。遅延は治療反応性を低下させる可能性があり、精巣の自己検査に関する健康教育が重要と結論された。
pmid-2424862.summary_en: This study analyzed 29 patients with stage III testicular tumors treated between 1979 and 1984, examining how delays in diagnosis and chemotherapy related to outcome. Complete response was 40% when treatment began within six months of symptom onset and 26.3% when delayed longer. The authors conclude that delay may reduce response to treatment and that public health education on testicular self-examination can help minimize delays.

pmid-2425060.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣摘除術後に経過観察を行った臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍126例を対象としています。28%が再発し、組織型とリンパ管侵襲が独立した再発予測因子でした。高リスク例を選別し、補助化学療法の適応を検討する根拠となると述べています。
pmid-2425060.summary_en: This 1986 study followed 126 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors managed by orchiectomy and surveillance. Relapse occurred in 28%. Univariate analysis linked vascular invasion, lymphatic invasion, histology, and epididymal or rete testis involvement to relapse, but multivariate analysis identified only histology and lymphatic invasion as independent predictors. The authors suggest these factors may identify high-risk patients who could benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-2425069.summary_ja: 1960年から1984年に治療された小児奇形腫142例を解析した報告です。悪性は28%で、AFP上昇は全ての悪性例で認められ再発の指標となりました。良性例は完全切除で97%が生存しました。非精巣性悪性例の生存率は32%と低く、切除可能例で手術後に多剤化学療法を行うと生存率が100%となりました。
pmid-2425069.summary_en: This 1986 review analyzed 142 infants and children with teratomas treated from 1960 to 1984. Sites included sacrococcygeal, ovarian, testicular, and mediastinal. Malignancy occurred in 28%. Elevated AFP was seen in all malignant cases and was a useful marker of recurrence; hCG was helpful mainly in teenage boys with testicular lesions. Benign tumors had 97% survival with excision. Survival of nontesticular malignancies was only 32%, improving to 100% in resectable cases when multiagent chemotherapy followed surgery.

pmid-2426072.summary_ja: 1980年代の精巣がん治療の進歩を総説したものです。進歩の要因として、腫瘍マーカーによる病勢と治療効果の評価、CTによる転移巣の精密な局在診断、効果的な強力化学療法の確立が挙げられています。完全奏効が得られない症例や化学療法の毒性軽減が依然として課題であると述べています。
pmid-2426072.summary_en: This 1986 review summarizes advances in testicular cancer management over the preceding decade. Three factors are credited: widespread use of tumor markers to monitor disease and response, CT scanning for precise localization of metastases, and development of effective intensive chemotherapy with better understanding of its toxicity. The authors note that patients who fail to respond completely still pose problems, and that reducing chemotherapy toxicity while maintaining efficacy remains an important goal.

pmid-2426092.summary_ja: 正常初期胎盤と絨毛癌の組織片を培養し、プロゲステロンがhCG産生に与える影響を検討しました。正常胎盤ではhCGのα・βサブユニットmRNAとhCG分泌が減少しましたが、絨毛癌では変化がみられませんでした。正常栄養膜細胞と悪性化した細胞でhCG調節機構が異なることを示唆しています。
pmid-2426092.summary_en: This 1986 study cultured explants of normal early placenta and choriocarcinoma and tested the effect of progesterone on hCG production. In normal placenta, progesterone decreased hCG alpha and beta mRNA levels and reduced hCG secretion, without affecting hPL. Choriocarcinoma tissue did not respond to progesterone, suggesting that hCG regulation differs between normal trophoblast and malignant trophoblast. The findings indicate that progesterone selectively suppresses hCG in normal placenta but not in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2426151.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株HT-H1の栄養膜様分化を検討した1986年の報告です。付着速度の異なる2亜集団のうち、速く付着する細胞のみがプロゲステロンを産生し、hCGを多く分泌しました。細胞株は栄養膜、胎盤、胚外内胚葉に類似した特徴を持つとしています。
pmid-2426151.summary_en: This 1986 study examined trophoblastic differentiation in the human teratocarcinoma cell line HT-H1. Cells separated into fast and slow adhering subpopulations, and fast adhering cells alone produced progesterone and secreted most hCG. Aggregates and cystic bodies did not secrete hCG. The authors conclude that HT-H1 shares features with trophoblast, placenta, and extraembryonic endoderm, and that fast adhering cells resemble syncytiotrophoblast.

pmid-2426374.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍患者の血清CA125、CEA、AFP、LDHおよびLDHアイソザイムを組織型別に解析しました。AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍でのみ陽性、LDHはディスジャーミノーマなどの充実性胚細胞腫瘍で著明に上昇しました。各マーカーを組み合わせることで、術前の組織型診断に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-2426374.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study measured serum CA125, CEA, AFP, LDH and LDH isoenzymes in ovarian tumor patients and compared them with histologic types. CA125 was useful for non-mucinous epithelial carcinoma, CEA for mucinous tumors and Krukenberg tumors, and AFP was positive only in endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors. LDH was markedly elevated in dysgerminoma and other solid germ cell tumors, with H-subunit-dominant isoenzyme patterns. Combined markers may aid preoperative histologic diagnosis.

pmid-2426376.summary_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌41例を臨床病期別に解析した1986年の報告です。病期Iは病期IIIより予後が良好で、混合型は純粋型より生存曲線が良好でした。1979～1985年の治療群では、VAC療法と2年間の維持療法、大網切除やセカンドルック手術などにより成績が向上しました。AFPの経時的測定は病勢を反映し、再発は術後約15週頃に多くみられました。
pmid-2426376.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese clinical study analyzed 41 cases of ovarian embryonal carcinoma by stage. Survival was better in stage I than in stages II or III, and mixed-type tumors had better survival than pure embryonal carcinoma. Outcomes improved in the 1979-1985 cohort, attributed to VAC chemotherapy with two years of maintenance and surgical refinements such as omentectomy and second-look operation. Serial AFP measurements reflected disease course, with relapse often appearing around 15 weeks after surgery.

pmid-2426419.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの進行例214例を対象に、PVB療法におけるビンブラスチン高用量(0.4mg/kg)と低用量(0.3mg/kg)を比較したEORTCの無作為化試験。完全奏効率は同等(68%対71%)で、生存期間に差はなかった。低用量では白血球減少と粘膜炎が有意に少なく、同等の効果でより低毒性であると結論づけられた。
pmid-2426419.summary_en: This EORTC Genitourinary Group randomized trial compared high-dose (0.4 mg/kg/cycle) and low-dose (0.3 mg/kg/cycle) vinblastine within cisplatin-vinblastine-bleomycin (PVB) induction chemotherapy for 214 patients with disseminated non-seminomatous testicular cancer. Complete response rates were similar (68% vs 71%), with no difference in disease-free or overall survival. Low-dose vinblastine caused significantly fewer severe leukopenias and less mucositis. Tumor volume was the major prognostic factor. The authors concluded that the lower dose is as effective and less toxic.

pmid-2426475.summary_ja: ブレオマイシンによるびまん性肺線維症が、精巣がんの肺転移と見誤られる結節性病変を形成した症例を報告。ブレオマイシンは転移性精巣がんの併用療法で重要だが、肺毒性は不可逆的または致死的となりうる。治療中の結節性肺病変を転移と即断せず、薬剤毒性も考慮すべきであることを示す。
pmid-2426475.summary_en: The authors report a patient in whom bleomycin-induced diffuse pulmonary fibrosis produced discrete nodular lesions that mimicked pulmonary metastases of testicular cancer. Bleomycin is an important component of combination chemotherapy for metastatic testis carcinoma, and its pulmonary toxicity can be irreversible or fatal. The paper discusses the clinical, radiographic, and histopathological patterns of bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity. The case highlights the diagnostic pitfall of attributing nodular lung lesions in treated testicular cancer patients to metastasis without considering drug toxicity.

pmid-2426638.summary_ja: 56例の部分奇胎を核型解析し、臨床病理学的特徴を検討した。47例は三倍体、9例は二倍体であり、二倍体のうち2例は遺伝学的解析で正常と判明した。三倍体では限局的な栄養膜過形成と間質内封入像が認められ、二倍体では認められなかった。追跡では、いずれも侵入奇胎や絨毛癌に進展せず、核型にかかわらず悪性転化の可能性は低いことが示された。
pmid-2426638.summary_en: This study karyotyped 56 partial moles from 55 patients and analyzed their clinicopathologic features. Most (47) were triploid, while nine were diploid, and two of the diploid moles were found to be normal by genetic analysis. Triploid moles showed focal trophoblastic hyperplasia with stromal inclusions, whereas diploid moles lacked these features. During follow-up, none progressed to invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, indicating that partial moles generally have a low malignant potential regardless of karyotype.

pmid-2426642.summary_ja: 合胞体栄養膜様の巨細胞を欠く純粋な卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の1例を報告。腫瘍はhCGを産生しており、免疫細胞化学的検査で、hCGはジャーミノーマ細胞の細胞質に局在していた。hCGの産生源が腫瘍細胞そのものであることを示唆し、腫瘍マーカーの解釈に示唆を与える。
pmid-2426642.summary_en: A case of pure ovarian dysgerminoma is reported in which the tumor contained no syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells yet produced human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). Immunocytochemistry localized hCG to the cytoplasm of the germinoma cells themselves, suggesting that the neoplastic cells are the source of hCG production rather than syncytiotrophoblastic components. The finding indicates that dysgerminoma cells can produce hCG without giant cells, which is relevant to tumor marker interpretation.

pmid-2426730.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を免疫組織化学的に検出した。AFPは混合型胚細胞腫瘍の卵黄嚢成分に認められ、胎児性癌では個々の細胞や管状構造に陽性であった。未熟奇形腫の原始嚢胞や腸管様上皮にも陽性所見がみられた。これらの所見は胎児性癌細胞の全能性を支持すると著者らは考察している。
pmid-2426730.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to localize alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in testicular germ cell tumors. AFP was seen in the yolk sac components of combined tumors and in single cells of embryonal carcinoma within solid masses and tubular patterns. Embryoid bodies in polyembryoma and combined tumors also stained, and immature teratomas showed AFP in primitive cysts and gut-like epithelium, probably of entodermal origin. The authors interpret these findings as supporting the totipotency of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2426851.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の若年女性が、ビンブラスチン・シスプラチンとの3剤併用療法でブレオマイシンを投与された後にスティーブンス・ジョンソン症候群を発症した。皮膚症状は制御されたが、その後ブレオマイシンによる肺線維症で急速に呼吸不全が進行し死亡した。胚細胞腫瘍の主要薬剤であるブレオマイシンの重篤な副作用に注意が必要である。
pmid-2426851.summary_en: A young girl with an ovarian immature teratoma developed Stevens-Johnson syndrome after receiving bleomycin in a three-drug regimen with vinblastine and cisplatin. Dermatologic toxicity was controlled, but rapidly progressive respiratory insufficiency from bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis followed and led to the patient's death. The report underscores that bleomycin, a key agent in germ cell tumor regimens, can cause severe mucocutaneous toxicity and fatal pulmonary toxicity, and highlights the need for vigilance during treatment.

pmid-2426944.summary_ja: 進行した混合型胚細胞腫瘍の100例にCISCAII/VBIVの周期的化学療法を行った。89%が持続的無病状態を達成し、探索的手術を受けた32例では生存腫瘍は認められなかった。血清hCGβサブユニット高値が最も強い予後因子であった。PVB療法より優れており、特に高リスク例で有用と結論されている。
pmid-2426944.summary_en: This report describes 100 patients with advanced mixed germ cell tumors treated with cyclic CISCAII/VBIV chemotherapy. The regimen achieved 89% continuous disease-free status, and 32 patients who underwent exploratory surgery after two courses showed no viable cancer. High serum beta-hCG was the strongest prognostic factor, followed by Samuels staging and extragonadal origin. Toxicity was substantial, with frequent leukopenic fever, but long-term complications were uncommon. The authors conclude that CISCAII/VBIV is superior to PVB, particularly for high-risk patients.

pmid-2426948.summary_ja: 混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌・セミノーマ)の転移に対して化学療法を終えた後、難治性の前部ぶどう膜炎を発症した29歳男性の症例。前房穿刺を2回行ったが転移細胞は確認できなかった。2回目の穿刺液でhCGβサブユニットを測定し、眼内転移の診断を確定した。細胞診で診断できない場合に、眼内液の腫瘍マーカーが有用であることを示す。
pmid-2426948.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with anterior uveitis unresponsive to therapy had recently completed chemotherapy for metastatic mixed germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma and seminoma). Two anterior chamber paracenteses were nondiagnostic for metastatic cells. At the second procedure, the tumor marker hCG-beta subunit was measured in the aqueous humor and used to confirm intraocular metastasis. The case shows that serologic tumor markers in ocular fluid can aid diagnosis when cytology fails.

pmid-2427033.summary_ja: 進行した胚細胞腫瘍の2例。28歳男性は腹痛と上昇したhCGを伴い、後腹膜腫瘤を認めセミノーマと診断され、CDDP・VLB・PEPの3コースと放射線療法で寛解した。21歳男性は縦隔腫瘤とAFP高値を呈し、放射線療法、外科的切除、化学療法を施行後、肺再発に対し救援化学療法を行い、いずれも再発なく経過している。
pmid-2427033.summary_en: Two patients with advanced germ cell tumors achieved complete remission with intensive multimodal treatment. The first, a 28-year-old man presenting with abdominal pain and elevated hCG, had large retroperitoneal masses diagnosed as seminoma and was treated with three courses of CDDP, VLB, and PEP followed by radiotherapy. The second, a 21-year-old student with a mediastinal mass and elevated AFP, received radiotherapy, surgical resection, and chemotherapy, then salvage chemotherapy with CDDP, ADR, PEP, and etoposide for lung recurrence. Both remain disease-free after 12 and 4 months.

pmid-2427047.summary_ja: 精巣がんのマーカーとして妊娠関連血漿タンパクA(PAPP-A)の有用性を検討した研究である。PAPP-Aは一部の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でのみ上昇したが、正常値との重なりが大きく臨床的意義は限定的であった。精巣摘除または前立腺摘除後には正常男性と同程度まで低下し、疾患のない男性におけるPAPP-Aの産生源は精巣や前立腺ではないと考察された。
pmid-2427047.summary_en: This study examined whether circulating pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A (PAPP-A) could serve as a marker for testicular cancer in men with testicular and prostatic tumors. PAPP-A was elevated only in certain nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, but its values overlapped substantially with normal ranges, limiting clinical significance. After orchidectomy or prostatectomy, levels fell to those of normal men. The authors concluded that some nonseminomatous tumors produce PAPP-A, but in disease-free men its source is probably not the testis or prostate.

pmid-2427186.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対しシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンの併用化学療法を行った後に残存した後腹膜腫瘍を検討した研究である。残存腫瘍の多くは壊死や線維化のみであったが、原発腫瘍に奇形腫成分があった場合は約半数で成熟奇形腫が認められた。原発腫瘍の組織像が残存腫瘍の性状を予測することを示し、残存腫瘍の切除方針を考える上での示唆を与えている。
pmid-2427186.summary_en: This Groningen series of 25 patients with stage IIB/IIC nonseminomatous testicular tumors, treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin plus surgery, examined residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy. One patient died during treatment; the other 24 underwent laparotomy and were alive at a mean of 56 months. Residual masses were mostly necrosis or fibrosis, while mature teratoma was found in half of the residual masses when the primary tumor contained a teratoma component. Histology of the primary tumor thus predicted the nature of residual disease.

pmid-2427625.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患のフォローアップに用いるhCG-β CTP測定用の酵素免疫測定法(EIA)を開発し評価した研究である。血清hCG検出感度は0.2 mIU/mLで、既存のhCG-β RIAとよく相関し、LHやFSHとの交差反応は小さかった。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の管理で赤血球凝集法やRIAより高感度であり、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性が示された。
pmid-2427625.summary_en: This study developed an enzyme immunoassay for hCG-beta CTP, a carboxyl-terminal region of hCG-beta, and evaluated it in trophoblastic disease. The assay detected serum hCG at 0.2 mIU/mL, correlated well with the existing hCG-beta RIA, and showed minimal cross-reactivity with LH and FSH. It was applied to hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, and was roughly 25-fold more sensitive than hemagglutination and 10-fold more sensitive than hCG-beta RIA, supporting its utility for monitoring.

pmid-2427755.summary_ja: 血清hCGが著明に高値を示した50歳男性の未分化膵癌の症例報告である。癌巣内の合胞体栄養膜様細胞がhCGを強く発現し、一部の単核癌細胞でも陽性であった。絨毛癌様形態を伴う膵癌による異所性hCG産生を示し、絨毛癌が既存の癌から生じるとするレトロディファレンシエーション説を支持すると考察している。
pmid-2427755.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man with undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma and markedly elevated serum hCG. Syncytiotrophoblast-like tumor cells were scattered within the carcinoma and stained diffusely for hCG, with positivity also in a few mononuclear cancer cells. The findings indicate ectopic hCG production by a pancreatic carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous features. The authors suggest this supports the retrodifferentiation theory, in which choriocarcinoma arises from preexisting carcinoma through metaplastic proliferation.

pmid-2428154.summary_ja: 全身化学療法中に腹部腫瘍が嚢胞性に増大した奇形癌患者の症例報告である。嚢胞液では腫瘍マーカーが陽性で血清では陰性であり、その乖離が示された。大量の嚢胞性奇形腫に対する外科的減量術により良好な経過を得た。嚢胞成分の挙動と局所の腫瘍マーカーの有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-2428154.summary_en: This report describes a patient with teratocarcinoma who developed progressive cystic enlargement of an abdominal tumor during systemic combination chemotherapy. Tumor markers were elevated in the cyst fluid but negative in serum, a discordance the authors highlight. The patient underwent successful surgical debulking of large amounts of cystic teratoma. The case illustrates that cystic components may behave differently from solid disease and that local markers can be informative when serum markers are negative.

pmid-2428460.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、進行セミノーマ31例（大部分は精巣の病期III等）にシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した。未治療例の持続完全寛解率は89%、広範な放射線療法歴のある例では28%であった。中央値34か月の追跡で74.5%が持続寛解を維持した。著者らは、本療法が一次治療として有効であり、横隔膜下照射のみの例では救済療法として優れると結論づけている。
pmid-2428460.summary_en: This 1986 study treated 31 patients with advanced seminoma, mostly testicular stage III or bulky stage II disease, plus five extragonadal cases, with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Patients not previously pretreated achieved continuous complete remission in 89 percent, compared with 28 percent of those who had received extensive radiotherapy. LDH above 500 mIU/ml predicted worse outcomes. With median follow-up of 34 months, 74.5 percent remained in continuous remission. The authors conclude that cisplatin combination chemotherapy is an effective primary treatment and an excellent salvage option after subdiaphragmatic radiotherapy alone.

pmid-2428701.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍5例で、CA-125をhCG、AFP、CEA、LDHと比較した1986年の報告。全例で術前にCA-125が上昇し、純粋ディスジャーミノーマの1例では唯一の上昇マーカーであった。化学療法中の推移は他の腫瘍マーカーと並行した。症例数は少ないものの、新たな腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性が示唆されている。
pmid-2428701.summary_en: This 1986 study evaluated CA-125 as a tumor marker in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors in five patients, comparing it with hCG, AFP, CEA, and LDH isoenzymes. CA-125 was elevated in all cases before surgery, ranging from 154 to 617 U/ml. In one pure dysgerminoma it was the only elevated marker. During chemotherapy, CA-125 levels paralleled the other tumor markers. The authors suggest CA-125 is a valuable indicator of clinical status and a potential new tumor marker for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, although the sample size is very small.

pmid-2428948.summary_ja: 精巣・後腹膜・縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍166例にVAB-6化学療法を施行した1986年の報告。全体の完全寛解率は78%で、性腺外起源の腫瘍は精巣起源より寛解率・再発率ともに不良であった。維持療法による生存延長は認められなかった。治療関連死はなく、多くの患者は約3か月の治療で済んだ。
pmid-2428948.summary_en: This 1986 study reports outcomes of 166 patients with germ cell tumors of the testis, retroperitoneum, and mediastinum treated with VAB-6 chemotherapy, with or without maintenance. Complete response was 78 percent overall, and uniformly high in seminoma. Testicular nonseminomatous tumors responded better, at 79 percent, than extragonadal tumors at 60 percent. Relapse occurred in 12 percent, more often in extragonadal tumors. Maintenance did not improve survival. Toxicity was tolerable without treatment-related deaths, and most patients needed only about three months of treatment.

pmid-2429292.summary_ja: 高βhCG血症を伴う73歳男性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。原発巣とリンパ節転移はいずれも栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞のみから成り、hCG、胎盤性ラクトゲン、SP1が免疫組織化学的に検出された。隣接する粘膜内腺癌の存在は、通常の胃癌由来とする仮説を支持した。
pmid-2429292.summary_en: This case report describes a 73-year-old man with primary gastric choriocarcinoma and high serum beta-hCG, with an associated intramucosal adenocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry showed that the primary tumor and lymph node metastases contained only cytotrophoblastic and syncytiotrophoblastic elements, positive for hCG, placental lactogen, and SP1. The adjacent adenocarcinoma supports the hypothesis that gastric choriocarcinoma arises from ordinary gastric cancer.

pmid-2429544.summary_ja: 下部消化管出血と病的大腿骨骨折で発症した42歳男性の大腸絨毛癌を報告。血清CEAとβ-hCGが上昇し、腫瘍性合胞体栄養膜細胞でCEAが陽性であった。妊娠性絨毛癌と精巣絨毛癌の追加症例でもCEA陽性であり、CEA陽性のみで原発部位を消化管などと判断すべきでないと結論づけている。
pmid-2429544.summary_en: This report describes a 42-year-old man with colonic choriocarcinoma presenting with lower gastrointestinal bleeding and a pathologic femoral fracture, with elevated serum CEA and beta-hCG. Immunohistochemistry showed CEA positivity in neoplastic syncytiotrophoblasts. Additional gestational and testicular choriocarcinoma cases were also CEA positive. The authors conclude that CEA staining in choriocarcinoma should not be taken as conclusive evidence of a gastrointestinal or other surface-epithelial primary origin.

pmid-2429641.summary_ja: 10か月の乳児に発生した卵巣奇形腫の症例報告で、結節性神経膠腫症と血清AFP上昇を伴っていた。結節性神経膠腫症は腹膜神経膠腫症と同様に良性で、補助療法は不要と考えられる。GFAPの免疫陽性により結節状の播種巣が確認され、原発腫瘍の卵黄嚢様小胞でAFPが検出された。
pmid-2429641.summary_en: This report describes a 10-month-old infant with a grade I solid ovarian teratoma accompanied by nodal gliomatosis and elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein. The authors believe this is the first description of nodal gliomatosis without gliomatosis peritonei. Like gliomatosis peritonei, nodal gliomatosis appears benign and needs no adjuvant therapy. Glial fibrillary acidic protein staining confirmed the nodal implants, and AFP was detected in yolk-sac-like vesicles and intestinal-type glands of the primary tumor.

pmid-2429765.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で、治療前にβ-hCGが高値の成人22例を対象に、BEP療法中のhCG一過性上昇(マーカーサージ)を解析した研究です。9例(41%)に出現し、うち再発は1例のみでした。マーカーサージは初回化学療法中の予後不良因子ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-2429765.summary_en: This 1986 study followed 22 adults with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and elevated pretreatment beta-hCG during BEP chemotherapy. A transient beta-hCG surge occurred in 9 patients (41%), and only one of them relapsed. The BEP regimen achieved an 83.3% disease-free survival rate. The authors concluded that the marker surge is not an adverse prognostic factor during initial chemotherapy.

pmid-2429828.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの培養上清から遊離hCGβを均一かつ高収量で単離するため、遊離hCGβに特異的なモノクローナル抗体B158を作製・精製した研究です。単離された遊離hCGβは標準のhCGβよりわずかに分子量が大きく、hCGαと正常に再結合しました。抗原部位は非連続的で立体構造依存的と考えられています。
pmid-2429828.summary_en: This 1986 paper describes the purification and characterization of monoclonal antibody B158, which binds free hCG beta-subunit with high affinity and little cross-reactivity with intact hormones. The antibody was used to isolate free hCG beta secreted by BeWo choriocarcinoma cells in homogeneous, high-yield form. The isolated product had a slightly higher molecular weight than standard hCG beta and recombined normally with hCG alpha. The antigenic site appears discontinuous and conformational.

pmid-2429830.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と絨毛癌細胞株JArで、hCGα遺伝子3'領域の多型的制限酵素部位を解析した研究です。既知の2か所の多型は1塩基変異によるもので、新たに3か所の多型が同定されました。絨毛癌では大きなDNA再構成は認められず、多型間の連鎖不平衡から絨毛癌発生に関与する癌遺伝子の存在が示唆されています。
pmid-2429830.summary_en: This 1986 study examined polymorphic restriction sites in the 3' region of the human CG-alpha gene in normal placenta and JAr choriocarcinoma cells. Genomic libraries were constructed and sequencing showed that the two known polymorphisms were single-base mutations, and three new polymorphisms were identified. No major DNA rearrangements were found in choriocarcinoma. Linkage disequilibrium among these sites may point to a putative oncogene involved in choriocarcinoma development.

pmid-2429972.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌幹細胞株PCC-aza-1を31℃で培養すると、上皮様細胞へ自然に分化することを示した研究です。アクチン線維の重合、タイトジャンクションの形成、サイトケラチン発現などの変化が見られました。分化は37℃に戻すと可逆的で、ポリオーマウイルスには感受性を獲得しましたがSV40には耐性のままでした。
pmid-2429972.summary_en: This 1986 study shows that murine embryonal carcinoma stem cells (PCC-aza-1) spontaneously differentiate into epithelial-like cells when cultured at 31 degrees C. The change involves cytoskeletal reorganization with actin cable polymerization, tight junction formation, and cytokeratin expression. The cells became fully permissive to polyoma virus but remained resistant to SV40. The differentiation is reversible when cells are returned to 37 degrees C.

pmid-2430114.summary_ja: hCG産生性ヒト胎児性癌を、ヌードマウスで40継代以上にわたり異種移植継代できたことを報告した研究です。組織学的・超微細構造的特徴、腫瘍マーカー(β-hCG)、DNAインデックスは継代を通じて維持され、脱分化やhCG産生の喪失は認められませんでした。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前臨床研究モデルとしての有用性が示されています。
pmid-2430114.summary_en: This urology study established a human embryonal carcinoma producing hCG as a serial xenograft in nude mice, maintained for more than 40 passages. Histological and ultrastructural features, tumor markers (beta-hCG), and DNA indices were preserved across passages. No dedifferentiation or loss of hCG production was observed, and tumor growth remained stable. The model is proposed for preclinical studies of testicular germ cell tumor biology and therapy.

pmid-2430391.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胎児性癌と絨毛癌の症例を報告したものです。細針吸引生検で診断が示唆され、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の検出により確定されました。細胞学的、肉眼的、組織学的所見が記載されており、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の診断における細胞診と血清腫瘍マーカーの有用性を示しています。
pmid-2430391.summary_en: This case report describes a primary malignant germ cell tumor of the mediastinum, consisting of embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Diagnosis was first suggested by fine needle aspiration biopsy and confirmed by demonstrating alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin in the patient's serum. The cytologic, gross, and microscopic findings are described. The case highlights the diagnostic value of cytology combined with serum tumor markers for mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-2430436.summary_ja: 1968〜1985年に治療された精巣セミノーマ27例の解析です。病期I症例が過半数を占めました。末梢静脈で43.8%、腫瘍側精索静脈では88.9%にhCG-βの上昇が見られ、精索静脈採血の有用性が示唆されました。病期IでhCG-βが上昇した症例でも予後不良とは限らず、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた症例に顕微鏡的転移はなく、再発例もありませんでした。
pmid-2430436.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study analyzed 27 patients with testicular seminoma treated from 1968 to 1985, most with stage I disease. Elevated hCG-beta was found in 43.8% of peripheral venous samples and 88.9% of tumor-side spermatic vein samples, suggesting venous sampling is more informative. Elevated hCG-beta in stage I did not necessarily predict poor outcome. None of the 10 patients with elevated levels who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection had microscopic metastasis, and none recurred.

pmid-2430437.summary_ja: 1968〜1985年に治療された精巣非セミノーマ性腫瘍30例の治療成績を検討した研究です。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は評価例の86.4%、hCG-βは73.7%で陽性でした。治療前hCG-βは絨毛癌成分の推定に有用でした。病期I症例は根治的精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清で再発率が低く、シスプラチン併用化学療法により進行例の5年生存率は40%に改善しました。
pmid-2430437.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study reviewed 30 patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumor treated from 1968 to 1985. AFP was elevated in 86.4% and hCG-beta in 73.7% of evaluated patients. Pretreatment hCG-beta helped identify choriocarcinoma elements, but outcomes in advanced disease depended mainly on metastasis extent. Stage I patients treated with radical orchiectomy and RPLND had low recurrence. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy raised five-year survival to 40% in advanced patients, though bulky disease may need cytoreductive surgery.

pmid-2430562.summary_ja: ヒト腫瘍細胞株が分泌する糖タンパク質ホルモンのαサブユニットのリン酸化を検討した。絨毛癌細胞株JARはhCG-αとhCG-βを分泌するが、リン酸化されるのはαサブユニットのみであった。異所性に産生されるホルモン産物の共有結合性修飾を示し、腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの理解に関連する。
pmid-2430562.summary_en: This study examined whether glycoprotein hormone alpha-subunits secreted by human tumor cell lines are phosphorylated. Trophoblastic lines, including the choriocarcinoma line JAR, and nontrophoblastic lines were analyzed. The JAR line phosphorylated only the alpha-subunit, although it secretes both hCG-alpha and hCG-beta. The findings describe a covalent modification of ectopic hormone products, which is relevant to understanding hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-2430686.summary_ja: 転移性卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの2例にエトポシド、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンを用いた化学療法を施行し、セカンドルック手術で完全寛解を確認した。1例は手術単独後に傍大動脈リンパ節で再発し、化学療法後に無病生存した。もう1例は病期III で、手術と3クールの化学療法後に無病生存した。著者らは、化学療法が放射線療法の代替となりうるとし、選択された病期I の症例にも考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-2430686.summary_en: Two patients with metastatic ovarian dysgerminoma treated with etoposide, bleomycin, and cisplatin achieved complete remission confirmed by second-look laparotomy. One patient relapsed in para-aortic nodes after surgery alone and remained disease-free after chemotherapy. The other had stage III disease and remained disease-free after surgery and three cycles. The authors suggest chemotherapy may be an alternative to radiotherapy and should be considered in selected stage I patients.

pmid-2430705.summary_ja: マイトマイシンCを、ヒト血清アルブミンを介して抗αフェトプロテイン抗体と結合させた。in vitroでは、AFP産生卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞に対して遊離薬剤の約20倍の細胞傷害性を示した。JOG-9卵黄嚢腫瘍を移植したヌードマウスでは、遊離薬剤や対照結合体より効果的に腫瘍増殖を抑制した。AFPを標的とした薬剤送達が卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療戦略となりうることを示す。
pmid-2430705.summary_en: Mitomycin C was conjugated to an anti-AFP antibody via human serum albumin. The conjugate was about 20-fold more cytotoxic than free drug against AFP-producing yolk sac tumor cells in vitro. In nude mice bearing the JOG-9 yolk sac tumor, it slowed tumor growth more effectively than free drug or a control conjugate. The study supports AFP-directed drug delivery as a potential treatment approach for yolk sac tumor.

pmid-2430862.summary_ja: 5種のヒト絨毛癌細胞株をハムスター頰嚢で増殖させた。増殖の速い株(BeWo、JEG-3、NUC-1)は遅い株より血管数が多かった。腫瘍血管新生因子の活性は、いずれの株でも発癌組織内での増殖と良好に相関した。絨毛癌株間で血管新生活性に不均一性があることを示した。
pmid-2430862.summary_en: Five human choriocarcinoma cell lines were grown in hamster cheek pouches. Rapidly growing lines (BeWo, JEG-3, NUC-1) had more blood vessels than slowly growing lines. Crude tumor angiogenesis factor activity correlated with in vivo growth across all lines in chick chorioallantoic membrane assays. Large-molecular-weight factors induced neovascularization, suggesting tumor cells secrete angiogenic factors that drive xenograft growth. The findings show heterogeneity in angiogenic activity among choriocarcinoma lines.

pmid-2430923.summary_ja: 肝癌由来と卵黄嚢腫瘍由来のαフェトプロテインを識別するモノクローナル抗体を作製した。3種は肝癌AFPに選択的に反応し、MA122は卵黄嚢腫瘍AFPに強く反応した。結合の差は、AFP分子の糖鎖部分の違いによると考えられる。MA122は乳児の胎児性癌の切片を染色し、肝癌は染色しなかった。
pmid-2430923.summary_en: Monoclonal antibodies were developed to distinguish hepatoma-derived AFP from yolk sac tumor-derived AFP. Three antibodies reacted selectively with hepatoma AFP, while MA122 reacted strongly with yolk sac tumor AFP. Their binding differences appear to reflect carbohydrate portions of the AFP molecules. MA122 stained an infantile embryonal carcinoma but not hepatoma, supporting its use in distinguishing AFP sources in germ cell tumor tissue.

pmid-2433232.summary_ja: 1986年の報告。妊娠17日目のマウス胚精巣におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を免疫組織化学的に検出した。AFPは異型胚細胞と散在する正常胚細胞で陽性だが、腫瘍幹細胞では陽性ではなかった。マウス奇形癌におけるAFP産生の細胞基盤を探る基礎研究であり、AFPが胚細胞の内胚葉起源のマーカーとなりうると提案している。
pmid-2433232.summary_en: This 1986 study localizes alpha-fetoprotein by immunohistochemistry in embryonic day 17 mouse testes, comparing tumor-susceptible and control strains. AFP was detected in atypical germ cells and scattered normal germ cells but not in tumor stem cells. The authors propose that AFP may mark the endodermal origin of germ cells, relevant to the cellular basis of AFP production in murine teratocarcinomas. The study is a basic-science investigation of germ cell tumor biology in a mouse model with a tumor-marker focus.

pmid-2433238.summary_ja: 1986年の報告。抗サイトケラチン抗体Troma 1とCAM 5.2を、正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、妊娠性および非妊娠性絨毛癌の標本で比較し、栄養膜マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。両抗体は同一の反応性を示し、絨毛癌細胞に特異的に反応した。組織学的な栄養膜の検出に有用であり、栄養膜疾患の診断補助になると結論づけている。
pmid-2433238.summary_en: This 1986 study evaluates monoclonal antibodies Troma 1 and CAM 5.2 as histological trophoblast markers across normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, gestational choriocarcinoma, and nongestational choriocarcinoma specimens. Both antibodies showed identical reactivity and labeled trophoblasts in normal and molar implantation sites, while labeling choriocarcinoma cells specifically. Both also react with endometrial gland epithelium. The authors conclude they are very useful for detecting trophoblasts in normal pregnancy and trophoblastic disease.

pmid-2433919.summary_ja: 1960～1984年に酒井市民病院で治療した精巣腫瘍59例の臨床的検討。セミノーマ30例、非セミノーマ29例の治療成績を病期別に示した。セミノーマの多くは精巣摘除術と放射線治療で良好な生存を得た。進行非セミノーマにはPVBレジメンを用いたが、再発例が多く、完全寛解の持続は限られた。
pmid-2433919.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese clinical series reviews 59 testicular cancer patients treated at Sakai Municipal Hospital from 1960 to 1984. Thirty had seminoma and 29 had non-seminoma, with most seminomas managed by orchiectomy followed by radiation. Advanced non-seminoma patients received PVB chemotherapy, but relapse was frequent and few achieved durable complete remission. Survival was favorable for seminoma, while only one non-seminoma patient in stages II and III remained alive. The study highlights stage-based outcomes and the limits of early combination chemotherapy.

pmid-2434467.summary_ja: 1986年の報告。未分化マウスF9奇形癌幹細胞に豊富で、分化した壁側内胚葉PYS-2細胞には乏しいcDNAを単離した。6クローンはレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPへの応答により2群に分かれた。胎児性癌細胞を用いて初期哺乳類細胞分化の分子機構を探る基礎研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的理解に関わる。
pmid-2434467.summary_en: This 1986 Journal of Biochemistry study constructs cDNA libraries from undifferentiated mouse F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells and screens for transcripts abundant in these cells but absent in differentiated parietal endoderm PYS-2 cells. Six clones were isolated, and their levels responded differently to retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP treatment. One clone belongs to a developmentally regulated repeat-containing gene family. The work addresses molecular mechanisms of early mammalian differentiation using embryonal carcinoma cells as a model, placing it within germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-2435085.summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児が心膜内腫瘍による急性心タンポナーデを呈した症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腫瘍が示唆された。大動脈基部由来の腫瘍を切除し、卵黄嚢癌成分を伴う奇形腫と診断した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は術前から上昇し、腫瘍のAFP陽性を確認した。術後1年の経過は良好であった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。
pmid-2435085.summary_en: This 1986 pediatric case report describes a three-month-old boy with acute tamponade caused by an intrapericardial tumor. Chest CT was the only imaging that suggested the mass, which was excised from the ascending aortic root. Histology showed a teratoma with yolk sac carcinoma components, and immunohistochemistry confirmed AFP expression in them. Serum AFP was elevated preoperatively. The child remained well one year after surgery. This is an extragonadal germ cell tumor arising in the pericardial region, which is within this site's scope.

pmid-2435133.summary_ja: 1986年の報告。セミノーマ22検体に抗胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ抗体を用いた免疫組織化学染色を行った。全例のセミノーマが陽性で、非セミノーマや正常精巣は陰性であった。腫瘍周囲の正常組織も陽性を示し、上皮内癌の存在が示唆された。組織診断や発生機序の理解に有用な方法と結論づけている。
pmid-2435133.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study applies immunoperoxidase staining with anti-placental alkaline phosphatase antibody to 22 seminomatous testicular tumor specimens. All seminomas stained positive, mainly on the cell surface, while normal testes and non-seminomas were negative. Unexpectedly, normal tissue adjacent to the tumor also stained, suggesting carcinoma in situ. The authors propose the method is useful for histopathological diagnosis and possibly for understanding tumor pathogenesis, evaluating placental alkaline phosphatase as a tumor marker.

pmid-2435134.summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍の6例(セミノーマ1例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍5例)にVAB-6併用化学療法を施行した。完全奏効は2例、部分奏効後に腫瘍減量手術と追加化学療法で無病となった例は3例であった。再発した1例はPVeBVレジメンで治療した。中央値16ヶ月の観察で全例が生存し無病であり、重篤な骨髄抑制や腎毒性は認めず、一過性のトランスアミナーゼ上昇がみられた。
pmid-2435134.summary_en: Six patients with advanced testicular cancer (one seminoma, five nonseminomatous germ cell tumors) were treated with VAB-6 combination chemotherapy without maintenance. Two achieved complete response, and three partial responders became disease-free after debulking surgery and additional chemotherapy. One nonseminomatous patient relapsed and received salvage PVeBV. With median follow-up of 16 months, all patients were alive without evidence of disease. Severe myelosuppression and renal toxicity did not occur; transient transaminase elevation was common. The authors conclude the regimen is highly effective and minimally toxic.

pmid-2439342.summary_ja: hCGまたはαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生する腫瘍8例に高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌用のEMA/CO療法を施行し、さらに再発胚細胞腫瘍に用いられるEpPt/OMBを3例に施行した。マーカー反応はAFP産生腫瘍3例中2例、hCG産生腫瘍5例全例で認められた。完全な生化学的奏効はすべて解剖学的奏効を伴った。マーカー産生腫瘍は化学感受性が高く、マーカーによりその亜群を同定できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2439342.summary_en: Eight patients with tumors producing hCG or AFP were treated with the EMA/CO regimen used for high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma, and three more received EpPt/OMB, a regimen used for relapsed germ cell tumors. Marker responses occurred in two of three AFP-producing tumors and all five hCG-producing tumors. All three EpPt/OMB-treated patients responded biochemically, and every complete biochemical response was accompanied by an anatomical response. The authors suggest marker-producing tumors may be particularly chemosensitive, so markers could identify this subgroup, while activity may extend to other solid tumors.

pmid-2836937.summary_ja: 小児の婦人科悪性腫瘍の約2%を占め、その60～70%は卵巣由来である。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍および性索間質腫瘍の治療進歩により治癒率が向上し、妊孕性温存も可能になった。外科的病期分類により、従来は局所限局と考えられていた症例に潜在的転移が見つかるようになった。本稿は小児卵巣腫瘍の各分類に対する治療選択肢を概説している。
pmid-2836937.summary_en: This review summarizes childhood ovarian malignancies, which account for 60-70% of pediatric gynecologic cancers. Advances in treating germ cell and sex cord tumors of the ovary have raised cure rates while preserving future fertility. Surgical staging has revealed early occult metastatic sites that previously caused high mortality in presumed localized disease. Drawing on the authors' institutional experience and the literature, the authors discuss treatment options for the various classes of pediatric ovarian tumors.

pmid-2868158.summary_ja: 放射性ヨウ素標識の抗SSEA-1モノクローナルIgMおよびそのF(ab')2断片を用い、マウスおよびヒト異種移植の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍をシンチグラフィで描出した。腫瘍への集積は非特異的捕捉よりも主に抗原特異性によるもので、投与後の経過時間に強く依存した。この抗体は薬物ターゲティングにも用いられ、胚細胞腫瘍の画像診断と標的治療への応用可能性が示された。
pmid-2868158.summary_en: Murine and heterotransplanted human nonseminomatous germ cell tumors were located by external scintigraphy using radioiodinated anti-SSEA-1, a monoclonal IgM, and its F(ab')2 fragment. Tumor uptake depended mainly on antigen specificity rather than nonspecific trapping, and varied with time after injection. The antibody was also used for in vitro and in vivo drug targeting, suggesting potential for imaging and targeted therapy of germ cell tumors.

pmid-2868159.summary_ja: 48歳男性が急性虫垂炎と臨床診断されて開腹したところ、骨盤内の停留精巣に発生したセミノーマが見つかった。腫瘍が盲腸後方の虫垂に直接浸潤し、炎症を引き起こしていた。虫垂への直接浸潤による発症は英語文献に報告がなく、極めて稀な提示様式である。
pmid-2868159.summary_en: A 48-year-old man was clinically diagnosed with acute appendicitis, but exploration revealed a seminoma arising in an undescended pelvic testis. The tumor had directly invaded the retrocecal appendix, causing the inflammation. The authors note that such direct extension into the appendix has not been described in the English literature, making this a highly unusual presentation of testicular germ cell malignancy.

pmid-2868770.summary_ja: 片側性精巣がん患者約1300例のうち26例(1.9%)に第二の胚細胞がんが発生し、内訳はセミノーマ18例、非セミノーマ8例であった。以前にセミノーマを有していた患者では、新たなセミノーマのリスクが高かった。停留・萎縮精巣の既往があると発症までの期間が短縮した。臨床病期Iの第二腫瘍は精巣摘除術後に経過観察できるとされ、生涯にわたるフォローアップの必要性には疑問が呈された。
pmid-2868770.summary_en: Among about 1300 patients with unilateral testicular cancer, 26 (1.9%) developed a second primary germ cell cancer, 18 seminomas and 8 nonseminomas. Prior seminoma carried a higher risk of new seminoma. Second tumors were diagnosed within three years in only half, and a history of undescended or atrophic testes shortened the interval. Patients with clinical stage I second tumors may be observed after orchiectomy without further treatment. The authors question the need for lifelong follow-up visits.

pmid-2872394.summary_ja: 1975～1984年にRoyal Marsden病院で治療された精巣がん724例のうち、69例(9.5%)に停留精巣の既往があった。診断時に未矯正の停留精巣を有した例は11例であった。停留精巣に対する治療の施行年齢分布は全国的な予測とほぼ一致しており、著者らは精巣固定術の施行年齢が精巣がんのリスクに影響しないと結論づけている。
pmid-2872394.summary_en: Of 724 testicular cancer patients treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital from 1975 to 1984, 69 (9.5%) had a history of cryptorchidism. Eleven had an uncorrected undescended testis at diagnosis, and 58 had undergone orchidopexy or orchidectomy for it. The age distribution at treatment for undescended testis was almost identical to national expectations. The authors conclude that age at orchidopexy does not influence the risk of testicular cancer.

pmid-2873883.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、SSEA-1に対するIgMモノクローナル抗体にメトトレキサートを結合させた製剤を、胎児性癌モデルのF-9奇形癌細胞で検証した。遊離薬より強い増殖抑制を示し、特異的結合、細胞内取り込み、リソソーム分解が確認された。抗原標的化による薬物送達の有用性を示唆する。
pmid-2873883.summary_en: This 1986 study tested methotrexate conjugated to an IgM monoclonal antibody against SSEA-1 on cultured F-9 teratocarcinoma cells, an embryonal carcinoma model. The conjugate was more potent than free methotrexate, with a 50% inhibitory dose of 4.5 nM versus 15 nM, and showed specific binding, internalization and lysosomal degradation. Pretreatment with unlabeled antibody reduced uptake, which recovered within 4 hours. The results suggest antigen-targeted delivery of methotrexate may enhance cytotoxicity against SSEA-1-positive germ cell tumor-like cells.

pmid-2874235.summary_ja: 未矯正の停留精巣から同時に両側に発生した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の1例を報告する。左側は純粋な高異型度セミノーマ、右側は奇形癌と絨毛癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴うセミノーマであった。停留精巣はリスクを高め、兄も停留精巣にセミノーマを発症しHLA-Aw24を共有していたため、遺伝的因子の関与も考察されている。
pmid-2874235.summary_en: This case report describes simultaneous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors arising from uncorrected cryptorchid testes in one patient. The left testis showed pure high-grade seminoma, while the right showed teratocarcinoma with choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor elements plus seminoma. The authors note that cryptorchidism raises GCT risk and that genetic factors may contribute, since the patient's brother had a left cryptorchid seminoma and both shared HLA-Aw24. Familial clustering of testicular tumors is discussed.

pmid-2875786.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いて1973〜1982年の米国とプエルトリコの精巣がん症例3000例以上を解析した疫学研究である。白人男性の罹患率は他の民族群より高く、組織型分布は民族間で差がなかった。未婚男性では非セミノーマのリスクが高く、若年男性では全群で罹患率が上昇していた。
pmid-2875786.summary_en: This SEER-based descriptive epidemiology report analyzes over 3000 testicular cancer cases in the US and Puerto Rico from 1973 to 1982. White men had higher incidence than Hispanic, Black, and Puerto Rican counterparts, with ethnic differences least evident at the extremes of age. Histologic distribution did not differ across ethnic groups, though morphology varied with age. Right-sided predominance appeared in childhood and in cryptorchid tumors. Never-married men had higher risk of nonseminoma. Incidence rose among young men in all groups.

pmid-2876131.summary_ja: 1977〜1983年にキング・ファイサル専門病院で治療された純粋型精巣セミノーマ30例を解析した。進行例や未分化型が多く、停留精巣の頻度も高かった。限局例は精巣摘除と放射線療法で良好に反応したが、腫瘍量が多い例では反応が不良であった。大量の後腹膜転移などには放射線療法前の化学療法を推奨している。
pmid-2876131.summary_en: This 1986 study describes 30 Saudi patients with pure testicular seminoma treated at King Faisal Specialist Hospital from 1977 to 1983. Many presented with extensive disease and poor performance status, with more anaplastic histology and cryptorchidism than other series. Elevated beta-hCG was relatively common. Most underwent orchiectomy followed by radiation therapy, and some received chemotherapy. Limited disease responded well, while extensive tumor burden responded poorly to radiation. The authors recommend preradiation chemotherapy for massive retroperitoneal, supradiaphragmatic, or extranodal disease.

pmid-2876145.summary_ja: 1973〜1983年のイングランドとウェールズにおける胞状奇胎の登録データを解析した研究である。出生1000対あたりの発生率は1983年に1.54へ上昇し、母体年齢による差も大きかった。約7.75%が侵入奇胎や絨毛癌に対して化学療法を要した。56日以内にhCGが正常化した群では化学療法が不要で、フォローアップ期間の短縮が提案されている。
pmid-2876145.summary_en: This population registry study examines hydatidiform mole in England and Wales from 1973 to 1983, when annual incidence rose to 1.54 per 1000 live births. Risk varied strongly with maternal age. About 7.75% needed chemotherapy for invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, more often after oxytocin- or prostaglandin-induced evacuation or hysterotomy. In 42% hCG became undetectable within 56 days and none of these needed chemotherapy, supporting shorter follow-up for this subgroup. Recrudescence risk after late normalization was 1 in 286, and subsequent-pregnancy mole risk was 1 in 76.

pmid-2877580.summary_ja: プルーンベリー症候群に後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍を合併した例として、おそらく初めての報告である。プルーンベリー症候群は停留精巣を含む先天異常症候群である。停留精巣は精巣腫瘍のリスクが高いことが知られており、本症例は稀な合併として臨床的に重要である。先天異常と胚細胞腫瘍の関連を示す点に価値がある。抄録には詳細な組織型や治療の記載はない。
pmid-2877580.summary_en: This case report describes what may be the first documented germ cell tumor complicating prune belly syndrome, a congenital disorder that includes cryptorchidism. The authors highlight that cryptorchid testes carry a known elevated risk of testicular tumors, making this association clinically relevant for patients with prune belly syndrome. The abstract provides limited clinical details about the patient, tumor histology, or management. Its main value lies in documenting an unusual association between a congenital anomaly syndrome and a retroperitoneal GCT.

pmid-2878840.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株8株(妊娠由来6株、非妊娠由来2株)について、モノクローナル抗体を用いてHLAクラスIおよびIIの発現を評価した研究である。クラスI抗原の発現は極めて低いかまたは欠如し、クラスII抗原はいずれの株でも検出されなかった。絨毛癌細胞株の基礎的な免疫学的特徴づけを提供している。
pmid-2878840.summary_en: This study examined HLA class I and class II antigen expression in eight human choriocarcinoma cell lines, six of gestational origin and two of non-gestational origin, using a radioimmune inhibition assay with monoclonal antibodies. HLA class I expression was very low or absent, and no class II antigen was detected in any line. The findings provide basic immunologic characterization of these choriocarcinoma models, which may inform future work on their interactions with host immunity.

pmid-2942034.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胚細胞腫瘍の1例で、抗急性リンパ芽球性白血病共通抗原抗体J5に免疫蛍光法と免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で反応した。この抗原はメラノーマや大腸癌、乳癌の細胞株、正常線維芽細胞、末梢顆粒球にも認められていた。充実性の非リンパ系腫瘍でこの抗原が確認された初めての報告とされ、予後や治療への意義が議論されている。
pmid-2942034.summary_en: This report describes a mediastinal germ cell tumour that reacted with the anti-common acute lymphoblastic leukaemia antigen antibody J5 by immunofluorescence and immunoperoxidase staining. The antigen had previously been found on melanoma, colon and breast cancer cell lines, as well as on normal fibroblasts and peripheral granulocytes. The authors believe this is the first description of a solid nonlymphoid neoplasm expressing the antigen, and they discuss possible implications for prognosis and therapy.

pmid-2942181.summary_ja: 生後3日の乳児にみられた、硬口蓋から口腔外へ突出する先天性奇形腫（epignathus）の症例報告である。組織学的に典型的な奇形腫の成分と脳組織が認められた。臨床・病理学的特徴を記載し、本病変の発生に関する胚発生学的背景を考察するとともに、文献の総説を付している。
pmid-2942181.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital teratoma protruding from the mouth (epignathus) and attached to the hard palate of a three-day-old infant. Histology showed typical teratomatous components and brain tissue. The authors report the clinical and pathological features of the lesion and discuss its embryological basis. The case is presented together with a review of the literature.

pmid-2942333.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対して8年前に放射線療法と併用化学療法を受けた33歳男性が、コントロール不良の高血圧で受診した。血管造影で左腎動脈に75%の狭窄、右腎動脈の閉塞が認められ、経皮的血管形成術で狭窄を拡張して血圧を良好に管理できた。腹部放射線療法の有無にかかわらず治療後に高血圧を来した患者では、腎動脈狭窄の検索が必要と述べている。
pmid-2942333.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with poorly controlled hypertension had received radiotherapy and combination chemotherapy for testicular teratoma eight years earlier. Arteriography showed 75% stenosis of the left renal artery and occlusion of the right renal artery. Transluminal angioplasty dilated the stenosis, and the hypertension was adequately controlled. The authors recommend investigating renal artery stenosis in patients who develop hypertension after abdominal radiotherapy, with or without chemotherapy.

pmid-2944267.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者に生じた片側性のセミノーマの症例報告である。精巣がんとダウン症候群の関連について考察し、対側精巣のフォローアップ生検の必要性を論じている。臨床でこの合併を念頭に置くことと、フォローアップ中に反対側精巣を慎重に監視することの重要性が示されている。
pmid-2944267.summary_en: This case report describes unilateral seminoma in a patient with Down syndrome. The authors discuss the relationship between testicular cancer and Down syndrome, which is the central theme of the report. They also address the need for follow-up biopsy of the contralateral testis in such patients. The brief report highlights the importance of considering this association in clinical practice and of careful monitoring of the opposite testis during follow-up.

pmid-2950130.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌患者の血清におけるMLR阻害活性と細胞傷害性抗体を検討した1986年の研究。活性は腫瘍量を反映し、hCGの正常化後に消失し再発時に再出現した。阻害因子はMHCクラスII抗原に対する免疫グロブリンと考えられた。免疫因子と疾患活動性の関連を示した。
pmid-2950130.summary_en: This 1986 study investigated mixed lymphocyte reaction (MLR)-blocking activity in sera from patients with gestational choriocarcinoma. Cytotoxic antibodies against husbands' lymphocytes were found in some patients, and HLA mismatches were common between patients and spouses. MLR-blocking activity was present during active tumor burden, disappeared 3-4 months after hCG normalized, and reappeared at relapse, suggesting it reflects tumor burden. The blocking factors were immunoglobulin antibodies directed at MHC class II antigens on husbands' B cells. The findings link immune factors to disease activity in gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3002579.summary_ja: 精巣がんの転移巣において、奇形腫由来癌腫と残存胎児性癌を光顕および電顕で比較した1986年の研究。奇形腫由来癌腫は腺管形成やムチン産生を示し、胎児性癌に特徴的な長い密着結合やテロリソソームを欠いた。両者の鑑別は治療方針の違いから臨床的に重要とされる。
pmid-3002579.summary_en: This 1986 study compared carcinomas of teratomatous origin (CTO) with residual embryonal carcinoma (EC) in testicular cancer metastases. Six CTOs and twelve ECs were examined by light and electron microscopy. CTOs formed glands, showed mucin, and lacked long tight junctions and telolysosomes, which were present in all ECs. CTOs more often had desmosomes and anchoring rootlets. Because CTOs are easily confused with EC but likely require different treatment, the authors emphasize that accurate distinction is clinically important. The study addresses diagnostic differentiation within germ cell tumor metastases.

pmid-3002596.summary_ja: ステージIIIの混合型胚細胞腫瘍23例で、化学療法後の残存胸部・後腹膜腫瘤を切除した1986年の研究。高用量シスプラチン治療群では73%が無病生存した。残存病変の組織像は、ほぼ3分の1で胸部と後腹膜で異なっていた。化学療法と手術の併用の有用性を示した。
pmid-3002596.summary_en: This 1986 study reviewed 23 patients with stage III mixed germ cell tumors who underwent surgical excision of residual thoracic and retroperitoneal masses after systemic chemotherapy. Among 15 patients treated with high-dose cisplatin regimens, 27% had persistent tumor, 40% had only necrosis or fibrosis, and 33% had mature teratoma. With median follow-up of 29 months, 73% remained disease-free. Histology of thoracic and retroperitoneal resections differed in 35% of patients. The authors concluded that sequential chemotherapy and surgery benefit advanced mixed germ cell tumors and that residual disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy should be resected.

pmid-3002601.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍181例中9例(5%)に両側性病変を認めた1986年の報告。同時性が2例、異時性が7例で、間隔は8か月から約7年に及んだ。文献的に発生頻度、組織像、治療、予後を検討した。長期フォローアップと超音波検査による対側腫瘍の早期発見の重要性を強調した。
pmid-3002601.summary_en: This 1986 study reported nine patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors among 181 patients, a 5% incidence. Two had synchronous bilateral tumors, and seven developed a contralateral tumor after intervals of 8 months to nearly 7 years. The authors reviewed the incidence, histology, therapy, and prognosis of bilateral disease through the literature. They emphasized long-term follow-up and the value of sonography for early detection of contralateral tumors. The paper provides clinical guidance for surveillance of testicular germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-3002602.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍6例の短期培養を用いた染色体解析を行った1986年の研究。全例に構造異常染色体が認められ、12番染色体短腕のi(12p)が全例に存在した。i(12p)は、セミノーマや奇形腫でも報告されており、全組織型に共通する特徴的な核型異常と考えられた。
