pmid-3002602.summary_en: This 1986 cytogenetic study analyzed short-term cultures from six testicular germ cell tumors, including four embryonal carcinomas and two mixed tumors predominantly teratomatous. All tumors were hypo-, hyper-, or triploid and contained structurally abnormal chromosomes. An isochromosome of the short arm of chromosome 12, i(12p), was found in every tumor, present in at least two copies per metaphase. Together with prior reports of i(12p) in seminoma and teratoma, the authors suggested that i(12p) is a characteristic karyotypic abnormality across all histologic types of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-3002916.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患185例に対し、メトトレキサートとホリン酸を一次治療として10年間用いた1986年の報告。非転移性疾患の90.2%、低リスク転移性疾患の68.2%が完全寛解した。hCGの低下曲線で治療を調整し、化学療法の曝露を抑えた。
pmid-3002916.summary_en: This 1986 study reported ten years of primary methotrexate with folinic acid therapy in 185 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. Complete remission occurred in 90.2% with nonmetastatic disease and 68.2% with low-risk metastatic disease, and 81.5% achieved sustained remission after one course. Methotrexate-resistant patients responded to actinomycin D or combination chemotherapy. Toxicities included granulocytopenia, thrombocytopenia, and hepatotoxicity. Serum hCG regression curves guided treatment timing and limited chemotherapy exposure while achieving high remission rates.

pmid-3002918.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、胞状奇胎・侵入奇胎・絨毛癌患者の血清hCG・SP1・hPLを測定した。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌ではhCG/SP1比が正常妊娠や胞状奇胎より著明に上昇し、悪性化の指標になりうることを示した。化学療法中には比が上昇した。SP1による経過観察は冗長と考えられ、hPLは再発と妊娠の鑑別に有用であった。
pmid-3002918.summary_en: This 1986 study measured serum hCG, SP1 and hPL in patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. In molar pregnancy both markers fell with remission. In invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, the hCG/SP1 ratio was markedly elevated compared with normal pregnancy and hydatidiform mole, suggesting a marker of malignant change. The ratio rose during chemotherapy. SP1 monitoring appeared redundant, while hPL helped distinguish relapse from pregnancy.

pmid-3004921.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者血清と精製hCGを検討した。腫瘍患者の血清の多くに甲状腺からのT3放出活性が認められ、正常妊娠血清では認められなかった。等電点3.3〜4.0の酸性hCG変異体は腫瘍患者に多く、in vitroで甲状腺刺激作用を示した。これらが一部の甲状腺機能亢進症の原因となりうる。
pmid-3004921.summary_en: This study examined serum and purified hCG from patients with trophoblastic disease and nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Most tumor-patient sera, but no pregnancy sera, released T3 from thyroid slices. Acidic hCG variants (pI 3.3-4.0) were abundant in tumor patients and had thyrotropic activity in vitro, which anti-hCG antiserum neutralized. These variants may explain some cases of hyperthyroidism in these tumors.

pmid-3005934.summary_ja: Y染色体材料を有する性腺異形成症例に生じた腫瘍140例を文献的に解析した。性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が多く、両側性や10歳未満の発症もみられた。これらの患者は卵巣腫瘍のリスクがあり、早期の開腹探索と両側性性腺摘出術が推奨されると結論付けている。
pmid-3005934.summary_en: This 1986 review analyzed 140 published cases of neoplasia arising in dysgenetic gonads, most with Y chromosome material. Gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma were the most frequent histologies, often bilateral and occurring in young patients, some under age 10. The authors conclude that patients with dysgenetic gonads and Y chromosome material are at risk of ovarian neoplasia and recommend early exploration and bilateral gonadectomy.

pmid-3007036.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とその患者を対象に、銀染色による核小体形成領域(Ag-NOR)を解析した。7例中4例で一貫した異所性NORが認められた。染色体再構成や既存の不活性NORの脱抑制が原因として考えられている。少数例の予備的な知見である。
pmid-3007036.summary_en: This 1986 cytogenetics study examined silver-stained nucleolus organizer regions (Ag-NORs) in human testicular germ cell tumors and their patients. Four of seven tumors showed consistent ectopic NORs, which the authors attribute to chromosomal rearrangement or derepression of previously inactive NORs. The findings are preliminary, from a small series, and aim to test whether NOR changes characterize solid tumors as they do hematopoietic malignancies.

pmid-3007637.summary_ja: 1975〜1982年に妊娠性絨毛性疾患で治療を受けた57例の、その後の83回の妊娠を検討した。正期産は66.3%、自然流産は11.3%であった。化学療法による胎児発育への影響は認めず、治療群の絨毛癌発生は1.8%で未治療の奇胎患者と差がなかった。
pmid-3007637.summary_en: This Japanese study of 57 women treated for trophoblastic disease between 1975 and 1982 reviewed 83 subsequent pregnancies. Term delivery occurred in 66.3%, spontaneous abortion in 11.3%, and congenital malformation in one infant. Secondary infertility was 5%, and MTX or actinomycin D did not impair fetal growth. Choriocarcinoma developed in 1.8% of treated patients, similar to untreated molar patients.

pmid-3007784.summary_ja: 触診で精巣に異常がなかった性腺外胚細胞腫瘍16例を検討した。後腹膜腫瘍12例中10例で潜在性の精巣病変が認められ、縦隔腫瘍の4例では精巣に異常はなかった。触診のみでは精巣原発を除外できず、高周波超音波検査を行い、限局病変があれば精巣摘除術を推奨している。
pmid-3007784.summary_en: This urology series reviewed 16 patients with primary extragonadal germ cell tumors whose testes appeared normal on palpation. Occult testicular residues were found in 10 of 12 retroperitoneal tumor patients, while all 4 mediastinal patients had normal testes. The authors conclude that palpation is insufficient to exclude a testicular primary and recommend high-frequency ultrasound, with orchiectomy if a focal lesion is found.

pmid-3008399.summary_ja: 41歳男性の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。転移性胎児性癌が11年以上にわたり持続して認められた。典型的な急速進行型とは異なり、積極的な化学療法や外科的切除への反応は乏しいものの、制御されない病態のまま10年以上生存した。転移を伴う胚細胞腫瘍として10年以上生存した初の報告とされる。
pmid-3008399.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old man with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who had nearly continuous evidence of metastatic embryonal carcinoma for more than eleven years. Unlike typical rapidly progressive NSGCT, the disease followed an indolent course with poor response to aggressive chemotherapy and surgical resection, yet survival exceeded ten years despite uncontrolled disease. The authors describe it as the first reported case of indolent metastatic germ cell neoplasm surviving more than ten years, highlighting that rare variants may behave unlike the typical aggressive course.

pmid-3009658.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎と絨毛癌を含む栄養膜性腫瘍32例に対し超音波検査の有用性を検討した1986年の研究である。24例で病巣エコーが検出され、その体積は尿中hCG値と相関した。エコーパターンは4型に分類され、子宮摘出17例では術後所見とよく一致した。エコー所見のみで絨毛癌と侵入奇胎を鑑別するのは困難であり、化学療法後の変化は尿中hCGより緩徐であった。
pmid-3009658.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study evaluated ultrasonography in 32 patients with trophoblastic tumors, including invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. Focal echoes were detected in 24 cases and their volume correlated with urinary hCG levels. Four echo patterns were defined, and ultrasound findings matched post-hysterectomy pathology in 17 cases. Histologic distinction between choriocarcinoma and invasive mole by echo pattern was difficult. Focal size and echo patterns responded to chemotherapy more slowly than urinary hCG.

pmid-3009660.summary_ja: 正常妊娠および胞状奇胎、妊娠性・非妊娠性絨毛癌の組織標本を用い、モノクローナル抗体Troma 1およびCAM 5.2の組織学的栄養膜マーカーとしての有用性を検討した1986年の研究である。両抗体は正常妊娠と胞状奇胎の絨毛性・非絨毛性栄養膜に反応し、絨毛癌細胞に特異的に反応した。子宮内膜腺上皮とは区別しやすく、栄養膜マーカーとして有用と結論された。
pmid-3009660.summary_en: This 1986 study evaluated two monoclonal antibodies, Troma 1 and CAM 5.2, as histological trophoblast markers. Tissues from normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, gestational and non-gestational choriocarcinoma, and non-gestational uteri were stained. Both antibodies reacted with villous and non-villous trophoblasts in normal pregnancy and molar tissue, and labeled choriocarcinoma cells specifically. The authors concluded that these antibodies can serve as useful trophoblast markers in normal pregnancy and trophoblastic disease.

pmid-3010204.summary_ja: 初回手術と併用化学療法後にセカンドルック開腹術を受けた、悪性非ディスジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍53例を検討した1986年の研究である。組織型は未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、胎児性癌などであった。セカンドルック所見は52例で陰性で、53例中50例が病勢なく生存していた。病期I卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例は陰性所見後に再発し死亡した。
pmid-3010204.summary_en: This 1986 study reviewed 53 patients with malignant nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors who underwent second-look laparotomy after initial surgery and combination chemotherapy. Histologies included immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, mixed germ cell tumor, and embryonal carcinoma. Second-look findings were negative in 52 patients, and 50 of 53 were surviving without disease. One patient with stage I endodermal sinus tumor relapsed after a negative second-look. The authors discuss possible indications, though the precise role remains unestablished.

pmid-3010437.summary_ja: 異種移植した人胎児性癌と人卵黄嚢腫瘍から、内因性の糖結合蛋白(レクチン)を分離し比較した1986年の研究である。胎児性癌にはカルシウム依存性の分子量66,000の蛋白が認められたが、卵黄嚢腫瘍では検出されなかった。分子量62,000のフコース結合蛋白も精製された。これらのレクチンは胚細胞腫瘍の分類、診断、治療の改善に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-3010437.summary_en: This 1986 study compared endogenous carbohydrate-binding proteins (lectins) from xenografted human embryonal carcinoma and human yolk sac tumor. Sepharose affinity columns and sugar elution isolated Ca2+-dependent and Ca2+-independent lectins. A Ca2+-dependent protein at Mr 66,000 was found in embryonal carcinoma but undetectable in yolk sac tumor, and a fucose-binding protein at Mr 62,000 was purified. The authors suggest these lectins may aid classification, diagnosis and therapy of germ cell tumors.

pmid-3011237.summary_ja: 持続性または転移性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患60例に対し、初回治療として経口エトポシドを投与した。59例が生化学的寛解に達し、再発率は5.1%であった。重篤な悪心・嘔吐を生じた1例はメトトレキサート療法へ変更された。エトポシドは絨毛癌に有効であり、薬剤抵抗性例に限定すべきではないと結論づけられている。
pmid-3011237.summary_en: This study reports primary oral etoposide therapy in 60 patients with persistent or metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease, including 12 with metastatic disease. Fifty-nine patients achieved biochemical remission. One patient had severe nausea and vomiting and was switched to methotrexate with folinic acid. Three patients relapsed, a relapse rate of 5.1 percent. The authors conclude that etoposide is active against choriocarcinoma and should not be restricted to drug-resistant disease. The study supports oral etoposide as a first-line option for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-3011241.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の2例で、強力化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫を解析した。両例とも高度異数性とi(12p)を認めた。一方の後腹膜病変では原発腫瘍と異なるDNA indexのクローンが見られ、化学療法により顕在化した可能性がある。成熟残存病変に対する積極的な外科的切除を支持する所見である。
pmid-3011241.summary_en: This report describes karyotyping and DNA flow cytometry of mature residual teratoma tissue in two patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor after intensive chemotherapy. Short-term tissue culture produced cells without embryonal carcinoma morphology. Both residual lesions were highly aneuploid and carried the i(12p) marker typical of testicular germ cell tumors. One retroperitoneal lesion showed a clone with a DNA index distinct from the primary tumor, possibly unmasked by chemotherapy. The authors argue that these findings support aggressive surgical resection of mature residual lesions because of the risk of secondary non-germ cell malignancy.

pmid-3012144.summary_ja: Turner症候群（核型45,X）の53歳女性に、同時性の肝内胆管癌と左鼠径部のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が認められた。切除された肝腫瘍は横行結腸間膜と十二指腸に浸潤していた。鼠径部病変は異形成性の性腺に由来していた。Turner症候群と胆管癌の合併は、これまで報告がない。
pmid-3012144.summary_en: This case report describes a 53-year-old woman with Turner syndrome (karyotype 45,X) who had synchronous intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and a left inguinal dysgerminoma. The resected liver tumor was cholangiocarcinoma invading the transverse mesocolon and duodenum. The inguinal lesion was a dysgerminoma arising from a dysgenetic gonad. The authors note that an association between cholangiocarcinoma and Turner syndrome had not previously been reported. The case illustrates coexisting malignancies in gonadal dysgenesis, a setting in which germ cell tumors can arise.

pmid-3012301.summary_ja: 仙尾部悪性胚細胞腫瘍の外科的切除から32日後に硬膜外脊髄圧迫症候群を発症した患者を報告した。ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる化学療法で速やかに症状が改善し、放射線療法や椎弓切除は不要であった。神経学的後遺症は残らなかった。化学療法単独での管理が有効であると結論づけられている。
pmid-3012301.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a sacrococcygeal malignant germ cell tumor who developed epidural spinal cord compression 32 days after surgical resection. Chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin led to rapid symptom resolution, without radiation therapy or laminectomy. The patient recovered neurologically without sequelae. The authors conclude that chemotherapy alone can be an effective approach to epidural compression caused by malignant germ cell tumor, potentially avoiding surgery and radiation. The tumor was not primary to the central nervous system.

pmid-3012847.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がん60例を前向きに検討。病期IIへの病期誤認6例、転移・再発5例を認めた。胎児性癌、血管侵襲、精索への進展が、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の転移・再発の有意な予測因子であり、これらに基づく管理方針を提案している。
pmid-3012847.summary_en: A prospective study of 60 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer undergoing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Six were upstaged to stage II, and five developed metastases or recurrence, four in the lungs and one in both lungs and retroperitoneal nodes. Analysis of the ten treatment-failure patients identified embryonal carcinoma, vascular invasion, and spermatic cord extension as significant predictors of metastasis or recurrence after RPLA. The authors propose a management plan based on these criteria.

pmid-3012918.summary_ja: 後腹膜病変の画像診断（リンパ管造影、超音波検査、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)）を比較検討。非セミノーマ患者15例で後腹膜リンパ節転移の検出能を評価した。性腺外および精巣の胚細胞腫瘍4症例を報告し、高齢男性の原因不明の腎疝痛が原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍によるものかもしれないと示唆している。
pmid-3012918.summary_en: Discusses diagnostic modalities for detecting pathological retroperitoneal processes, including bilateral lymphography, ultrasonography, and computed tomography. These were evaluated for detecting retroperitoneal lymph node metastases in 15 non-seminoma patients. The authors describe four cases of extragonadal and testicular germ cell tumours and suggest that unexplained renal colic in older men may be caused by primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumours.

pmid-3013398.summary_ja: 父と息子2人が原発性悪性精巣腫瘍を発症した家系を報告。父は両側セミノーマ、長男は奇形腫（セミノーマと胎児性癌成分を含む）、次男は純粋セミノーマであった。家族歴は潜在精巣とは独立した精巣がんのリスク因子となりうるとし、男性近親者の積極的なフォローアップを提唱している。
pmid-3013398.summary_en: Reports a family in which a father and two sons developed primary malignant testicular tumors, the 17th father-son case in the literature. The father had bilateral seminomas; the eldest son had testicular teratoma with seminoma and embryonal carcinoma elements; the second son had pure seminoma. None had cryptorchidism, trauma, or hernia. The authors argue family history may be an independent risk factor for testicular cancer and advocate aggressive follow-up of male relatives.

pmid-3015368.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎420例を対象に、予防的化学療法の有効性を5～15年追跡した研究。続発性絨毛性疾患の発生は化学療法群7.5％、対照群18.1％で、予防により減少した。絨毛癌は両群とも2例ずつ発生し、完全には防げなかった。化学療法の合併症は27.3％に認められたが、重篤な毒性や死亡はなかった。
pmid-3015368.summary_en: Evaluates prophylactic chemotherapy in 420 patients with molar pregnancy, followed for 5 to 15 years after evacuation. Secondary trophoblastic disease developed in 7.5% of treated patients versus 18.1% of controls, so prophylaxis reduced its occurrence. Choriocarcinoma developed in two patients in each group, so prophylaxis did not eliminate it. Chemotherapy complications occurred in 27.3% without severe toxicity or deaths.

pmid-3015699.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌2例がメトトレキサート治療に不応で、併用化学療法を要した。37例を後方視的に解析し、Bagshawe、Goldstein、オランダの3つのスコアリング系で初回メトトレキサート治療の失敗を予測する能力を比較した。Bagshaweとオランダ系の特異度は88％、92％。Goldstein系は感度が最も低かったが特異度は高かった。
pmid-3015699.summary_en: Two patients with gestational choriocarcinoma failed methotrexate and required combination chemotherapy. To predict methotrexate response, the authors retrospectively compared three scoring systems (Bagshawe, Goldstein, and the Dutch simplified system) in 37 patients. Bagshawe's and the Dutch system predicted treatment failure in 8 and 6 of 13 failures, with specificity of 88% and 92%. Goldstein's system was least sensitive but very specific.

pmid-3016346.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍120例の後方視的検討。原発巣の進展（血管侵襲、精索への進展など）が転移を予測するかを評価した。病理学的病期の進行に伴い転移率は91～97％。臨床病期Aで血管侵襲を伴う例の84％に播種が生じ、伴わない例では23％であった。待機的管理への示唆を論じている。
pmid-3016346.summary_en: A retrospective review of 120 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors examined whether local extent of the primary tumor predicts metastatic disease. Increasing pathological primary stage, including vascular and spermatic cord invasion, was associated with metastases in 91 to 97% of patients. Among clinical stage A tumors, 84% with vascular invasion disseminated versus 23% without. Tumor size was not predictive. The authors discuss implications for expectant management.

pmid-3016631.summary_ja: 10歳女児の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（ディスジャーミノーマ、絨毛癌、未熟奇形腫）と、傍大動脈リンパ節への純粋絨毛癌転移の症例報告。初回のビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシンに、交差耐性のない併用療法を追加した。30か月間無病生存を得た。同様の既報の生存例はないとしている。
pmid-3016631.summary_en: Case report of a 10-year-old girl with an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor (dysgerminoma, choriocarcinoma, immature teratoma) and pure choriocarcinoma paraaortic lymph node metastasis. After initial vinblastine-cisplatin-bleomycin, non-cross-resistant combinations of vinblastine-Adriamycin and vinblastine-actinomycin D-cyclophosphamide were added to prevent resistant cell colonies. She remained disease-free for 30 months. The authors note no previously reported survivals in such cases.

pmid-3017112.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者38例を正常対照と比較し、リンパ球サブセットとNK細胞活性を検討した研究です。患者ではT細胞系の絶対数が有意に低下し、高リスク群ではヘルパーT細胞とサプレッサー細胞傷害性T細胞の比が低下していました。これらの指標は化学療法への反応予測には有用ではありませんでした。
pmid-3017112.summary_en: This 1986 study compared lymphocyte subsets and natural killer cell activity in 38 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia against normal controls. Total lymphocytes, T cells, helper T cells, and suppressor-cytotoxic T cells were significantly lower in patients, and high-risk patients had a reduced helper-to-suppressor ratio. B-cell counts and NK activity did not differ. The parameters did not predict response to chemotherapy.

pmid-3017457.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来のTera I、Tera II細胞株でras遺伝子ファミリーを解析した研究です。両株でc-Ki-ras-2が約10倍に増幅していましたが、c-Ha-ras-1とN-rasには構造変化はありませんでした。コドン12の点突然変異は検出されず、両株でPvu II部位の消失を伴うDNA再構成が認められました。
pmid-3017457.summary_en: This 1986 study analyzed the ras gene family in two human teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines, Tera I and Tera II, using restriction digestion and Southern blotting. The authors found a ten-fold amplification of c-Ki-ras-2 in both lines, with no structural change in c-Ha-ras-1 or N-ras. No point mutation at codon 12 was detected, but a DNA rearrangement involving loss of a Pvu II site was found in both cell lines.

pmid-3017721.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍184例（セミノーマ92例、非セミノーマ性92例）で乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)を測定した研究です。LDH上昇は病期や腫瘍量とともに増加し、化学療法中の推移や再発例の評価にも有用でした。LDHはαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やβ-hCGを補完する腫瘍マーカーとして有用とされています。
pmid-3017721.summary_en: This 1986 study measured total lactate dehydrogenase in 184 patients with testicular germ cell tumours, including 92 seminomas and 92 non-seminomatous tumours. Elevation rose with stage and tumour bulk in both histologies. LDH levels tracked regression or progression during chemotherapy and were elevated in many relapsing patients. The authors conclude that LDH complements AFP and beta-hCG in managing these tumours.

pmid-3017799.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞NTERA-2 cl. D1に対し、レチノイン酸以外の薬剤による分化誘導を検討した研究です。酪酸やcAMPなどでは分化は誘導されず、BUdR、HMBA、DMSOなどでは神経細胞への分化が見られました。BUdR、IUdR、HMBA、DMAはヒトサイトメガロウイルス(HCMV)が増殖できる細胞も誘導しました。
pmid-3017799.summary_en: This 1986 study tested agents other than retinoic acid for inducing differentiation of NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. Butyrate, cAMP, cisplatin and TPA did not induce differentiation, while retinol, BUdR, IUdR, HMBA, DMA and DMSO induced neuronal differentiation to varying degrees. BUdR, IUdR, HMBA and DMA also generated HCMV-permissive cells, which differed from those induced by retinoic acid.

pmid-3019056.summary_ja: 妊娠女性と胞状奇胎・絨毛癌患者の尿中hCGについて、レクチン親和性を比較した研究です。妊娠例では90%以上のhCGがレンズマメレクチンカラムに結合しましたが、絨毛性腫瘍例では未吸着の割合が高くなりました。レクチンアフィニティクロマトグラフィーは妊娠と絨毛性腫瘍の鑑別診断に寄与する可能性があります。
pmid-3019056.summary_en: This 1986 study compared lectin affinity of urinary hCG from pregnant women with that from patients with hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma. Over 90% of hCG in pregnancy bound to the lentil lectin column, whereas much of the trophoblastic tumour hCG was unbound. The authors suggest lectin affinity chromatography may aid differential diagnosis between pregnancy and trophoblastic tumours. Unbound hCG from choriocarcinoma patients retained in vivo biological activity.

pmid-3019076.summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形癌と広範な転移を有した28歳男性の剖検例です。両精巣は臨床的に小さく腫瘤は触知されませんでしたが、右精巣の病理組織学的検査で、セルトリ細胞のみ症候群の背景に初期の胚細胞腫瘍が認められました。異型胚細胞は一部の精細管に限局し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の起源であるという考えを支持する所見とされています。
pmid-3019076.summary_en: This autopsy case report describes a 28-year-old man with retroperitoneal teratocarcinoma and widespread metastases. Both testes were clinically small, but histology of the right testis revealed an incipient germ cell tumour within Sertoli-cell-only syndrome. Atypical germ cells were confined to a few tubules, some showing seminoma-like intratubular growth and syncytiotrophoblast-like giant cells. The findings support atypical germ cells as the origin of testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-3019502.summary_ja: オンタリオ州がん登録データを用いて、1964～1982年の精巣胚細胞腫瘍による組織型別死亡率を算出した集団ベースの研究です。非セミノーマの死亡率は全期間でセミノーマを上回りました。1976年以降は両者とも約50%低下し、シスプラチンの導入時期と一致しています。全体の死亡率低下は主に非セミノーマによるものでした。
pmid-3019502.summary_en: This population-based study used Ontario Cancer Registry data from 1964 to 1982 to calculate death rates from seminoma and nonseminoma testicular germ cell cancer. Nonseminoma mortality exceeded seminoma mortality throughout. Both declined about 50% after 1976, coinciding with cisplatin's introduction, and the decline in overall mortality was mainly due to nonseminoma. The authors note a concerning rise in overall rates between 1980 and 1984.

pmid-3019779.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例を、精巣摘除術のみで治療し、腫瘍マーカーとCTによる密な監視を行った研究である。7例(21%)に転移が生じ、いずれも術後6か月以内に診断された。再発例の残存腫瘤には壊死と成熟奇形腫がみられた。全例が12～38か月の追跡で生存しており、監視療法の有効性が示唆された。
pmid-3019779.summary_en: This 1986 study followed 33 patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor managed by orchidectomy alone, using frequent tumor marker assays and CT surveillance. Metastases developed in 7 patients (21%), all within six months of surgery, mostly in para-aortic nodes. Six relapsed patients received PVB chemotherapy, and one refused. Residual masses showed necrosis and mature teratoma. All 33 patients remained alive after 12 to 38 months of follow-up, suggesting surveillance can be a viable strategy.

pmid-3020061.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の患者45例を検討し、9例(20%)に上大静脈症候群が認められた研究である。全例が男性で平均年齢は27歳であった。成熟奇形腫を除く全組織型で本症候群がみられた。若年男性の縦隔腫瘤と上大静脈症候群では、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べられている。
pmid-3020061.summary_en: This 1986 study reviewed 45 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors and found superior vena caval syndrome in nine (20%). All patients were male, with an average age of 27. The syndrome occurred with every histologic type except mature teratoma. The authors advise considering primary mediastinal germ cell tumor in young men presenting with a mediastinal mass and superior vena caval syndrome, as a practical diagnostic clue.

pmid-3020319.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存病変から奇形腫を切除された精巣または縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍51例の長期成績である。60%が再発を認めなかった。縦隔原発、非胚細胞成分を伴う未熟奇形腫、腫瘍量が再発の予測因子であり、多変量解析では縦隔原発が不良な生存の予測因子であった。完全切除と高リスク例への密なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-3020319.summary_en: This 1986 series examined 51 patients with testicular or mediastinal germ cell tumors who underwent resection of teratoma from residual disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Thirty patients (60%) remained relapse-free. Mediastinal primary site, immature teratoma with non-germ cell elements, and tumor burden predicted relapse, and mediastinal site predicted poor survival on multivariate analysis. Complete surgical excision is recommended, with close follow-up for high-risk patients.

pmid-3021889.summary_ja: 南テムズおよびロサンゼルスのがん登録データを用い、精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍男性の出生月を検討した疫学研究である。4～5月に出生ピークがあるとの先行報告を検証した。奇形腫に限られた8月のわずかなピークが認められたが、効果は小さく一貫性がなく、病因の手がかりは得られなかった。
pmid-3021889.summary_en: This epidemiologic study examined birth month among men with malignant germ cell tumors of the testis, using South Thames and Los Angeles cancer registry data. It was prompted by a report of an April-May birth peak in testis cancer. The authors found a slight August peak confined to teratomas, but the effects were small and inconsistent and offered no clear clue to etiology.

pmid-3022018.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍16例に対し、化学療法後に遅延精巣摘除術を行った1986年の研究。完全寛解13例のうち3例で精巣内に生存腫瘍が残存し、原発巣と転移巣で反応が異なることを示した。疑わしい精巣原発病変には化学療法後の精巣摘除術が必要であり、切除標本の病理所見は全身反応を反映しないと結論づけている。
pmid-3022018.summary_en: This 1986 study examined 16 patients with advanced germ cell cancer who underwent delayed orchiectomy after initial chemotherapy. Thirteen had complete and three partial remission. Three of the 13 complete responders had viable tumor persisting in the testis, while one early relapse occurred among the rest. The findings showed that germ cell tumors respond differently at primary and metastatic sites, supporting post-chemotherapy orchiectomy for suspicious testicular primaries, since the resected pathology does not reflect the systemic response.

pmid-3022907.summary_ja: 小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌89例を後方視的に解析した1986年の報告。生存率は年次とともに改善し、精巣腫瘍は予後良好であった。新生児期以降の仙尾部腫瘍も比較的予後が良く、新生児の良性仙尾部奇形腫を尾骨切除せず切除した場合は卵黄嚢腫瘍として再発すると予後不良であった。縦隔腫瘍は女性に多い。
pmid-3022907.summary_en: This 1986 Pediatric Oncology Group review analyzed 89 children with yolk sac tumor or embryonal carcinoma, many associated with teratomas. Survival improved over time across sites. Testicular tumors had excellent survival regardless of age or embryonal carcinoma. Sacrococcygeal tumors diagnosed after the neonatal period had a better prognosis, while neonatal benign sacrococcygeal teratomas resected without coccygectomy had poor outcomes when recurring as yolk sac tumor. Mediastinal tumors occurred in females.

pmid-3022908.summary_ja: シスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法を受けた転移性悪性胚細胞腫瘍79例の1986年の報告。化学療法歴のない患者の5年生存率は69%、既治療患者は32%であった。治療後の成熟奇形腫は数年後に再活性化しうるため完全切除が望ましい。主な長期後遺症はレイノー様現象と消化器症状であった。
pmid-3022908.summary_en: This 1986 study reviewed 79 patients with metastatic malignant germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Median survival was 66 months among 43 survivors, with 5-year survival of 69% in untreated patients versus 32% in those previously chemotherapy-treated. Favorable factors included limited disease and complete response. Posttreatment mature teratoma should be completely resected because it can reactivate malignancy years later. Long-term sequelae were mainly Raynaud-like phenomena and gastrointestinal problems.

pmid-3027934.summary_ja: 1962年から1983年にフィンランド北部で診断された悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患26例を検討した。内訳は絨毛癌8例と侵入奇胎18例で、11例は転移例であった。初期には化学療法に手術や放射線療法を併用することが多く、後期は主に化学療法のみで治療された。全例が無病生存し、6例が出産している。小規模施設でも治療は可能と結論している。
pmid-3027934.summary_en: This Finnish study reviewed 26 patients with malignant trophoblastic disease diagnosed from 1962 to 1983 in northern Finland, including 8 choriocarcinomas and 18 invasive moles. Eleven patients had metastatic disease. Early treatment often combined single-agent chemotherapy with surgery or irradiation, while later cases relied mainly on single- or multidrug chemotherapy. All patients survived disease-free, and six later had children. The authors conclude that such disease can be treated successfully even in small gynecologic oncology centers.

pmid-3030577.summary_ja: 完全奇胎と妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の免疫生物学を総説している。完全奇胎はすべて父性由来の染色体を持つため、患者は父性HLA抗原に感作されると論じている。絨毛癌は組織適合性があると増悪しやすいが、必須ではない。γインターフェロンは絨毛癌細胞のHLA発現を高める。奇胎の栄養膜は正常胎盤栄養膜と同様の腫瘍胎児性抗原パターンを示す。
pmid-3030577.summary_en: This review examines the immunobiology of complete molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic tumor. Complete moles act as a paternal-HLA allograft that sensitizes patients, and choriocarcinoma may be favored by histocompatibility but does not require it. Interferon-gamma enhances HLA expression on choriocarcinoma cells. Molar trophoblast shares oncofetal antigen expression patterns with normal placental trophoblast, which can help assess trophoblastic differentiation. The authors outline recent advances and suggest directions for future research.

pmid-3030714.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎、絨毛癌および持続性絨毛性疾患の患者で、血清リラキシンとヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の推移を検討した。治療前のリラキシン値は正常妊娠より低いものの検出可能で、黄体が主な供給源と考えられた。両者は病経過中に平行して変化し、黄体の存在下でリラキシン分泌がhCG刺激に依存することが示唆された。
pmid-3030714.summary_en: This study measured serum relaxin and hCG levels over time in patients with invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and persistent trophoblastic disease. Pretreatment relaxin levels were detectable but significantly lower than in normal pregnancy. Two patients who underwent laparotomy had a corpus luteum, suggesting it is the main source of circulating relaxin in these conditions. Relaxin and hCG changed in parallel during the disease course, indicating that relaxin secretion depends on hCG stimulation in the presence of a corpus luteum.

pmid-3031967.summary_ja: 原発性の悪性子宮病変を認めない若いナイジェリア人女性2例が、絨毛癌からの転移性浸潤による大量血尿と腎腫大で発症した症例報告。絨毛癌が腎転移として初めて発見されうる、まれな提示様式であることを強調している。
pmid-3031967.summary_en: This case report describes two young Nigerian women who presented with profuse hematuria and renal enlargement caused by metastatic infiltration from choriocarcinoma. Neither had a primary malignant uterine lesion, which made the renal presentation unusual. The authors highlight the rarity of this mode of presentation, emphasizing that choriocarcinoma can first manifest as renal metastasis when no uterine primary is identifiable.

pmid-3082808.summary_ja: 1961～1981年にインディアナ大学で放射線療法を受けた純粋精巣セミノーマ54例の後方視的解析。全体の生存率は87%で、病期Iでは91%だった。巨視的病変には3500～4000 radの線量が必要と考えられ、縦隔照射例で縦隔再発はなかった。再発例の救済は8例中1例にとどまり、救済療法による毒性死も認められた。
pmid-3082808.summary_en: This retrospective review of 54 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with megavoltage irradiation at Indiana University (1961-1981) reports an overall survival of 87%. Survival was 91% for stage I and lower in advanced stages. Stage I disease was controlled at 2500 rad, while macroscopic disease in stage II required 3500-4000 rad for control. All stage II and III patients received mediastinal irradiation, and none recurred in the mediastinum. Salvage was achieved in only one of eight recurrences, and toxicity from salvage therapy caused deaths.

pmid-3082827.summary_ja: 胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)特異的モノクローナル抗体を用い、ヒト絨毛癌異種移植片のγシンチグラフィによる検出を検討した。抗体は正常組織より腫瘍に集積し、直径0.3cm未満の腫瘍も描出できた。画像強度はPLAP含有量とよく相関し、抗体を用いた絨毛癌の画像診断の可能性を示した。
pmid-3082827.summary_en: Using a placental alkaline phosphatase-specific monoclonal antibody, 11-D-10, the authors evaluated radioimmunodetection of human choriocarcinoma xenografts in athymic mice. The radiolabeled antibody accumulated preferentially in tumor tissue relative to normal tissues, with tumor-to-blood ratios rising from 1.38 at day 2 to 2.51 at day 5, whereas control IgM remained low. Tumors smaller than 0.3 cm were clearly imaged by gamma-scintigraphy, and image strength correlated with PLAP content. The study supports antibody-based imaging of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3087451.summary_ja: セミノーマで精巣摘除術を受けた男性29例について、放射線療法の前後で精子数とホルモン値を調べた研究です。治療前から半数以上で精子形成が障害されていました。精子数は照射1年後に最低となり2年にかけて回復しました。FSHは1年後に上昇し、約半数は3年以内に正常化しました。FSH上昇は治療前の値と相関し、照射線量とは相関せず、妊孕性低下は主に治療前の障害に起因すると示唆されています。
pmid-3087451.summary_en: This study examined sperm production and reproductive hormones in 29 men with seminoma after orchiectomy, before and after radiotherapy. Most had impaired spermatogenesis before treatment, with pretreatment sperm counts below 3 million/ml predicting poorer recovery. Sperm counts reached a minimum one year after irradiation and improved by two years. Testosterone stayed low-normal, and FSH rose at one year, normalizing in about half of patients by three years. The FSH rise correlated with pretreatment FSH, not with the small gonadal dose, suggesting that baseline impairment mainly determines later fertility loss.

pmid-3089974.summary_ja: 乳児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍におけるテストステロンを免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。検討した16例すべてで陽性でした。陽性細胞はライディッヒ細胞様の原始間葉系細胞とセルトリ細胞様の管腔形成円柱細胞で、腫瘍細胞の約1〜20%を占め、典型的な卵黄嚢構造と混在していました。成人の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍では陽性例はありませんでした。胚細胞と性索・間質成分の混合から成る独立した疾患単位と結論づけられています。
pmid-3089974.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined testosterone in yolk sac tumors of the infant testis. All 16 tested cases were positive, with testosterone found in primitive mesenchymal cells resembling Leydig cells and columnar duct-forming cells resembling Sertoli cells. These made up about 1 to 20 percent of tumor cells, intermingled with typical yolk sac structures. Adult testicular yolk sac tumors showed no such positivity. The authors conclude that infant yolk sac tumor is a distinct entity, combining germ cell and sex cord-stromal elements, based on its histology, immunophenotype, and clinical behavior.

pmid-3091820.summary_ja: XY核型を有する表現型女性9例を、臨床、細胞遺伝学、ホルモン、内視鏡、組織学的に評価した研究です。XY性腺異形成が5例、精巣性女性化症候群が4例でした。性腺異形成の2例で性腺芽腫が見つかりました。Y染色体を有しゴナドトロピンが高値の患者では、悪性化を防ぐため早期の両側性腺摘除が推奨されています。精巣性女性化症候群では悪性化リスクが低いため、思春期終了まで摘除を遅らせるべきとされています。
pmid-3091820.summary_en: This report describes nine phenotypic females with an XY karyotype, evaluated with clinical, cytogenetic, hormonal, endoscopic, and histologic protocols. Five had XY gonadal dysgenesis and four had testicular feminization. Gonadoblastomas were found in two patients with gonadal dysgenesis. Elevated FSH and LH supported dysgenesis, and laparoscopic gonadal biopsy helped distinguish it from feminization. The authors recommend early bilateral gonadectomy in patients with a Y chromosome and elevated gonadotropins because of malignancy risk. Gonadectomy in testicular feminization should be delayed until puberty ends due to low malignancy risk.

pmid-3093094.summary_ja: 129系由来のマウス胚細胞腫瘍モデルである402AX奇形癌は、MHCクラスI抗原を発現しません。抵抗性宿主では腫瘍細胞が129型のMHCクラスI抗原を発現します。本研究は、脾臓のLyt 1、Lyt 2、L3T4陽性T細胞が生体内でこの発現を制御し、その分化には抵抗性の宿主環境が必要であることを示しています。腫瘍に感作したT細胞は移植片対宿主病を起こし、マイナー組織適合抗原への反応が腫瘍免疫に関与することが示唆されています。
pmid-3093094.summary_en: The 402AX murine teratocarcinoma, a germ cell tumor model of 129-strain origin, lacks MHC class I antigens. In genetically resistant hosts, tumor cells induce 129-type MHC class I expression. This study shows that splenic Lyt 1, Lyt 2, and L3T4-expressing T cells regulate this expression in vivo and need a resistant host environment to differentiate. T cells primed against the tumor and transferred into susceptible mice caused graft-versus-host disease, suggesting that tumor immunity involves reactivity to minor histocompatibility antigens.

pmid-3093106.summary_ja: 129系由来の自然発生精巣腫瘍である402AX奇形癌は、MHC抗原を発現しません。腫瘍で感作された抵抗性マウスの血清が、in vitroで腫瘍細胞のMHC抗原発現を誘導することを間接免疫蛍光法で示しました。誘導因子は402AX細胞に特異的で、インターフェロンではありません。インターフェロン非依存性の可溶性因子が腫瘍細胞のMHCクラスI発現を誘導しうることを示しています。
pmid-3093106.summary_en: The 402AX murine teratocarcinoma, a spontaneous testicular tumor of 129 origin, does not express MHC antigens. This study shows that serum from tumor-primed resistant mice induces MHC antigen expression on tumor cells in vitro, measured by indirect immunofluorescence. The inducing factor is specific to 402AX cells and is not interferon, because the tumor did not respond to gamma interferon and inducer serum had little interferon activity. The work identifies a distinct interferon-independent soluble factor that can induce MHC class I expression on tumor cells.

pmid-3094216.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者253例を最長27年間、定期的な胸部X線検査で追跡した。無症候性の胸腔内転移の発見率は1年以降で低く、発見1件あたりの費用は極めて高額であった。そのため初回治療後1年を超える胸部X線フォローアップは推奨されず、病期IIAおよびIIBでは妥当性が示唆された。
pmid-3094216.summary_en: This report analyzes 253 patients with testicular seminoma followed by periodic chest X-ray for up to 27 years. Asymptomatic intrathoracic metastases were detected at low rates after the first year, and the cost per detected metastasis rose steeply. The authors conclude that chest X-ray follow-up is not advisable beyond one year after primary treatment. In Stage I disease the yield is low and costly, whereas follow-up appears reasonable in Stages IIA and IIB.

pmid-3095284.summary_ja: ラットで胎仔摘出により卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、奇形腫を誘導する条件を検討した。腫瘍が生じたのは妊娠7日目から14日目の摘出のみで、卵黄嚢腫瘍の発生にはRT1（主要組織適合複合体）の適合が必要であった。妊娠10日目に摘出した担癌ラットの平均生存期間は116日であった。腫瘍径は摘出時期により異なった。
pmid-3095284.summary_en: The authors established an experimental rat model of yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma induced by fetectomy (removal of fetuses). Tumor induction was possible only when fetectomy was performed between gestational days 7 and 14, and RT1 major histocompatibility complex compatibility was required for YST development. About 39% of fetectomized rats developed YST in one mating combination. Mean survival of tumor-bearing rats fetectomized on day 10 was 116 days, and tumor size varied with the timing of fetectomy.

pmid-3095378.summary_ja: 手術で確認された良性縦隔奇形腫11例の超音波像を検討した。嚢胞性奇形腫8例は、充実性・複合性・嚢胞性の像を示し、嚢胞内容が漿液性か非漿液性かで超音波パターンが異なった。漿液性では嚢胞として描出され、非漿液性や皮脂様内容では充実性・複合性となった。
pmid-3095378.summary_en: Real-time sonograms of 11 surgically proven benign mediastinal teratomas were reviewed. Eight cystic teratomas appeared as complex, solid, or cystic masses, and their echo pattern depended on whether the cyst fluid was serous. Serous fluid produced a purely cystic appearance, while nonserous or sebaceous content appeared solid or complex. The three solid teratomas contained small cysts and appeared complex. The study highlights how ultrasonography can characterize these mediastinal tumors.

pmid-3095892.summary_ja: 1970年から1984年に放射線療法を受けた病期II精巣セミノーマ53例を検討した。再発率は17%で、IIA、IIB、IICの順に上昇した。横隔膜上照射は横隔膜下照射と比べて有利ではなかった。残存腫瘤は予後を予測しなかった。IICでは放射線療法の改良による改善は難しく、化学療法が選択されるべきと示唆された。
pmid-3095892.summary_en: This study reviewed 53 patients with Stage II testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy between 1970 and 1984. Relapse occurred in 17%, with rates increasing from IIA to IIC. Supradiaphragmatic irradiation offered no advantage over infradiaphragmatic treatment. Residual masses persisted in many IIC patients but did not predict outcome. Elevated hCG did not influence results. The authors suggest that further refinement of radiotherapy is unlikely to improve IIC outcomes, and chemotherapy may be preferred.

pmid-3095923.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で神経様細胞へ分化する胎児性癌細胞株でpp60c-src発現を解析した。神経突起形成と神経特異的タンパク質発現の時期に、pp60c-srcは8〜20倍に増加した。誘導されたタンパク質はアミノ末端の変化により移動度が異なり、発生中の神経細胞のc-srcに類似していた。この細胞株は、神経分化におけるsrcタンパク質の機能研究に有用なモデルとなる。
pmid-3095923.summary_en: The authors examined pp60c-src expression in an embryonal carcinoma cell line that differentiates into neuron-like cells after retinoic acid treatment. The levels of pp60c-src rose 8- to 20-fold during neurite outgrowth and neuron-specific protein expression. The induced protein showed altered electrophoretic mobility due to changes in its amino-terminal region, resembling c-src in developing neurons. The findings suggest this cell line is a useful model for studying src protein function in neuronal differentiation.

pmid-3096321.summary_ja: オルニチン脱炭酸酵素阻害剤であるα-ジフルオロメチルオルニチン（DFMO）は、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株を試験管内で分化させた。分化細胞は形態、生化学的性質、細胞表面抗原により未分化細胞と区別された。細胞内ポリアミン量の変化が分化に関与し、ヒト胚発生にも関わる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-3096321.summary_en: This study shows that alpha-difluoromethylornithine, an ornithine decarboxylase inhibitor, induces differentiation in a human embryonal carcinoma cell line in vitro. Differentiated cells were distinguished from undifferentiated cells by morphology, biochemical properties, and cell surface antigens. The authors propose that changes in intracellular polyamine levels may contribute to embryonal carcinoma differentiation and possibly human embryogenesis. The cell line is suggested as a model for early human development.

pmid-3098566.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌異種移植マウスで、抗hCGモノクローナル抗体にDTPAまたはTTHAを結合させた111In標識体の体内分布を比較した。両結合体は肝臓と脾臓に高い集積を示した。DTPA結合体は腫瘍対組織比が最も高く、画像診断薬として最も有用と考えられた。ただし腫瘍対血液比は低く、バックグラウンドの補正が必要とされた。
pmid-3098566.summary_en: The authors compared the biodistribution of 111In-labeled antibody conjugates, using DTPA or TTHA chelators linked to a monoclonal anti-hCG antibody, in mice bearing human choriocarcinoma xenografts. Both conjugates accumulated strongly in the liver and spleen. The TTHA conjugate and 111In-citrate showed elevated femur uptake. The DTPA conjugate gave the highest tumor-to-tissue ratios, though its tumor-to-blood ratio was lower. The authors suggest the DTPA conjugate is most useful for imaging but would need background subtraction.

pmid-3330275.summary_ja: 乳幼児および小児における原発性悪性精巣腫瘍を概説している。多くは胚細胞由来である。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGが診断と管理に有用であり、疑わしい腫瘍は高位鼠径切開で外科的に評価すべきとされる。卵黄嚢腫瘍の一部には術後化学療法が推奨され、多くの患者は長期の無再発生存が可能である。
pmid-3330275.summary_en: A review of primary malignant testicular tumors in infants and children, which are uncommon and most often of germ cell origin. Serum AFP and beta-hCG levels aid diagnosis and management, and all suspected tumors should be surgically evaluated through a high inguinal incision. Postoperative chemotherapy is advised for some yolk sac tumors and for all embryonal rhabdomyosarcomas. Most patients with malignant testicular tumors achieve prolonged relapse-free survival.

pmid-3332015.summary_ja: 活性化ヒトc-Ha-ras遺伝子を導入したマウス受精卵から、奇形癌に類似した腫瘍が生じた。組織学的に内胚葉、中胚葉、胚体外外胚葉由来の細胞を含んでいた。初期胚発生の段階で生じたと考えられ、活性化rasと奇形癌形成の関連を示唆する。胚細胞腫瘍の動物モデルとして意義がある。
pmid-3332015.summary_en: Transgenic mouse experiments introduced normal or activated human c-Ha-ras DNA into zygotes. Among the resulting abnormal embryos, two tumors formed, one after injection of activated ras DNA. Histology showed tissue from endoderm, mesoderm, and extra-embryonic ectoderm, resembling teratocarcinoma. The authors suggest these tumors arose from very early embryonic development, linking activated ras to teratocarcinoma formation in mice.

pmid-3457202.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌およびセミノーマ由来のα-L-フコシダーゼを等電点電気泳動で解析し、マウス胚細胞腫瘍由来幹細胞と比較した。ヒト腫瘍の酵素は正常組織に近い等電点（pI約4.5～7）を示し、マウス胚性細胞で優勢な塩基性アイソフォームは認められなかった。マウスのEC細胞はヒトの腫瘍細胞を完全には再現しないと結論づけられた。
pmid-3457202.summary_en: Isoelectric focusing profiles of alpha-L-fucosidase from human embryonal carcinoma and seminoma were compared with mouse germ cell tumor-derived stem cells and somatic neoplasms. Human tumors showed isoforms in the acidic-to-neutral range (pI about 4.5 to 7), similar to normal tissue, while the basic forms prominent in mouse embryonic cells were absent. The authors conclude that mouse EC cells do not fully replicate human tumor cells for this enzyme.

pmid-3458626.summary_ja: 無多能性のF9細胞および多能性のP19胎児性癌細胞とその分化誘導細胞を用い、PMAの作用を検討した。PMAはEC細胞の増殖を抑制し、分化細胞では増殖を促進した。またP19細胞ではレチノイン酸による分化を増強した。内胚葉様細胞ではホルボールエステル受容体とプロテインキナーゼC活性が上昇し、EGF結合が阻害された。
pmid-3458626.summary_en: Phorbol ester PMA was studied in nullipotent F9 and pluripotent P19 embryonal carcinoma cell lines and their differentiated derivatives. PMA inhibited EC cell growth but was mitogenic in differentiated cells, and potentiated retinoic acid-induced differentiation only in P19 cells. Phorbol ester receptor and protein kinase C activity increased in endoderm-like derivatives, and PMA inhibited EGF binding in those cells, suggesting a link between receptor expression and cell behavior.

pmid-3459156.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤および3種類の絨毛癌細胞株における胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ（ALPase）の発現を検討した研究。in vitro翻訳、RNAブロット解析、胎盤cDNAライブラリーを用いてALPaseのcDNAクローンを単離した。胎盤は3.0 kbのmRNAを発現し、絨毛癌細胞は異なる2.6 kbの転写産物を発現した。これは栄養膜の悪性転化に、特有の胎盤型ALPase転写産物とタンパク質産物の発現が関連することを示唆している。
pmid-3459156.summary_en: This study examined expression of placental-type alkaline phosphatase (ALPase) in human placenta and three choriocarcinoma cell lines. Using in vitro translation, RNA blot analysis, and a placental cDNA library, the authors isolated cDNA clones for placental ALPase. Placenta expressed a 3.0 kb mRNA, whereas choriocarcinoma cells expressed a distinct 2.6 kb transcript that yielded an intermediate-sized polypeptide. The findings suggest that malignant transformation of trophoblast is associated with expression of a distinct placental ALPase transcript and protein product.

pmid-3461569.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍について、卵黄嚢腫瘍が主体で成人の精巣がんとは性質が異なることを概説した報告である。根治的精巣摘除術で十分とされ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清や放射線療法、予防的化学療法の生存改善効果の根拠は乏しいと述べている。注意深いフォローアップにより転移性疾患や再発を早期に発見し、化学療法を開始できる。9例中8例が無病生存しており予後は良好である。
pmid-3461569.summary_en: This review describes testicular tumours in children, emphasizing that yolk sac tumour is the predominant childhood type and differs from adult testicular cancer. Based on a series of nine yolk sac tumour patients, the authors argue that radical orchidectomy is adequate surgery, with little evidence that retroperitoneal node dissection, radiotherapy, or prophylactic chemotherapy improves survival. Careful follow-up allows early detection of metastatic disease or recurrence, enabling prompt chemotherapy. Overall prognosis is good, with eight of nine patients surviving disease-free.

pmid-3462563.summary_ja: 1971年から1985年にニュージーランドのワイカト女性病院で診断された61例の胞状奇胎を対象とした後方視的研究。分娩700例に1例の発生率であった。1980年に標準化された監視が導入された後、血清β-hCGでモニタリングした29例のうち、古典的奇胎の15%が持続性の絨毛活性のため化学療法を要したが、部分奇胎では該当例がなかった。組織学的に証明された奇胎後絨毛癌は記録されなかった。
pmid-3462563.summary_en: This retrospective study of 61 hydatidiform moles diagnosed at Waikato Women's Hospital (New Zealand) from 1971 to 1985 reports an incidence of 1 in 700 deliveries. After a National Trophoblastic Disease Register and standardized surveillance were introduced in 1980, follow-up completeness improved. Among 29 patients monitored with serum beta-hCG, 15% of classic moles and none of the partial moles required chemotherapy for persistent trophoblastic activity. No histologically proven postmolar choriocarcinoma was recorded.

pmid-3467319.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARが分泌するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の翻訳後修飾を解析した基礎研究である。遊離α鎖は細胞内外ともにリン酸化され、αβ二量体のリン酸化は翻訳後プロセシングの後期に起こると考えられた。ホルボールエステルによりリン酸化が促進され、リン酸化部位はセリンとスレオニン残基であった。
pmid-3467319.summary_en: This study examines phosphorylation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) secreted by the JAR choriocarcinoma cell line. Both intracellular and secreted free alpha subunits were phosphorylated, whereas phosphorylation of the secreted alpha-beta dimer appeared to be a late post-translational event. Phorbol ester markedly stimulated free alpha-subunit phosphorylation, and in vitro kinase assays favored the uncombined alpha subunit. Phosphorylation occurred on serine and threonine residues.

pmid-3485347.summary_ja: 進行期純粋セミノーマの化学療法後のリンパ節転移について、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の経時変化を18例で検討した。完全消失4例、部分消失12例と大半の腫瘤は縮小した。残存する腫瘤の多くは線維化であり、他に病変のない患者では外科的切除を要しないと結論づけている。
pmid-3485347.summary_en: Serial CT findings of nodal metastases from pure seminoma treated with chemotherapy were evaluated in 18 patients. Half of presenting masses had low-attenuation areas without calcification. After chemotherapy, four masses resolved completely, 12 partially, and one was unchanged; one patient died of progressive liver metastases. Pathology of residual masses in four patients showed only fibrosis. Persistent residual masses after advanced seminoma chemotherapy usually represent fibrosis and do not require surgical excision.

pmid-3491893.summary_ja: 乳児、とくに男児に稀にみられる胃奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビューです。内向型の亜型が消化管出血を来しうることが示されました。年齢や腫瘍の肉眼所見、出血の有無は悪性を示すものではなく、良性疾患であることを強調しています。単純切除で十分な治療になると結論づけています。
pmid-3491893.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes gastric teratoma, a rare lesion seen most often in male infants. The authors found that the endophytic subtype can cause gastrointestinal bleeding. They emphasize that neither patient age, gross tumor appearance, nor the presence of bleeding indicates malignancy, since the condition is benign. Simple surgical excision is considered satisfactory treatment. The conclusions are based on their own case together with the existing published literature on this entity.

pmid-3498731.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌由来細胞株Tera-2のクローン培養を用い、上皮増殖因子（EGF）が細胞運動と増殖に与える影響を検討しました。EGFはコロニー径の拡大で示されるように遊走を促進しましたが、増殖にはほとんど影響しませんでした。EGFは胎児性癌細胞において増殖よりも遊走を優先的に促進すると結論づけています。
pmid-3498731.summary_en: This study examines how epidermal growth factor (EGF) affects clonal cultures of Tera-2, a human embryonal carcinoma-derived cell line. Cells were plated at clonal density, and locomotion and proliferation were measured with and without serum and EGF. EGF increased cell migration, shown by larger colony diameter, but rarely changed proliferation. The authors conclude that EGF preferentially promotes migration rather than growth in human embryonal carcinoma cells in vitro. The work offers insight into the behavior of germ cell tumor-derived cells.

pmid-3510280.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の男性胚細胞腫瘍30例を対象に、イホスファミド単剤の第II相試験を行いました。客観的奏効率は23%で、完全奏効1例と部分奏効6例が得られました。主な有害事象は血尿、悪心・嘔吐、好中球減少、腎毒性で、血尿は用量依存的でした。前治療歴の多い集団でも有効性が示されたと結論しています。
pmid-3510280.summary_en: This phase II trial tested single-agent ifosfamide in 30 men with cisplatin-refractory male germ cell tumors. Patients received 2 g/m2 for five days every three weeks, with N-acetylcysteine for uroprotection. The overall objective response rate was 23%, including one complete and six partial responses, and median response duration was 3.5 months. Hematuria, nausea, neutropenia, and nephrotoxicity were the main toxicities, and hematuria was dose-related. The authors conclude that ifosfamide is active in this heavily pretreated population.

pmid-3511087.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来細胞株Tera-2のクローンをレチノイン酸で処理し、in vitroでの分化を解析しました。増殖性の幹細胞はThy-1とN-CAM/D2-CAMを発現し、処理後には破傷風毒素受容体とA2B5受容体を獲得しました。3週間後には約3%の細胞が神経細胞様形態を示し、神経フィラメントを発現しました。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞が神経表現型へ分化しうることを示しています。
pmid-3511087.summary_en: This study examines in vitro differentiation of clones from the human teratoma cell line Tera-2 treated with retinoic acid. Proliferating stem cells expressed Thy-1 and N-CAM/D2-CAM, and treated cultures acquired tetanus toxin and A2B5 receptors. After three weeks, about 3% of cells showed neuron-like morphology and expressed neurofilament subunits. The authors show that this germ cell tumor-derived line can differentiate toward a neuronal phenotype. It provides an in vitro model of neural differentiation from malignant stem-like cells.

pmid-3511298.summary_ja: 1980年から1984年に陰嚢腫瘤249例に高分解能超音波検査を行った検討です。腫瘍が疑われた20例はすべて病理で確認されましたが、悪性は10例で偽陽性率は50%でした。精巣腫瘍は典型的に低エコーを示し、偽陽性病変の多くは良性でした。超音波所見のみで根治的精巣摘除術を一律に行うべきではなく、選択例では精巣温存生検も考慮されると結論づけています。
pmid-3511298.summary_en: This series evaluated high-resolution real-time ultrasound for scrotal masses in 249 patients studied from 1980 to 1984. Twenty scans suggested testicular neoplasm, all confirmed pathologically, but only half were malignant, giving a 50% false-positive rate. Neoplasms were typically hypoechoic, while false-positive lesions were mostly hypoechoic benign lesions. One false negative occurred. The authors argue that radical orchiectomy should not be performed indiscriminately for sonographically suspicious lesions, and that testis-sparing biopsy may be appropriate in selected cases.

pmid-3511301.summary_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマの1例で、一側は臨床的に触知せず超音波検査で初めて検出されました。両側精巣腫瘍は多くが逐次的に発見されるため、初診時の対側病変の検出に超音波スクリーニングが有用と考えられています。異時性の第二腫瘍が抱える問題と、同時診断例との違いも論じられています。
pmid-3511301.summary_en: This report describes simultaneous bilateral seminomas, with one tumor clinically occult and detected only by ultrasonography. Most bilateral testicular tumors are found sequentially, and the authors suggest that ultrasound screening could identify subclinical contralateral lesions at initial diagnosis. They discuss the problems posed by asynchronous second tumors compared with those diagnosed simultaneously. The paper highlights the value of bilateral ultrasound for detecting occult contralateral disease in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-3511438.summary_ja: 小児3例の後腹膜奇形腫で、単純X線写真上に特徴的な破片状石灰化が認められたことを報告しています。全例で腫瘍による腎への影響から高血圧を来し、術後に改善しました。石灰化所見はほぼ病理学的特異的であるため、詳細な画像検査は不要と考えられています。術前は尿路検査1回と腹部単純X線写真で十分とされています。
pmid-3511438.summary_en: This report describes three children with retroperitoneal teratomas showing characteristic shard-like calcifications on radiographs. All patients had hypertension caused by tumor effects on the kidneys, which resolved after surgery. The authors suggest the findings are nearly pathognomonic, so extensive imaging is unnecessary in similar patients. Only a single urinary tract study and plain abdominal radiographs are advised before prompt surgical resection. The paper provides a practical imaging approach for this tumor in children.

pmid-3511885.summary_ja: 鼻咽頭および副鼻腔原発の移行上皮癌に卵黄嚢腫瘍様成分が混在した成人2例の報告である。免疫染色で卵黄嚢への分化が支持された。両者とも放射線療法と多剤併用化学療法を受け、1例は制御不能な再発で死亡した。混在型は純粋な移行上皮癌より予後不良と考えられ、非生殖腺部位の卵黄嚢成分の一例として位置づけられる。
pmid-3511885.summary_en: This report describes two adults with primary nasopharyngeal and paranasal sinus tumors showing transitional cell carcinoma combined with areas resembling endodermal sinus tumor, also called yolk sac carcinoma. Immunohistochemistry supported yolk sac differentiation. Both patients received irradiation and multidrug chemotherapy. One died of uncontrolled recurrence, while the other developed recurrent transitional cell carcinoma without the yolk sac component. The authors suggest that this combined pattern behaves more aggressively than pure transitional cell carcinoma of this region.

pmid-3512743.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株8種のHLAクラスI・II抗原発現を、蛍光抗体法と放射免疫阻害試験で解析した。胃由来の非妊娠性SCH株のみが明らかな陽性を示し、妊娠性絨毛癌株の多くはごくわずかなクラスI抗原しか発現していなかった。クラスII抗原は全株で陰性であった。絨毛癌細胞の免疫逃避機構を考える上で示唆に富む。
pmid-3512743.summary_en: This Japanese study examined HLA class I and class II antigen expression in eight choriocarcinoma cell lines, including six gestational and two non-gestational lines. Immunofluorescence and radioimmunoassay inhibition tests with monoclonal antibodies were used. Only the non-gestational SCH line, of gastric origin, showed clear HLA class I positivity, while most gestational lines expressed very slight class I antigen. No cell line expressed class II antigen. The results suggest that choriocarcinoma cells may largely express minimal HLA class I, which could bear on immune evasion.

pmid-3513222.summary_ja: 乳児に発生した転移(性)頸部奇形腫の、文献上初めて記録された症例の報告である。診断上の留意点も併せて考察されている。頸部の疑わしい新生児腫瘤には早期生検が推奨され、可能な限り早期の完全切除も考慮すべきとされる。良性の頸部腫瘤と誤認されやすい奇形腫の悪性の可能性を示す重要な症例である。
pmid-3513222.summary_en: This report presents the first documented case of metastatic cervical teratoma in infancy, with a review of diagnostic considerations. The authors emphasize that suspicious neonatal head and neck masses warrant early biopsy. They also recommend considering complete surgical resection of the teratoma as soon as clinically feasible. The brief communication underscores the malignant potential of cervical teratomas that may otherwise be mistaken for benign neck masses. Because teratoma metastasis in infancy is rare, this case is clinically significant for pediatric germ cell tumor management.

pmid-3514610.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株PA1の糖脂質構造を、質量分析、メチル化分析、糖鎖分解酵素処理により解析した。シアル酸を持つ血液型1型糖鎖が胎児性癌細胞の特徴的マーカーである可能性が示された。モノクローナル抗体K21とK4が反応する抗原が同定された。他の多くの細胞株にはこれらの抗原は存在せず、悪性奇形癌にも共通する可能性がある。
pmid-3514610.summary_en: This biochemical study determined the glycolipid structures of the human embryonal carcinoma cell line PA1 using mass spectrometry, methylation analysis, and glycosidase digestion. PA1 cells contained globotriaosylceramide, sialylated and nonsialylated lacto-N-neotetraosylceramide, and blood group type 1 glycolipids. Monoclonal antibodies K21 and K4 recognized two of these structures. The authors propose that sialylated type 1 blood group sequences are characteristic markers of human embryonal carcinoma cells and malignant teratocarcinomas, absent in many unrelated cell lines.

pmid-3517196.summary_ja: チャイニーズハムスターで胎児摘出後に卵黄嚢を転位させ、奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍を誘発した1986年の研究です。良性奇形腫10例と悪性腫瘍2例が得られ、組織学的にも卵黄嚢腫瘍と判定されました。腫瘍由来細胞株では1p+の一貫した染色体異常が認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-3517196.summary_en: This 1986 study induced teratomas and yolk sac tumors in Chinese hamsters by fetectomy followed by displacement of the yolk sac. Of 33 hamsters, ten benign teratomas and two malignant tumors with teratomatous elements were obtained. Histology and laminin staining supported yolk sac tumor classification, and electron microscopy suggested an origin from yolk sac cells. Karyotyping of cell lines from one tumor showed XX and XY clones and a consistent 1p+ abnormality, which the authors suggest may contribute to yolk sac tumor development. The work provides an experimental model of germ cell tumor origin in a rodent species.

pmid-3518655.summary_ja: 29歳女性の十二指腸に発生した、妊娠に関連しない性腺外の絨毛癌の症例報告です。免疫組織化学染色でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンが陽性を示し、栄養膜細胞への分化が確認されました。生殖器外に絨毛癌が生じうることと、消化管病変の診断にこれらの染色が有用であることを示しています。
pmid-3518655.summary_en: This case report describes nongestational extragenital choriocarcinoma arising in the duodenum of a 29-year-old woman. Immunohistochemistry showed positivity for human chorionic gonadotropin and human placental lactogen, supporting trophoblastic differentiation. The report documents a rare extragonadal site of choriocarcinoma that is not associated with pregnancy. It highlights that choriocarcinoma can occur outside the genital tract, and that hCG and placental lactogen staining can aid diagnosis of gastrointestinal lesions when the tumor origin is uncertain.

pmid-3521625.summary_ja: 良性奇形腫48例を対象に、内胚葉由来上皮の組織学的特徴を検討した1986年の病理学的研究です。大腸型の腸上皮、移行上皮、呼吸器型上皮が確認され、基底膜、平滑筋、リンパ濾胞などを伴うことがありました。奇形腫内の内胚葉成分の形態学的特徴を詳しく示しています。
pmid-3521625.summary_en: This 1986 Annales de Pathologie study examines histological features of endoderm-derived epithelia in 48 benign teratomas. It describes intestine-type epithelium with histochemical features of the large intestine, including occasional argentaffin and Paneth cells, as well as transitional epithelium and respiratory-type epithelium. Several epithelial types were associated with supporting structures such as basement membrane, smooth muscle, seromucous glands, cartilage and lymphoid aggregates. The work provides a detailed morphological characterization of endodermal components within teratomas.

pmid-3523046.summary_ja: 精巣の診察では異常がないのに後腹膜リンパ節転移を示す若年男性では、精巣超音波検査が潜在性の腫瘍部位の特定に有用だと論じた1986年の報告です。血清のβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の測定は不可欠とされ、尿妊娠検査は迅速なスクリーニングに役立つと述べています。精巣がんの診断における画像と腫瘍マーカーの重要性を示しています。
pmid-3523046.summary_en: This 1986 Journal of Surgical Oncology report discusses testicular cancer presenting with retroperitoneal nodes and a normal testicular examination. Testicular ultrasound can localize a subclinical tumor in such patients, and serum beta-hCG and AFP are essential for evaluation. The authors note that a urine pregnancy test gives a rapid screening result, while quantitative hCG and AFP assays take longer. The paper emphasizes the diagnostic value of ultrasound and tumor markers in identifying occult testicular germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-3523489.summary_ja: 卵巣上皮性腺がん細胞株HEYを免疫原として作製されたモノクローナル抗体M2Aの1986年の報告です。M2Aは分子量40,000の細胞表面糖タンパク質を認識し、胎児精巣、セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマを染色しました。成人組織やその他の性腺・性腺外腫瘍は染色されず、組織診断の補助としての可能性が示されています。
pmid-3523489.summary_en: This 1986 PNAS article reports a monoclonal antibody, M2A, raised against the ovarian epithelial adenocarcinoma cell line HEY. M2A recognizes a 40,000-dalton surface glycoprotein and stains fetal testis as well as seminomas and dysgerminomas. It did not stain normal adult tissues or other gonadal and extragonadal tumors in the study. The authors propose M2A as a potential aid for confirming the histological diagnosis of seminoma and dysgerminoma. The work addresses diagnostic immunohistochemistry for germ cell tumors.

pmid-3524645.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者16例を対象に、シスプラチン投与中のマグネシウム補充の効果をランダム化して検討した1986年の研究です。補充群では血清マグネシウム濃度が有意に高く維持され、好中球減少による治療遅延も減少傾向を示しました。非補充群では尿中NAG値で示される腎尿細管障害が有意に大きくなりました。腫瘍増殖や予後に差はなく、著者らは補充療法の日常的な導入を提案しています。
pmid-3524645.summary_en: This 1986 randomized trial in 16 patients with testicular cancer receiving cisplatin compared magnesium supplementation (intravenous and oral) with no supplementation. Serum magnesium stayed significantly higher in the supplemented group, and neutropenia-related treatment delays showed a trend toward reduction. The non-supplemented group had significantly greater renal tubular damage by urinary NAG. Tumour growth and outcome did not differ. The authors conclude magnesium supplementation is beneficial and should be routine during cisplatin treatment.

pmid-3525734.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、レチノールによる増殖抑制を受けない胎児性癌細胞株NR1を樹立・解析しています。レチノールは形態変化やSSEA-1の減少をもたらしますが、レチノイン酸ほど強い変化ではありません。F9細胞と異なりこの変化は可逆的で、基質への接着増加も見られました。著者らは、細胞が可逆的な初期分化段階にとどまる可能性を指摘しています。
pmid-3525734.summary_en: This 1986 study describes NR1, an embryonal carcinoma cell line that is not growth-inhibited by retinol. Retinol induces morphological change, reduced SSEA-1 expression and increased fibronectin reactivity, but these effects are less pronounced than with retinoic acid. Unlike F9 cells, the changes are reversible, and increased substrate adhesion is noted. The authors suggest retinol-treated cells may remain at a reversible early differentiation stage, or may express markers of irreversible differentiation without actually differentiating.

pmid-3525800.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫6例と文献を検討した報告です。多くは妊娠22〜34週で診断され、腫瘍による子宮拡大や羊水過多を伴います。新生児用のAAP分類は胎児例の予後を予測しませんでした。妊娠30週以降の診断では、計画的帝王切開後に8例中6例が生存しました。胎児水腫や胎盤肥大を伴う症例は全例が子宮内死亡に至りました。
pmid-3525800.summary_en: This review of six fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases and the literature finds most present between 22 and 34 weeks gestation with an enlarged uterus and/or polyhydramnios. The AAP surgical classification, a strong neonatal prognostic marker, does not predict fetal outcome. Chromosomal abnormalities are rare. Presentation after 30 weeks gives a good prognosis, with 6 of 8 fetuses surviving after planned cesarean delivery. Hydrops or placentomegaly predicted fetal demise in all 7 cases.

pmid-3526333.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、マウスF9奇形癌細胞のレチノイン酸誘導性分化過程におけるc-myc遺伝子の発現を検討しています。レチノイン酸処理により、c-myc mRNAは3時間で50%、12時間で90%減少しました。メチル化解析では、F9細胞のc-mycは分化した卵黄嚢細胞株PYS2や肝臓に比べて低メチル化状態でした。遺伝子の構造変化や増幅は認められませんでした。
pmid-3526333.summary_en: This 1986 study examines c-myc expression during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of mouse F9 teratocarcinoma cells. Retinoic acid reduces c-myc mRNA by 50% at 3 hours and 90% at 12 hours. Comparing methylation patterns, the c-myc gene is hypomethylated in F9 cells relative to differentiated PYS2 parietal yolk sac cells and liver, with differentially methylated sites in the second intron. The gene shows no gross rearrangement or amplification.

pmid-3531048.summary_ja: 米国陸軍病理研究所の症例から卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイド13例を検討した研究です。甲状腺グロブリン陽性の甲状腺組織と、神経内分泌顆粒を有するカルチノイド成分が確認されました。カルシトニンは陰性で、セロトニンは一部で陽性でした。ストルマ内のC細胞様細胞がカルチノイドの起源と考察されています。
pmid-3531048.summary_en: A review of 13 ovarian strumal carcinoids from the AFIP files. These tumors show both endocrine and neuroendocrine differentiation, with thyroglobulin positivity in strumal areas and neuroendocrine granules in cells resembling thyroid C-cells. Calcitonin was negative, while serotonin was variably positive. The authors propose that struma cells with C-cell-like morphology give rise to the carcinoid component.

pmid-3532836.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞に対する2種類のモノクローナル抗体(TM7-3、TM3-8)の作製と性状解析を報告しています。10株中9株の絨毛癌細胞株と反応し、絨毛癌および胞状奇胎の細胞性栄養膜細胞様腫瘍細胞を選択的に染色しました。正常組織への反応は限定的でした。トロホブラスト性腫瘍の同定に有用である可能性が示されています。
pmid-3532836.summary_en: Two monoclonal antibodies, TM7-3 and TM3-8, were generated against choriocarcinoma cells. They reacted with nine of ten choriocarcinoma cell lines and selectively with cytotrophoblast-like tumor cells in choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole, but not syncytiotrophoblast-like cells. Reactivity in normal tissues was limited to renal tubules and pancreatic ducts. The antibodies may aid in identifying trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-3533360.summary_ja: 悪性腫瘍における胎盤由来タンパクの臨床的有用性をまとめた総説です。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は栄養膜疾患の鋭敏なマーカーで、胚外成分を含む性腺の胚細胞腫瘍では再発の検出に有用です。胎盤型アルカリフォスファターゼはセミノーマやディスジャーミノーマで分泌され、治療経過観察に用いられています。スクリーニングへの適用は否定的です。
pmid-3533360.summary_en: A clinical review of placental proteins in malignancy. Chorionic gonadotrophin is a sensitive marker for trophoblastic disease, and gonadal germ cell tumors with extraembryonic components can secrete hCG and SP1, which are useful for detecting recurrence. Placental alkaline phosphatase is secreted by seminomas and dysgerminomas and is used in some clinics for monitoring. The markers aid treatment monitoring and recurrence detection but are not suitable for population screening.

pmid-3534303.summary_ja: 臨床寛解中の急性リンパ性白血病を合併した成人セミノーマの症例報告です。生存率向上に伴い白血病の精巣再発が増加しており、治療前に病理学的診断が必要と述べています。成人における精巣再発疑いへの対応、危険因子、超音波検査による診断、精巣腫瘤の鑑別診断について考察しています。
pmid-3534303.summary_en: A case report of seminoma in an adult with acute lymphocytic leukemia in clinical remission. The authors note that testicular relapse of ALL is becoming more common as survival improves, requiring histopathological diagnosis before treatment. They discuss the adult approach to presumed testicular relapse, given that children undergo transscrotal biopsy, along with risk factors, ultrasound diagnosis, and the differential diagnosis of testicular masses.

pmid-3534304.summary_ja: 後腹膜に転移したセミノーマの症例報告です。後腹膜腫瘤の生検で未分化セミノーマが確認されました。触診では精巣腫瘤を認めませんでしたが、超音波検査で左精巣に低エコー域を認めました。摘出精巣は線維組織のみで、原発巣が退縮した状態と報告されています。
pmid-3534304.summary_en: A case report of testicular seminoma metastatic to the retroperitoneum. Biopsy of the retroperitoneal mass showed anaplastic seminoma, while no testicular mass was palpable. Testicular ultrasonography revealed a hypoechoic lesion in the left testis suggestive of a primary seminoma. However, histology of the resected testis showed only fibrous tissue without definable tumor, indicating regression of the primary.

pmid-3538768.summary_ja: 境界悪性の粘液性嚢胞腺腫を伴う卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイドの報告です。免疫染色で甲状腺濾胞内のコロイドにサイログロブリンが確認されました。カルチノイド成分は銀好性を示し、神経分泌顆粒を有していました。カルシトニンは陰性で、一部の細胞でCEAが陽性でした。
pmid-3538768.summary_en: A report of ovarian strumal carcinoid coexisting with a mucinous cystadenoma of borderline malignancy. Immunohistochemistry confirmed thyroglobulin in colloid-filled thyroid follicles, while the carcinoid component was argyrophilic with neurosecretory granules. Electron microscopy showed carcinoid cells extending toward follicle lumens. Calcitonin was absent, but CEA was present in some carcinoid cells. No amyloid was detected.

pmid-3543166.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、卵巣のディスジャーミノーマに浸潤するリンパ球を連続切片上でモノクローナル抗体パネルを用いて解析した。浸潤リンパ球は白血球マーカーに陽性で、抑制性・細胞傷害性とヘルパー性のT細胞がほぼ同数含まれ、多くがHLA-DRを発現していた。間質のリンパ球は活性化T細胞と考えられ、腫瘍細胞はHLA-ABCおよびHLA-DRを発現していなかった。リンパ球浸潤の程度は予後との関連が論じられてきたと述べられている。
pmid-3543166.summary_en: This 1986 study characterized the lymphoid cells infiltrating ovarian dysgerminomas using a panel of monoclonal antibodies on serial tumor sections. Infiltrating lymphoid cells were HLe-1 positive and included roughly equal numbers of T cells with suppressor/cytotoxic and helper/inducer phenotypes, with most cells HLA-DR positive. Lymphoid cells in the connective stroma were judged to be activated T cells, whereas tumor cells lacked HLA-ABC and HLA-DR expression. The authors note that the degree of lymphoid infiltration has been linked to prognosis.

pmid-3543874.summary_ja: 1986年の症例報告で、原発性右心室奇形腫の手術後に生存した、著者らの知る限り唯一の乳児例を報告している。乳児期および小児期の心臓奇形腫の既報例についてもレビューしている。心臓奇形腫は心臓の稀な原発性腫瘍であり、極めて若年の患者で良好な手術成績が得られたことを示している。小児のこの稀な腫瘍の臨床像と治療について文脈を提供している。
pmid-3543874.summary_en: This 1986 case report describes the only infant known to the authors to have survived surgery for a primary right ventricular teratoma. The paper also reviews other reported cases of cardiac teratoma in infancy and childhood. Cardiac teratoma is a rare primary tumor of the heart, and this report documents a successful surgical outcome in a very young patient. The review provides context on the presentation and management of these uncommon pediatric tumors.

pmid-3546507.summary_ja: 1986年の研究で、奇形癌の幹細胞様の腫瘍形成細胞であるマウス胎児性癌（EC）細胞がMHCクラスI抗原を発現するかを検討した。従来はH-2K、D/L遺伝子産物を発現しないとされていた。細胞媒介性細胞傷害、血清学的解析、分子生物学的手法により、EC細胞がMHCクラスIまたはクラスI様分子を発現することを示した。胚細胞腫瘍モデル細胞に関する免疫学的前提を見直す知見である。
pmid-3546507.summary_en: This 1986 study examined whether murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem-like tumor-initiating cells of teratocarcinomas, express class I major histocompatibility complex antigens. Earlier work had concluded that they do not express H-2K or D/L products. Using cell-mediated lysis, serological assays, and molecular biology approaches, the authors show that EC cells do express some MHC class I or class I-like molecules. The findings revise immunological assumptions about germ cell tumor model cells.

pmid-3633952.summary_ja: 1986年の臨床研究で、難治性胚細胞腫瘍の男性患者48例に対しVIP（VP-16、イホスファミド、シスプラチン）救援化学療法を評価した。33%が完全寛解に達したが、生存期間中央値は7か月であった。骨髄抑制と腎機能不全が高頻度の毒性であった。極めて予後不良な集団で活性を示し、イホスファミドの寄与は不明確であるため、初回救援療法としてさらなる検討が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-3633952.summary_en: This 1986 clinical study evaluated VP-16, ifosfamide, and cisplatin (VIP) salvage chemotherapy in 48 male patients with refractory germ cell tumors. Thirty-three percent achieved complete remission, though the median survival was 7 months. Myelosuppression and renal insufficiency were frequent toxicities. The authors conclude that VIP shows activity in this highly unfavorable population and that its specific contribution from ifosfamide remains unclear, supporting further study as initial salvage therapy.

pmid-3698059.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌異種移植を有するヌードマウスにおいて、抗hCGモノクローナル抗体W14Aの完全長抗体とFab2(1)断片を直接比較した。断片では概して腫瘍対血液比が改善し、腫瘍への標的性向上が示唆された。抗体分布を左右する因子も概説されている。絨毛癌を対象としたhCG標的療法の基礎研究である。
pmid-3698059.summary_en: In nude mice bearing human choriocarcinoma xenografts, this study directly compared intact anti-hCG monoclonal antibody W14A with its Fab2(1) fragments. Fragments generally improved the tumor-to-blood ratio, suggesting better tumor targeting with reduced circulating background. The authors outline several parameters that may determine antibody distribution. The work is an early experimental study of antibody-based imaging or targeting of choriocarcinoma, relevant to hCG-directed approaches in gestational and germ cell tumors.

pmid-3699554.summary_ja: 虫垂に発生した類皮嚢腫の1例を報告する。類皮嚢腫は腹部腫瘤の原因として認識されているが、虫垂発生例は稀である。既報では盲腸発生例が記載されている。良性の成熟奇形腫様病変である本疾患の、虫垂発生例に関する限られた文献に症例を加えた報告である。
pmid-3699554.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst arising from the vermiform appendix, a rare site for this lesion. Dermoid cysts are a well-recognized cause of abdominal masses, and previously reported cases have involved the caecum. The authors present their patient to add to the limited literature on appendiceal dermoid cysts, a benign mature teratoma-type lesion. The report emphasizes the rarity and clinical recognition of this entity in the right iliac fossa.

pmid-3699573.summary_ja: 母体と胎児の双方に絨毛癌を認めた症例を報告する。このような例は文献上わずか7例目である。39週の胎児の剖検で転移性絨毛癌が確認され、母体では子宮内の潜在性絨毛癌が判明した。直ちに積極的化学療法を開始し、寛解が得られた。胎児例では母体の精査が重要であることを示す。
pmid-3699573.summary_en: This report describes a case of choriocarcinoma in both a mother and her fetus, a combination found in only seven reported cases. Autopsy of the 39-week fetus revealed metastatic choriocarcinoma, and workup identified an occult uterine choriocarcinoma in the mother. Aggressive chemotherapy was started promptly, achieving remission. The case highlights the importance of maternal evaluation when fetal choriocarcinoma is found, and the effectiveness of prompt chemotherapy.

pmid-3699814.summary_ja: 妊娠28週で出生した体重950gの男児の症例を報告する。両側精巣に性腺芽腫様病変を認め、核型は46,XYであった。複数の先天奇形を伴い、出生後1時間で死亡した。性腺異形成の文脈で生じた稀な胚細胞関連病変を示し、精巣における性腺芽腫様変化の病理学的スペクトラムを記録した症例である。
pmid-3699814.summary_en: This case report describes a male infant born at 28 weeks with bilateral gonadoblastoma-like testicular lesions and a 46,XY karyotype. The infant also had multiple congenital anomalies and survived only one hour. The gonadoblastoma-like lesions represent an early, rare germ cell-related finding in a gonadal dysgenesis context. The report documents a neonatal case, illustrating the pathologic spectrum of gonadoblastoma-like changes in the testis.

pmid-3701129.summary_ja: 1986年の報告で、ホルモン産生腫瘍に分類されない上皮性卵巣腫瘍と類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)の患者において、エストロゲン産生能を検討した。術前の血清エストラジオールは閉経後・閉経前ともに対照より高値で、多くは術後に低下した。膣スメアや子宮内膜の所見もエストロゲンの影響を示し、一部の卵巣腫瘍がエストロゲンを産生する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-3701129.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese study measured estrogen activity in women with common epithelial ovarian tumors and ovarian dermoid cysts (mature teratomas), which are not classed as hormone-producing tumors. Preoperative serum estradiol was elevated in both postmenopausal and premenopausal patients compared with controls, and often fell after surgery. Vaginal smear cytology and endometrial histology also showed estrogenic changes. The findings suggest that some ovarian tumors, including dermoid cysts, may produce estrogen.

pmid-3701139.summary_ja: 1986年の報告で、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを免疫原として作製したモノクローナル抗体TM7-3とTM3-8を解析した。両抗体は絨毛癌や胞状奇胎の細胞性栄養膜細胞様成分と反応し、多くの正常組織とは反応しなかった。抗原は細胞性栄養膜細胞の悪性転化に伴い増加する可能性があり、栄養膜細胞の分化研究に有用と考えられる。
pmid-3701139.summary_en: This 1986 study developed two monoclonal antibodies, TM7-3 and TM3-8, raised against the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. The antibodies reacted with most choriocarcinoma cell lines and with cytotrophoblast-like components in choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole tissue, but barely with syncytiotrophoblast or most normal tissues. The antigen appeared to increase as cytotrophoblasts became malignant. The authors suggest these antibodies may be useful for studying human trophoblast differentiation and the malignant transformation of trophoblasts.

pmid-3703140.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の左付属器原発切除後に多剤化学療法を受けていた20歳女性の症例報告である。急性硬膜下血腫で発症し、血管造影で角回動脈分枝の腫瘍性動脈瘤が判明した。緊急で血腫除去、動脈瘤切除、血行再建を行った。切除標本では絨毛癌が動脈瘤内腔を満たし血管壁へ浸潤していた。絨毛癌の転移が腫瘍性動脈瘤を引き起こしうることを示す。
pmid-3703140.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 20-year-old woman with a left adnexal choriocarcinoma who had received multiagent chemotherapy after resection. She presented with acute subdural hematoma, and angiography revealed a neoplastic aneurysm at a branch of the angular artery. Emergency hematoma evacuation, aneurysm resection, and revascularization were performed. Histology showed choriocarcinoma filling the aneurysm lumen and invading the vessel wall. No other intracranial metastases were seen during six months of follow-up.

pmid-3705273.summary_ja: 混合性胚細胞性精巣がんの患者で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に精索遺残部位に局所再発が生じた症例の報告である。この再発は腹膜に及ぶことが多く生存率を低下させる。著者らは根治的鼠径精巣摘除術時に精索近位部へ非吸収性縫合糸マーカーを付けることを提案する。これにより、後腹膜郭清が必要な際に残存精索を完全に摘出でき、外科的に予防可能な再発を防げるとしている。
pmid-3705273.summary_en: This report describes a patient with mixed germ cell testicular carcinoma who developed local recurrence at retained spermatic cord remnants after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Such recurrence often involves the peritoneum and worsens survival. The authors recommend attaching a long nonabsorbable suture marker to the proximal spermatic cord during radical inguinal orchiectomy, so that the entire remaining cord can be removed if a retroperitoneal node dissection is needed. This aims to prevent a surgically avoidable recurrence site.

pmid-3706279.summary_ja: SEERデータ(1973〜1982年)などを用いて、米国における絨毛癌の発生率を推定した疫学研究である。出生生児約19,920件に1件と算出された。年齢と出生効果を調整すると、白人が最も低く、黒人などでは高リスクであった。母親の年齢上昇とともに発生率は著しく増加し、10代の出産者でもリスクが高かった。
pmid-3706279.summary_en: This epidemiologic study estimated the US incidence of choriocarcinoma using SEER data (1973-1982) and national vital statistics. Overall incidence was about 1 in 24,096 pregnancies, or 1 in 19,920 livebirths. Whites had the lowest rate, while Black and other race women had 2.1- and 1.8-fold higher risk after adjustment. Incidence rose sharply with maternal age, with women aged 40-44 having 8.6-fold excess risk relative to those aged 20-24, and teenage mothers also showed elevated risk.

pmid-3706608.summary_ja: 妊娠関連疾患を統一的な免疫学的概念で説明することを提唱する1986年の論考である。原発性慢性流産、妊娠高血圧症候群、特発性子宮内胎児発育遅延では母体の反応低下が関与するとされる。一方、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では母体の過剰反応と遮断抗体産生の増加が栄養膜細胞の異常増殖に関わる可能性がある。新たなデータは示されていない。
pmid-3706608.summary_en: This 1986 paper proposes a unifying immunologic concept linking several pregnancy disorders. It suggests that maternal hyporesponse to fetal antigens, with reduced blocking activity, contributes to primary chronic abortion, preeclampsia, and idiopathic intrauterine growth retardation. Conversely, a maternal hyperresponse with increased blocking antibody production may promote abnormal trophoblast proliferation in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma. The paper offers a conceptual framework rather than new data.

pmid-3706617.summary_ja: 出血を伴う大きな肝腫瘍で発症した29歳と27歳の女性2例の症例報告である。1例は切除されたが、1例は失血で死亡した。両腫瘍は絨毛癌と区別できず、血清hCGは著明に高値であった。子宮や骨盤臓器は正常で、肝原発と考えられた。肝原発として発症する悪性栄養膜腫瘍の診断の難しさを示す。
pmid-3706617.summary_en: This report describes two women, aged 29 and 27, who presented with large hemorrhagic liver tumors. One was resected, while the other died of blood loss. Both tumors resembled choriocarcinoma, and both patients had markedly elevated serum hCG with positive pregnancy tests. The endometrium and pelvic organs were normal, suggesting a primary hepatic origin. Immunostaining was strongly positive for hCG and human placental lactogen, with weak AFP and alpha-1-antitrypsin positivity. The case series highlights the diagnostic challenge of trophoblastic tumors presenting as liver primaries.

pmid-3707843.summary_ja: 1943〜1982年のデンマークにおける精巣がん5,140例を解析した登録研究である。年齢調整罹患率は2倍以上に増加し、15〜24歳では4倍に達した。死亡率は1978〜1982年に50%低下し、シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法の導入が主因とされた。罹患率と死亡率の傾向は乖離しており、死亡率のみで病因を推定することは不適切と結論づけている。
pmid-3707843.summary_en: This Danish registry study examined testicular cancer trends from 1943 to 1982, including 5,140 cases. Age-standardized incidence more than doubled, with a four-fold rise among men aged 15-24, while older men showed no increase, consistent with a cohort effect. Mortality fell by 50% in 1978-1982, largely attributed to cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Because incidence and mortality trends diverged, the authors argue mortality data are unsuitable for etiologic inference and call for further search for risk factors.

pmid-3708631.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス卵巣奇形癌モデルに対するPropionibacterium acnesピリジン抽出画分の抗腫瘍効果を検討した。低腫瘍量では好中球活性化成分により生存期間が延長したが、大量の腫瘍に対しては、マクロファージ活性化成分を欠くため効果が減弱した。
pmid-3708631.summary_en: This study tested a pyridine-extracted fraction of Propionibacterium acnes for antitumor effects in a murine ovarian teratocarcinoma model. The extract prolonged survival of mice challenged with low tumor inocula, with early cytoreduction linked to tumoricidal neutrophil influx into the peritoneal cavity. Efficacy against larger tumor loads was diminished because the extract lacked macrophage-activating components, which are needed for the later cytostatic macrophage phase. The findings suggest that neutrophil-activating components drive antitumor effects at low tumor burden, while macrophage activation is required against larger tumors.

pmid-3709923.summary_ja: 78歳患者に生じた卵巣原発の甲状腺腫様カルチノイドの症例報告である。甲状腺組織とカルチノイドが混在する稀な胚細胞由来腫瘍で、特殊染色を用いた病理診断が必要となる。良性経過のため、単純卵巣摘出術または卵管卵巣摘出術による外科治療が基本となる。
pmid-3709923.summary_en: This report describes a 78-year-old patient with a primary strumal carcinoid of the ovary, a rare tumor of germ cell origin composed of an intimate mixture of thyroid tissue and carcinoid. Diagnosis requires pathological examination with special stains. Because the tumor is generally benign, treatment is primarily surgical, consisting of simple oophorectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy. Recognizing this entity matters because it is easily missed without appropriate staining, and the surgical approach reflects its benign behavior.

pmid-3711401.summary_ja: 出生直後の新生児に多発皮膚腫瘍を生じた、胎盤原発絨毛癌の転移例の報告である。生後数日の皮膚生検で、光学・電子顕微鏡観察とhCGの免疫組織化学染色により診断された。胎盤から新生児へ転移した既報例および悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の皮膚転移例を文献的に概観している。
pmid-3711401.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with multiple cutaneous tumors due to metastatic placental choriocarcinoma, a rare event. The primary tumor was found in the placenta, and diagnosis was made from a skin biopsy a few days after birth using light and electron microscopy and immunohistochemical staining for hCG. The authors review prior cases of placental choriocarcinoma metastasizing to infants and skin metastases from malignant gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-3712770.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた悪性転化の1例である。多くの報告が扁平上皮癌であるのに対し、本例は扁平上皮癌と腺癌が別々に存在し、腺癌は腸管様の胎児性構造を示した。免疫組織化学的に両悪性成分はCEA陽性で、AFPは腺癌のみ陽性であった。腺癌は扁平上皮癌とは異なる発生機序をもつと考察されている。
pmid-3712770.summary_en: This report describes a case of malignant degeneration arising in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. Unlike most reported cases, which are squamous cell carcinomas, the tumor contained separate squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma components, the latter with an embryonal intestinal-like structure. Immunohistochemistry showed CEA positivity in both malignant components, while AFP was positive only in the adenocarcinoma. The authors suggest that the adenocarcinoma arises through a different pathogenesis from the squamous cell carcinoma.

pmid-3718820.summary_ja: 1979〜1982年に精巣悪性奇形腫で後腹膜リンパ節腫大を有する83例を治療。化学療法後の残存傍大動脈病変に放射線療法を行った47例では再発がなく、非施行群では11例中2例が再発した。主な有害事象は皮下線維化で、放射線療法は手術の代替になりうると結論。
