pmid-3718820.summary_en: This study from 1979 to 1982 treated 83 patients with testicular malignant teratoma and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy at presentation or after surveillance. After chemotherapy, 47 patients received radiotherapy for residual para-aortic disease, and none relapsed there, whereas 2 of 11 patients without radiotherapy or immediate node dissection relapsed. Radiotherapy-related morbidity was minimal, mainly subcutaneous fibrosis in six patients. The authors conclude that radiotherapy effectively sterilizes minimal residual tumor after chemotherapy and may be an alternative to surgery for persistent retroperitoneal disease in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-3720008.summary_ja: Y染色体の遠位蛍光を有する患者では性腺芽腫が発生した一方、Yq遠位蛍光が変化した45,X/46,XYnfモザイクの患者では認められなかった。文献的にも、この型で性腺芽腫を示した確実な症例はなかった。Yqの蛍光変化が発生異常性腺の腫瘍化を防ぐ可能性を提示している。
pmid-3720008.summary_en: This report summarizes four patients with 45,X/46,XY karyotype, one with 45,X/47,XYY mosaicism, and one with 46,XY karyotype and ambiguous genitalia. Three patients with a fluorescent Y chromosome developed one or two gonadoblastomas regardless of age, whereas three with 45,X/46,XYnf mosaicism had none. Review of published cases found no well-documented 45,X/46,XYnf mosaic with gonadoblastoma. The authors suggest that alterations in the distal fluorescence of Yq may protect the dysgenetic gonad against neoplastic transformation, and they discuss possible mechanisms.

pmid-3721756.summary_ja: 本論文は60歳以上の男性にみられる陰嚢内腫瘍を組織由来別に分類し、その特徴と予後を概説している。リンパ腫が約半数で最多、胚細胞腫瘍は約25%でセミノーマが多く、精巣摘除術と後腹膜放射線療法後の予後は良好である。一方、胎児性成分を伴う奇形癌は約3%で予後不良とされる。
pmid-3721756.summary_en: This 1986 review classifies intrascrotal tumors in men by tissue origin, with emphasis on older patients. Lymphoma is the most common group, followed by germ cell tumors (25%), mostly classical seminoma with good prognosis after orchiectomy and retroperitoneal radiation. Teratocarcinoma with embryonal elements (3%) is highly malignant with survival under two years. Gonadal stromal tumors (10%) are usually benign, and paratesticular neoplasms (15%) are heterogeneous. Diagnosis and prognosis rely on histopathology after removal.

pmid-3721950.summary_ja: 本症例報告は13歳の少年の精巣がんを報告している。少年は腫瘤に気づいていたものの受診しなかった。著者らは、医師による男性生殖器の丁寧な診察と、思春期の少年への自己検査の指導の必要性を強調している。早期受診と教育の重要性を示す報告である。
pmid-3721950.summary_en: This 1986 case report describes a 13-year-old adolescent with testicular cancer. The patient noticed the testicular mass but did not seek medical care. The authors emphasize that physicians should carefully examine male genitalia and that adolescents should be taught testicular self-examination. The report underscores the importance of early presentation and education in adolescent testicular cancer, where delayed care can worsen outcomes.

pmid-3722259.summary_ja: 本論文は、3胚葉に由来する稀な心膜内奇形腫を概説している。多くは生後2年以内に発症し、縦隔圧迫や心膜液貯留による重篤な心肺症状を呈する。心エコー検査と心血管造影で診断し、早期手術による切除で持続的な改善が得られると報告している。
pmid-3722259.summary_en: This 1986 report reviews intrapericardial teratoma, a rare and generally benign tumor derived from all three germ layers. Most cases occur in the first two years of life. Presenting features include severe cardiorespiratory distress from mediastinal compression and pericardial effusion. Echocardiography and cine-angiography confirm the diagnosis, and early surgical removal yields immediate and durable clinical improvement.

pmid-3724214.summary_ja: 本報告は、精巣悪性奇形腫の心臓内転移を外科的に切除した症例を報告している。胸腔外病変はなく血清マーカーは正常であった。シスプラチンを基本とする化学療法で76%の腫瘍マーカーが正常化するが、24%では残存病変が残り、切除の需要が増えている。残存病変の組織所見は追加治療の判断に有用である。
pmid-3724214.summary_en: This 1986 report describes successful surgical excision of an intracardiac metastasis from a testicular malignant teratoma in a patient with no demonstrable extrathoracic disease and normal serum markers. The authors note that cisplatin-based chemotherapy normalizes tumor markers in 76% of patients, while 24% retain bulky residual disease that increasingly requires resection. Histology of residual deposits guides additional therapy, and relapse can occur even when disease appears stable.

pmid-3726124.summary_ja: 21歳の非妊婦で左卵巣類皮嚢腫に腸卵巣瘻を合併した症例の報告です。この合併症の検出には造影剤注腸検査が有用であることを示しています。卵巣類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫の一種で、消化器症状を伴う場合は腸管との瘻孔形成も考慮すべきだとされています。
pmid-3726124.summary_en: A 21-year-old nonpregnant woman with a left ovarian dermoid cyst developed an entero-ovarian fistula. The case report highlights that contrast media enema is important for detecting this unusual complication of an ovarian mature teratoma. Dermoid cysts are a common benign form of mature teratoma. Clinicians should consider fistulous communication with the bowel when evaluating ovarian dermoid cysts with gastrointestinal symptoms.

pmid-37281494.summary_ja: 自然発生の精巣奇形癌STT-2を含む各種胎児性癌細胞株について、8細胞期マウス胚との凝集によるキメラ胚形成能を比較しました。細胞株により定着能に差があり、STT-2細胞が最も効率よく胚に取り込まれました。子宮内での発生でも7〜28体節期の胎児に取り込まれ、精巣由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞がマウス胚発生に関与しうることが示されています。
pmid-37281494.summary_en: Various embryonal carcinoma lines, including the spontaneous testicular teratocarcinoma STT-2, were compared for their ability to form chimeric blastocysts when aggregated with normal 8-cell mouse embryos. Colonization efficiency differed among lines, and STT-2 cells were most efficiently incorporated. STT-2 cells contributed to fetuses up to the 7- to 28-somite stages in utero, showing that male germ cell-derived testicular teratocarcinoma cells can participate in mouse embryogenesis.

pmid-3729471.summary_ja: 卵巣上皮性癌では、シスプラチンを含むPAC療法の併用化学療法により生存成績が改善し、併用放射線療法は減少したと報告されています。卵黄嚢腫瘍では、VAC療法またはPVB療法を受けた患者の約50%が2年以上生存したとされ、従来の治療法より良好な成績が示されています。
pmid-3729471.summary_en: This review of Japanese experience summarizes treatment of ovarian cancer and endodermal sinus tumor. For common epithelial ovarian cancer, combined chemotherapy with cis-DDP-based PAC has improved survival while combined radiotherapy has declined. For endodermal sinus tumor, patients treated with VAC or PVB combination chemotherapy showed long-term survival of about 50%, versus poor outcomes with earlier radiotherapy or older regimens.

pmid-3732659.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株NG2を用い、レチノイン酸による分化を検討しました。単一細胞ではレチノイン酸により壁側内胚葉へ不可逆的に分化しました。単層コロニーでは周辺部の細胞のみが分化し、中心部は21日間にわたり多様な細胞型を生じました。レチノイン酸は分化を強制するのではなく、内因性刺激への反応を加速すると結論されています。
pmid-3732659.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cell line NG2 was studied for differentiation after retinoic acid exposure. Single cells treated with retinoic acid irreversibly differentiated into parietal endoderm. In monolayer colonies, only peripheral cells differentiated, while central cells yielded diverse cell types over 21 days. The authors conclude that retinoic acid accelerates EC cells' response to intrinsic differentiation signals rather than overriding them.

pmid-3732911.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株3種を用い、ヒトインターフェロンの抗ウイルス作用と抗増殖作用を検討しました。抗ウイルス作用に対する感受性は低いものの、IFN-αとIFN-βは用量依存的に増殖を抑制しました。IFN-βの腹腔内投与は異種移植腫瘍の増殖を抑制し、絨毛癌細胞はインターフェロンに弱いながら感受性を示すと結論されています。
pmid-3732911.summary_en: Three human choriocarcinoma cell lines were tested for sensitivity to human interferons in vitro and in vivo. The cells showed low antiviral sensitivity, but interferon-alpha and -beta suppressed proliferation in a dose-dependent manner, with NUC-1 least responsive. Interferon-gamma had no antiproliferative effect. Intraperitoneal interferon-beta inhibited growth of xenografts in hamster cheek pouches and nude mice. Choriocarcinoma cells show weak but real sensitivity to interferon.

pmid-3732917.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の綿密なフォローアップ中に絨毛癌を発症した症例です。診断前後を通じて血清β-hCGは放射免疫測定法の感度以下に留まりました。β-hCGが上昇しない絨毛癌の報告は本例で4例目とされ、奇胎フォロー中はhCG正常でも絨毛癌を否定できないことが示されています。
pmid-3732917.summary_en: A case of choriocarcinoma developed during close follow-up after hydatidiform mole. Serum beta-hCG levels, measured by radioimmunoassay before, during, and after diagnosis, remained below assay sensitivity throughout. The authors note this is only the fourth reported case of choriocarcinoma without elevated beta-hCG, highlighting that normal hCG levels do not exclude choriocarcinoma during surveillance of molar pregnancy.

pmid-3732921.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の肝転移症例15例について、初発症状、治療反応、治療合併症を解析しています。多くの患者は全肝照射と多剤併用化学療法を受けました。2例が持続寛解に至り、併用療法による肝毒性は非生存13例中1例の死亡に直接関与しました。肝転移の診断、治療、予後的意義が論じられています。
pmid-3732921.summary_en: This report analyzes 15 patients with hepatic metastases of choriocarcinoma, covering presentation, treatment response, and therapy-related complications. Most received multiagent chemotherapy with whole-liver irradiation. Two patients achieved sustained remission. Hepatotoxicity from the combined regimen caused one death among 13 non-survivors. The authors discuss diagnosis, management, and the prognostic significance of liver metastases from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3735547.summary_ja: 本報告は、非双生児の兄弟2名といとこ1名の計3名が胎児性癌を発症した家族性精巣腫瘍例を提示している。同一組織型の精巣腫瘍が家族内で集積することは稀であり、遺伝的素因の可能性が示唆される。ただし抄録には臨床経過や治療、遺伝学的検索の詳細は記載されておらず、病因についての結論は限定的である。
pmid-3735547.summary_en: This report describes a family with testicular embryonal carcinoma: two non-twin brothers and a first cousin all presented with this histologic type. Familial clustering of testicular tumors of the same histology is rarely reported, and the authors present the three cases to highlight a possible hereditary predisposition. The brief abstract provides limited detail on clinical course, treatment, or genetic analysis, so conclusions about etiology are limited.

pmid-3735548.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の患者において、腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で後腹膜リンパ節腫大に類似した重複下大静脈の1例を報告する。後腹膜リンパ節の誤読は、精巣がんにおいて誤った病期分類や不適切な治療につながりうるため、正確な画像診断の解釈が重要である。また、精巣のリンパ排液および異常な静脈・リンパ解剖が画像解釈に与えうる影響について、発生学的観点から考察している。
pmid-3735548.summary_en: This report describes a duplicated inferior vena cava that mimicked retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy on abdominal CT in a patient with testicular embryonal carcinoma. Accurate interpretation matters because misreading retroperitoneal nodes can lead to incorrect clinical staging and inappropriate treatment in testicular cancer. The authors also discuss the embryology of testicular lymphatic drainage and how anomalous venous and lymphatic anatomy may influence imaging interpretation.

pmid-3735549.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する経腹的後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の後に、びまん性の腹腔内転移を生じた2例を報告している。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では稀な転移様式であり、手術に伴うリンパ漏からの直接播種が原因と考えられている。この合併症の診断におけるCTの有用性を強調している。
pmid-3735549.summary_en: This report describes two patients who developed diffuse intraperitoneal metastases after transabdominal retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for testicular carcinoma. Such a pattern is unusual for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors and is thought to result from direct tumor seeding through surgically related lymphatic leakage. The authors highlight the value of computed tomography in recognizing this complication, which may otherwise be mistaken for other peritoneal disease or treatment-related change.

pmid-3737045.summary_ja: 1962年から1981年にかけて専門施設で治療された、子宮外妊娠に伴う絨毛癌8例を検討している。無月経、腹痛、付属器腫瘤など古典的な子宮外妊娠と類似した症状を呈し、75%が診断時に転移性疾患を有していた。他施設で化学療法を受けた2例が転移性疾患で死亡しており、妊娠反応陽性の子宮外妊娠では絨毛癌を念頭に置く必要性を示している。
pmid-3737045.summary_en: This study reviews eight patients with choriocarcinoma associated with ectopic pregnancy treated at a dedicated trophoblastic disease center over two decades. Presenting features closely resembled classic ectopic pregnancy, including amenorrhea, abdominal pain, and adnexal mass, and most had metastatic disease at diagnosis. Two patients died, both after prior chemotherapy elsewhere. The findings emphasize considering choriocarcinoma when ectopic pregnancy presents with a positive pregnancy test and high-risk features.

pmid-3737981.summary_ja: 1963年から1983年に病期I精巣セミノーマと診断され、精巣摘除術と横隔膜下リンパ節照射を受けた232例の成績を報告している。再発は5例のみで、セミノーマで死亡した例はなかった。放射線療法の急性・晩期毒性は低かったが、15例に消化性潰瘍が生じ、腹部手術歴が関連していた。反対側精巣腫瘍や二次性悪性腫瘍も一部で認められた。
pmid-3737981.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 232 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1963 and 1983 with orchiectomy followed by infradiaphragmatic lymph node irradiation. Only five patients relapsed, and none died of seminoma. Contralateral testicular tumors and second malignancies occurred in a subset. Radiotherapy morbidity was low, although peptic ulceration developed in 15 patients, with prior abdominal surgery associated with dyspepsia and ulceration. The authors discuss future management policy.

pmid-3739710.summary_ja: 58歳女性の卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイドの症例を報告している。甲状腺成分とカルチノイド成分を併せ持ち、電子顕微鏡で神経分泌顆粒を認め、免疫染色で甲状腺成分にサイロキシンとサイログロブリンの陽性所見が得られた。著者らは、内胚葉由来の多方向性分化により生じたと考察しており、卵巣奇形腫の特殊型としての位置づけも示唆される。
pmid-3739710.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old woman with strumal carcinoid of the ovary, a tumor containing both thyroid tissue and carcinoid components. Electron microscopy showed neurosecretory-type granules, and immunohistochemistry confirmed thyroxine and thyroglobulin in the thyroid component. Mucous glands were also present. The authors propose that the tumor arises from multidirectional endodermal differentiation, and the case supports its placement among specialized ovarian teratomas.

pmid-3740215.summary_ja: 腫瘍感受性の129/Sv-terマウスを用い、胎生13日から出生までの精巣発生過程を形態学的に解析した研究です。感受性マウスでは胎児性癌細胞が観察され、対照群には見られませんでした。全群に合胞体状の異型胚細胞が認められ、変性や前癌病変との関連が検討されています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期発生過程を理解する上で重要な知見です。
pmid-3740215.summary_en: This morphologic study examined developing testes of tumor-susceptible 129/Sv-ter mice from embryonic day 13 to birth to clarify spontaneous teratocarcinogenesis. Embryonal carcinoma cells were found in susceptible mice but not in control strains, with vesicular and nodular arrangements. Atypical gonocytes forming syncytial arrangements appeared in all groups, and their role in degeneration and preneoplasia is discussed. The findings clarify early events in testicular germ cell tumor development in this model.

pmid-3740851.summary_ja: レチノイン酸によるF9奇形癌幹細胞の分化誘導初期における、タンパク質合成の変化を解析した研究です。二次元ゲル電気泳動と自動解析を用い、誘導後6〜24時間の変化を追跡しました。一部のタンパク質の合成は増加し、他は減少し、24時間後には2〜4倍の刺激が認められました。多くの微妙な変化が表現型の変化に伴うことが示されています。
pmid-3740851.summary_en: This study examined how retinoic acid alters protein synthesis during early differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells. Using two-dimensional gel autoradiography with computerized analysis, the authors tracked changes from 6 to 24 hours after induction. Synthesis of several proteins increased and others decreased, with stimulation reaching two- to fourfold by 24 hours. The results indicate that many subtle protein synthesis changes accompany the emergence of the new differentiated phenotype.

pmid-3742914.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜良性奇形腫の2症例で、骨シンチグラフィ製剤Tc-99m MDPが腫瘍内に集積した所見を報告しています。神経芽腫での集積は報告がありましたが、奇形腫では確認されていませんでした。後腹膜腫瘤の核医学検査の解釈に役立つ知見です。
pmid-3742914.summary_en: This short report describes two cases of primary retroperitoneal benign teratoma in which technetium-99m MDP, a bone-imaging agent, localized within the tumor. Bone-scan agent uptake has been reported in neuroblastoma but had not been confirmed in teratomas. The authors document extraosseous accumulation of a bone-imaging tracer in benign teratoma, which may matter when interpreting nuclear medicine scans of retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-3745281.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoのメトトレキサート誘導による合胞体栄養膜様への分化に対し、細胞密度が与える影響を検討した研究です。密度が高い培養では巨細胞形成や胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ発現が低下しました。高密度では薬剤取り込みが少ないことが一因と考えられています。
pmid-3745281.summary_en: This study investigated how cell number and population density affect methotrexate-induced differentiation of BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells toward a syncytiotrophoblast-like phenotype. Giant cell formation, placental alkaline phosphatase expression, and purine salvage were all reduced in crowded cultures. Lower methotrexate uptake in dense cultures likely contributed. The findings suggest that cell density can modulate drug-induced differentiation responses in choriocarcinoma models.

pmid-3745924.summary_ja: 合成ペプチド由来のモノクローナル抗体を用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に特異的な二抗体サンドイッチ型ELISAを開発した研究です。血清を含まない培地で2.2 IU/Lを検出でき、LHとの交差反応は認められませんでした。対照法のRIAとの相関は良好(r=0.99)で、絨毛癌や胞状奇胎の患者血清も検証に用いられています。
pmid-3745924.summary_en: The authors developed a two-site sandwich ELISA for human chorionic gonadotropin using monoclonal antibodies raised against a synthetic carboxy-terminal peptide of beta-hCG. The assay detected 2.2 IU/L in serum-free medium and showed no cross-reactivity with LH up to 5000 IU/L. It correlated well (r = 0.99) with a reference RIA using sera from healthy individuals and patients with choriocarcinoma, hydatidiform mole, or teratocarcinoma.

pmid-3746027.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の未分化ディスジャーミノーマ細胞株(JOHYL-1)をヌードマウスに移植し、ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドの単剤効果を比較した研究です。生細胞比率はアクチノマイシンDで最も低くなりました。各薬剤で細胞周期の変化と形態学的変化が認められています。
pmid-3746027.summary_en: This experimental study tested single-agent vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide against a human undifferentiated dysgerminoma cell line (JOHYL-1) in ascitic form, using nude mouse heterotransplantation. Actinomycin D was most effective, leaving the lowest proportion of viable cells, followed by vincristine and cyclophosphamide. Cell cycle shifts and morphological changes were observed with each drug. Lactate dehydrogenase isozyme patterns showed no major differences among the agents.

pmid-3754109.summary_ja: 喀血と多発性の肺、リンパ節、脳転移を呈した26歳男性の精巣原発絨毛癌の症例。精巣摘除術とPVB化学療法は進行により奏効しなかったため、6コースの併用化学療法を施行した。遠隔転移は縮小し、重篤な毒性なく完全寛解が得られた。フォローアップ時点で健康状態は良好であった。
pmid-3754109.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with testicular choriocarcinoma presented with hemoptysis and multiple lung, lymph node, and cerebral metastases. After orchiectomy and initial PVB chemotherapy failed because of progression, he received a six-course combination of methotrexate, vincristine, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, adriamycin, and melphalan. Distant metastases largely regressed, and he achieved complete remission without severe toxicity. He remained in good health at follow-up.

pmid-3754728.summary_ja: 縦隔（胸腺）原発セミノーマ3例では、リンパ濾胞過形成・嚢胞・類上皮肉芽腫・線維化などの二次的変化が強く、セミノーマ成分が不明瞭となった。ケラチン免疫染色や胎盤型ALP陽性所見が診断の助けとなる。予後が良好なため、他の縦隔腫瘍との誤診に注意が必要である。
pmid-3754728.summary_en: Three thymic seminomas showed unusual secondary changes, including reactive follicular hyperplasia, large cysts, epithelioid granulomas, and fibrosis, which obscured the seminoma component. Keratin immunostaining highlighted thymic epithelium adjacent to seminoma cells, and seminoma cells were placental alkaline phosphatase positive. These changes were not seen to this degree in other mediastinal tumors. Given the favorable prognosis, the authors caution against misdiagnosis.

pmid-3755028.summary_ja: 無脳症を伴う妊娠21週の胎児に発生した肝奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は三胚葉すべてに由来する組織から成る成熟奇形腫であった。著者らの知る限り、無脳症に伴う肝奇形腫の報告は過去になく、胎児期奇形腫の稀な症例として重要である。
pmid-3755028.summary_en: A case of hepatic teratoma in a 21-week fetus with anencephaly is described. The mature teratoma contained tissues derived from all three germ cell layers. The authors state that hepatic teratoma associated with anencephaly had not been reported previously.

pmid-3756768.summary_ja: 進行期純粋セミノーマ18例にVIP療法を施行し、評価可能16例中14例（88%）が完全寛解に至った。既治療例でも7例中5例（71%）が寛解した。骨髄毒性は強く、10例で減量や投与間隔延長を要した。巨大セミノーマに対して有効性が高いと結論している。
pmid-3756768.summary_en: Eighteen patients with advanced pure seminoma (Stages IIC to IV, including two with primary extragonadal disease) received VIP chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 14 of 16 evaluable patients, including five of seven previously irradiated patients. Remissions lasted 6 to 41 or more months with no relapses. Marked bone marrow toxicity required dose reduction in 10 patients. VIP was highly effective in bulky seminoma, with or without prior radiotherapy.

pmid-3756819.summary_ja: 乏精子症と不妊を訴えた男性の精巣に、上皮内癌（セミノーマ上皮内癌）を認めた。異型細胞内にIgG沈着を認め、血清中には対照500例以上で認められない60kDa精子分子に対する抗体が検出された。染色体の数的・構造的異常もあり、異型細胞は既に悪性化していると考えられた。
pmid-3756819.summary_en: A man with oligospermia and childlessness had carcinoma in situ (seminoma in situ) in one testis, with atypical spermatogonia. Immunohistochemistry showed intracellular IgG deposits in the atypical cells. Serum contained antibodies to a 60 kD sperm molecule that were absent in over 500 controls. Testis biopsy cytogenetics revealed numerical and structural chromosomal aberrations, suggesting the atypical cells were already malignant.

pmid-3759324.summary_ja: 59歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に併存した甲状腺様カルチノイド（strumal carcinoid）を検討。カルチノイドと甲状腺濾胞の両成分が銀親和性を示し、サイログロブリンや神経内分泌マーカーが陽性。電顕で神経分泌顆粒を確認し、混成細胞が起源と考察。
pmid-3759324.summary_en: Immunohistochemical and electron microscopic study of a strumal carcinoid arising with a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary in a 59-year-old woman. The tumor comprised carcinoid and thyroid follicular components. Both showed argyrophilia, and cells stained for thyroglobulin and several neuroendocrine markers, with neurosecretory granules seen ultrastructurally. The authors interpret these cells as hybrid thyroid follicular and carcinoid cells and suggest they are the origin of strumal carcinoid.

pmid-3763073.summary_ja: 1944〜1985年にM.D.アンダーソン病院で治療された純粋な卵巣未熟奇形腫41例の検討。中央年齢17歳、腹痛が主症状。手術単独16例中15例が再発した一方、併用化学療法を受けた多くは生存。全体の71%が生存。病期I・グレード1を除き術後併用化学療法を推奨。
pmid-3763073.summary_en: This M.D. Anderson series reviewed 41 patients with pure immature teratoma of the ovary treated from 1944 to 1985, with a median age of 17 years. Abdominal pain was the most common presenting symptom. Most patients had FIGO stage I disease, and tumors ranged from 6 to 31 cm. Of 16 patients treated with surgery alone, 15 relapsed, whereas most patients receiving vincristine, actinomycin-D and cyclophosphamide remained alive. Overall, 71% were alive and well. The authors recommend surgery followed by combination chemotherapy, except for stage I grade 1 disease.

pmid-3766140.summary_ja: 30週の胎児と26歳女性に生じた頸部奇形腫の2症例報告と文献的考察。両例とも三胚葉由来の成分からなり、胎児例では未熟な成分も認められた。サイログロブリン染色は胎児例のみ陽性で、圧迫された甲状腺濾胞を確認。
pmid-3766140.summary_en: Two cases of cervical teratoma are described: a large neck mass in a 30-week fetus and a multicystic mass in the right lower pole of the thyroid in a 26-year-old woman. Both tumors were composed of tissues from all three germ layers, mostly mature, with some primitive immature elements in the fetal case. Thyroglobulin immunostaining was positive only in the fetal tumor, in compressed thyroid follicles and primitive glandular structures. The report reviews the literature on cervical teratomas.

pmid-3766348.summary_ja: 28歳男性が左陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹で受診。10年前に右半側精巣摘除術を受けており、組織型は胎児性癌とセミノーマであった。今回の左側はセミノーマの純粋型。日本で報告された両側性の胚細胞由来精巣腫瘍96例を集計し、発生頻度や予後を考察。
pmid-3766348.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with painless swelling of the left scrotal contents. Ten years earlier he had undergone right semicastration for embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. Left semicastration now showed pure seminoma. The authors also summarize 96 previously reported Japanese cases of bilateral germ cell testicular tumors, covering incidence, age, histology, interval between tumors, prognosis and proposed mechanisms of tumorigenesis.

pmid-3766664.summary_ja: 本報告は眼窩先天性奇形腫の2症例を提示する。2か月女児では充実性で急速に増大し、15歳女児では嚢胞性で緩徐に進行した。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織から成り、真の腫瘍よりも過誤腫様とされる。新生児の眼窩腫瘤の鑑別診断に含め、可能な限り早期の完全摘出が視機能と眼窩の対称的発育の維持に有利であると結論づけている。
pmid-3766664.summary_en: This case report describes two patients with congenital orbital teratomas, one solid and rapidly growing in a 2-month-old girl and one cystic and slowly progressive in a 15-year-old girl. Teratomas consist of tissues from all three germ layers and are considered choristomas rather than true neoplasms. The authors emphasize the importance of this entity in the differential diagnosis of neonatal orbital masses. Early, complete extirpation, when feasible, offered the best chance of preserving vision and symmetric orbital growth.

pmid-3767390.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍4例に半合成ポドフィロトキシン系薬剤エトポシド(NK 171)を5日間投与した臨床研究である。静脈内または経口投与が行われ、経口投与の1例は23か月間完全寛解を得た。効果は完全寛解1例、不変1例、進行2例であった。脱毛、食欲不振、口内炎などの副作用が見られたが、いずれも重篤・永続的ではなかった。併用化学療法での検討が進行中と報告されている。
pmid-3767390.summary_en: This Japanese clinical study evaluated the semisynthetic podophyllotoxin etoposide (NK 171) in four patients with testicular tumors, given intravenously or orally for five days. One patient had complete remission for 23 months after oral dosing. Responses were one complete remission, one no change, and two progressive disease. Side effects included alopecia, anorexia, stomatitis, phlebitis, anemia, and liver dysfunction, none serious or permanent. The authors noted ongoing testing of etoposide within combination chemotherapy.

pmid-3768168.summary_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌BeWo細胞において、メトトレキサート誘導性の分化に対するヒポキサンチンの影響を検討した。プリンを除去した培地ではメトトレキサートによりRNA合成と細胞肥大が抑制され、ヒポキサンチンの添加で回復した。一方、合胞体栄養膜様形態への分化と胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼの発現はプリンの有無に影響されなかった。プリン欠乏は細胞増殖を左右するが、分化応答は左右しないことが示唆された。
pmid-3768168.summary_en: This study examines how hypoxanthine affects methotrexate-induced differentiation of cultured human choriocarcinoma BeWo cells. Using purine-free medium, methotrexate exposure reduced RNA synthesis and blocked cell enlargement, effects reversed by adding hypoxanthine. In contrast, morphological differentiation toward a syncytiotrophoblast-like phenotype and placental alkaline phosphatase expression were unaffected by purine availability. The findings suggest that purine deprivation governs cell growth but not the differentiation response to methotrexate in this model.

pmid-3768840.summary_ja: 24歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の甲状腺組織から発生したびまん性大細胞型リンパ腫の症例報告である。著者らは、卵巣奇形腫内に発生した悪性リンパ腫の初報例であると述べている。良性様の外観を示す卵巣胚細胞腫瘍内に生じた稀な合併病変として提示されている。治療経過や転帰は抄録には記載されていない。
pmid-3768840.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a diffuse large cell lymphoma arising within thyroid tissue contained in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors state that this is the first reported case of malignant lymphoma arising within an ovarian teratoma. The report highlights an unusual complication occurring within a benign-appearing germ cell tumor of the ovary. Details on treatment and outcome are not provided in the abstract.

pmid-3770648.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性2例の報告である。悪性奇形腫の亜全摘術直後に骨髄への組織球浸潤を伴う悪性組織球症を発症した。両例で風疹抗体価の上昇がみられ、IgM抗体は検出されなかった。1例はウイルス関連血球貪食症候群として治療されたが、両例とも診断後約5か月で死亡した。著者らは縦隔奇形腫と血液悪性腫瘍の関連を指摘し、経時的なウイルス抗体価の測定を勧めている。
pmid-3770648.summary_en: This report describes two young men with mediastinal germ cell tumours who developed malignant histiocytosis with marrow infiltration shortly after subtotal excision of a malignant teratoma. Both showed rising rubella antibody titres without IgM, and one was treated for virus-associated haemophagocytic syndrome. Both died about five months after diagnosis. The authors suggest a biological association between mediastinal teratoma and haematological malignancy, and recommend serial viral titres in such patients.

pmid-3773050.summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児で、斜頸と頸部腫瘤を呈した咽頭傍間隙の浸食性奇形腫の症例である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で診断が示唆され、血管造影で頭蓋底の内頸動脈の圧迫が認められた。5か月時に外科的切除を行い、錐体骨の一部を含めて腫瘍を摘出した。顔面神経、頸動脈、迷走神経は温存された。術中の髄液漏は筋肉パッチで制御された。本腫瘍の診断におけるCTの有用性を強調している。
pmid-3773050.summary_en: This report describes a three-month-old infant with an erosive teratoma of the parapharyngeal space presenting as torticollis and a neck mass. Computed tomography suggested the diagnosis, and angiography showed compromise of the internal carotid artery. Surgical resection at five months removed the tumor along with part of the petrous bone, with the facial nerve, carotid artery, and vagus nerve preserved. An intraoperative CSF leak was controlled with a muscle plug. The authors stress the value of CT in diagnosing this tumor.

pmid-3773076.summary_ja: 1986年の報告である。精巣の悪性奇形腫に併存して発生した稀な悪性性腺間質腫瘍を記述している。非胚細胞成分は化学療法に抵抗性を示し、リンパ節、肺、骨、肝臓に転移した。著者らは、化学療法感受性の胚細胞腫瘍が破壊されると非胚細胞腫瘍が目立つ可能性を論じ、この成分が主要な予後因子であり、以後の治療変更の指標になると述べている。
pmid-3773076.summary_en: This 1986 report describes a rare malignant gonadal stromal tumor arising alongside a malignant teratoma of the testis. The nongerminal stromal component proved resistant to chemotherapy and metastasized to lymph nodes, lung, bone, and liver. The authors argue that chemoresistant nongerminal components may become more apparent when chemosensitive germ cell elements are destroyed by treatment, and that this component is the main prognostic factor and should guide subsequent therapy.

pmid-3775664.summary_ja: 27歳男性の甲状腺腫に生じた原発性悪性奇形腫の症例報告。術前に診察、穿刺吸引、CTで悪性が疑われ、亜全摘術で確定した。放射線療法と化学療法は忍容性良好だったが、術後2か月で死亡した。成人の頸部奇形腫は悪性で予後不良との文献的知見もまとめられている。
pmid-3775664.summary_en: The authors report a 27-year-old man with a large goiter who was found to have a primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid, a very rare finding. Malignancy was suspected preoperatively from examination, needle aspiration, and CT, and subtotal debulking thyroidectomy confirmed it. Combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy were well tolerated, but the patient died two months after surgery. The paper also reviews the literature on adult cervical teratomas, which are usually malignant with a poor prognosis.

pmid-3775798.summary_ja: 中国の漢方薬由来の植物蛋白トリクサンチンを培養細胞で検討した。絨毛癌細胞に対して選択的な細胞毒性を示し、マウスメラノーマ細胞も感受性を示した。24時間処理では効果は目立たないが、対照培地で48時間追加培養すると細胞毒性が増強した。トロフォブラスト細胞に特異的な活性があると結論づけている。
pmid-3775798.summary_en: The study tested trichosanthin, a plant protein from a Chinese medicinal herb already used to treat trophoblastic tumours, on cultured cells. Trichosanthin showed selective cytotoxicity toward choriocarcinoma cells, and mouse melanoma cells were also sensitive. Cytotoxicity was modest after 24 hours but increased with a further 48 hours of incubation in control medium. The authors conclude that trichosanthin has specific activity against trophoblastic cells.

pmid-3776996.summary_ja: 肺原発絨毛癌と女性化乳房を伴う男性の血清と腫瘍組織のホルモンを解析した。血清エストロゲンは上昇し、アンドロゲンも異常に高値であった。腫瘍はアンドロゲンとエストロゲンを濃縮し、アロマターゼ活性を保持していた。β-hCGが精巣のアンドロゲン産生を刺激したと考察し、女性化乳房はエストロゲンが相対的に過剰な場合に生じると結論づけている。
pmid-3776996.summary_en: The authors studied sex hormone profiles in serum and tumor tissue from a man with pulmonary choriocarcinoma and gynecomastia. Serum estrogens were elevated, and serum androgens were unusually high. The tumor contained increased androgens and estrogens and had aromatase activity but lacked androgen biosynthesis enzymes. They conclude that tumor-derived beta-hCG stimulated testicular androgen production, and that gynecomastia can occur when estrogens are disproportionately elevated.

pmid-3778123.summary_ja: 19歳男性の良性縦隔奇形腫の症例と剖検所見を報告。文献解析で、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるクラインフェルター症候群の頻度は一般集団の30〜40倍と推定された。著者らは、この染色体異常が性腺外縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の発生素地になる可能性を指摘している。
pmid-3778123.summary_en: The authors describe a histologically benign mediastinal teratoma in a 19-year-old man with Klinefelter's syndrome, including clinical and autopsy findings. A literature-based analysis found that Klinefelter's syndrome occurs 30 to 40 times more often among patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors than in the general population. The authors suggest this genetic abnormality predisposes patients to extragonadal mediastinal germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-3778153.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来のホムンクルスの病理・画像所見を報告し、文献上の22例と比較した。子宮内妊娠と同時に卵巣ホムンクルスが存在した初めての例とされる。本例では上肢が下肢より発達しており、従来の報告とは逆の所見であった。
pmid-3778153.summary_en: The paper describes the pathologic and radiographic findings of a homunculus arising in a mature ovarian teratoma and compares them with 22 previously reported cases. The authors note it is the first reported ovarian homunculus coexisting with an intrauterine pregnancy. In this case the upper extremities were better developed than the lower extremities, the reverse of earlier reports.

pmid-3778463.summary_ja: 多能性細胞株311の未分化胎児性癌細胞でc-mos転写産物(約1.8・4.6・6.1kb)を検出した。レチノイン酸による分化誘導で発現は抑制された。c-mosは分化した組織では通常発現しないが、発生の初期段階で役割を果たすと示唆されている。
pmid-3778463.summary_en: The study detected c-mos proto-oncogene transcripts in undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells of the pluripotential cell line 311, with three major transcripts of about 1.8, 4.6, and 6.1 kb. Expression was suppressed when retinoic acid induced differentiation. c-mos is normally silent in differentiated tissues, and the authors suggest its product plays a role in early development.

pmid-3779692.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍モデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞株PA1の糖タンパク質に結合したO型糖鎖を解析した基礎研究である。還元的β脱離、エキソグリコシダーゼ消化、過ヨウ素酸酸化、レクチンアフィニティクロマトグラフィーを用い、αおよびβの両アノマーを持つ二糖アルコールを同定した。胚細胞腫瘍細胞の糖鎖構造を明らかにする構造生化学的知見である。
pmid-3779692.summary_en: This basic biochemistry study analyzes O-linked glycans from PA1, a human embryonal carcinoma cell line used as a germ cell tumor model. Using reductive beta-elimination, exoglycosidase digestion, periodate oxidation, and lectin affinity chromatography, the authors identified disaccharide alcohols carrying both alpha- and beta-anomers of D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-GalNAc. The structures were confirmed by lectin binding. The findings define the glycan repertoire of germ cell tumor cells at the structural level and provide baseline data on glycoprotein composition in this tumor type.

pmid-3780760.summary_ja: 1965〜1984年にイタリアの単施設で治療された卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）105例の臨床的検討である。好発年齢は生殖年齢で、約10%に捻転が認められ、2例で上皮性悪性変化がみられた。治療は年齢や経産回数、合併する婦人科疾患に応じて選択され、文献と比較されている。
pmid-3780760.summary_en: This Italian single-institution series reviews 105 ovarian dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas, treated between 1965 and 1984. Patients ranged from 9 to 70 years, with most in the reproductive age group. Most lesions were unilateral, while about 9.5% were bilateral. Torsion occurred in about 10% of cases, and epithelial malignant degeneration in 2 cases (1.95%). Enucleation was performed in 12 cases, and other management was tailored to age, parity, and associated gynecologic disease. The authors compare their findings with the published literature.

pmid-3780761.summary_ja: FIGO病期Ⅰ期の純粋型卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ5例の報告である。全例に片側卵管卵巣摘出術が行われ、5年間のフォローアップで再発は認められなかった。あわせて、病期分類、予後評価、およびⅠ期における議論の多い治療法について現状をレビューしている。
pmid-3780761.summary_en: This report describes five patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma, all with FIGO stage I disease. Each underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy as the primary surgical treatment. Five-year follow-up showed no recurrence in any patient. The authors also review the current approach to staging, prognostic assessment, and the controversial therapeutic options for stage I disease.

pmid-3781466.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株から、メトトレキサート耐性の亜株を段階的に7株樹立し、耐性獲得の機序を解析した基礎研究である。薬剤の細胞内輸送の低下と、DHFR遺伝子増幅によるDHFR活性の上昇が耐性に関与していた。二重微小染色体の出現も耐性度と並行しており、絨毛癌治療における化学療法の不成功を説明しうる知見である。
pmid-3781466.summary_en: This basic research study investigates how human choriocarcinoma cells acquire resistance to methotrexate, a key drug for treating choriocarcinoma. Seven resistant sublines were derived stepwise from two choriocarcinoma cell lines. Resistance involved reduced drug transport and increased dihydrofolate reductase activity, which was linked to amplification of the DHFR gene. Double-minute chromosomes appeared in parallel with resistance levels, though some cells had them without DHFR amplification, suggesting additional mechanisms. The findings help explain why methotrexate chemotherapy can fail.

pmid-3781489.summary_ja: 正常の死産児・乳児・小児の卵巣剖検例を再検討し、ゴナドブラストーマに類似する構造を調べた研究である。55例中19例の乳児で、環状小管を伴う性索腫瘍様の構造が認められ、多くは卵胞嚢胞に伴っていた。これらは腫瘍発生の初期病変である可能性があり、良性の模倣病変と真の腫瘍との鑑別に有用である。
pmid-3781489.summary_en: Researchers reviewed ovarian autopsy tissue from 55 stillborn infants and children to clarify lesions resembling gonadoblastoma. Structures mimicking gonadoblastoma and sex cord tumours with annular tubules were found in 19 infants, usually with follicular cysts and resembling atretic follicles. They appeared most often during the period of physiological oocyte loss. The authors propose these structures represent an early 'first hit' and may be precursors to some sex cord-stromal and possibly germ cell neoplasms in childhood. The study is useful for distinguishing benign mimics from true neoplasia.

pmid-3781492.summary_ja: 精管切除後11年の40歳男性が右精巣腫瘍を呈し、精巣摘除術でセミノーマが確認された。輸精管の結節部では輸精管結節症とともに増殖する胚細胞が認められ、悪性胚細胞の停滞部位である可能性が示唆された。症例報告であり、その発症機序を考察している。
pmid-3781492.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man who had a vasectomy 11 years earlier and later presented with a right testicular tumor. Orchidectomy revealed a seminoma along with a nodule on the vas deferens. Histology of the vasal nodule showed vasitis nodosa and, notably, proliferating germ cells. The authors suggest the vas deferens may be a site where malignant germ cells become arrested and discuss the pathogenesis of this lesion.

pmid-3781557.summary_ja: 奇形腫の3つの起源様式と双生児の5つの起源様式について、確率を算出した遺伝学的理論研究である。同じ枠組みで、単黄体・二精子受精双生児の検定やセントロメア地図作成が可能になるとされる。非分離によるトリソミーや三倍体も同様の情報をもたらすと述べている。要旨のみのため、詳細な導出は示されていない。
pmid-3781557.summary_en: This theoretical genetics paper estimates probabilities for three proposed modes of teratoma origin alongside five modes of twin origin. The same framework allows testing for monoluteal dispermic twins and supports centromere mapping. The authors note that trisomy and triploidy arising from nondisjunction yield equivalent information. Only the abstract was available, so the derivations and the specific teratoma mechanisms are not described here.

pmid-3782549.summary_ja: 化学療法後に未熟卵巣奇形腫の肝転移で生じた、未熟組織から成熟組織への逆転換の症例報告である。逆転換はまれな現象であり、CTによって肝転移の内部構造の変化を示した。治療による組織学的成熟が経時的に画像所見を変化させうることを示し、治療後の転移性奇形腫の画像理解に有用である。
pmid-3782549.summary_en: A case report describing retroconversion, the reversion of immature to mature tissue, in hepatic metastases from an immature ovarian teratoma after chemotherapy. The authors used computed tomography to document changes in the internal architecture of the liver metastases during this uncommon phenomenon, highlighting imaging features associated with the transformation. Because retroconversion is rare, the report is mainly valuable for radiologic recognition of treated metastatic teratoma and for understanding how therapy-induced histologic maturation can alter imaging appearances over time in patients.

pmid-3782951.summary_ja: 異型ディスジャーミノーマ由来のJOHYL-1株をヌードマウスの腹腔内へ移植し、腹膜の経時変化を観察した。中皮細胞の腫大や脱落が、腫瘍細胞の接着と筋層浸潤に先行することを示した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍が腹膜に定着する機序の理解に寄与し、本細胞株が腹膜播種の有用なin vivoモデルであることを示した。
pmid-3782951.summary_en: Using the JOHYL-1 ascites cell line derived from an atypical dysgerminoma, the authors transplanted tumor cells intraperitoneally into nude mice and followed peritoneal changes by light and scanning electron microscopy. Mesothelial swelling, microvillous changes, and loss of mesothelial cells preceded tumor adhesion and infiltration into the muscle layer. The study shows how ovarian germ cell tumor cells implant in the peritoneum and proposes this cell line as a useful in vivo model of peritoneal dissemination.

pmid-3783382.summary_ja: 6歳半の女児が仮性思春期早発症で受診し、性腺芽腫と診断された。核型は46,XXで、血清エストラジオールが著明に高値であった。Y染色体と異形成性生殖腺が発生素因となることを概説し、Y染色体の有無による分類を提案している。小児の非定型的な性分化疾患における胚細胞腫瘍の管理に役立つ知見である。
pmid-3783382.summary_en: A 6.5-year-old girl with pseudoprecocious puberty was found to have a gonadoblastoma. Karyotype was 46,XX, serum estradiol was markedly elevated, and androgens were normal. The authors review how the Y chromosome and dysgenetic gonad predispose to gonadoblastoma development. They propose subclassifying gonadoblastomas according to Y chromosome presence or absence, a useful framework for managing rare germ cell tumors in pediatric patients with atypical sexual development.

pmid-3784564.summary_ja: 肺実質に生じたテラトカルシノーマの9例目の報告である。治療は広範な外科的切除と補助化学療法を組み合わせる。残存病変またはリンパ節転移には術後放射線療法、胸壁浸潤には術前放射線療法を考慮する。原発性肺胚細胞腫瘍は極めてまれで治療エビデンスが限られるため、症例に基づく指針は重要である。
pmid-3784564.summary_en: The authors report the ninth documented case of teratocarcinoma arising in lung parenchyma. Management should combine wide surgical resection with adjuvant chemotherapy. Postoperative radiation therapy is recommended for residual disease or nodal metastasis, while preoperative radiation may be considered when the chest wall is involved. The report is valuable because primary pulmonary germ cell tumors are extremely rare and treatment evidence is limited, so case-based guidance matters.

pmid-3787857.summary_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞は稀な良性病変で、精巣腫瘍の約1%を占める。20〜40歳に無痛性の精巣腫大や偶発的結節として発見されることが多い。良性奇形腫の単一表皮分化に由来し、胚細胞起源を示す根拠がある。治療には議論があるが、多くの著者は根治的精巣摘除術を行っている。
pmid-3787857.summary_en: An epidermoid cyst of the testis is a rare benign lesion, accounting for about 1% of testicular tumors. It typically presents between ages 20 and 40 as painless testicular enlargement or an incidental nodule. Histology shows a keratin-filled cyst lined by squamous epithelium. The authors note evidence that it arises from germ cells as monoepidermal differentiation of a benign teratoma. Most authors treat it with radical orchiectomy, although management is debated.

pmid-3787858.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後、術後CTで下大静脈に充満欠損が偶然発見された稀な症例の報告である。通常の血栓か腫瘍性血栓かを鑑別できなかったため血栓摘出術を施行し、術後診断は通常の血栓であった。下大静脈に孤立して生じる血栓の原因を文献的に概説し、血栓摘出術の適応について考察している。
pmid-3787858.summary_en: This case report describes inferior vena cava (IVC) thrombosis detected by postoperative computed tomography after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for a testicular tumor. The filling defect could not be distinguished between an ordinary and a neoplastic thrombus, so thrombectomy was performed, and the thrombus proved benign. The authors review causes of isolated IVC thrombi and discuss indications for thrombectomy in this setting.

pmid-3787873.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが下大静脈に二次的に浸潤し、多発性肺塞栓症からカバフィルター留置を要した症例の報告である。下大静脈血栓症および肺塞栓のCT・静脈造影所見を詳述する。セミノーマに特徴的な低吸収性リンパ節腫大がCTでの血栓診断を妨げうること、画像上で下大静脈血栓症を認めた精巣腫瘍患者では腫瘍浸潤を疑うべきことを指摘している。
pmid-3787873.summary_en: This report describes a patient with testicular seminoma that secondarily invaded the inferior vena cava, causing multiple pulmonary emboli that required placement of a caval filter. The authors detail the CT and venographic features of caval thrombosis and pulmonary embolism. They note that the low-density lymphadenopathy typical of seminoma may obscure caval thrombosis on CT, and advise suspecting tumor invasion in any testicular tumor patient with radiographic caval thrombosis.

pmid-3791287.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の基質内に形成された微小小脳と小脳茎の症例解析である。神経細胞の分布と構成を、小脳組織発生に関する近年のデータに照らして検討している。胚の菱脳翼板に類似した増殖能を持つ神経外胚葉性の胚芽層が、この高度に組織化された神経組織を生じさせたと推察している。良性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における神経分化の一例である。
pmid-3791287.summary_en: This study analyzes a microcerebellum and cerebellar stalk that formed within the stroma of a mature ovarian teratoma. The distribution and organization of nerve cells were examined in light of recent data on cerebellar histogenesis. The authors propose that a neuroectodermal germinal zone with proliferative capacity, similar to the alar plates of the embryonic rhombencephalon, generated this highly organized neural tissue. The finding illustrates neural differentiation within a benign ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-3791848.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類におけるコンピュータ断層撮影とリンパ管造影の影響を、セミノーマ78例と奇形腫66例で検討した。CTにより、セミノーマの6%、奇形腫の20%が病期上方修正された。さらに、CTで病期Iと判定された一部の患者では、リンパ管造影で病期が変更された。CTは化学療法や放射線療法前後の転移の評価、再発の検索に有用であった。著者らは、奇形腫では胸腹部CT、セミノーマではリンパ管造影と腹部CT、必要に応じて胸部CTを推奨している。
pmid-3791848.summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of computed tomography (CT) and lymphography on staging of testicular germ cell tumors in 78 seminoma and 66 teratoma patients. CT upstaged 6% of seminoma and 20% of teratoma patients, and lymphography changed the stage in a further subset of CT-stage I patients. CT was valuable for assessing metastatic disease around chemotherapy and radiotherapy and for detecting relapse. The authors recommend thoracoabdominal CT for teratoma and lymphography followed by abdominal and thoracic CT for seminoma.

pmid-3794452.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト絨毛癌細胞株(GCH-1)に対し、エトポシドとシスプラチンの抗腫瘍効果と副作用を検討した。抑制効果はエトポシド>シスプラチン>MTXの順で、シスプラチン群で体重減少が最も大きかった。エトポシドは肝臓・腎臓からの消失が速く、副作用の少なさに関与すると考えられた。
pmid-3794452.summary_en: This study evaluated the antitumor and adverse effects of etoposide and cisplatin against a human choriocarcinoma cell line (GCH-1) transplanted into nude mice, compared with methotrexate. Both agents suppressed tumor growth, with etoposide being most effective, and serum beta-hCG rose only in untreated controls. Cisplatin caused the greatest body weight loss. Drug concentration measurements showed etoposide cleared more rapidly from liver and kidney than cisplatin, which may partly explain its lower toxicity.

pmid-3794948.summary_ja: 生後40日の男児に発生した巨大な胃奇形腫の症例である。グリア組織の間に未熟な神経成分が認められた。過去の報告では多くが良性とされ、胃の奇形腫の悪性化は極めて稀である。新生児期に未熟成分を伴う胃奇形腫が見られた点が特徴である。
pmid-3794948.summary_en: A 40-day-old male infant presented with a massive gastric teratoma containing immature neural elements among glial masses. This case report describes the clinical and histological features of a rare primary gastric teratoma in early infancy. The authors note that most previously reported gastric teratomas have been benign, and that malignancy at this site is extremely rare. The case highlights the unusual location of the tumor and the presence of immature components in a neonate.

pmid-3804558.summary_ja: 周辺部にステロイドホルモン産生細胞を伴う機能性間質を有する卵巣腫瘍24例の病理学的検討である。多くは卵巣甲状腺腫を含む単胚葉性奇形腫で、シンシチオトロホブラストを含むディスジャーミノーマも含まれた。一部の腫瘍細胞でhCGとそのβサブユニットが検出された。
pmid-3804558.summary_en: This retrospective pathology series describes 24 ovarian tumors with functioning stroma in which steroid-hormone-producing cells lie at the periphery. Most were monodermal teratomas, including struma ovarii, and the group also included a dysgerminoma containing syncytiotrophoblast cells. Clinically, androgenic and estrogenic features were common, and hCG and its beta subunit were detected in some neoplastic cells. The authors recommend distinguishing these tumors from typical ovarian tumors with functioning stroma, in which lutein cells are scattered throughout the stroma.

pmid-3806969.summary_ja: 55歳日本人男性の胃原発絨毛癌の症例報告である。当初は胃癌と診断されたが、生検で絨毛癌の組織像を呈していた。剖検では多数の転移巣がいずれも絨毛癌と確認された。胃癌からの脱分化により生じる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-3806969.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old Japanese man who presented with epigastric pain and was initially diagnosed with gastric carcinoma. Surgical biopsy revealed a choriocarcinoma histologic pattern, and autopsy showed multiple metastatic sites, all confirmed as choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that primary gastric choriocarcinoma may arise from gastric cancer through retrodifferentiation. The report emphasizes the importance of histologic re-evaluation when radiologic and endoscopic findings suggest a common carcinoma.

pmid-3812148.summary_ja: 62歳男性の精巣純粋絨毛癌の症例報告(1986年)。陰嚢腫大を当初は水瘤や副睾丸炎と誤診した。精巣摘除後、β-hCG高値、AFP正常で、シスプラチンを含む化学療法8コース施行。肺転移が進行し死亡。剖検で肺、副腎、腎臓への転移を確認。
pmid-3812148.summary_en: This 1986 case report describes a 62-year-old man with pure choriocarcinoma of the testis. Presentation was a painless enlarging scrotal mass, initially misdiagnosed as hydrocele and epididymitis. After high orchiectomy, histopathology confirmed classic pure choriocarcinoma with elevated beta-hCG and normal AFP. He received eight courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, but developed pulmonary metastases and died of carcinomatosis. Autopsy showed metastases to lungs, adrenal glands, and kidney without nodal involvement.

pmid-3940510.summary_ja: 1986年の耳鼻咽喉科領域の報告。精巣セミノーマの側頭骨転移を示す。左側頭骨の病理学的検査で、外耳道、鼓膜、中耳腔、乳突粘膜、鼓膜張筋へ腫瘍浸潤を認めた。二次性セミノーマの側頭骨病理報告は極めて稀と記載。
pmid-3940510.summary_en: This 1986 Archives of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery report describes temporal bone metastasis of classic testicular seminoma, which the authors note is extremely rare. Pathologic examination of the left temporal bone showed tumor infiltration involving the external auditory canal, tympanic membrane, middle ear cavity, mastoid mucosa, and tensor tympani muscle. The authors state that no prior temporal bone pathology report of secondary seminoma exists beyond one clinical case.

pmid-3941332.summary_ja: 1986年の前向き研究。臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣がん62例に精巣摘除術のみで経過観察を行った。59例中69.5%が無病生存、30.5%が再発。再発は後腹膜転移や肺転移が中心。胎児性癌、pT>1、血管侵襲、経陰嚢生検が再発因子とされた。
pmid-3941332.summary_en: This 1986 J Clin Oncol study prospectively followed 62 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer who received orchiectomy alone with surveillance. Of 59 evaluable cases, 69.5% remained disease free, while 30.5% relapsed, mostly retroperitoneal or pulmonary. Embryonal carcinoma, pT>1 tumors, vascular invasion, and transscrotal biopsy predicted relapse. Salvage cisplatin-based therapy achieved remission in most relapsing patients. The authors conclude surveillance should be restricted to specialized centers.

pmid-3941973.summary_ja: 分娩後2日目にくも膜下出血を発症した女性の症例を報告する。緊急手術で破裂した頭蓋内動脈瘤からの血腫を除去したところ、動脈瘤壁に絨毛癌の転移が組織学的に確認された。著者らは絨毛癌転移による頭蓋内動脈瘤の既報6例もあわせて検討し、絨毛癌が脳血管に転移して出血を引き起こしうることを示している。
pmid-3941973.summary_en: A woman presented with subarachnoid hemorrhage two days after delivery. Emergency surgery removed an intracerebral clot from a ruptured aneurysm, and histology showed that the aneurysm wall was metastatic choriocarcinoma. The authors reviewed six previously reported cases of intracranial aneurysm caused by choriocarcinoma metastasis, indicating that choriocarcinoma can seed cerebral vessels and cause hemorrhage.

pmid-3943018.summary_ja: 精巣の病期II胎児性癌に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した後にリンパ嚢腫を生じた症例を報告する。42か月にわたり安定して推移し、追加の抗腫瘍療法は不要であった。文献的検討から、基本的には待機的管理が妥当とし、隣接構造の閉塞があれば経皮的ドレナージを考慮し、保存的治療が奏効しない場合に開放術を選択すべきとしている。
pmid-3943018.summary_en: A patient developed a lymphocele after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for stage II testicular embryonal carcinoma. Diagnostic workup confirmed its benign nature, and it remained stable over 42 months without further antitumor therapy. Reviewing the literature, the authors conclude that management should be expectant. Percutaneous drainage with or without sclerotherapy is reasonable if neighboring structures are obstructed, and open marsupialization is reserved for failure of conservative measures.

pmid-3943353.summary_ja: 成人の頸部奇形腫としては12例目となる症例を報告する。傍咽頭間隙に生じた悪性病変が、転移による頸髄圧迫症状で発症した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、ダイナミックスキャン、血管造影による評価を示し、文献を検討している。性腺外の悪性奇形腫が脊髄圧迫で発症しうることを示す稀な症例である。
pmid-3943353.summary_en: The authors describe a 12th reported adult cervical teratoma, a malignant lesion in the parapharyngeal space that presented with cervical cord compression from metastases. CT, dynamic scanning, and angiographic evaluation are shown, and the literature is reviewed. The case illustrates that extragonadal malignant teratoma can present with spinal cord compression, a rare manifestation to keep in mind in the differential diagnosis of neck masses.

pmid-3943365.summary_ja: 2例の嚢胞性病変が経過中に自然に画像上消失した症例を報告する。1例は21歳男性の縦隔セミノーマ内の嚢胞性変化で、その後の胸部X線およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で消失した。もう1例は65歳男性の心膜嚢胞である。悪性および良性嚢胞が自然に画像上消失する機序について考察している。
pmid-3943365.summary_en: The authors describe two rare cystic lesions that resolved spontaneously on serial chest radiography and CT. One was a cystic change within a mediastinal seminoma in a 21-year-old man, which disappeared on subsequent imaging. The other was a pericardial cyst in a 65-year-old man that also resolved. Possible mechanisms for the spontaneous radiographic resolution of malignant and benign cysts are discussed.

pmid-3944893.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの165例を解析し、予後因子を検討した。病期Iでは胎児性癌と血管侵襲が後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の転移・再発の予測因子であった。臨床病期IIでは大きいまたは多数のリンパ節、リンパ管・血管侵襲、胎児性癌が再発リスクを高めた。病期IIIでは3つ以上の臓器系の関与と卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛癌が生存率を低下させた。
pmid-3944893.summary_en: This study of 165 patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer examined factors predicting outcome. In pathological stage I, embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion predicted metastasis or recurrence after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. In clinical stage II, large or numerous nodes, lymphovascular invasion, and embryonal carcinoma with or without choriocarcinoma predicted recurrence. In stage III, involvement of three or more organ systems and yolk sac tumor or choriocarcinoma worsened survival.

pmid-3944894.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍73例のうち、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略する試験プロトコルに登録されたのは10例であった。残りの63例は画像所見の疑い、腫瘍マーカー上昇などで除外された。登録例のうち3例が再発し、いずれも後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法で救済された。再発例はすべて胎児性癌であり、フォローアップのみで管理する症例では局所および転移の十分な評価が必要であると結論している。
pmid-3944894.summary_en: Of 73 patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors, 10 were enrolled in a protocol omitting retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, after 63 were excluded for suspicious imaging, elevated markers, or other reasons. Three of the 10 relapsed and were salvaged with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and chemotherapy, and all three had embryonal carcinoma. The authors conclude that thorough local and metastatic assessment is needed to reduce recurrence risk in patients managed with follow-up alone.

pmid-3944917.summary_ja: 前立腺に原発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の1例を報告し、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の問題を考察している。これらの腫瘍の予後、病期分類、管理は転移性の原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と類似すると述べている。抄録には患者の治療経過や転帰の詳細は記載されていない。1986年の報告で、前立腺の胚細胞腫瘍の位置づけを示す文献である。
pmid-3944917.summary_en: The authors describe one patient with a primary nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the prostate and discuss extragonadal germ cell tumors more broadly. They note that prognosis, staging, and management of these tumors parallel those of metastatic primary testicular germ cell tumors. The abstract provides no detail on the patient's treatment or outcome.

pmid-3945108.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の14例を臨床・病理学的に検討した1986年の報告である。症例数が少なく治療法も多様だったため、特定の治療は推奨できないとしている。一部の症例では仙骨前奇形腫を併発していた。組織学的グレードは予後の信頼できる指標とされ、グレード0の転移病変は良性で予後良好と考えられた。
pmid-3945108.summary_en: This 1986 review describes 14 patients with immature ovarian teratoma, with clinical and pathologic analysis. Two patients had immature presacral teratoma alongside the ovarian lesion, and one had monodermal malignant neuroectodermal teratoma. Because the cohort was small and treatment varied widely, the authors could not recommend a specific therapy. Histologic grade appeared to be a reliable prognostic indicator, and grade 0 metastatic lesions were considered benign with favorable outcome.

pmid-3945470.summary_ja: 超音波検査で卵巣腫瘍を胞状奇胎と誤認した症例の報告である。腫瘍が産生した低値のβ-hCGにより、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の診断が裏付けられた。合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴い、hCGがわずかに上昇する場合の鑑別診断を考察している。腹水を伴う病期ICの症例である。
pmid-3945470.summary_en: The authors report a case in which ultrasound mistook an ovarian neoplasm for a hydatidiform mole. Low hCG produced by the tumor helped confirm the diagnosis of dysgerminoma. The tumor contained syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, and the report discusses the differential diagnosis of minimally elevated hCG. The patient presented with ascites and was staged IC. The case highlights diagnostic pitfalls of sonography in intrauterine trophoblastic disease versus ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-3946034.summary_ja: セミノーマに対し放射線療法を受けた男性84名を対象に、平均10年の追跡期間で性機能・婚姻・妊孕性をアンケート調査した。精液量の減少が49%、オルガズムの強度低下が33%と多く報告された。30%が不妊を心配し、治療後に13名が子どもを授かった。性機能障害と不妊は一部の患者にとって重要な懸念であると結論づけている。
pmid-3946034.summary_en: This study surveyed 84 men treated with radiotherapy for seminoma (stages I to III) with a mean follow-up of ten years. Most were married, but sizable minorities reported reduced sexual activity, erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, and reduced orgasm intensity. Reduced semen volume (49%) was most common. Thirty percent worried about infertility, and thirteen children were conceived after treatment. The authors conclude that sexual dysfunction and infertility are important concerns for a subgroup of men treated for seminoma.

pmid-3946525.summary_ja: in situハイブリダイゼーションにより、胞状奇胎の細胞栄養膜細胞とBeWo絨毛癌細胞株でc-mycおよびc-rasがん遺伝子の発現を検出した。初期絨毛胎盤でも発現が認められた一方、11週胚や満期胎盤では認められなかった。妊娠各時期の胎盤組織と比較し、発現パターンの違いを示した。絨毛性疾患における知見の意義を考察している。
pmid-3946525.summary_en: Using in situ hybridization, the authors detected c-myc and c-ras oncogene expression in cytotrophoblast of hydatidiform mole and in the malignant trophoblast cell line BeWo. Expression was also seen in early villous placenta but not in an 11-week conceptus or term placenta. The study compares expression across these gestational and malignant trophoblast samples and discusses the significance of the findings. Because the subject is gestational trophoblastic disease itself, it falls within this site's scope.

pmid-3948114.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺異形成（Swyer症候群）の6症例を報告している。性腺腫瘍の有無別にH-Y抗原を測定し、2名の同胞は経時的に追跡された。性腺腫瘍を切除後、H-Y抗原は中間値へ変化し、性腺芽腫を伴う症例では男性域まで上昇した。性腺遺残組織の腫瘍化能とH-Y抗原レベルとの関連が示唆されている。性腺芽腫は性腺腫瘍の代表例である。
pmid-3948114.summary_en: The authors describe six patients with Swyer syndrome (46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis). Serial H-Y antigen measurements were compared in patients with and without gonadal tumors, including two siblings followed over time. Antigen levels shifted toward the intermediate range after tumor-bearing gonads were removed, while one sibling's levels rose into the male range with gonadoblastoma. The findings suggest a link between the tumorigenic potential of gonadal remnants and H-Y antigen levels.

pmid-3948124.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移例で、頭蓋内圧亢進により治療導入前に生命が脅かされた患者の臨床報告である。バルビツール酸系薬剤で頭蓋内圧を管理し、適切な治療を開始できた経過を示している。頭蓋内転移は予後を悪化させるものの、治療への良好な反応も報告されている。中枢神経系以外に原発した胚細胞腫瘍からの脳転移である点が特徴である。
pmid-3948124.summary_en: This clinical report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma and intracranial metastases in whom raised intracranial pressure threatened survival before appropriate therapy could take effect. The authors outline how barbiturate therapy was used to manage intracranial pressure so that treatment could be started. The abstract notes that intracranial metastases worsen prognosis, though reports show response to therapy is possible. The case concerns brain metastasis from a non-CNS germ cell tumor.

pmid-3949674.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で内胚葉様に分化させたH6胎児性癌細胞株が、拡散性で安定な増殖促進因子を分泌することを示した。この作用は線維芽細胞や幹細胞自身よりも大きかった。作用は一部、細胞外マトリックスタンパク質やインスリン様増殖因子2に由来すると考えられている。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的モデルとして、胎児性癌幹細胞の増殖制御を検討している。
pmid-3949674.summary_en: The authors show that retinoic acid-induced endoderm-like cells derived from the H6 embryonal carcinoma line secrete a diffusible, stable factor that stimulates growth of H6 stem cells more than fibroblasts or stem cells themselves. Stimulation was not reciprocal and was partly attributed to extracellular matrix proteins or insulin-like growth factor type 2, but not insulin. The study addresses growth regulation of embryonal carcinoma stem cells as a model of germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-3950163.summary_ja: 横隔膜に生じた嚢胞性奇形腫の英語文献上初の症例報告である。CT所見は卵巣奇形腫に類似し、軟部組織、脂肪、石灰化、歯を含んでいた。極めてまれな部位の腫瘍であり、性腺外奇形腫の画像所見として卵巣奇形腫との類似性を示した点に意義があり、画像診断の参考となる。
pmid-3950163.summary_en: This report presents the first English-language case of a cystic teratoma arising in the diaphragm, an exceedingly rare site. CT findings resembled those of ovarian teratomas, showing soft tissue, fat, areas of calcification, and a tooth within the mass. The authors highlight that the imaging appearance of this extragonadal tumor closely matches ovarian teratomas, which may help recognition of similar lesions elsewhere.

pmid-3951713.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの患者に、硬膜転移を原因とする急性硬膜下血腫が生じた症例である。非外傷性の硬膜下血腫は、播種性悪性腫瘍の硬膜転移による稀な合併症である。本症例では、転移性セミノーマが初発症状として出血を呈しており、胚細胞腫瘍の中枢神経転移が出血で発症しうることを示した点に意義がある。
pmid-3951713.summary_en: A patient with testicular seminoma developed an acute subdural hematoma. The hematoma was attributed to dural metastasis from the seminoma. The authors note that nontraumatic subdural hematomas are rare complications of dural metastases from disseminated malignancies. This case highlights bleeding as a presenting feature of CNS metastasis from a germ cell tumor arising outside the central nervous system.

pmid-3951790.summary_ja: 1968年から1983年に北イスラエル腫瘍センターで治療された精巣セミノーマ41例の治療成績と治療失敗の経過を解析した報告である。5年生存率は全体で85.4%、病期I症例では92.2%であった。進行例では併用化学療法が推奨され、経陰嚢的アプローチ時の陰嚢照射は必要とされ、補助的な縦隔照射は不要と結論された。
pmid-3951790.summary_en: Outcomes were analyzed for 41 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated at the Northern Israel Oncology Center between 1968 and 1983. The five-year actuarial survival was 85.4% overall and 92.2% for stage I disease. Treatment failures were reviewed, leading to recommendations for combination chemotherapy in advanced disease, scrotal irradiation after transscrotal approach, and omission of adjuvant mediastinal irradiation.

pmid-3952551.summary_ja: 急性腹症を呈した卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の捻転と出血の症例報告である。CTにより診断し、その後の病理学的検査で確認された。急性腹症の患者において、CTが付属器捻転と関連出血の同定に有用であることを強調しており、今後の診療における画像診断の有用性を示している。
pmid-3952551.summary_en: This case report describes torsion and hemorrhage of a benign ovarian cystic teratoma presenting as an acute abdomen. CT enabled the diagnosis, which was subsequently confirmed by pathologic examination. The authors emphasize the value of CT in identifying adnexal torsion and associated hemorrhage in patients with acute abdominal symptoms, supporting its use in the initial evaluation of such presentations.

pmid-3952553.summary_ja: 小児の扁桃に生じた三胚葉性奇形腫の症例を報告している。特徴的な歯様石灰化の評価に単純X線撮影、嚢胞性と充実性の鑑別に超音波検査、病変の広がりと頭蓋内浸潤の評価にコンピュータ断層撮影が有用とされた。外科的切除で治癒し、合併症は出血や呼吸困難に関連するものであった。
pmid-3952553.summary_en: This report describes a trigerminal teratoma of the tonsil in a child, presenting as a head and neck mass. The authors emphasize radiography for detecting tooth-like calcifications, ultrasound for differentiating cystic from solid components, and CT for assessing the extent of the lesion and intracranial involvement. Surgical excision was curative, and complications were related to hemorrhage or respiratory difficulty.

pmid-3955630.summary_ja: マウス初期胚発生の段階を反映する3種の胎児性癌（EC）細胞株（F9、PCC3 N/1、PCC4 Azal）の細胞周期特性を解析した。クローン内の有糸分裂間期の不均一性を利用し、2つのランダム遷移確率モデルに成長制御点を加えて改変した。改変モデルはF9株の細胞周期成長動態をよく記述した。本論文は一連の研究の第I報である。
pmid-3955630.summary_en: The cell-cycle kinetics of three embryonal carcinoma lines (F9, PCC3 N/1, PCC4 Azal), which reflect successive stages of early mouse embryogenesis, were analyzed. A two-random transition probability model was modified by adding a growth-regulating point, exploiting intraclonal heterogeneity in intermitotic times. The modified model described F9 cell-cycle growth kinetics well. This paper is part I of a series.

pmid-3955631.summary_ja: F9およびPCC3 N/1胎児性癌細胞でランダム遷移確率モデルを拡張し、決定論的なL期が「細胞成長周期」を反映すると報告した。これはある細胞周期で始まり次のG1期に完了する超有糸分裂期で、DNA分裂周期とは解離していることが示唆された。遺伝子発現開始前に核細胞質比を変えうる仕組みとして、初期胚発生でのG1期延長に関連する。
pmid-3955631.summary_en: Extending the two-random transition probability model in F9 and PCC3 N/1 embryonal carcinoma cells, the authors argue that the deterministic L period reflects a 'cell-growth cycle'. Evidence suggests this is a supramitotic phase that starts in one cell cycle and completes in the next G1 period, dissociated from the DNA-division cycle. This may allow cells to alter the nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratio before gene expression begins, linking to G1 prolongation in early embryogenesis.

pmid-3956593.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞で高濃度チミジンによりDNA合成を阻害すると、レチノイン酸（RA）様の分化が誘導された。S期前1/3にRAを加えるとDNA複製パターンが変化し、次の細胞周期で分化が現れた。S期後半の添加では分化は次周期以降に遅れた。初期S期の複製イベントがRAによる分化誘導の標的と考えられる。
pmid-3956593.summary_en: Inhibiting DNA synthesis in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells with high thymidine induced differentiation resembling retinoic acid (RA) action. RA added during the first third of S phase altered DNA replication patterns and produced differentiation in the following cell cycle, whereas later addition delayed it. Low serum did not induce differentiation without RA. The authors propose that early S-phase replication events are targets of RA-induced differentiation.

pmid-3957019.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌に対して手術と化学療法を受けた32歳男性の症例検討である。治癒を告げられ綿密な追跡が不要となった5年後に、パニック発作を伴う広場恐怖症を発症し、就労と社会生活に支障をきたした。薬物療法、行動療法、精神療法により恐怖症は改善した。がん治療後の分離不安と攻撃性について論じている。
pmid-3957019.summary_en: A case conference describes a 32-year-old man treated for testicular embryonal carcinoma with surgery and chemotherapy. Five years after being told he was cured and no longer needed close follow-up, he developed agoraphobia with panic attacks that impaired work and social life. Pharmacotherapy, behavior therapy and psychotherapy successfully treated the phobia. The authors discuss cancer-related separation anxiety and aggression after treatment.

pmid-3957127.summary_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した悪性黒色腫の、文献上11例目となる症例を報告。術後4カ月で再発した黒色腫は、免疫化学療法に完全奏効した。卵巣奇形腫由来の黒色腫はまれで文献も少なく、本症例はその管理に関する知見を加える。
pmid-3957127.summary_en: The authors report the 11th well-documented case of malignant melanoma arising within a cystic teratoma of the ovary, a rare origin. The melanoma recurred four months after surgery. It responded completely to immunochemotherapy, a finding noted as the outcome of this individual case. The report adds to a small literature on melanoma arising in ovarian teratomas and its management.

pmid-3957253.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた腺癌に、メラノサイトの定着と色素沈着を認めた。超微細構造解析で上皮性腫瘍細胞とメラノサイトを確認し、多くの腫瘍細胞に複合メラノソームが見られた（前メラノソームは見られず）。メラニンがメラノサイトから腫瘍細胞へ移行したことが示唆された。悪性腫瘍へのメラノサイト定着の意義は未解明である。
pmid-3957253.summary_en: An adenocarcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst showed areas of melanocyte colonization and pigmentation. Ultrastructural examination found epithelial tumor cells and melanocytes, with many tumor cells containing compound melanosomes but not premelanosomes. This suggests melanin transfer from melanocytes to tumor cells. The authors note that melanocyte colonization of malignant tumors is a curious phenomenon whose significance remains to be elucidated.

pmid-3957465.summary_ja: 精巣原発腫瘍、特にセミノーマの患者血清から胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）様酵素を検出した。モノクローナル抗体パネルにより6種の表現型に分類され、多くはセミノーマ組織と同じ1型であった。進行例で上昇し、手術や放射線療法後、無病時には低下した。いずれの表現型も予後不良とは関連しなかった。
pmid-3957465.summary_en: PLAP-like enzymes were detected in sera of patients with primary testicular tumors, mainly seminomas. A panel of monoclonal antibodies typed sera into six phenotypes, most belonging to type I, matching seminoma tissue. Levels rose with advanced disease and fell after surgery, radiotherapy or remission. Serum phenotypes generally matched tissue and recurrence samples, but none predicted prognosis. The findings support eutopic PLAP-like antigen expression that is enhanced by malignancy.

pmid-3957552.summary_ja: 肉眼的に正常な卵巣から偶然見つかった早期ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を全割で検索した。腫瘍は主に皮質に存在し、原始卵胞が最も多い白膜直下領域で密度が高かった。腫瘍病変部では卵母細胞数の減少が認められた。これらの所見と文献上の年齢分布から、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）は卵母細胞由来と推測された。
pmid-3957552.summary_en: An early dysgerminoma found incidentally in a grossly normal ovary was completely sectioned. The tumor was mainly cortical, densest in the subtunical zone where primordial follicles are most numerous, and was associated with reduced oocyte counts in involved areas. Together with age-incidence data from the literature, these findings support an oocytic origin for dysgerminoma.

pmid-3958517.summary_ja: メトトレキサート（MTX）耐性絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対するシスプラチン（CDDP）の効果を、MTXおよびアクチノマイシンD（ACD）と比較し、in vitroおよびヌードマウス移植モデルで検討した。in vitroではCDDPとACDが増殖を強く抑制したが、MTXは弱かった。in vivoではCDDPとACDが2クールの投与後に腫瘍増殖を抑制し、MTXでは明らかな抑制は見られなかった。MTX耐性絨毛癌に対するCDDPの有用性が示唆された。
pmid-3958517.summary_en: Cisplatin (CDDP) was tested against methotrexate-resistant choriocarcinoma BeWo cells in vitro and in BeWo xenografts in nude mice, compared with methotrexate (MTX) and actinomycin D (ACD). In vitro, CDDP and ACD strongly inhibited growth, while MTX was weak. In vivo, CDDP and ACD suppressed tumor growth after two courses, whereas MTX showed no apparent suppression. CDDP may be an option for MTX-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3959206.summary_ja: 33歳男性で無痛性の精巣腫瘤と左鎖骨上窩腫瘤が見られました。鎖骨上窩病変の生検で古典的セミノーマと診断され、腹部リンパ節腫大も認められました。根治的精巣摘除術では線維性瘢痕のみで、原発巣の自然退縮が示されました。セミノーマでの報告はまれです。
pmid-3959206.summary_en: A 33-year-old man presented with a painless testicular mass and an enlarging left supraclavicular mass. Biopsy of the supraclavicular lesion showed classical seminoma, and imaging revealed massive abdominal lymphadenopathy. Radical orchiectomy unexpectedly found only fibrous scar tissue, indicating complete regression of the primary testicular tumor while metastases progressed. This phenomenon is well described in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors but rarely reported with seminoma.

pmid-3959209.summary_ja: 43歳男性で、精巣セミノーマからの転移による前立腺病変が臨床的に明らかでした。本稿では、この稀な病態の徴候、症状、診断および治療を論じています。また、前立腺転移の発生機序に関する仮説も提示されています。
pmid-3959209.summary_en: A 43-year-old man presented with clinically manifest prostatic involvement from metastatic testicular seminoma. The report discusses the signs, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment of this uncommon entity. The authors also offer a hypothesis regarding how the prostatic metastasis developed. The abstract is brief and does not report outcomes in detail.

pmid-3959229.summary_ja: 精巣の成熟奇形腫が、後腹膜に成熟奇形腫として転移した稀な症例です。精巣の成熟奇形腫は低悪性度の悪性腫瘍とみなすべきだと結論づけています。良性病変と単純に考えないことが重要と強調されています。
pmid-3959229.summary_en: A case of mature teratoma of the testis is described, in which the tumor metastasized to the retroperitoneum as mature teratoma. The authors highlight this unusual presentation. They conclude that mature teratoma of the testis should be regarded as a low-grade malignant neoplasm rather than a purely benign lesion. The report is brief and focuses on the histologic nature and metastatic behavior of the tumor.

pmid-3960415.summary_ja: 卵管妊娠から生じた卵管原発絨毛癌の症例です。付属器切除術と両側卵巣莢膜黄体嚢胞の切除を含む手術の後、化学療法で治療されました。治療2年後に健康な児を出産し、5年後も生存しています。文献的考察も含まれます。
pmid-3960415.summary_en: A patient with primary choriocarcinoma of the fallopian tube arising from a tubal pregnancy is reported. Initial treatment included adnexectomy and resection of bilateral ovarian theca-lutein cysts, followed by chemotherapy. The patient later delivered a healthy infant two years after treatment and remained alive and well five years after the event. The report is accompanied by a review of the literature.

pmid-3962811.summary_ja: 転移性腎腫瘍の2症例です。1例は左頸部腫瘤と肉眼的血尿を呈した鰓原性癌の58歳女性、もう1例は泌尿器症状のない絨毛癌の25歳女性です。両例とも片側腎摘除術を受けました。過去に生存例79例の転移性腎腫瘍が報告されていると記されています。
pmid-3962811.summary_en: Two cases of metastatic renal tumors are reported. The first patient was a 58-year-old woman with branchiogenic carcinoma who presented with a left neck mass and macrohematuria. The second was a 25-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma and no urological symptoms. Both underwent unilateral nephrectomy. The authors note that 79 surviving cases of metastatic renal tumor had previously been reported.

pmid-3963297.summary_ja: マウスの7日齢胚を腎被膜下に移植し、H-2複合体が胚由来奇形腫の増殖に与える影響を検討しました。H-2D遺伝子座やその遠位領域が増殖に関与すると考えられています。組織学的に胎児性癌細胞が増殖に必要でした。受容マウスの放射線感受性免疫因子も増殖を促す可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-3963297.summary_en: This mouse study examined how H-2 histocompatibility genes affect the growth of teratomas derived from seven-day embryos transplanted under kidney capsules. Tumor weights varied by strain, and the H-2D locus or its distal region appeared to influence growth. Histology showed that embryonal carcinoma cells were required for teratoma growth. The authors suggest that a radiation-sensitive immune factor in the recipient contributes to stimulating growth.

pmid-3963842.summary_ja: 妊婦尿と絨毛癌患者尿から精製したhCGの糖鎖を比較した研究です。腫瘍由来hCGでは、α-フコシルトランスフェラーゼの活性亢進とN-アセチルグルコサミニルトランスフェラーゼIVの出現により、糖鎖に広範な構造変化が共通して認められました。
pmid-3963842.summary_en: This 1986 study compares the asparagine-linked sugar chains of hCG purified from pregnant women's urine and from choriocarcinoma patients. Tumor-derived hCG showed extensive, consistent structural changes in its glycans, attributed to increased alpha-fucosyltransferase activity and the appearance of N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase IV. The findings suggest altered glycosylation is a biochemical feature of choriocarcinoma-derived hCG.

pmid-3964537.summary_ja: ワックス包埋精巣腫瘍の核を用い、フローサイトメトリーでc-mycがんタンパク(p62c-myc)を定量する手法を開発した研究です。奇形腫分化の進行とともに発現が増加しました。中分化型・未分化型で再発した患者は無病患者より発現が低く、新たな予後指標となる可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-3964537.summary_en: This study developed a flow cytometric assay to quantify c-myc oncoprotein (p62c-myc) in nuclei from wax-embedded testicular tumours, using a monoclonal antibody. Oncoprotein levels rose with increasing teratoma differentiation. Patients with intermediate or undifferentiated tumours who later relapsed had lower p62c-myc levels than disease-free patients. The authors suggest such quantitative biochemical measures could provide new prognostic indices for cancer patients.

pmid-3964540.summary_ja: 抗hCGモノクローナル抗体とカルボキシペプチダーゼG2の結合を3法で比較し、JAR絨毛癌細胞に対する細胞傷害性を評価した基礎研究です。1〜3単位/mlで72時間曝露すると多くの細胞の生存能が失われました。絨毛癌への抗体指向性酵素療法に向けた予備的検討です。
pmid-3964540.summary_en: Carboxypeptidase G2 was conjugated to an anti-hCG monoclonal antibody (W14A) by three methods, and coupling efficiency and activity retention were compared. In vitro, free and conjugated enzyme were tested against JAR choriocarcinoma cells. Exposure for 72 hours at 1-3 units/ml reduced viability in a significant fraction of cells. The authors acknowledge the limits of the in vitro model. The work is a preliminary step toward antibody-directed enzyme therapy for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2420663.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来のF9胎児性癌細胞を用いた発生生物学的研究である。レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPの添加により、臓側内胚葉と壁側内胚葉のいずれへ分化するかが制御されることを示した。AFP産生細胞はcAMP処理後にAFPの合成を失い、壁側内胚葉の遺伝子を発現するようになった。マウス胚の内胚葉分化を模倣する現象として、胚細胞腫瘍研究の基礎的知見となりうる。
pmid-2420663.summary_en: This 1986 developmental biology study examines F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a murine teratocarcinoma-derived line, grown as aggregates and induced to form embryoid bodies. Retinoic acid with or without dibutyryl cAMP directs differentiation toward visceral or parietal endoderm. The authors measured laminin, type IV collagen, and fibronectin, and found that AFP-producing cells moved to cAMP medium lost AFP synthesis and began expressing parietal endoderm genes. Visceral endoderm cells could redifferentiate at any time, while parietal commitment occurred after three days, mirroring mouse embryo endoderm development.

pmid-2429884.summary_ja: ヒト造血細胞に対して作製されたIgMモノクローナル抗体3種を、マウス細胞への反応性から解析した研究です。主にマウス胎児性癌細胞と反応し、初期胚や胚性外胚葉も染色されました。F9細胞由来の高分子糖ペプチドの約5〜10%を沈降させ、成体の一部の上皮細胞も染色されました。
pmid-2429884.summary_en: Three IgM monoclonal antibodies, originally raised against human hematopoietic cells, were characterized for reactivity with mouse cells. They reacted predominantly with mouse embryonal carcinoma cells and also stained early embryos, trophectoderm, and embryonic ectoderm, with some staining of adult epithelial cells. Antigen analysis showed that two antibodies precipitated about 10% of high-molecular-mass glycopeptides from F9 cells and one about 5%. The main focus is embryonic and developmental antigen expression.

pmid-2430849.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞の胚様体からの壁側内胚葉の増殖を、in vitroで検討した。壁側内胚葉のみが凝集体から遊走し、in vivoと同様の分布を示した。主に臓側内胚葉からなるF9胚様体でも、コラーゲン上で増殖が生じ、基質との相互作用が壁側内胚葉分化を誘導することが示唆された。臨床腫瘍ではなく、奇形癌モデルを初期胚発生研究に用いている。
pmid-2430849.summary_en: Parietal endoderm outgrowth from mouse teratocarcinoma stem-cell embryoid bodies was examined in vitro. Only parietal endoderm migrated from aggregates, mirroring the in vivo pattern. Retinoic-acid-treated F9 bodies containing mainly visceral endoderm still produced outgrowth on collagen, suggesting substrate interaction induces parietal endoderm differentiation. The work uses the teratocarcinoma model to study early embryonic endoderm differentiation rather than clinical tumors.

pmid-2431266.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化誘導し、IAPのcDNAクローンを単離した。IAP転写産物は壁側内胚葉様細胞とレチノイン酸処理F9細胞で豊富に認められたが、未分化株では認められなかった。IAP遺伝子の活性化は転写調節によるもので、分化過程で自律的に制御されることを示唆する。
pmid-2431266.summary_en: IAP cDNA clones were isolated from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced to differentiate into parietal endoderm-like cells. IAP transcripts were abundant in parietal endoderm-like cells and in retinoic-acid-induced F9 cells, but absent from F9 and two pluripotent lines. Sequence analysis revealed heterogeneity among clones, and transcription in isolated nuclei indicated transcriptional regulation. The findings suggest IAP genes are regulated autonomously during differentiation.

pmid-2867942.summary_ja: Tera 2由来のクローン化ヒト胎児性癌細胞株CL12およびCL13を用い、レチノイン酸による分化に伴うアデニル酸シクラーゼの反応性変化を解析した。6日以内に増殖は停止し、安定した分化表現型を示した。分化細胞ではカルシトニンによる刺激が約7.5倍に増強し、受容体数の増加がその要因であった。さらにソマトスタチンによる抑制効果が出現した。
pmid-2867942.summary_en: This study examined adenylate cyclase responses in two cloned human embryonal carcinoma cell lines, CL12 and CL13, derived from Tera 2 cells. Retinoic acid induced growth arrest and a stable differentiated phenotype within six days. Differentiated cells showed a markedly greater calcitonin-stimulated cyclase response, due to increased hormone receptor numbers, and acquired a somatostatin inhibitory effect. The authors propose these hormonal response changes may regulate embryonic development and could serve as markers of differentiation.

pmid-2947966.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞PC13とその分化細胞におけるIGF受容体とIGF様分子の発現を検討した1986年の研究。分化により受容体の発現が変化し、分化細胞は結合蛋白やIGF様分子を分泌した。発生初期の胚外中胚葉にも発現が見られた。胎児性癌を発生モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-2947966.summary_en: This 1986 study examined insulin-like growth factor (IGF) receptors and IGF-like molecules in PC13 embryonal carcinoma cells and their differentiated derivatives, PC13END. Undifferentiated cells expressed high-affinity IGF receptors, and differentiation reduced unoccupied receptor sites. Differentiated cells secreted a soluble IGF-binding protein and IGF-like molecules. Extraembryonic mesoderm of early postimplantation mouse embryos also expressed IGF-like molecules. The authors proposed that IGFs are expressed during early mammalian development and may act in an autocrine manner. The work is developmental biology using murine embryonal carcinoma as a model, not a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-3000582.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9をレチノイン酸で分化させ、レチノイド結合蛋白の変化を検討した1986年の研究。細胞内の二種のレチノイド結合蛋白と細胞表面受容体が分化に伴い増加した。分化状態の維持にはレチノイドが必要ではなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、レチノイド代謝の基礎研究である。
pmid-3000582.summary_en: This 1986 study examined retinoid-binding proteins in the embryonal carcinoma cell line F9 before and after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Undifferentiated cells had low levels of cellular retinol-binding protein and cellular retinoic acid-binding protein. Retinoic acid raised both proteins, in parallel with beta-2-microglobulin, a differentiation marker. Differentiated cells took up retinol from plasma retinol-binding protein and expressed a surface receptor for it. Differentiated cells did not appear dependent on retinoids to maintain the differentiated state. The work concerns retinoid biology, using an embryonal carcinoma line as the experimental model rather than studying clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-3007038.summary_ja: 染色体転座を持つヒト奇形癌細胞株を用い、癌遺伝子c-mybを6q21〜q23に局在させた。転座切断点が近接するため再構成や増幅を検討したが、認められなかった。発現量も非造血系細胞株と同等で、c-mybは本奇形癌の発生に関与しないと考えられた。腫瘍由来の細胞株のみが研究材料である。
pmid-3007038.summary_en: This study mapped the proto-oncogene c-myb to 6q21-q23 in a human teratocarcinoma cell line carrying 6q and 11 translocations. Because the breakpoints lie near c-myb, the authors tested for rearrangement, deletion, amplification and expression changes. None was found, and expression was comparable to that of nonhematopoietic cell lines, suggesting c-myb does not contribute to this teratocarcinoma. The tumor-derived cell line is the sole study material.

pmid-3011859.summary_ja: 抗血清を用い、末梢血単核細胞および絨毛癌細胞株でc-fms遺伝子産物(CSF-1受容体)を検出した。絨毛癌細胞は細胞表面に150kDaの糖タンパク質を発現し、高親和性のCSF-1結合部位を有していた。CSF-1が正常な栄養膜の発達に関与する可能性も示唆されている。臨床疾患ではなく受容体発現の解析が主題である。
pmid-3011859.summary_en: The authors used antisera to detect the human c-fms gene product, the CSF-1 receptor, in peripheral blood mononuclear cells and in human choriocarcinoma cell lines. The 150-kD glycoprotein was expressed on the cell surface, showed tyrosine kinase activity, and was found in choriocarcinoma cells, which also bound human CSF-1 with high affinity. The study compares these cells with monocytic HL-60 cells. The authors suggest CSF-1 may play a role in normal trophoblast development. Choriocarcinoma cell lines are a substantive experimental system here, though the paper concerns receptor expression rather than clinical disease.

pmid-3084422.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞の変異誘発株を宿主胚盤胞に注入し、キメラ形成能を検討した発生学的研究。胚齢9.5日では親株と同程度にキメラを形成したが、異常胚が多かった。14.5日までに生存するのは定着が限られた例のみで、変異誘発株は広く寄与すると初期胚発生に致死的と考えられた。
pmid-3084422.summary_en: This developmental biology study examined the chimeric potential of a mutator strain of mouse teratocarcinoma cells by injecting them into host blastocysts. At embryonic day 9.5, the mutator strain produced chimeras at a rate comparable to its parent, but many chimeric embryos were abnormal, with severity linked to the proportion of mutator-derived cells. By day 14.5, few chimeras survived, and only those with limited colonization developed normally. The mutator strain appears lethal to early embryonic development when widely incorporated.

pmid-3154546.summary_ja: 眼窩の筋円錐内に完全に位置していた、まれな類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。術前に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、超音波検査を併用することで病変の描出が向上した。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫に類する病変だが、一般には胚細胞腫瘍には分類されず、本サイトでの関連性は境界的と判断した。
pmid-3154546.summary_en: A case report describing an unusual dermoid cyst located entirely within the muscle cone of the orbit. Preoperative delineation of the lesion was improved by combining MRI with CT and ultrasonography. The report is a brief clinical description of an orbital lesion rather than a germ cell tumor study. Its relevance to this site is borderline, since dermoid cysts are mature teratoma-type lesions but are not typically classified as germ cell tumors.
