In immunoblots of cultured choriocarcinoma cells, it detected a single 28,000 polypeptide. The findings identify a trophoblast-associated antigen in choriocarcinoma and placental tissues.

pmid-6321615.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後の完全除去確認と絨毛性疾患の診断に子宮鏡検査が有用かを検討した1984年の報告。除去後早期の検査で奇胎遺残や壊死脱落膜が15例に認められ、6例で再搔爬が必要だった。侵入奇胎2例の診断にも役立ち、子宮鏡所見から悪性続発症の管理における有用性が示された。
pmid-6321615.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study evaluated hysteroscopy in 21 patients after hydatidiform mole evacuation to confirm complete removal of trophoblastic tissue. Residual mole or necrotic decidua was found in 15 early examinations, and re-curettage was required in six cases. Hysteroscopy also helped diagnose invasive mole in two patients. Among 27 suspected trophoblastic disease cases, four characteristic findings were identified. Nine of 21 patients with choriocarcinoma, invasive mole or persistent disease showed one or two suggestive findings. The authors conclude hysteroscopy is useful for confirming evacuation and managing malignant sequelae.

pmid-6321616.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍患者の免疫能を治療経過に沿って検討した1984年の報告。胞状奇胎では除去後に細胞性免疫が亢進し、侵入奇胎では液性抑制因子が治療とともに上昇した。絨毛癌では細胞性免疫が一旦低下したものの完全には消失せず、特異的免疫療法の検討を示唆している。
pmid-6321616.summary_en: This study tracked cellular and humoral immune function in patients with trophoblastic tumors over their clinical course. Hydatidiform mole showed accelerated cellular immunity after molar delivery and rising humoral suppressive factors. Invasive mole showed no significant cellular change but increasing suppressive factors that peaked around day 60. In choriocarcinoma, cellular immunity initially accelerated, then declined between days 60 and 90, while humoral suppression peaked near day 120. The authors suggest cellular immunity persisted, supporting consideration of specific immunotherapy for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6321856.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の細胞表面糖鎖を、レクチンと抗体を用いて組織化学的に比較した1984年の報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍は特定のレクチンと抗I-(Ma)抗体に一貫して陽性、セミノーマや絨毛癌はほぼ陰性であった。胎児性癌は組織構築により染色性が異なり、未熟奇形腫では分化の方向に依存した。糖鎖の変化が胚細胞腫瘍の分類に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-6321856.summary_en: This 1984 study examined cell surface carbohydrate chains in human germ cell tumors using four lectins and an anti-I-(Ma) antibody. Embryonal carcinomas showed staining that varied with architecture. Yolk sac tumors consistently reacted with peanut and U. europaeus agglutinins and anti-I-(Ma), while most seminomas and choriocarcinomas were negative. Immature teratomas showed patterns dependent on the direction and maturity of differentiation. The authors suggest glycan changes during differentiation may help classify germ cell tumors, though their biologic role remains unclear.

pmid-6322588.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍205例を対象に、組織切片のキナクリン染色でY・X染色体クロマチンを判定した1984年の後方視的研究。Yクロマチン陽性率は胞状奇胎9%、侵入奇胎50%、絨毛癌74%だった。悪性例での高い陽性率から、劣性変異癌遺伝子のホモ接合性は絨毛癌の発症に重要でないと考察している。
pmid-6322588.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed sex chromosome status in 205 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia cases using quinacrine staining of tissue sections for Y and X chromatin. Y-chromatin positivity occurred in 9% of hydatidiform moles, 50% of invasive moles (2 of 4), and 74% of choriocarcinomas. The high Y-chromatin rate in malignant cases suggests that homozygosity for a recessive oncogene is not an important factor in choriocarcinoma pathogenesis. The authors favor a partial allograft mechanism after nonmolar pregnancies with diminished host immunity.

pmid-6325316.summary_ja: 絨毛癌が完全胞状奇胎から生じるかを、染色体・HLA・PGM1多型により検討した。完全奇胎は雄核発生で、父親由来の完全なホモ接合性を示す。一方、絨毛癌細胞はヘテロ接合性を示し、単一精子による空卵受精由来の奇胎から発生したとは考えにくいと結論している。
pmid-6325316.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study investigates whether choriocarcinoma arises from complete hydatidiform mole. Chromosomal, HLA and PGM1 polymorphism analyses show that complete moles are androgenetic, with paternally derived, homozygous genomes. Choriocarcinoma cells, however, display heterozygosity, indicating they did not originate from moles formed by fertilization of an empty egg by a single haploid sperm. The authors conclude that this mechanism is unlikely to be the origin of choriocarcinoma, a finding relevant to the genesis of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6325758.summary_ja: 小細胞肺癌と精巣セミノーマからの髄内脊髄転移の剖検2例を報告し、文献的考察を加えた。この稀な転移様式の原発巣としては肺癌よりセミノーマが最も多いとされる。動脈系および椎骨静脈系を介した血行性転移が推定されている。精巣腫瘍の稀な転移部位として注目される。
pmid-6325758.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese report presents two autopsy cases of intramedullary spinal cord metastasis, one from small cell lung cancer and one from testicular seminoma. The authors review the literature and note that seminoma, rather than lung cancer, is the most common primary tumor of this rare metastatic pattern. In their case they propose hematogenous spread via arterial and vertebral venous systems. The paper highlights spinal cord involvement as a rare site of metastasis from germ cell tumor.

pmid-6325794.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎1例と絨毛癌2例の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者で循環免疫複合体を解析した。寛解期にhCGの低下と並行して複合体が上昇した。胞状奇胎症例の複合体からは父親由来HLA抗原(AW32)に反応する物質が検出され、他の2例でも同様の父親HLA特異的な抑制が認められた。父親由来HLA抗原への免疫認識が治療反応に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-6325794.summary_en: This 1984 JNCI study characterizes circulating immune complexes in three patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including one hydatidiform mole and two choriocarcinoma cases. PEG-precipitable complexes rose as hCG fell during remission. Fractionation of one molar patient's complexes revealed material immunoreactive to a paternal HLA antigen (AW32), not maternal antigens, and similar paternal HLA-specific inhibition was seen in two patients. The authors suggest that immune recognition of paternal HLA antigens may contribute to therapeutic response in trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6326253.summary_ja: 進行性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性29例に対しシスプラチン基盤化学療法後に行った手術33件を報告。26例で肉眼的完全切除が得られた。線維化・壊死や成熟奇形腫は予後良好で、生存腫瘍が残存した11例中5例のみが生存した。術前のAFP・β-hCG・LDH高値は残存腫瘍を示唆し、二次・三次治療の放射線療法で14例中8例が腫瘍消失した。
pmid-6326253.summary_en: This 1984 report describes 33 surgical procedures in 29 men with advanced malignant germ cell tumours treated after cisplatin-based chemotherapy with vinblastine and bleomycin. Complete macroscopic resection was achieved in 26 patients. Histology showed fibrosis/necrosis, mature teratoma, or viable malignancy, with fibrosis or mature teratoma carrying an excellent prognosis. Elevated preoperative AFP, beta-hCG, or LDH indicated residual viable tumour. Radiotherapy as second- or third-line treatment rendered 8 of 14 patients tumour-free. Residual masses should be resected as completely as possible.

pmid-6328963.summary_ja: 精巣異常を有する男性133例を解析し、受診遅延と治療経過を検討した。症状出現後1か月以内に精巣摘除術を受けた症例は52例で、41例は受診が遅れ、40例は当初ほかの疾患として治療されていた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍89例のうち20例が死亡し、その16例では診断が遅れていた。迅速な診断・治療により死亡率は10%未満に抑えられると結論している。
pmid-6328963.summary_en: This 1984 American Family Physician article reviews 133 men with testicular abnormalities, examining delays in seeking care and treatment. Fifty-two underwent orchiectomy within a month of symptoms, while 41 delayed presentation and 40 were initially treated for other conditions. Of 89 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, 20 died, 16 of whom had delayed diagnosis. The authors conclude that prompt diagnosis and treatment could reduce mortality from these tumors to under 10 percent.

pmid-6329973.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン(hPL)の免疫染色を、正常胎盤と比較した研究である。中間型栄養膜細胞という第三の栄養膜細胞型を同定し、その染色パターンを報告した。腫瘍の種類や検体により染色性は異なる。両マーカーは栄養膜腫瘍の組織発生の解明や診断・予後判定に役立つと述べている。
pmid-6329973.summary_en: This immunocytochemical study localized hCG and placental lactogen in placental site trophoblastic tumors, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas, comparing them with normal placental development. It identifies a third trophoblast type, intermediate trophoblast, with staining features that distinguish it from cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast. Staining patterns vary by tumor type and specimen. The authors suggest these markers help clarify histogenesis and may aid diagnosis and prognosis.

pmid-6330244.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、末梢血、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌のDNAを解析し、hPLおよびhCGα・β遺伝子の制限酵素パターンを比較した研究である。組織間で同一パターンを示し、悪性転化時の遺伝子欠失や増幅は認めなかった。hCGα遺伝子の多型から胞状奇胎の雄性発生起源が支持され、一部は絨毛癌へ進展しうることが示唆された。腫瘍発生には介在配列が関与する可能性がある。
pmid-6330244.summary_en: This Japanese study analyzed genomic DNA from normal placenta, peripheral blood, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma using cDNA probes for hPL and hCG alpha and beta. Restriction patterns were identical across tissues, suggesting no gene deletion or amplification during malignant transformation. Polymorphisms in the hCG alpha gene supported an androgenetic origin of hydatidiform mole and suggested that some moles may progress to choriocarcinoma. An intervening sequence may be involved in tumorigenesis.

pmid-6331151.summary_ja: 難治性または再発した胚細胞腫瘍22例(未治療1例を含む計23例)に、エトポシドとシスプラチンを4週ごとに投与した臨床研究である。完全寛解は、以前に完全寛解を得ていた症例で主に得られた。骨髄抑制は全例に認められ、重症例2名が死亡した。以前に完全寛解を得ていた再発例に対する救済化学療法として有用と考えられる。
pmid-6331151.summary_en: This clinical study treated 22 patients with progressive or relapsing germ cell tumors, plus one untreated patient, with etoposide and cisplatin every four weeks. Complete remissions occurred mainly in patients who had previously achieved complete remission with cisplatin-based therapy. Patients without prior complete remission rarely responded. Myelosuppression was universal, and two heavily pretreated patients died. The regimen may be useful as salvage therapy only after a prior complete remission.

pmid-6333777.summary_ja: 妊娠ラットの子宮壁を穿刺することで、Lewisラットに卵黄嚢癌を実験的に誘発した研究です。腫瘍は壁側および臓側卵黄嚢癌の像を示し、株化後は壁側内胚葉の表現型のみを保持しました。ラミニン、エンタクチン、IV型コラーゲンの合成パターンは一貫しており、基底膜の解析に有用な簡便なモデルとして提案されています。
pmid-6333777.summary_en: This study describes an experimental model in which yolk sac carcinomas were induced in Lewis rats by puncturing the pregnant uterine wall during gestation. The tumors showed parietal and visceral yolk sac carcinoma patterns, with some trophoblastic giant cells. Established lines were adapted to ascitic growth and tissue culture, though they ultimately expressed only a parietal endoderm phenotype. Immunohistochemical and metabolic labeling analyses revealed a consistent biosynthesis pattern of basement membrane components: laminin, entactin, and type IV collagen. The authors propose this as a simple model for further characterization of basement membranes in yolk sac tumors.

pmid-6335886.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PC13をレチノイン酸で分化させた際の増殖特性の変化を解析した研究です。分化した内胚葉様細胞は細胞周期が長く、分裂能が徐々に低下して有限な寿命を獲得しました。EGFは細胞周期を短縮し生存を延長させ、大部分の細胞がEGF受容体を発現していました。
pmid-6335886.summary_en: This study examines how PC13 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells change growth behavior when induced to differentiate with retinoic acid. The differentiated endoderm-like cells had longer cell cycles and a progressively decreasing probability of division, indicating acquisition of a limited lifespan typical of mortal cells. Epidermal growth factor shortened their cell cycle, enhanced their survival, and prolonged their lifespan, with most cells expressing EGF receptors. The findings show that a tumor-derived cell line can acquire growth-factor responsiveness and mortality after differentiation, relevant to the biology of embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-6336034.summary_ja: 奇形癌細胞株402AXのMHC抗原発現誘導の機序を検討した研究です。遺伝的に抵抗性のマウスで継代すると、脾臓のLyt1陽性およびLyt2陽性T細胞の相乗作用により発現が誘導されました。in vitroでは腫瘍感作マウスの血清が誘導因子となり、一部のクラスI転写産物は転写後調節を受ける可能性が示されました。
pmid-6336034.summary_en: This study examines the regulation of major histocompatibility complex (MHC) antigen expression in teratocarcinoma 402AX cells. MHC expression is induced when these cells are passaged in vivo in genetically resistant host mice. In vivo, induction depends on the synergistic action of Lyt 1 and Lyt 2 positive splenic T cells. In vitro, serum from tumor-primed resistant mice induces expression. Northern blot data suggest that some MHC class I transcripts may be regulated post-transcriptionally, highlighting immune recognition mechanisms in teratocarcinoma.

pmid-6362401.summary_ja: 35歳女性の上行結腸(盲腸)腺癌に合併した、きわめて稀な大腸原発絨毛癌の症例報告です。原発巣と転移巣の絨毛癌成分でβ-hCGが陽性を示しました。過去の報告は2例のみで、いずれもS状結腸でした。発生起源に関する学説も簡潔に概説されています。
pmid-6362401.summary_en: This report describes a rare primary choriocarcinoma of the colon in a 35-year-old woman, arising in association with adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon (cecum). Immunoperoxidase staining demonstrated beta-human chorionic gonadotropin in the choriocarcinomatous component of the primary tumor and in the metastases. The authors note that only two prior cases, both in the sigmoid colon, had been reported. Theories of histogenesis of this rare neoplasm are briefly reviewed, making it a notable example of extragonadal choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6362705.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学染色で、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼに対する2種類のモノクローナル抗体H17E2とD20Lを比較した研究です。全てのセミノーマと悪性奇形腫はH17E2で強陽性を示しました。正常組織は両抗体とも陰性で、胚細胞腫瘍全般はH17E2が認識する型を発現すると結論づけられています。
pmid-6362705.summary_en: This study compares two monoclonal antibodies against placental alkaline phosphatase, H17E2 and D20L, for immunohistochemical staining of testicular germ cell tumors and a broad panel of normal and malignant tissues. All seminomas and malignant teratomas stained strongly with H17E2, while D20L staining was negative or patchy. Neither antibody stained normal tissues. Among other malignancies, few cases were positive, including some ovarian and endometrial carcinomas and colonic carcinomas. The authors conclude that germ cell neoplasms generally express a placental alkaline phosphatase form recognized by H17E2.

pmid-6363699.summary_ja: 14例から得た良性卵巣奇形腫21検体の染色体と酵素マーカーを解析し、起源を検討した研究です。患者でヘテロ接合性であったマーカーの52%はホモ接合化していました。卵巣奇形腫は複数の機序で胚細胞から生じ、減数分裂I・IIの不全や成熟卵子の倍加が関与すると考察されています。
pmid-6363699.summary_en: This study analyzed chromosome and enzyme markers in 21 benign ovarian teratomas from 14 patients to determine their origin. Markers heterozygous in the patient were homozygous in 52% of tumors and fully heterozygous in 19%, with the rest showing mixed patterns. These findings indicate that benign ovarian teratomas arise from germ cells through several mechanisms. Tumors with heterozygous centromeres likely result from failed meiosis I, while others with homozygous centromeres may arise from failed meiosis II or from duplication of a mature ovum, the female counterpart of a complete hydatidiform mole.

pmid-6364524.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの新規3例と既報124例のレビューです。好発は白人男性の20代で、胸痛が最多の症状でした。外科的切除は74例中28例で成功し、放射線療法を第一選択とした64例中局所再発は7例のみでした。縦隔と鎖骨上への推奨線量が示され、精巣セミノーマと同等の放射線感受性を持つと結論されています。
pmid-6364524.summary_en: This report presents three new cases of primary mediastinal seminoma and reviews 124 previously published cases. Most patients were white males in their third decade, with chest pain as the most common symptom. Surgical resection was successful in 28 of 74 attempts, and radiation therapy as primary treatment yielded local failure in only 7 of 64 cases. Tumors spread mainly by distant metastasis. The authors recommend specific mediastinal and supraclavicular radiation doses and note that primary mediastinal seminoma is as radiosensitive as its testicular counterpart.

pmid-6365569.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対する治療戦略（修正または根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法、放射線療法、待機的管理）を比較した批判的総説である。修正術後の再発率は9.5%、根治術後は4〜13%と報告され、pT病期と進行率の間に有意な相関が認められた。著者らは、臨床病期Iの患者には、修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清と厳重なフォローアップが依然として望ましいと結論づけた。
pmid-6365569.summary_en: This critical review compares treatment strategies after orchiectomy for non-seminomatous testicular tumors: modified or radical retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, adjuvant chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and surveillance. The authors report relapse rates of 9.5% after modified and 4-13% after radical dissection, and find that pT stage correlates significantly with progression. They conclude that modified RLND with close follow-up remains preferable for clinical stage I patients, while adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk patients still requires demonstration of benefit.

pmid-6366090.summary_ja: 1984年の報告で、子宮摘出術で切除された絨毛癌組織のHLA抗原発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。モノクローナル抗体による蛍光抗体法で、宿主の子宮筋層細胞は陽性、絨毛癌細胞は陰性であった。腫瘍細胞の生存はHE染色やhCG染色、術前の高値尿中hCG、化学療法歴のないことから裏付けられた。絨毛癌細胞はHLA抗原を欠くことで免疫認識を逃れている可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6366090.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study examined HLA class I and class II antigen expression in a uterine choriocarcinoma resected after hysterectomy. Using monoclonal antibodies and immunofluorescence, the authors found that host myometrial cells stained positively for HLA-A,B,C and HLA-DR, whereas choriocarcinoma cells were negative. Tumor cell viability was supported by hematoxylin-eosin staining, anti-hCG staining, the patient's high preoperative urinary hCG, and absence of prior chemotherapy. The findings agree with earlier studies on choriocarcinoma cell lines, suggesting the tumor may evade immune recognition through loss of HLA expression.

pmid-6366733.summary_ja: 1984年の病理学的検討で、小児の仙尾部病変を解析した。二分脊椎に伴う奇形と腫瘍を対象とし、奇形腫は56例中11例が悪性であった。未熟組織は乳児の仙尾部奇形腫の予後不良を示さず、悪性化は卵黄嚢成分や癌腫成分を伴う奇形腫に限られた。骨盤前部発生例に多く、生後4か月以前は稀であった。
pmid-6366733.summary_en: This 1984 pathology review describes sacrococcygeal lesions in children from a single institution, including malformations associated with spina bifida and neoplasms such as 56 teratomas, 11 of which were malignant. Postsacral lipomas and dermoids often had intraspinal connections through occult spina bifida. In infant sacrococcygeal teratoma, immature tissue did not indicate a worse prognosis. Malignancy was largely confined to teratomas with carcinomatous or yolk sac components, was more common in predominantly presacral tumors, and was rare before 4 months of age.

pmid-6367359.summary_ja: 1984年の免疫組織化学的研究で、卵巣または精巣の奇形腫20例をGFAP抗体を用いてPAP法で検討した。20例中13例でGFAP陽性となり、神経膠線維や上衣細胞などに認められた。未分化な卵巣奇形癌の腫瘍細胞にも陽性所見があり、卵巣神経膠腫の可能性が考えられた。PAP法は感度の高い組織化学的手法として有用と結論された。
pmid-6367359.summary_en: This 1984 immunohistochemical study examined 20 ovarian or testicular teratomas using a peroxidase-antiperoxidase method with an antibody to glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP). GFAP positivity was seen in 13 of 20 teratomas, localized to perikarya, neuroglial fibrils, or ependymal cells, and occasionally in choroid plexus. GFAP-positive tumor cells were also found in an undifferentiated ovarian teratocarcinoma, which the authors suggested might represent an ovarian glioma. The authors concluded that this method is a sensitive histochemical tool for characterizing normal and neoplastic cells.

pmid-6367423.summary_ja: 1984年のMayo Clinicの研究で、17歳未満の小児精巣腫瘍19例(卵黄嚢腫瘍12例、胎児性癌7例)を対象とした。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のβサブユニット、α1-アンチトリプシン、ヒトアルブミンの免疫染色パターンと臨床経過を比較した。染色パターンは臨床転帰と相関せず、予後予測には役立たないとされた。
pmid-6367423.summary_en: This 1984 Mayo Clinic study compared immunohistochemical staining patterns with clinicopathologic outcomes in 19 pediatric testicular tumors, including 12 yolk sac tumors and 7 embryonal carcinomas, in patients younger than 17 years. Immunoperoxidase staining for alpha-fetoprotein, the beta-subunit of hCG, alpha-1-antitrypsin, and human albumin was performed. The authors found that staining patterns did not correlate with clinical prognosis, indicating that these markers did not predict outcome in pediatric testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6368238.summary_ja: 1984年の文献的検討で、小児精巣腫瘍の既報1,124例と自施設45例を、成人1,062例と比較した。非胚細胞性組織型は小児で29%、成人で8%であり、卵黄嚢腫瘍が49%を占めた。転移は小児9%、成人61%であった。奇形腫は精巣摘除術で治癒し、2歳未満の限局性卵黄嚢腫瘍は精巣摘除術のみで治療可能で、年長児には補助化学療法が必要とされた。
pmid-6368238.summary_en: This 1984 review evaluated 1,124 published and 45 institutional cases of childhood testicular tumors and compared them with 1,062 adult cases. Non-germinal histologies accounted for 29% of pediatric cases versus 8% of adult cases, and yolk sac tumor was the most common histology at 49%. Metastases were less frequent in children (9%) than adults (61%). Teratoma had the best prognosis and was cured by orchiectomy. Localized yolk sac tumor in infants under 2 years was treated with orchiectomy alone, while older children required adjuvant chemotherapy, which was indicated in 15% of cases.

pmid-6368378.summary_ja: 1984年の免疫遺伝学的研究で、XY型マウス奇形癌細胞株PCC7および7'の雄特異的移植抗原発現を検討した。雌マウスは腫瘍を拒絶したが雄マウスは拒絶せず、雄特異的抗原の発現が示された。雄皮膚移植でH-Y抗原に対して雌を免疫する方法でも確認された。雄特異的抗原を欠くPCC7変異株はY染色体の消失によるものと確認され、変異誘発後の選択の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6368378.summary_en: This 1984 immunogenetics study examined male-specific transplantation antigen expression in two XY murine teratocarcinoma cell lines, PCC7 and 7'. Female mice rejected tumors from these lines while male mice did not, indicating male-specific antigen expression, which was confirmed by immunizing females against H-Y antigen with male skin grafts. A PCC7 variant lacking male-specific antigen expression was described, and karyotype and DNA analysis showed the loss resulted from loss of the Y chromosome. The authors suggested such variants could be selected after mutagenesis.

pmid-6368760.summary_ja: 1984年の第II相試験で、進行性・難治性胚細胞腫瘍11例に高用量VP-16-213単剤療法を実施した。前半は自家骨髄移植を併用して2,400 mg/m2、その後は1,200 mg/m2を投与した。評価可能な10例で完全奏効2例、部分奏効4例が得られたが、いずれも持続期間は短かった。骨髄抑制などの毒性は強く、標準化学療法で治癒が期待できない症例への早期投与が検討に値するとされた。
pmid-6368760.summary_en: This 1984 phase II study tested high-dose VP-16-213 monotherapy in 11 patients with progressive refractory germ cell tumors, given at 2,400 mg/m2 with autologous bone marrow transplantation, then 1,200 mg/m2 without it. Seven patients had received standard-dose VP-16-213 previously. Among 10 evaluable patients, two complete and four partial responses were observed, all of short duration. Toxicities included severe myelosuppression, nausea, vomiting, alopecia, mucositis, and hepatitis. The authors suggested augmented-dose therapy may warrant consideration in initial management of germ cell tumors not expected to be cured by standard chemotherapy.

pmid-6373934.summary_ja: マウス卵巣奇形癌(MOT)モデルで、腫瘍接種24時間後の腹腔内C. parvum投与により75〜95%のマウスが治癒した。治癒は投与後24時間以内に腹腔へ動員された腫瘍細胞溶解性好中球によるもので、好中球は30分以内にMOT標的に結合して溶解した。生物学的応答修飾剤による抗腫瘍効果の可能性を示している。
pmid-6373934.summary_en: In a murine ovarian teratocarcinoma (MOT) model, intraperitoneal Corynebacterium parvum given 24 hours after tumor inoculation cured 75 to 95% of mice. Protection was mediated by tumor-lytic neutrophils recruited to the peritoneal cavity within the first day. Neutrophils, not those from indomethacin-pretreated mice, bound and lysed MOT targets within 30 minutes. The findings suggest neutrophils are potential antitumor effectors recruitable by biologic response modifiers.

pmid-6378939.summary_ja: 抗アクチン抗体による間接免疫蛍光法と電子顕微鏡で、部分的に合胞体化するヒト絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞の細胞骨格を解析した。ストレス線維、皮質層、ラッフル膜、合胞体栄養膜様の微絨毛が認められた。微小管形成中心は核と対応せず細胞質に分散しており、合胞体の細胞骨格は核配置に直接従属しないことを示している。
pmid-6378939.summary_en: Using anti-actin immunofluorescence and electron microscopy, the authors examined cytoskeletal organization in BeWo cells, a human choriocarcinoma line that forms partly syncytial multinucleated plaques. The syncytia contain stress fibres, cortical layers, ruffled membranes, and dense microvilli resembling syncytiotrophoblast. Microtubule-organizing centres were dispersed in the cytoplasm rather than tied to individual nuclei, suggesting that cytoskeletal organization in these syncytia is not directly governed by nuclear positions.

pmid-6379467.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞が壁側・臓側の胚体外内胚葉へ分化する過程で、MHC H-2Kbの転写産物とβ2ミクログロブリンが増加することを示した。導入した外来H-2Kbm1遺伝子も同様に調節されたが、ウサギβ-グロビン遺伝子は恒常的に発現した。分化に伴うMHC発現の調節は、導入遺伝子に一般的なものではなく、MHC遺伝子に特異的であることを示唆する。
pmid-6379467.summary_en: The authors show that MHC class I H-2K transcripts and beta2-microglobulin mRNA increase during both parietal and visceral extra-embryonic endoderm differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. A foreign H-2Kbm1 gene introduced into these cells was regulated in the same way, while a rabbit beta-globin gene remained constitutively expressed. This indicates that the differentiation-associated regulation is specific to the MHC gene rather than a general feature of introduced genes.

pmid-6381077.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞PCC4-azalとラット腸絨毛上皮細胞の雑種は、奇形癌特有の形質を保持しつつ腫瘍形成が抑制された。一部は親株より広い分化を示し、単層培養での内胚葉形成や浮遊培養での胚様体形成が見られた。腫瘍形成性の2株は三胚葉すべての派生組織を生じ、親株は原始神経組織への分化にとどまった。
pmid-6381077.summary_en: This 1984 study examined somatic cell hybrids generated by fusing mouse PCC4-azal teratocarcinoma cells with rat intestinal villus epithelial cells. The hybrids retained teratocarcinoma-specific traits but did not express differentiated-cell functions, and tumour formation was partially or completely suppressed. Some hybrids showed more extensive differentiation than the parental line, forming endoderm in monolayer culture and embryoid bodies in suspension. Two tumour-forming hybrids generated derivatives of all three germ layers, whereas parental PCC4-azal tumours differentiated only into primitive neuronal tissue.

pmid-6386265.summary_ja: 17歳女性の完全内臓逆位を伴う卵巣胎児性癌の初報告例である。1936年以降の報告で内臓逆位に伴う癌として16例目、卵巣癌として2例目、卵巣胎児性癌として初例とされる。肝転移例として報告され、文献的考察が加えられている。
pmid-6386265.summary_en: This first-reported case describes embryonal carcinoma of the ovary in a 17-year-old girl with complete situs inversus. The authors note it is the sixteenth cancer reported with complete situs inversus since 1936, the second ovarian cancer, and the first embryonal carcinoma of the ovary in this association. It is also the youngest reported cancer case with this anomaly. The title identifies the case as liver metastasis from the ovarian tumour, and the paper includes a review of the literature.

pmid-6386719.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫性カルチノイドの症例報告で、組織化学、電子顕微鏡、免疫細胞化学的に検討された。カルチノイド部はセロトニン陽性の分泌顆粒を有する。卵巣甲状腺腫に隣接する微小濾胞にサイログロブリン陽性細胞とセロトニン陽性細胞がみられ、本症は卵巣奇形腫の亜型として生じると考察された。
pmid-6386719.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian strumal carcinoid studied by histochemistry, electron microscopy and immunocytochemistry. The thyroid component was micro-macrofollicular, while the carcinoid areas showed a trabecular pattern with argyrophilic granules positive for serotonin. Thyroglobulin- and serotonin-containing cells lay adjacent in microfollicles near struma ovarii. The authors suggest that strumal carcinoids develop in association with struma ovarii and represent a subset of ovarian teratomas, and they review hypotheses on the cell of origin.

pmid-6389622.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫のCT所見を文献的に検討し、4例の所見を報告する。標準CTに直接の非再構成冠状断・矢状断像を加えて病変の範囲と不均一な内容物を評価した。CTは悪性転化の予測または除外に有用であったとされる。
pmid-6389622.summary_en: This paper reviews the computed tomography findings of ovarian cystic teratomas and discusses four patients. Direct nonreconstructed coronal and sagittal views were added to standard CT to define the extent of the process and the heterogeneous contents characteristic of these tumours. The authors found CT successful in predicting or excluding malignant degeneration. The study focuses on imaging characteristics of ovarian teratoma and provides diagnostic guidance for radiologists evaluating these lesions.

pmid-6389728.summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるHLA-DR抗原の発現を、手術標本の免疫染色と4種の細胞株の阻害試験で検討した。腫瘍細胞はHLA-DR陽性を示さず、浸潤部に接する子宮側の数個の細胞に陽性像がみられた。絨毛癌にはHLA-DR抗原が存在しないと結論され、同種移植腫瘍としての免疫学的特性が示唆された。
pmid-6389728.summary_en: This study investigated whether HLA-DR antigen is expressed on choriocarcinoma, which is genetically regarded as an allogeneic graft. Immunoperoxidase staining of a surgically removed choriocarcinoma and inhibition radioimmunoassays on four choriocarcinoma cell lines showed no HLA-DR-positive tumour cells. Some uterine-side cells contacting the invasive front stained positive. The authors conclude that HLA-DR antigen is not found on choriocarcinoma, which is relevant to its immunological behaviour as an allogeneic tumour.

pmid-6394753.summary_ja: 本研究は細胞遺伝学的解析により、胞状奇胎を二つの異なる症候群に分類した。古典的な完全胞状奇胎は二倍体核型を示し、部分胞状奇胎は69本の染色体を持つ。両者は病理学的・生物学的に異なり、相互移行は認められないとされる。絨毛癌は完全胞状奇胎に関連して見られ、部分胞状奇胎では報告がない。
pmid-6394753.summary_en: This 1984 study compares hydatidiform moles using cytogenetic analysis, identifying two distinct syndromes: classic complete moles with a diploid karyotype and partial moles with 69 chromosomes. The authors conclude that the two entities are pathologically and biologically distinct, with no transition between them. They also note that choriocarcinoma has been found in association with complete moles but not with partial moles. The work is relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease, which this site includes as related content, and clarifies diagnostic and prognostic distinctions between mole subtypes.

pmid-6394754.summary_ja: 本論文は、正常妊娠・流産・胞状奇胎後に生じうる胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（胎盤部絨毛腫）を扱う。着床部反応や絨毛癌との鑑別が重要とされる。診断には妊娠歴、血清hCGとhPL測定、免疫組織化学が有用である。悪性度の判定は困難で治療成績も一定しないと述べている。良性と悪性の区分に向けた診断基準の精緻化が提案されている。
pmid-6394754.summary_en: This 1984 review describes placental-site trophoblastic lesions, sometimes called placental site tumor or placental-site chorioma, which may arise after normal pregnancy, abortion, or hydatidiform mole. The authors stress the need to distinguish these lesions from implantation-site reactions and from choriocarcinoma. Diagnosis relies on pregnancy history, serum chorionic gonadotropin and human placental lactogen measurements, and immunohistochemistry. Malignancy grading can be difficult, and treatment outcomes are variable. They propose the term placental-site chorioma for the entity, with some lesions classified as benign and others as placental-site choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6396197.summary_ja: 本研究は、未分化ヒト胎児性癌細胞の表面抗原を認識するモノクローナル抗体TRA-1-60とTRA-1-81を作製し、特性解析を行った。分化したEC細胞や、マウス奇形癌細胞株にはほとんど反応しない。一方、他の腫瘍や正常組織にも交差反応がみられた。これらのマーカーは多能性ヒトEC細胞の分化研究に有用とされる。
pmid-6396197.summary_en: This 1984 study characterizes two new monoclonal antibodies, TRA-1-60 and TRA-1-81, and compares them with a third antibody, 8-7D. These antibodies recognize distinct cell-surface antigens on undifferentiated human embryonal carcinoma cells. They react weakly or not at all with differentiated EC derivatives and murine teratocarcinoma lines, though cross-reacting epitopes appear on some other tumor and normal tissues. All three antibodies immunoprecipitate high-molecular-weight polypeptides but recognize slightly different molecules. The authors suggest these markers can help study differentiation of pluripotent human EC cells, which are the stem-like components of human germ cell tumors.

pmid-6396305.summary_ja: 本研究は、病理学的に確定した卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫25例の超音波像を検討し、腫瘍壁の描出を評価した。壁は12例（48%）で同定され、多くは薄く低エコーであった。厚い脂肪組織による全周性高エコー壁が1例で見られ、最も特異的な所見とされるが稀である。卵巣類皮嚢腫の画像診断に役立つ。
pmid-6396305.summary_en: This sonographic study reviews 25 patients with proven ovarian benign cystic teratomas to evaluate the appearance of the tumor wall. The wall was identified in 12 patients (48%) and was usually thin and hypoechoic relative to the echogenic contents. In one patient, a circumferential hyperechoic wall due to thick adipose tissue was seen, which the authors describe as the most specific finding but rarely encountered. The findings aid ultrasound interpretation of ovarian dermoid cysts. The paper focuses on imaging of ovarian germ cell-derived teratomas, relevant to this site's coverage of ovarian germ cell tumors and their diagnosis.

pmid-6418432.summary_ja: 本後方視的解析は、1950年から1969年の間に精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して放射線照射を受けた838例を対象としたスコットランドの研究である。全体の10年生存率は61.8%で、セミノーマでは75.3%、奇形腫では37.7%であった。この期間においてメガボルテージビームの導入による生存率の改善は認められなかった。本研究は、精巣腫瘍に対する放射線療法の歴史的な転帰データを提供し、組織型による生存率の違いを示している。
pmid-6418432.summary_en: This Scottish retrospective analysis reviews 838 patients irradiated for testicular germ cell tumors between 1950 and 1969. The overall 10-year survival was 61.8%, with 75.3% for seminomas and 37.7% for teratomas. The authors found no survival improvement attributable to the introduction of megavoltage beams during this period. The study provides historical outcome data on radiotherapy for testicular tumors, showing histology-dependent differences in survival.

pmid-6423265.summary_ja: メモリアル・スローン・ケタリングがんセンターで、未分化型セミノーマの未治療25例を解析した。臨床病期Iは44%、臨床病期IIまたはIIIは56%だった。古典型セミノーマと同じ治療で5年見かけ上治癒率は80%であった。再発で来院した既治療8例の生存率は不良であり、予後は受診時の病態に強く依存する。
pmid-6423265.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering series of 25 untreated patients with anaplastic seminoma, about 17% of its seminoma experience, found 44% clinical Stage I and 56% clinical Stage II or III. Treatment with classical seminoma regimens achieved an overall 80% 5-year apparent cure rate. Eight previously treated patients presenting with recurrence had poor survival, indicating that prognosis depends strongly on disease status at presentation.

pmid-6426966.summary_ja: 精巣がん60例を対象に、精巣摘除術後で追加治療前の精液所見とホルモン値を調べた。約半数で精子数減少、運動率低下、異常精子の増加がみられ、年齢・組織型・病期との相関はなかった。テストステロン低値やLH・FSH上昇もみられ、性腺機能低下が示唆された。凍結保存の意義は限定的だが、低妊孕性は可逆的な場合があるため治療中も妊孕性温存を図るべきと結論づけている。
pmid-6426966.summary_en: In 60 patients with testicular cancer examined after orchiectomy but before further therapy, about half had low sperm counts, poor motility, or high abnormal sperm percentages. Findings did not correlate with age, histology, or stage. Testosterone was often low, with elevated LH and FSH in some, indicating gonadal dysfunction. Cryopreservation may be of questionable value for most patients, though hypofertility may be reversible, so fertility should be preserved during treatment.

pmid-6431040.summary_ja: ラットで胎児膜を子宮外に移植し、胎仔摘出術単独群と発がん剤DMBA併用群で腫瘍誘発を試みた。単独群では65.7%に成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が生じ、DMBA併用群では36.8%に発生した。DMBAは発生率と組織型に影響せず、胎児膜由来の起源の解明にはさらなる研究が必要とされた。
pmid-6431040.summary_en: Fetal membrane was implanted extrauterinely in rats after fetectomy, alone or with DMBA carcinogen application. Tumors occurred in 65.7% of fetectomy-only rats, comprising mature teratomas and yolk sac tumors, and in 36.8% of DMBA-treated rats. DMBA did not change incidence or histology. The authors note that histogenesis from fetal membrane requires further study.

pmid-6433251.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋型性腺異形成症の17歳女性例で、両側性性腺芽細胞腫にディスジャーミノーマへの変化を伴っていた。性腺摘除後に性ステロイド産生は著明に低下し、性腺の内分泌活性が示された。H-Y陽性の46,XY性腺異形成症では腫瘍化が起こりやすいと考察している。
pmid-6433251.summary_en: A 17-year-old girl with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis had an H-Y positive phenotype, bilateral gonadoblastomas with dysgerminomatous change, and nearly complete female secondary sex development. Gonadal steroid production fell markedly after gonadectomy, indicating endocrine activity. The authors note that neoplastic transformation is likely in H-Y positive 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, consistent with this case.

pmid-6443174.summary_ja: 多能性奇形癌幹細胞を酪酸ナトリウムで誘導し、分化マーカーであるプラスミノーゲンアクチベーターを産生させた。複数のクロマトグラフィー工程により酵素を精製し、免疫学的に組織型プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター（t-PA）と同定した。等電点はpH 7.3、SDS-PAGEによる分子量は約77,000であった。本研究は、実験用マウス奇形癌モデルを用いたin vitroの生化学的解析であり、胚細胞腫瘍の分化生物学に関連する。
pmid-6443174.summary_en: Pluripotent teratocarcinoma stem cells were induced with sodium butyrate to produce plasminogen activator, a differentiation marker. The enzyme was purified using multiple chromatography steps and characterized: immunologically identified as tissue-type plasminogen activator (t-PA), with a pH 7.3 isoelectric point and a molecular weight of about 77,000 by SDS-PAGE. The study is an in vitro biochemical analysis of an experimental murine teratocarcinoma model, relevant to germ cell tumor differentiation biology.

pmid-6463837.summary_ja: 15歳女性に、頸髄の髄内嚢胞性奇形腫様腫瘍と卵巣奇形腫が合併した症例を報告した。脊髄造影ではT-5からC-5への閉塞像が認められた。脊髄腫瘍は部分切除され、卵巣奇形腫は後に摘出された。奇形腫および奇形腫様腫瘍の病理と経過を、外科的管理とともに考察している。
pmid-6463837.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl presented with gait disturbance and was found to have an intramedullary cystic teratoid tumor of the cervical spinal cord with a dermal sinus. Myelography showed a block at T-5 with extension to C-5. Partial excision was performed, and a left ovarian teratoma was later removed. The paper reviews the pathology and natural history of teratomas and teratoid tumors along with surgical management, combining an intraspinal teratoid tumor with an ovarian teratoma.

pmid-6466547.summary_ja: 本研究は1984年に報告された、イングランド東アングリア地域における精巣がんの年齢別発生率の検討である。1960年以降、奇形腫と精巣セミノーマの発生率はほぼ倍増した。奇形腫は若年男性で増加し、セミノーマは1975〜1980年に最も急速に増加した。著者らは発生率上昇の原因についても考察している。
pmid-6466547.summary_en: This 1984 study analyzed age-related incidence of testicular cancer in East Anglia, England, from 1960 to 1980. Teratoma incidence was stable during the 1960s, then increased in the 1970s, mainly due to rising rates among younger men. Seminoma incidence rose steadily, most rapidly between 1975 and 1980. Overall, testicular cancer incidence nearly doubled since 1960, and the authors suggested possible causes for these increases.

pmid-6467138.summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症の患者に、右卵巣未分化胚細胞腫、甲状腺乳頭癌、膵腺癌が併発した症例の報告である。これら3つの悪性腫瘍の併発は初めての報告とされる。若年者ではリンパ網内系腫瘍や白血病が多く、長期生存者では上皮性悪性腫瘍が多いという、本症候群の腫瘍発生傾向を論じている。核腫大は早期または異常な老化と関連するとも述べている。
pmid-6467138.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes a patient with ataxia-telangiectasia who developed a right ovarian dysgerminoma, papillary thyroid carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. It is presented as the first reported case combining these conditions. The authors review the malignancy pattern in ataxia-telangiectasia, noting that lymphoreticular neoplasms and leukemia predominate in younger patients, while epithelial cancers are more common in longer-surviving patients. They also link nucleomegaly to precocious or abnormal aging.

pmid-6468525.summary_ja: 本研究は、STOマウス線維芽細胞の馴化培地に含まれる分化遅延因子（DRF）の性状を検討したものである。DRFは胎児性癌細胞（NG2およびF9）の分化を遅らせることが示された。ゲル濾過で分子量約57000のポリペプチドとされ、28倍に精製された。DRFは分化を完全には阻止せず、遅延させるにとどまった。他の細胞由来の培地にも同様の活性が認められた。
pmid-6468525.summary_en: This 1984 study characterized a differentiation retarding factor (DRF) present in medium conditioned by STO mouse fibroblast cells. DRF inhibited spontaneous differentiation of NG2 embryonal carcinoma cells and retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. It was identified as a polypeptide of about 57 kDa by gel filtration and partially purified 28-fold. DRF delayed but did not fully prevent differentiation in prolonged culture. Conditioned medium from other cell types also showed similar activity, and it could replace feeder cells in NG2 stock cultures.

pmid-6468531.summary_ja: 本研究は、奇形癌由来の壁側内胚葉細胞におけるラミニンの局在を免疫組織化学的に検討したものである。ラミニンは細胞の基底面に分布していたが、コルヒチンまたはサイトカラシンD処理で一端に偏在した。両剤の併用では偏在は起こらなかった。レクチン受容体と表面絨毛はサイトカラシンDでのみ偏在した。ラミニンまたはその受容体は微小管と微小線維の両方に連結していると考察している。
pmid-6468531.summary_en: This 1984 study examined laminin distribution in teratocarcinoma-derived parietal endoderm cells using immunohistochemistry. Laminin was normally distributed on the basal cell surface but became strongly polarized to one end after colchicine or cytochalasin D treatment. Combined treatment prevented this polarization. Lectin receptors and surface villi were polarized by cytochalasin D but not by colchicine. The authors suggest that laminin or its receptor links to both microfilaments and microtubules, and that its transmembrane regulation differs from that of other surface components.

pmid-6469085.summary_ja: 女性仮性半陰陽の患者に生じた大きな卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例報告である。術前の血清乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）は著明に上昇していた。腫瘍を完全切除すると、LDHは正常値に戻った。LDHが上昇したディスジャーミノーマの報告は過去に5例のみであり、いずれも他の卵巣腫瘍より高値であった。著者らは、LDHを卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の診断、予後、経過観察に有用な酵素性腫瘍マーカーとして提唱している。
pmid-6469085.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes a female pseudohermaphrodite with a large ovarian dysgerminoma whose preoperative serum lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) was markedly elevated. After complete tumor excision, LDH levels returned to normal, supporting its value for monitoring. The authors note only five previously reported dysgerminomas with elevated LDH, and in each case LDH was higher than in other ovarian tumors. They propose LDH as an enzymatic tumor marker for the diagnosis, prognosis, and surveillance of ovarian dysgerminoma.

pmid-6469377.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣腫瘍の治療の進歩を概観したものである。進行した胚細胞腫瘍では、セミノーマか非セミノーマかを問わず、初回の減量化学療法が第一選択とされる。セミノーマとそれ以外の胚細胞腫瘍の区別は、実際よりも歴史的なものである可能性が指摘されている。統一された病期分類と多施設共同の無作為化試験の必要性を強調し、現行の治療で約90%が治癒可能と述べている。
pmid-6469377.summary_en: This 1984 review discusses treatment advances for testicular tumors. Primary cytoreductive chemotherapy is the standard for advanced germ cell tumors, whether seminomatous or nonseminomatous. The author questions whether the distinction between seminomas and other germ cell tumors is more historical than real. A unified staging system and multi-institutional randomized trials are urgently needed. With current options, about 90% of patients should be cured, and early recognition and new therapies for relapsing patients remain priorities without compromising cure rates.

pmid-6469481.summary_ja: 本報告は、非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の男性86例の治療経験を評価したものである。71例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清、15例に腎摘除が施行された。84例に化学療法が行われ、初回療法はビンクリスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンの併用であった。維持療法にはビンクリスチン、メトトレキサート、クロラムブシルが用いられた。臨床病期N0M0の31例では再発は認められなかった。
pmid-6469481.summary_en: This 1984 report evaluates treatment outcomes in 86 men with nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Seventy-one underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, 15 also had nephrectomy, and 84 received chemotherapy. Initial therapy combined vincristine, bleomycin, and cisplatin, followed by maintenance with vincristine, methotrexate, and chlorambucil. Maintenance was also given to clinical stage N0 M0 patients, and in 31 of them no relapse occurred.

pmid-6471811.summary_ja: 精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマを電子顕微鏡と顕微分光測光法で解析し、古典的セミノーマと比較した研究です。精母細胞性セミノーマは細胞小器官が多い一方、減数分裂や先体の前駆構造は認められませんでした。DNA量の解析では半数体細胞はなく、より分化の進んだセミノーマの亜型と結論づけています。
pmid-6471811.summary_en: This study examined spermatocytic seminoma of the testis using electron microscopy and microspectrophotometric DNA analysis, comparing it with classic seminoma. Spermatocytic seminoma cells contained more cytoplasmic organelles but lacked features of meiotic division or acrosome precursors. DNA content analysis showed no haploid cells and lower modal DNA values, mostly hyperdiploid or peritriploid, versus peritriploid to peripentaploid in classic seminoma. The authors conclude it is a better-differentiated seminoma variant that is committed toward spermatocytic differentiation but has not fully reached that stage.

pmid-6472517.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の女性5例の臨床病理学的検討です。手術を中心に治療され、うち1例は放射線療法と化学療法も受けました。全例が4〜11年間無病生存しています。1例は精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマに類似した組織像を示し、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫では報告のない所見とされています。
pmid-6472517.summary_en: This clinicopathologic report describes five women aged 15 to 30 with ovarian dysgerminoma, treated mainly with surgery, with one patient also receiving radiation and chemotherapy. Three cases were stage Ia and two were stage III. All patients were disease-free for 4 to 11 years. One tumor showed a histologic pattern resembling testicular spermatocytic seminoma, which the authors describe as previously unreported for ovarian dysgerminoma. The study highlights favorable long-term outcomes across stages and this unusual morphologic variant.

pmid-6472750.summary_ja: 26歳女性が腹痛と腹腔内出血で受診し、妊娠反応は陽性でした。手術で破裂卵巣妊娠と判明し、組織学的に嚢胞性奇形腫内の原発性卵胞内卵巣妊娠と確認されました。卵巣腫瘍内に生じる卵巣妊娠は極めて稀とされています。卵巣腫瘍があっても異所性妊娠を疑う重要性が示されています。
pmid-6472750.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman presented with acute abdominal pain and hemoperitoneum after a positive pregnancy test. Surgery revealed a ruptured ovarian pregnancy, and histology confirmed a primary intrafollicular ovarian pregnancy located within a cystic teratoma. The authors note that ovarian pregnancy occurring within an ovarian tumor is exceedingly rare. The report emphasizes considering ectopic pregnancy in women of reproductive age with acute abdominal pain and a positive pregnancy test, even when an ovarian tumor is present.

pmid-6476029.summary_ja: 女性表現型で性腺異形成を示し、性染色体の断片が判定できない4例を検討しました。性腺組織は精巣組織または胚細胞腫瘍でした。臨床所見やXga・H-Y抗原の検査は組織所見と一貫して相関しませんでした。腫瘍リスクが高いため、予防的性腺摘出と続くホルモン補充療法が推奨されています。
pmid-6476029.summary_en: This study examined four patients with female phenotypes, dysgenetic gonads, and small sex chromosomal fragments that could not be characterized cytogenetically. Gonadal histology showed testicular tissue or germ cell tumors. Clinical features, DNA replication studies, and Xga and H-Y antigen assays did not consistently correlate with gonadal histology. The authors recommend prophylactic gonadectomy followed by hormone replacement in all patients with female phenotype, gonadal dysgenesis, and indeterminate sex chromosomal fragments, given the markedly increased tumor risk.

pmid-6476839.summary_ja: 顔面と頸部の浮腫を呈した13歳男児に、大きな前上縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、針生検でセミノーマと確定した。ビンクリスチンとプレドニゾロン、さらにシクロホスファミドを加えた化学療法で腫瘤は著明に縮小し、その後3,750 radの放射線療法を施行した。4年以上のフォローアップで無症状かつ再発の所見はない。小児の大きな原発性縦隔セミノーマの化学感受性を示す症例である。
pmid-6476839.summary_en: A 13-year-old boy with edematous face and neck was found to have a large anterior superior mediastinal mass, and needle biopsy confirmed seminoma. He received two-drug chemotherapy with vincristine and prednisolone, followed by three-drug chemotherapy adding cyclophosphamide, with considerable tumor regression. Mediastinal and lower neck irradiation followed at 3,750 rad. After more than four years of follow-up, he remained asymptomatic without evidence of recurrence. The case shows the chemosensitivity of large primary mediastinal seminoma in a pediatric patient.

pmid-6478436.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が後腹膜に転移した症例で、減量化学療法後に明らかな肉腫成分が出現しました。肉腫部分は胎児性横紋筋肉腫や線維肉腫などからなり、残りの未熟奇形腫とは異なっていました。従来の残存胚細胞腫瘍の分類に当てはまらず、今後の治療判断に疑問を投げかけています。
pmid-6478436.summary_en: A patient with testicular teratoma metastatic to the retroperitoneum developed areas of frank sarcoma after cytoreductive chemotherapy. The sarcomatous components included embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma with a sarcoma botryoides pattern, alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, and fibrosarcoma, distinct from the immature teratoma that made up the rest of the lesion and the primary tumor. Diagnosis was supported by histologic, ultrastructural, and immunocytochemical features. The authors note this case does not fit traditional categorization of residual germ cell tumors and raises questions about subsequent therapeutic decisions.

pmid-6478446.summary_ja: 動物への継代移植を介さずに、ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌の短期培養を樹立する方法を報告しています。剖検または生検組織を凍結ミクロトームで切片にし、生存腫瘍を選択して培養しました。培養上清の放射免疫測定で栄養膜由来であることを確認し、染色体解析では複数の異数性が認められました。
pmid-6478446.summary_en: The authors describe a method for establishing short-term in vitro cultures of human gestational choriocarcinoma without serial passage in animal hosts. Starting material was postmortem or surgical biopsy tissue from patients with known choriocarcinoma. Tissue was sectioned on a freezing microtome, and viable tumor was selected for explantation. Radioimmunoassays of culture supernatants confirmed the trophoblastic nature of the growing cells, and cytogenetic analysis revealed several aneuploid modes. The technique provides a practical model for studying gestational choriocarcinoma biology.

pmid-6479493.summary_ja: 無分化能性のF9胎児性癌細胞株と多分化能のPCC3株のコロニーにおける自発的分化を比較した研究。6日目から神経芽細胞が出現し、銀染色やメロシアニン540染色などで評価された。F9は分化が進んでも高いコロニー形成能を保った一方、PCC3はそれを失った。F9は増殖抑制機構の一部を失っており、無分化能は増殖と分化の協調的制御の観点から理解できると結論づけている。
pmid-6479493.summary_en: Study of spontaneous differentiation in colonies of the nullipotent F9 embryonal carcinoma cell line, compared with the multipotent PCC3 line. Neuroblasts appeared from day 6 and were assessed by silver staining, merocyanine 540 staining, and neurite observation. F9 colonies preserved high plating efficiency despite advanced differentiation, whereas PCC3 lost colony-forming activity. The authors conclude F9 cells lost certain growth-control mechanisms and propose that nullipotence reflects coordinated regulation of proliferation and differentiation in EC cells.

pmid-6479697.summary_ja: 卵巣から得た未熟奇形腫細胞を初期培養段階で培養し、形態学的に解析した報告。腫瘍は神経膠様組織とそれを囲む神経上皮様組織からなっていた。神経膠様細胞は培養中に上皮様細胞へ分化し、培養像は元の病変に類似するようになった。神経膠様細胞が奇形腫を形成する分化細胞へ変化しうる全能性を持つと考察している。
pmid-6479697.summary_en: Immature teratoma cells obtained from a patient's ovary were cultured and morphologically characterized at an early culture stage. The tumor consisted largely of neuroglial-like tissue surrounded by neuroepithelial-like tissue. In vitro, neuroglial-like cells differentiated into epithelioid cells, and the culture morphology came to resemble the original lesion. Some differentiated cells grew out from cell aggregates on neuroglial colonies. The authors suggest neuroglial-like cells retain totipotency to form teratoma-like differentiated tissue.

pmid-6480679.summary_ja: 13歳女児の悪性卵巣奇形腫症例。単純X線撮影とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、腹腔内および縦隔に広範な石灰化した転移(性)病変が認められた。病理所見と画像所見を報告し、小児の悪性卵巣奇形腫における石灰化転移の画像パターンを示している。単一症例の報告である。
pmid-6480679.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with malignant ovarian teratoma showed extensive calcified intraperitoneal and mediastinal implants on plain radiography and computed tomography. The report describes the pathologic and radiologic findings and documents the calcified metastatic pattern of a pediatric malignant ovarian germ cell tumor. It is a single-patient report focused on imaging features of metastatic deposits rather than treatment outcomes.

pmid-6482446.summary_ja: 成熟固形奇形腫の卵巣腫瘍で、成熟神経膠組織からなる腹膜およびリンパ節転移(腹膜神経膠腫症)を伴う症例の報告。広範な腹腔内転移は通常進行を示すが、本症では治療法にかかわらず予後は良好だった。両側付属器切除などの根治的手術は不必要に破壊的であり、転移(性)病変への治療も必要ないと論じている。
pmid-6482446.summary_en: A report of ovarian mature solid teratoma with peritoneal and lymph node metastases consisting of mature glial tissue, termed gliomatosis peritonei. Although widespread intraperitoneal spread usually signals advanced disease, the prognosis was excellent regardless of therapy. The authors argue that radical surgery such as bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy is unnecessarily destructive and that treatment of the metastases is not required in such cases.

pmid-6484699.summary_ja: 表現型は女性でXY核型を示す性腺異形成症例の臨床・内分泌所見の報告。両側に性腺芽腫が確認され、右側は大きなディスジャーミノーマにほぼ置換されていた。性分化疾患におけるXY性腺異形成と性腺芽腫・ディスジャーミノーマの関連を示す症例である。
pmid-6484699.summary_en: Clinical and endocrine report of a phenotypic woman with an XY karyotype and gonadal dysgenesis. Gonadal examination showed bilateral gonadoblastomas, with the right gonad almost completely replaced by a massive dysgerminoma. The case illustrates the association of XY gonadal dysgenesis with gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, a recognized germ cell neoplasia risk in disorders of sex development.

pmid-6492973.summary_ja: 小児の頭頸部奇形腫3例を報告した臨床的検討である。病変は不規則に進行性増大したが、組織学的な悪性所見は稀であった。死亡の主因は呼吸障害で、完全切除が死亡率と再発の低減に最も有効な治療とされる。小児の頸部腫瘤に対する穿刺吸引細胞診の有用性も論じている。
pmid-6492973.summary_en: This clinical series describes three children with teratomas of the head and neck, a rare site for this tumor. Although the lesions showed uncoordinated progressive growth, histologic malignancy was uncommon. Respiratory compromise was the main cause of mortality. The authors recommend complete surgical excision as the treatment of choice to reduce mortality and recurrence, and discuss the role of fine needle aspiration in evaluating pediatric neck masses.

pmid-6496212.summary_ja: 異常妊娠と絨毛性腫瘍における補体系の変化を概説した論文である。胞状奇胎や絨毛性悪性腫瘍では補体活性が低下しており、病変絨毛による活性化が関与すると考えられている。胞状奇胎の悪性転化予防に免疫療法が有効で、転移性絨毛性悪性腫瘍には免疫療法と併用化学療法が著効すると報告されている。
pmid-6496212.summary_en: This review examines the complement system in abnormal pregnancy and chorionic neoplasia. Complement activity is depressed in hydatidiform mole, abruptio placentae, threatened abortion, and chorionic malignancy, possibly due to activation by lesioned chorionic villi. The authors report that immunotherapy can help prevent malignant transformation of hydatidiform mole, and that immunotherapy combined with combination chemotherapy is markedly effective for metastatic chorionic malignancy.

pmid-6496214.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の組織におけるhCGα、hCGβ、hPLのmRNAの局在をin situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した研究である。正常胎盤ではhPLは合胞体栄養膜層のみに認められた。絨毛癌ではhPLの発現は乏しく、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)遺伝子は合胞体様領域で発現していた。絨毛形成がhPL発現と関連し、hCGは細胞性栄養膜を含む未分化な組織でも発現しうると結論している。
pmid-6496214.summary_en: This study uses in situ hybridization on human hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma tissues to map hCG alpha, hCG beta, and hPL mRNA expression. In normal placenta, hPL appeared only in the syncytial layer, whereas in mole and choriocarcinoma hCG transcripts were detected in syncytial-like areas. hPL expression was low in choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that villus formation is associated with hPL expression, whereas hCG genes can be expressed in disorganized tissues containing cytotrophoblastic elements.

pmid-6498061.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の奇形腫患者10例に筋肉内投与したインターフェロンの第II相試験である。分化型奇形腫の2例は病勢安定、未分化型胚細胞腫瘍の8例は進行した。分化型奇形腫の少年は複数コースで病勢が維持されたが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇により追加の細胞障害性化学療法を要した。未分化型には無効で、切除不能な分化型奇形腫には有用な可能性があると結論している。
pmid-6498061.summary_en: This phase 2 trial gave intramuscular interferon to 10 patients with chemotherapy-resistant teratomas. Two patients with differentiated teratoma stabilized, while eight with anaplastic germ cell tumor progressed. One boy with differentiated teratoma had disease maintained across several interferon courses, but rising hCG required additional cytotoxic chemotherapy. The authors conclude that lymphoblastoid interferon is inactive against anaplastic germ cell tumors, whereas interferon may help unresectable differentiated teratoma.

pmid-6498743.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腸間膜の類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）に伴う自己免疫性溶血性貧血を呈した患者を報告する。奇形腫は外科的完全切除のみが一貫して根治的であるため、早期認識が重要とされる。嚢腫壁内の免疫担当細胞から、腫瘍組織が赤血球と交差反応する抗腫瘍自己抗体を産生する可能性が示唆された。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による嚢胞構造の描出の有用性も強調されている。
pmid-6498743.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with autoimmune hemolytic anemia associated with a dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) of the mesentery. The authors note that early recognition of abdominal teratoma is important, because complete surgical removal is the only consistently curative treatment. Immunocompetent cells found in the cyst wall suggest the tumor tissue may produce antitumor autoantibodies that cross-react with the patient's erythrocytes. The paper also emphasizes the value of computed tomography in visualizing the cystic structure before surgery.

pmid-6498772.summary_ja: 卵巣の純粋未熟奇形腫7例を対象に、組織学的グレードと核型を検討した研究である。Norris基準で0〜3に分類し、グレード0〜2の4例は46,XX正常核型を示し生存している。グレード3の3例には核型異常があり、死亡例は病期IIcであった。正常な46,XX核型は良好な予後、核型の逸脱は不良な予後を示唆すると著者らは提唱している。
pmid-6498772.summary_en: This study examined seven cases of pure ovarian immature teratoma in patients aged 10 to 38 years, assessing histologic grade and karyotype. Tumors were graded from 0 to 3 using Norris criteria. Four low-grade tumors (grades 0 to 2) showed normal 46,XX karyotypes, and those patients remain alive. Three grade 3 tumors showed karyotypic abnormalities, and the only death occurred in a Stage IIc patient. The authors propose that a normal 46,XX karyotype indicates a favorable prognosis, whereas karyotypic deviations suggest a poor prognosis.

pmid-6499379.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの管理におけるコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の役割を検討した。初期病期分類では、大きな腹部病変の範囲評価にCTが有用であった。病期IIcでは放射線療法後1年以内の再発が多く、主に腹部外であった。腫瘍マーカーや胸部X線に変化がなくても縦隔再発がCTで検出された。病期IIbおよびIIcには初年度の定期的なCT監視を推奨している。
pmid-6499379.summary_en: This study evaluated computed tomography (CT) in the management of testicular seminoma. CT was valuable for defining the extent of bulky abdominal disease at initial staging but offered little benefit for Stage I and IIa patients. After radiotherapy for Stage IIc disease, relapse within one year was common and mostly extra-abdominal. Mediastinal relapse was detected by CT even without raised tumor markers or chest radiograph changes. The authors recommend regular CT surveillance during the first year for Stage IIb and IIc patients.

pmid-6499380.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣奇形腫の35例において、病期分類とフォローアップ中に従来のX線画像診断とコンピュータ断層撮影（CT）を比較した。リンパ管造影は病期IIaの病変をよく検出し、CTは腹部病変の体積をより正確に評価した。CTは腫瘍マーカーの上昇がなくても進行を検出し、多くは4か月以内に出現した。選択的胸部CTは全肺断層撮影に比べて優位性がなかった。著者らは、腎門より上部の評価、リンパ管造影が不明瞭な場合などにCTを用い、初年度は3か月ごとの腹部CTを推奨している。
pmid-6499380.summary_en: This study compared conventional radiographic imaging with computed tomography (CT) in 35 patients with testicular teratoma during staging and follow-up. Lymphangiography detected Stage IIa lesions better than CT, while CT defined the volume of abdominal disease more accurately. CT detected progressive disease without tumor marker elevation, usually within four months. Selective thoracic CT offered no advantage over whole-lung tomography. The authors recommend CT for areas above the renal hila, for equivocal lymphangiography, and abdominal CT every three months in the first year.

pmid-6500156.summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症について報告する論文である。未熟奇形腫は胚様の未熟構造を含む悪性奇形腫で、全卵巣癌の1%未満を占める。若年女性に多いが、妊娠合併例の報告は極めて稀とされる。抄録は背景の記載に限られ、症例の詳細や転帰は含まれていない。
pmid-6500156.summary_en: This article describes immature teratoma associated with gliomatosis peritonei in the setting of pregnancy. Immature teratoma is a malignant form of teratoma containing immature, embryo-like structures. It accounts for less than 1% of all ovarian cancers and occurs most often in young women. The authors note that it is very rarely reported in association with pregnancy. The abstract provides background only and does not describe the case details or outcome.

pmid-6500205.summary_ja: Nulli-SCCl胎児性癌細胞株を単層培養し、レチノイン酸とヘキサメチレンビスアセトアミドによる分化誘導を比較した。両剤により異なる2つの分化表現型が得られた。これらはマウス胚盤胞内細胞塊由来の壁側内胚葉および臓側内胚葉に類似していた。形態、抗原発現、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター分泌、タンパク質合成の点で、未分化の胎児性癌細胞および両表現型は互いに異なっていた。
pmid-6500205.summary_en: This in vitro study examined the Nulli-SCCl embryonal carcinoma cell line in monolayer culture. Treatment with retinoic acid or hexamethylenebisacetamide induced differentiation at high efficiency, but each agent produced a distinct phenotype. These phenotypes resembled parietal and visceral endoderm, the earliest derivatives of mouse blastocyst inner cell mass cells. Both differed from undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells and from each other in morphology, antigen expression, plasminogen activator secretion, and protein synthesis.

pmid-6501585.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の肺転移患者20例を対象に、化学療法後に切除した肺転移巣の組織像と予後を検討した研究です。壊死・瘢痕化や良性分化を示す病変は予後良好で、未分化腫瘍優位の病変は26か月以内の死亡と関連しました。組織学的反応が生存に相関することを示しています。
pmid-6501585.summary_en: This study reviewed 20 patients with testicular teratoma metastatic to the lung who underwent surgical resection of pulmonary metastases after chemotherapy. Patients whose metastases showed necrosis, scarring, or benign differentiation had favorable outcomes, whereas predominantly undifferentiated pulmonary tumors were associated with death within 26 months. The authors conclude that post-chemotherapy necrosis and differentiation of teratomatous lung metastases signify a good prognosis, linking histologic response to survival.

pmid-6501629.summary_ja: 新生児の鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告です。羊水過多と呼吸窮迫を呈した症例で、術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)により腫瘍の鑑別、頭蓋内進展、悪性所見の評価を行い、その後外科的切除が行われました。鼻咽頭の奇形腫評価におけるCTの有用性を示しています。
pmid-6501629.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a teratoma of the nasopharynx, presenting with polyhydramnios and respiratory distress. Preoperative high-resolution CT was used to characterize the mass, distinguish it from other tumors, and assess possible intracranial extension and malignant features. The tumor was then surgically excised. The authors emphasize that CT is valuable for evaluating teratomatous tumors in this location.

pmid-6504861.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株と正常妊娠末期の胎盤細胞初代培養を比較し、プリン代謝を検討した研究です。絨毛癌細胞はアデニン、ヒポキサンチン、アデノシンをヌクレオチドへより多く取り込み、主にATPに組み込まれました。hCG分泌は悪性細胞株の方が少なく、胎盤細胞の特殊機能の保持が示されています。
pmid-6504861.summary_en: This 1984 study compared purine metabolism in the BeWo human choriocarcinoma cell line with primary cultured term human placental cells. Choriocarcinoma cells incorporated substantially more adenine, hypoxanthine, and adenosine into nucleotides, mainly ATP, whereas placental cells showed less active purine metabolism. The malignant cells secreted less hCG than primary placental cultures. The authors conclude that placental cells retain a higher degree of specialized function than malignant placental-origin cells.

pmid-6505257.summary_ja: 1984年の報告で、病期II〜IVの進行精巣非セミノーマ63例に化学療法後の照射療法を行い、92.1%が無病生存しました。先行照射後に再発し化学療法を受けた53例では71.7%が生存しました。腫瘍体積や照射歴で成績が異なる一方、照射の寄与は自明ではないと著者は述べています。
pmid-6505257.summary_en: This 1984 Radiotherapy and Oncology report describes 63 patients with stage II to IV testicular non-seminoma treated with chemotherapy followed by involved-field radiotherapy, with 92% disease-free survival. A second group of 53 patients who had received prior radiotherapy and then chemotherapy for recurrence had 72% survival. Outcomes differed by tumour volume and prior irradiation, and the authors caution that radiotherapy's contribution cannot be assumed.

pmid-6505280.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍で遠隔転移のない113例を対象に、横隔膜下照射後の転移リスクを解析しました。組織型、T分類、リンパ節転移、血管侵襲が予後因子でした。血管侵襲があると組織型の予後的意義は失われます。T<4・N0・V-は経過観察、高リスク群には予防的化学療法が妥当と提案されています。
pmid-6505280.summary_en: This study analysed 113 patients with clinically M0 non-seminoma testicular tumours treated with subdiaphragmatic irradiation to assess the risk of subsequent metastasis. Histology, T category, nodal involvement and vascular invasion were prognostic, and vascular invasion removed the prognostic impact of histological subtype. The authors suggest watch-and-wait for T less than 4, N0, V-negative disease, and elective chemotherapy for higher-risk groups.

pmid-6511123.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍における胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ様酵素(PLAP様)の発現を検討しました。典型的セミノーマ13例で高い発現がみられ、胎児性癌では少量、正常精巣では微量でした。モノクローナル抗体と阻害実験により、セミノーマの酵素は胎児性癌や正常精巣のものに類似することが示されました。正常精巣由来酵素の正所性発現が増加している可能性が示唆されます。
pmid-6511123.summary_en: This study examined placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like) enzymes in testicular tumours. Very high levels were found in 13 typical seminomas, with lower amounts in some embryonal carcinomas and trace levels in normal testis. Monoclonal antibody and inhibition studies showed seminoma enzymes resemble those in embryonal carcinoma and normal testis, suggesting enhanced eutopic expression of normal testicular enzymes.

pmid-6511164.summary_ja: 主に海綿状血管腫様成分から成る両側性の良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告です。右側病変は純粋な卵巣血管腫に類似していました。両側性の発生はまれであり、血管腫成分の大きさや、その後に生じた下肢血管腫も診断上の注目点として挙げられています。
pmid-6511164.summary_en: This case report describes bilateral benign cystic ovarian teratomas composed predominantly of cavernous hemangiomatous elements. The right-sided lesion mimicked a pure ovarian hemangioma. The authors highlight the rarity of this bilateral presentation, the sizes of the hemangiomatous components, and a subsequent hemangioma of the leg as points of interest for diagnosis.

pmid-6511784.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞において、糖鎖化阻害剤ツニカマイシンが胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の生合成に与える影響を検討しました。酵素活性と免疫反応性が並行して低下し、PLAP mRNA活性の抑制が生合成減少の原因と示されました。胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーであるPLAPの発現制御機構を理解するうえで重要な知見です。
pmid-6511784.summary_en: This 1984 study examined the effect of tunicamycin, a protein glycosylation inhibitor, on placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in choriocarcinoma cells. Tunicamycin reduced enzyme activity and immunoreactivity in parallel, suppressed PLAP mRNA activity and decreased biosynthesis. A 58,000-dalton polypeptide formed that degraded at a rate similar to glycosylated controls. The work clarifies regulatory mechanisms of this germ cell tumour marker.

pmid-6513037.summary_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫(良性嚢胞性奇形腫)から発生した腺扁平上皮癌の89歳女性の症例報告です。類皮嚢腫の悪性変化はまれとされています。この組織型の発生としては初の報告で、最高齢例でもあります。類皮嚢腫は慎重な病理学的検査が重要だと強調されています。
pmid-6513037.summary_en: This case report describes an 89-year-old woman with adenosquamous carcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst (benign cystic teratoma). The authors note that malignant change in dermoid cysts is rare. They report this as the first reported adenosquamous carcinoma arising in such a cyst and the oldest patient on record, and emphasise careful pathological examination of dermoid cysts.

pmid-6517466.summary_ja: 口腔・咽頭から発生し口外へ突出する稀な先天性の胎生期腫瘍であるエピグナサスの2症例を報告しています。分類や臨床・画像診断をレビューし、術前評価の向上により安全な外科的切除が可能になると述べています。残存病変や発生学的奇形の進展を検出するため、定期的な長期フォローアップが重要であると強調しています。
pmid-6517466.summary_en: This report describes two cases of epignathus, a rare congenital embryonal tumor arising from the oral cavity or pharynx and protruding from the mouth. The authors review its classification and clinical and radiological diagnostic features. They note that improved preoperative assessment allows safe surgical excision. The paper emphasizes that careful long-term follow-up with regular examinations is essential to detect residual lesions or extension of the original embryological malformation.

pmid-6523647.summary_ja: 両側精巣に異なる組織型の胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例です。右精巣はセミノーマと胎児性癌、左精巣はセミノーマと成熟奇形腫でした。右の大動脈傍リンパ節転移巣に軟骨成分を含む成熟奇形腫がみられ、転移部位での自然な成熟を示しています。文献的考察も加えられています。
pmid-6523647.summary_en: This report describes a man with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors of different histologic types. The right testis contained seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, while the left contained seminoma and mature teratoma. A mature teratoma with cartilage was also found in a right para-aortic lymph node, indicating spontaneous maturation in the metastatic region. The authors review the literature on cases showing maturation at metastatic sites, highlighting its relevance to diagnosis and management.

pmid-6524097.summary_ja: 体重の20%を超える巨大仙尾部奇形腫が破裂した新生児の症例です。出生前超音波検査により胎内診断が可能となり、安全な分娩管理に役立つと述べています。体液・電解質異常の迅速な補正と出血血管の緊急結紮により救命され、良好な予後が得られました。
pmid-6524097.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma exceeding 20% of body weight that ruptured. Such tumours often cause delivery complications, including obstruction and rupture. Prenatal ultrasound screening allows in utero diagnosis and safer delivery planning. The authors emphasize that ruptured giant tumours should not be dismissed as too unstable for surgery. Prompt correction of fluid and electrolyte disturbances and emergency ligation of bleeding vessels saved the infant, who had an excellent later prognosis.

pmid-6524231.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍で化学療法後も残存した胸部陰影を有する3症例を報告しています。全例で開胸による完全切除が行われ、悪性細胞のない成熟奇形腫が確認されました。全例が2〜18年後も転移なく生存しており、化学療法抵抗性病変の完全摘出が推奨されています。
pmid-6524231.summary_en: This paper reviews three patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumour and thoracic opacities resistant to conservative therapy. One patient had near-complete regression after a short chemotherapy course, while the others had enlarging masses despite combination chemotherapy and normal tumour markers. All underwent thoracotomy with complete surgical resection, which revealed mature teratoma without malignant cells. All remained metastasis-free at 2 to 18 years. The authors recommend complete extirpation of chemotherapy-resistant lesions because of compression risk and the need for active histology before restarting chemotherapy.

pmid-6524568.summary_ja: 42歳男性の両側精巣腫大例です。両側高位精巣摘除術でセミノーマ、胎児性癌、成熟奇形腫が確認されました。後腹膜リンパ節郭清で大動脈傍の転移巣7か所が見つかり、そのうち1か所に軟骨を含む成熟奇形腫がみられました。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法後、約1.5年の完全寛解が得られています。
pmid-6524568.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 42-year-old man with bilateral testicular swelling. Bilateral high orchiectomy revealed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma in the right testis and seminoma and mature teratoma in the left. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy found seven para-aortic metastatic regions, one containing mature teratoma with cartilage. After multidrug chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine, and peplomycin, the patient achieved complete remission for about 1.5 years. The authors also review the literature on bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with maturation in metastases.

pmid-6524965.summary_ja: 正常な子宮内妊娠と併存した広範転移性絨毛癌の症例報告である。患者は甲状腺腫瘤を主訴に受診し、これを契機に悪性疾患が発見された。妊婦の原因不明の甲状腺腫瘍を評価する際には、絨毛性疾患を念頭に置く必要性が示されている。非典型的な転移部位が初発症状となった点で臨床的に示唆に富む。
pmid-6524965.summary_en: This case report describes widely metastatic choriocarcinoma diagnosed during a normal intrauterine pregnancy. The patient presented with a thyroid mass, which led to the discovery of the malignancy. The authors highlight how an unusual metastatic site can be the initial clinical sign of gestational choriocarcinoma coexisting with a viable pregnancy. They emphasize considering trophoblastic disease when evaluating unexplained thyroid tumors in pregnant women.

pmid-6526585.summary_ja: 乳児期に発症した頭頸部奇形腫の小児症例報告である。出生時に顎下部腫瘤があり気道閉塞の危険があった。その後左扁桃に2つ目の奇形腫が生じ、両病変は類似の組織像を示した。奇形腫の発生理論との関連が考察され、両腫瘍は摘出され再発なく経過している。小児の頭頸部奇形腫のまれさに言及している。
pmid-6526585.summary_en: This case report describes a child with head and neck teratomas diagnosed in infancy. A neonate presented with a submandibular mass causing life-threatening airway risk, and later developed a second teratoma of the left tonsil. Both lesions showed similar histological composition, which the authors discuss in relation to proposed theories of teratoma origin. Both tumors were surgically removed and the child remained well without recurrence. The paper notes the rarity of head and neck teratomas in childhood.

pmid-6535649.summary_ja: 精巣由来のヒト胚細胞腫瘍2株をヌードマウスと軟寒天培養で検討した論文。腫瘍Aは胎児性癌で、卵黄嚢腫瘍およびセミノーマの特徴を示す境界的な組織像を呈し、マウス内で20継代にわたり形態を維持したがin vitroでは増殖しなかった。腫瘍Bは奇形癌で、半固形培地で嚢胞状の胚様体を形成し、その超微細構造は内細胞塊や内胚葉に類似していた。
pmid-6535649.summary_en: This study characterizes two human testicular germ cell tumors propagated in nude mice and soft-agar culture. Tumor A was an embryonal carcinoma with borderline features of yolk sac tumor and seminoma. It maintained its morphology and cytogenetic features over 20 passages in mice but did not grow in vitro. Tumor B, a teratocarcinoma with yolk sac elements and syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, formed cystic embryoid bodies in semi-solid culture. These embryoid bodies showed ultrastructural features resembling inner cell mass and endoderm, although transplanted colonies reproduced only the morphology of the transplants.

pmid-6536257.summary_ja: 21歳の患者で腹部腫瘤として触知された膵臓類皮嚢腫の症例報告。嚢腫は完全切除され、上腸間膜静脈の選択的結紮を要したが、合併症はなかった。著者らは、本疾患の希少性と静脈との関係による術式への影響を文献を踏まえて考察している。
pmid-6536257.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old patient with a pancreatic dermoid cyst that presented as a palpable abdominal mass. Complete excision of the cyst required elective ligation of the superior mesenteric vein, and the operation was completed without complications. The authors review the rarity of this entity and discuss the relationship of the venous involvement to surgical management, drawing on recent references.

pmid-6537894.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、純粋セミノーマを発症した表現型男性の46,XX真性半陰陽の症例を記述しており、この種の報告としては初めてである。組織の血清学的検査によりH-Y抗原が検出された。著者らは、この所見がH-Y遺伝子の一次性性決定における役割を支持し、異形成性生殖腺の悪性転化の特異的因子である可能性を示唆すると論じている。
pmid-6537894.summary_en: This case report describes a phenotypic male 46,XX true hermaphrodite who developed a pure seminoma, the first such report. Serologic testing of the tissue detected H-Y antigen. The authors argue that this supports a role for the H-Y gene in primary sex determination and suggests it may be the specific factor responsible for malignant transformation of dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-6537906.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍からの転移性腫瘤のCT所見を検討し、嚢胞性、半嚢胞性、充実性に分類した。嚢胞性と半嚢胞性の腫瘤はいずれも奇形腫成分を含み、非奇形腫性の転移巣は充実性であった。CT形態が転移巣の組織構成を反映しうることを示している。
pmid-6537906.summary_en: This study evaluated the computed tomography appearances of metastatic masses arising from testicular neoplasms. The lesions were classified as cystic, semicystic, or solid. Cystic and semicystic masses shared the presence of teratomatous components, whereas non-teratomatous metastases were consistently solid. The findings suggest that CT morphology may reflect the histologic composition of metastases from testicular tumors.

pmid-6538051.summary_ja: 臨床的に正常な子宮から発生し、非典型的な甲状腺中毒症と肺の単発転移で初発した妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。子宮の臨床的評価は絨毛癌の診断に信頼性が低いと強調している。非典型的な甲状腺中毒症を示す女性では本疾患を疑うべきと指摘する。
pmid-6538051.summary_en: This case report describes a woman whose gestational choriocarcinoma first presented with atypical thyrotoxicosis and a solitary lung metastasis arising from a clinically normal uterus. The authors emphasize that clinical evaluation of the uterus is unreliable for diagnosis. They advise that choriocarcinoma should be suspected in females with atypical thyrotoxicosis to avoid diagnostic delay.

pmid-6538214.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対する温熱の影響を、細胞増殖とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生から検討した。43℃1時間の加温で増殖は有意に抑制され、感受性は細胞周期と関連した。メトトレキサートとの併用では特定の時間帯に増強効果を示した。β-hCGは加温単独では上昇せず、加温とメトトレキサートの同時投与で上昇した。
pmid-6538214.summary_en: This study examined the effect of hyperthermia on the gestational choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo, measuring cell growth and beta-hCG production. Heating at 43 degrees C for one hour significantly reduced growth, and sensitivity depended on the cell cycle phase. Heat applied within a defined window enhanced the effect of methotrexate. Beta-hCG rose only when heat and methotrexate were given together.

pmid-6538552.summary_ja: インタクトなヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンおよびそのβサブユニットと反応し、関連ホルモンとの交差反応が少ないマウスモノクローナル抗体W14Aを報告。絨毛癌と栄養膜奇形腫の放射免疫局在診断に適するとされ、予備的な放射免疫測定法も開発された。
pmid-6538552.summary_en: This paper reports a mouse monoclonal antibody, W14A, that reacts with intact human chorionic gonadotropin and its beta-subunit, with minimal cross-reactivity to related hormones. The authors state that it is suitable for radioimmunolocalization of choriocarcinoma and trophoblastic teratoma in humans. A preliminary radioimmunoassay was also developed using the antibody.

pmid-6538758.summary_ja: 男性絨毛癌を抗原とするモノクローナル抗体をI-131で標識し、転移性絨毛癌の術後画像診断を検討した。ヌードマウスでは描出できたが、患者では切除後にのみ確認された。著者らは血清中のブロッキング因子が原因と考えている。転移性栄養膜疾患15例で、ブロッキング因子はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)と同様に病変の鋭敏な指標となり、hCGが上昇しない症例に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-6538758.summary_en: This study used an iodine-131-labeled monoclonal antibody raised against male choriocarcinoma to image metastatic choriocarcinoma after surgery. Imaging succeeded in nude mice but in the patient only after resection, which the authors attribute to serum blocking factor. In 15 patients with metastatic trophoblastic disease, blocking factor tracked with hCG as a sensitive marker and may help in patients without hCG elevation.

pmid-6539203.summary_ja: 切除不能な胚細胞腫瘍に対する積極的治療の後に急性白血病を発症した3例を報告した。放射線と化学療法の併用が2例、化学療法単独が1例であった。治療開始から白血病による死亡までは4か月から61か月であった。治療関連の二次性白血病が、胚細胞腫瘍の強力な治療に伴う晩期合併症であることを示している。
pmid-6539203.summary_en: This 1984 report describes three patients who developed acute leukemia after intensive treatment for inoperable germ cell tumors. Two received radiotherapy plus cytotoxic chemotherapy and one received chemotherapy alone. Leukemia developed between 4 and 61 months after starting therapy, and all three patients died from it. The report highlights treatment-related secondary leukemia as a late complication of aggressive germ cell tumor therapy.

pmid-6539205.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株をサイトカラシンBで処理すると、核分裂は保たれ細胞分裂のみ阻害されて、多核の合胞体栄養膜様細胞が形成された。これらの細胞では細胞あたりのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌が増加し、hCGは主にこの細胞内に局在した。多核化がhCGの合成と分泌を促進することが示唆された。
pmid-6539205.summary_en: This study examined how multinucleation affects hCG production in a human choriocarcinoma cell line. Treatment with cytochalasin B blocked cell division without blocking nuclear division, producing multinucleated syncytiotrophoblast-like cells. These cells secreted more hCG per cell, and immunostaining localized hCG predominantly within them. The authors conclude that multinucleation stimulates hCG synthesis and secretion in choriocarcinoma cells, linking cell morphology with tumor marker production.

pmid-6539342.summary_ja: 67歳男性が血尿で受診した膀胱腫瘍は、当初わずかに栄養膜細胞を含む移行上皮癌であった。約1年半かけて徐々に絨毛癌へと変化した。剖検で他の原発巣はなく、膀胱原発の絨毛癌と確定した。尿路上皮癌から絨毛癌への組織型転換が起こりうることを示す稀な症例である。
pmid-6539342.summary_en: A 67-year-old man presented with hematuria from a bladder tumor initially diagnosed as transitional cell carcinoma with rare trophoblastic cells. Over about 18 months the tumor gradually evolved into choriocarcinoma. Autopsy confirmed a primary choriocarcinoma of the bladder without any other site of origin. The case illustrates a rare lineage transformation within a urothelial carcinoma and underscores that choriocarcinoma can arise primarily outside the gonads.

pmid-6539388.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍37例の原発巣と後腹膜リンパ節10例で、レクチン染色により脈管内の腫瘍細胞を検出した。非セミノーマでは原発巣の血管浸潤がリンパ節転移と、リンパ節の血管浸潤が他臓器転移と相関した。セミノーマでは明確な相関は認められなかった。症例数が少ないため、より大規模な検討が必要とされている。
pmid-6539388.summary_en: This preliminary study used lectin-immunoperoxidase staining to detect tumor cells within vessels in testicular germ cell tumors. Primary tumors from 37 patients and retroperitoneal lymph nodes from 10 patients were examined. In nonseminomatous tumors, vascular invasion in primary tumors correlated with lymph node metastasis, and vascular invasion in nodes correlated with other metastases. No clear correlation was found for seminoma. The authors note the small sample size and call for larger studies.

pmid-6540000.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣と腹部腫瘤を有する50歳男性で、子宮と卵管といったミュラー管由来構造が遺残していた。腹腔内に大きなセミノーマを認めた。子宮卵管摘除と両側腹腔内精巣摘除を行い、維持療法としてテストステロンと骨盤照射を施行した。停留精巣を伴う仮性半陰陽とセミノーマの稀な合併例である。
pmid-6540000.summary_en: A 50-year-old man with bilateral cryptorchidism and an abdominal mass was found to have persistent müllerian and wolffian duct structures, including a uterus and fallopian tubes. He had a large intra-abdominal seminoma. He underwent hysterosalpingectomy and bilateral intra-abdominal orchidectomy, then received maintenance testosterone and pelvic irradiation. The case describes a rare association of pseudohermaphroditism with seminoma in an intra-abdominal undescended testis.

pmid-6540030.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の3例を報告した。メトトレキサートとアクチノマイシンDに、シクロホスファミドまたはビンブラスチンを併用した化学療法を基本とし、原発巣と転移巣に外科治療を加えた。化学療法不応例に子宮摘出を行い、肺と腎の転移に対してそれぞれ開胸術と腎摘除を行った。高リスクの妊娠性絨毛性疾患では積極的な多剤化学療法を第一選択とすべきと結論している。
pmid-6540030.summary_en: Three patients with metastatic choriocarcinoma are described. Treatment combined methotrexate and actinomycin D with cyclophosphamide or vinblastine, and surgery addressed both primary and metastatic lesions. Hysterectomy was indicated when chemotherapy failed, while thoracotomy and nephrectomy treated pulmonary and renal metastases, and craniotomy controlled brain hemorrhage. The authors conclude that aggressive multidrug chemotherapy should be the primary treatment for high-risk trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6540137.summary_ja: 50歳女性のS状結腸腫瘍は、高分化乳頭状腺癌と絨毛癌の2成分から成った。絨毛癌は既存の大腸癌から化生性増殖により生じた可能性が示唆された。術前血清hCGは著明に高値であった。剖検では肝、肺、リンパ節の転移巣がすべて絨毛癌成分のみから成っていた。
pmid-6540137.summary_en: A 50-year-old woman had a sigmoid colon tumor with two components: well-differentiated papillary adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest the choriocarcinoma arose from the preexisting colon carcinoma through metaplastic change. Preoperative serum hCG was very high. Autopsy showed metastases to liver, lungs and lymph nodes composed exclusively of choriocarcinoma, indicating the metastatic disease was entirely choriocarcinomatous.

pmid-6540240.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の膀胱癌は、未分化癌に加えて明瞭な絨毛癌成分を含んでいた。循環血中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は高値であった。合胞体性腫瘍巨細胞でhCGを組織化学的に証明し、電顕で合胞体栄養膜細胞への分化を認めたことが診断を支持した。膀胱原発の絨毛癌と未分化癌の混合型は稀である。
pmid-6540240.summary_en: A postmenopausal woman developed a bladder carcinoma with a distinct choriocarcinomatous component, accompanied by undifferentiated carcinoma. She had high circulating chorionic gonadotropin titers. The diagnosis was supported by histochemical demonstration of hCG in syncytial tumor giant cells and electron microscopy showing syncytiotrophoblastic differentiation. Such mixed tumors are rare, and the findings support a syncytiotrophoblastic origin of the choriocarcinomatous element.

pmid-6540246.summary_ja: ヒトおよびマウスの胎児性癌(EC)細胞株を、より分化した細胞株と比較し、シスプラチン(CDDP)に対する感受性を検討したin vitro研究である。EC細胞株はCDDPに最も感受性が高く、CDDPは分化マーカーの多くを誘導しなかった。これは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のEC細胞がシスプラチン療法によく反応する理由を説明すると考察されている。
pmid-6540246.summary_en: This in vitro study compared the sensitivity of human and mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines with more differentiated cell lines to cis-platinum (CDDP). EC lines were among the most sensitive to CDDP, and CDDP did not induce several EC differentiation markers regardless of dose. The authors suggest these findings explain why EC cells in non-seminomatous germ cell tumors respond well to cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-6540333.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌の異種移植片(CC3)をヌードラットに移植することに成功した報告である。腫瘍は最長5週間にわたり進行的に増殖したが、その後退縮した。予備的な結果から、退縮はホストの年齢に依存する可能性が示唆された。絨毛癌のin vivoモデルとしての可能性を示す。
pmid-6540333.summary_en: The authors report successful transplantation of a human choriocarcinoma xenograft (CC3) into nude rats. Tumors grew progressively for up to five weeks but then regressed. Preliminary data suggest that tumor regression depends on the age of the host animal. The model may be useful for studying choriocarcinoma biology in vivo, although the findings are preliminary.

pmid-6540755.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌をシリアンハムスターの頬嚢に移植したモデルで、hCGに対する6種類のモノクローナル抗体を放射性免疫画像診断の観点から評価した。抗体061は放射性ヨウ素標識後に最も高い腫瘍対非標的比を示した。対照抗体と比べ腫瘍対筋肉比は高く、5日後には明瞭な腫瘍画像が得られた。hCGを標的とする抗体が絨毛癌の画像診断に有用である可能性を示す。
pmid-6540755.summary_en: Six monoclonal antibodies against human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) were evaluated for radioimmunodetection of a human choriocarcinoma growing in the cheek pouch of Syrian hamsters. Antibody 061 gave the highest tumor-to-nontarget ratios after injection of radioiodinated antibody. Its tumor-to-muscle ratio was about 27.5 versus 2.2 for a control antibody, and sharp tumor images were obtained by five days. The study supports hCG-targeted antibodies for imaging choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6541022.summary_ja: メトトレキサート(MTX)を抗hCG抗体断片を結合したリポソームに封入し、BeWo絨毛癌細胞に対するin vitroでの効果を評価した。抗体結合リポソームは、遊離MTXや非標的リポソーム封入MTXよりも低い50%阻害濃度を示した。短時間曝露でも抗体結合による特異的効果が確認された。絨毛癌に対する抗体標的型リポソーム免疫化学療法の可能性が示唆された。
