Among 746 fully monitored patients, marker positivity (elevated AFP and/or hCG) was 8% in seminoma and 63% in nonseminomatous disease. Marker prevalence increased with stage, and marker-negative patients had a better prognosis. Elevated AFP correlated with a primary endodermal sinus tumor component, and elevated hCG with a choriocarcinoma component.

pmid-6201566.summary_ja: シスプラチン導入療法後の精巣がん検体16例を軟寒天で培養し、7例(44%)でコロニーを形成した。VP-16のin vitro感受性試験で4例中3例の増殖が抑制され、そのうち2例はVP-16を用いた救援療法で奏効した。コロニーのAFPとhCG染色は血清値と一部一致した。
pmid-6201566.summary_en: Sixteen testicular cancer specimens obtained after cisplatin-based induction were cloned in soft agar, and seven (44%) formed colonies across histologic subtypes. In vitro VP-16 exposure reduced colony formation below 50% of controls in three of four tested specimens, and two of those patients responded to a VP-16-based salvage regimen. AFP and hCG immunostaining of colonies partly matched serum levels. One residual retroperitoneal mass with teratoma histology formed AFP-positive colonies, and the patient later developed elevated serum AFP.

pmid-6203379.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の10例に精巣摘除術後、BOM療法(導入)とCOM療法(維持)を行った。全例が1年6か月から5年3か月まで無病生存している。導入のみの4例中2例で再発したが、他のレジメンで完全奏効した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や放射線療法の代替となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-6203379.summary_en: Ten patients with stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors underwent orchiectomy, followed by BOM (bleomycin, vincristine, methotrexate with leucovorin rescue) induction and COM (cyclophosphamide, vincristine, methotrexate) maintenance. All ten remained disease-free for 1.5 to 5.3 years. Relapse occurred in two of four patients who received induction only, and they responded to other regimens. The authors suggest combination chemotherapy may be an alternative to retroperitoneal node dissection and radiation therapy.

pmid-6208545.summary_ja: 新生児の肝奇形腫の症例で、組織学的には三胚葉成分を含む未熟奇形腫が主体であった。悪性組織は認められず、臨床的な転移もなかった。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に上昇していた。小児肝奇形腫の文献レビューも併せて示され、まれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の病像を提示している。
pmid-6208545.summary_en: This pediatric pathology report describes a hepatic teratoma in a newborn, histologically a predominantly immature teratoma containing tissue from all three germ layers. No malignant tissue was identified, and the child showed no clinical metastasis. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. The article also reviews the literature on hepatic teratomas in children, providing context for this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-6222124.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清に含まれる免疫抑制因子を解析した1983年の研究。この因子はサプレッサーT細胞を誘導し、IgGのFc部分に強く結合したことからFcγ受容体様分子と推定された。他のヒト癌細胞株の上清にも類似分子が認められ、腫瘍による免疫抑制との関連が考察されている。
pmid-6222124.summary_en: This 1983 study examined immunosuppressive factors released by choriocarcinoma cell lines. Culture supernatants contained an immunosuppressive factor that induced suppressor T cells, along with a nonspecific lymphocyte proliferation factor. The immunosuppressive factor bound the Fc portion of IgG, suggesting an Fc gamma receptor-like molecule. Similar molecules were found in supernatants of various other human cancer cell lines. The findings are discussed in relation to tumor-induced immunosuppression and trophoblast-derived factors.

pmid-6229588.summary_ja: 4例の患者から得た16個の卵巣類皮嚢腫を染色体および遺伝子マーカーで解析した研究。全例が46,XX型で、13個は第一減数分裂後の胚細胞、3個は第一減数分裂前の胚細胞に由来すると推定された。単一宿主の多発卵巣類皮嚢腫は、異なる胚細胞から多様な機序で生じると結論づけられた。
pmid-6229588.summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined sixteen ovarian dermoid cysts from four patients to clarify the origin of gonadal teratomas. All tumors had a 46,XX karyotype. Thirteen tumors showed homozygous chromosomal heteromorphisms and mostly homozygous gene markers, suggesting origin from a germ cell after the first meiotic division. Three tumors showed heterozygous patterns like the host, suggesting origin before the first meiotic division. Multiple ovarian dermoid cysts in one host thus appear to arise from different germ cells by diverse mechanisms.

pmid-6295621.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者103例を対象に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と術後ダクチノマイシン療法の成績を検討した1983年の研究。病期I例の3年生存率は96%、補助化学療法を受けた病期IIA/IIB例では88%だった。病期IIC例は28.5%にとどまり、単剤補助化学療法の再評価が提言された。
pmid-6295621.summary_en: This 1983 study reviewed 103 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) and postoperative dactinomycin. Stage I patients who underwent RPLND alone had a 96% three-year survival. Among stage IIA/IIB patients receiving adjuvant dactinomycin, survival was 88%, while stage IIC patients had 28.5% survival. The authors suggest that single-agent adjuvant dactinomycin should be reevaluated.

pmid-6296544.summary_ja: 両側の精巣に同時性に発生した原発性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告と文献的考察。385例中9例（2.3%）が両側性原発胚細胞腫瘍で、そのうち1例は両精巣に同時に発生していた。治療は単発例と同様に、組織型と転移の状況に基づいて行うとされる。
pmid-6296544.summary_en: This report describes a case of synchronous bilateral primary germ cell tumors of the testis, which are exceedingly rare. In a series of 385 patients, the authors identified nine with bilateral primary germ cell tumors (2.3%), including one with synchronous involvement of both testes. The most common synchronous testicular tumors are seminomas, followed by embryonal carcinomas, teratocarcinomas, and choriocarcinomas. Treatment follows the same principles as for solitary testicular tumors, based on histology and metastasis.

pmid-6296679.summary_ja: 1958〜1978年に絨毛癌または侵入奇胎で治療された457例の長期生存者を対象に、細胞傷害性化学療法後の二次腫瘍発生を追跡した研究である。大多数がメトトレキサートを投与され、57%は他の抗がん剤も併用された。平均7.8年、総計3522患者年の観察で二次腫瘍は白血病と乳癌の2例のみで、期待値3.5例を下回った。中期的に発癌性はないと結論している。
pmid-6296679.summary_en: This 1983 NEJM study followed 457 long-term survivors treated for choriocarcinoma or invasive mole between 1958 and 1978 to assess second tumor risk after cytotoxic chemotherapy. Most patients received methotrexate, and 57% also received other cytotoxic agents such as dactinomycin, vincristine and cyclophosphamide. Over a mean of 7.8 years and 3522 patient-years, only two second neoplasms developed (one acute leukemia, one breast carcinoma), fewer than the 3.5 expected. The authors concluded that methotrexate-based chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma does not appear carcinogenic in the medium term.

pmid-6296681.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞におけるレトロウイルス感染とプロウイルスのメチル化を調べた基礎研究。EC細胞ではプロウイルスがde novoにメチル化されるが、分化した奇形癌細胞ではメチル化されない。メチル化は遺伝子発現抑制の維持に役立つが、初期胚では追加の機構が働くと示唆される。
pmid-6296681.summary_en: This 1983 Nature study examined retrovirus infection in mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. Input proviruses were blocked at transcription and became de novo methylated in EC cells but not in differentiated teratocarcinoma cells. The kinetics of this methylation suggested that, although DNA methylation likely maintains gene silencing, the early embryo uses additional mechanisms to initiate negative gene regulation. The work is basic epigenetic research on EC cells as a model of early developmental gene control rather than clinical GCT.

pmid-6297938.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞(F9、PC-13)の増殖と増殖因子への応答を調べた基礎研究。分化誘導後の細胞はMSV形質転換細胞由来因子に応答して増殖が増えたが、未分化の親細胞は応答しなかった。両細胞株とも形質転換増殖因子様活性を持つ因子を分泌しており、初期発生における役割が示唆された。
pmid-6297938.summary_en: This 1983 Experimental Cell Research study examined growth responses of mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells to transforming growth factors. Differentiated derivatives of F9 and PC-13 EC cells grew more in response to factors released by MSV-transformed cells, while the parental EC cells did not respond. Both EC lines released factors with transforming growth factor activity, whose chemical properties matched those of the MSV-derived factors. The authors suggest these molecules may act during early mammalian development, reflecting the link between EC cells and early embryonic cells.

pmid-6298475.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍60例(性腺外2例を含む)に対し、化学療法後に残存病変の切除または完全奏効の確認手術を行った研究。残存病変は瘢痕42%、奇形腫23%、活動性腫瘍28%であった。偽陰性率は3%。活動性腫瘍を有した17例中9例は救援化学療法に反応し、安定した完全寛解が得られた。化学療法不応例の減量手術は全例が死亡しており、その有用性は限定的であった。
pmid-6298475.summary_en: This 1983 Journal of Urology study evaluated surgery after curative chemotherapy in 60 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors, including 2 with extragonadal tumors. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and thoracotomy were performed to remove residual masses or confirm response. Residual findings included scarring (42%), teratoma (23%) and active tumor (28%). The false-negative rate was 3%, and 9 of 17 patients with active tumor responded to salvage chemotherapy. All 10 patients who underwent debulking after chemotherapy failure died.

pmid-6299504.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍208例を解析し、胎児性癌51例、セミノーマ115例、混合型42例に分類した研究。平均年齢は胎児性癌27.6歳、セミノーマ38.3歳であった。胎児性癌優位の混合型は、セミノーマ優位の混合型より若年であった。若年では胎児性癌、高齢ではセミノーマが生じやすく、中間年齢では両者の混合が生じると論じている。
pmid-6299504.summary_en: This 1983 Cancer study analyzed 208 testicular germ cell tumors, comprising 51 pure embryonal carcinomas, 115 pure seminomas and 42 mixed tumors. Mean ages were 27.6 years for embryonal carcinoma, 38.3 years for seminoma and 30.3 years for combined tumors. Mixed tumors with embryonal carcinoma predominance occurred at younger ages than those with seminoma predominance. The authors propose that germ cells give rise to embryonal carcinoma in younger patients and seminoma in older patients, with intermediate ages producing mixtures of both.

pmid-6299821.summary_ja: 変異誘発によりマウス胎児性癌細胞株3種から分化欠損型の変異サブライン8株を作製した研究。レチノイン酸とHMBAへの応答性から3群に分類された。レチノイン酸結合蛋白を欠くため分化できない群、結合蛋白を保持するが分化が不十分な群、HMBAに抵抗性を示しつつレチノイン酸には応答する群がある。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学モデルとしての基礎研究である。
pmid-6299821.summary_en: This 1983 Developmental Biology study generated eight differentiation-defective sublines from three murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines by mutagenesis. Based on responses to retinoic acid and hexamethylenebisacetamide, the mutants fell into three groups: cells lacking cellular retinoic acid binding protein that failed to differentiate, cells retaining the binding protein but differentiating poorly, and cells that resisted HMBA but still responded to retinoic acid. The work is basic research into EC differentiation mechanisms, using EC cells as a model of germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6300738.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の現代的管理を総説した論文。胞状奇胎は米国で約2000妊娠に1例とされ、治療後8週で約半数がhCGを検出できる。侵入奇胎や絨毛癌に進展する例もある。リスク分類、β-hCGの定期的測定、メトトレキサートを含む多剤化学療法の重要性を論じている。高リスク例の完全寛解率は約90%とされる。
pmid-6300738.summary_en: This 1983 review outlines modern management of gestational trophoblastic disease. Hydatidiform mole occurs in about 1 in 2000 US pregnancies, and about half of patients retain detectable hCG at 8 weeks after evacuation, with some developing invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize risk stratification, serial beta-hCG monitoring, and multiagent chemotherapy such as methotrexate-based regimens, with radiation for brain or liver metastases. High-risk patients achieved about 90% complete remission, and the review credits the 25 years of methotrexate experience for these results.

pmid-6301713.summary_ja: 1983年の研究で、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清に、マウス奇形癌細胞株F9と反応する抗体が検出された。この抗体は、F9抗原の構成成分である大型糖ペプチドに結合した。胎児性癌細胞の分化を誘導するレチノイン酸処理により、抗体の反応性と糖ペプチド合成は低下し、これらが胚性細胞の分化関連抗原であることが示唆された。
pmid-6301713.summary_en: This 1983 study detected antibodies in sera from patients with ovarian germ cell tumours that reacted with murine teratocarcinoma F9 cells. Immunochemical analysis showed these antibodies bind large glycopeptides that are components of F9 antigens. Retinoic acid, which induces differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells, reduced both antibody staining and glycopeptide biosynthesis, indicating the glycopeptides are differentiation-associated antigens on embryonic cells.

pmid-6302532.summary_ja: 本研究はリビアのベンガジとポーランドの卵巣腫瘍登録データを比較し、組織型の分布を検討した。ベンガジでは胚細胞腫瘍が最も多く（50%）、上皮性腫瘍（33.3%）を上回った。これは欧米の若年者にみられる分布に類似する。この差は、リビア女性の出生率が高いことによると考えられた。
pmid-6302532.summary_en: This comparative study examined histologic types of ovarian tumors in 108 cases from Benghazi, Libya and 2,238 cases from a Polish registry, classified by WHO criteria. In Benghazi, germ cell tumors were the most common type (50%), exceeding epithelial tumors (33.3%), a pattern resembling adolescent ovarian tumors in Europe and the USA. The authors attribute the difference from Poland to higher fertility among Libyan women.

pmid-6303723.summary_ja: 本総説はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を胎児抗原のモデルとして概説し、妊娠性または胚細胞起源の絨毛癌に対する理想に近い腫瘍マーカーであることを強調している。診断、予後判定、経過観察における有用性や、高リスク集団でのスクリーニングへの応用を述べる。抗hCG抗体を用いた放射免疫局在診断や、免疫療法の標的としての可能性にも言及する。
pmid-6303723.summary_en: This review presents hCG as a model fetal antigen, emphasizing its role as a secreted antigen and near-ideal tumor marker for choriocarcinoma of gestational or germ cell origin. It notes hCG's value in diagnosis, prognosis and monitoring, and its use as a biochemical screening test in high-risk populations. The paper also discusses radioimmunolocalization with labelled anti-hCG antibodies, liposome-based approaches, and hCG as a target for antibody-based immunization in fertility control and oncology.

pmid-6305246.summary_ja: 1983年の症例報告で、原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の3例に血小板減少症が認められた。全例が縦隔前上部腫瘤を伴う胎児性癌であった。血小板減少は重度かつ持続的で、骨髄では巨核球が増加していた。免疫学的破壊や腫瘍による捕捉は否定され、プレドニゾンや脾摘出でも改善しなかった。化学療法は困難で、予後不良因子となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6305246.summary_en: This 1983 case series reports thrombocytopenia in three patients with primary extragonadal germ cell cancer, all with embryonal cell cancer and anterior superior mediastinal masses. Thrombocytopenia was severe and persistent, with increased bone marrow megakaryocytes. Immune destruction and tumor sequestration were absent, and prednisone and splenectomy failed to raise platelet counts. Chemotherapy was difficult. The authors suggest thrombocytopenia may be an adverse prognostic feature.

pmid-6305481.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者53例で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とそのサブユニットを検討した。hCG上昇は60%、hCG-β上昇は23%、hCG-α上昇は15%に認められた。コンカナバリンA非反応性の割合は妊婦より高く、糖鎖構造の不均一性が示された。腫瘍から放出されたhCGは、化学療法中の臨床的評価に有用である可能性がある。
pmid-6305481.summary_en: This study examined hCG and its subunits in 53 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Elevated hCG was found in 60%, hCG-beta in 23%, and hCG-alpha in 15%, with no isolated subunit elevation without the intact hormone. Lectin affinity chromatography showed greater concanavalin A nonreactive hCG and hCG-alpha in cancer patients than in pregnant women, indicating structural heterogeneity. Tumor-released hCG may be clinically useful during chemotherapy.

pmid-6307907.summary_ja: 正常卵巣および卵巣の上皮性、性索間質性、胚細胞腫瘍について中間径フィラメントの発現を免疫組織学的に検討した。分化した奇形腫は対応する組織系統のフィラメントを発現し、類皮嚢腫では上皮成分がプレケラチン、間葉成分がビメンチンを示した。フィラメント発現は親組織を反映し、卵巣腫瘍の鑑別診断に有用であることが示唆された。
pmid-6307907.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of intermediate filament expression in normal ovaries and ovarian tumors. Surface epithelial tumors expressed prekeratin, while sex cord-stromal and germinal tumors expressed only vimentin. Differentiated teratomas expressed filaments matching their tissue components, and dermoid cysts showed prekeratin in epithelial and vimentin in mesenchymal elements. The authors conclude that intermediate filament profiles reflect parental tissue and can aid differential diagnosis of ovarian tumors of different histogenesis.

pmid-6308713.summary_ja: 精巣女性化症候群の16歳患者に生じた古典的セミノーマを報告した。本症候群では性腺の悪性変化の頻度が高いとされる。思春期直後の開腹探索と性腺摘出が推奨されている。性腺が腫瘍化する危険性が高いため、手術時期の判断が管理上重要であることが示されている。
pmid-6308713.summary_en: Reports a classical seminoma arising in a 16-year-old with testicular feminization syndrome. The authors note a high incidence of malignant gonadal degeneration in this syndrome. They recommend exploration and gonadectomy immediately after puberty. Gonads in androgen insensitivity carry a substantial risk of neoplastic transformation, making timing of surgery a key management decision.

pmid-6309385.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の5例で血清プロラクチン、ゴナドトロピン、アンドロゲン、エストロゲン、ゲスタゲンを測定した。これらのホルモンは組織ポリペプチド抗原、CEA、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、フェリチンとともに腫瘍マーカーとして有用である可能性が示された。値はしばしば上昇したが、一定のパターンや病勢との関連は認められなかった。
pmid-6309385.summary_en: Measured serum prolactin, gonadotropins, androgens, estrogens, and gestagens in five patients with malignant testicular germ cell tumor. Several hormones appeared to function as tumor markers alongside tissue polypeptide antigen, CEA, AFP, and ferritin. Levels were often elevated, but no constant pattern or relation to disease severity was observed. The authors call for confirmation in larger cohorts to clarify pathogenesis.

pmid-6310868.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の2株（HCCM-5、BeWo）でヒトインターフェロンへの応答を解析した。両株はVSV増殖と細胞増殖の抑制に抵抗性を示したが、EMCVに対しては正常な抗ウイルス活性を示した。IFNは両株で2-5A系の構成要素を誘導し、BeWo細胞では2-5Aが検出された。絨毛癌細胞のインターフェロン応答が本研究の主題である。
pmid-6310868.summary_en: Two human choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines, HCCM-5 and BeWo, were examined for responses to human interferon. Both resisted interferon's inhibition of vesicular stomatitis virus replication and cell growth, yet showed normal antiviral activity against encephalomyocarditis virus. Interferon induced 2-5A system components in both lines, and 2-5A was detected in BeWo cells. The study characterizes the interferon responsiveness of choriocarcinoma cells as its main subject.

pmid-6311234.summary_ja: 1962〜78年に英国で登録された小児悪性卵巣腫瘍の84%は胚細胞腫瘍で、ディスジャーミノーマが最多だった。低年齢では未熟奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍など悪性度の高い組織型が多かった。多剤化学療法の導入により、ディスジャーミノーマ以外の胚細胞腫瘍の予後は大きく改善した。家族内集積から遺伝的要因も示唆された。
pmid-6311234.summary_en: This British registry review of childhood malignant ovarian tumours from 1962 to 1978 found that 84% were germ cell tumours, led by dysgerminomas. Younger children more often had more aggressive histology such as immature teratomas and endodermal sinus tumours. Ten-year survival varied by histology, and polychemotherapy markedly improved outcomes for non-dysgerminoma germ cell tumours. Familial clustering suggested a possible genetic component.

pmid-6312918.summary_ja: 体外培養したヒト奇形癌に、レトロウイルス様粒子が高頻度で認められることを示した。この粒子は内在性逆転写酵素活性を持ち、ショ糖密度勾配で1.16 g/mlに分画され、動物レトロウイルス株と免疫学的に区別できる。ヒトT細胞白血病ウイルス（HTLV）についても概説している。ヒト奇形癌が本総説の中心的な対象である。
pmid-6312918.summary_en: Electron microscopy and biochemical analysis showed retrovirus-like particles regularly present in human teratocarcinomas cultured in vitro. The particles have endogenous reverse transcriptase activity, band at 1.16 g/ml in sucrose, and are immunologically distinct from animal retrovirus strains. The overview also summarizes HTLV, the human T-cell lymphoma viruses linked to adult T-cell leukemia. Human teratocarcinoma is a central subject of this review.

pmid-6313179.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学染色により、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌などでリラキシンを検討した。リラキシンは正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜に加え、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌でも初めて確認された。非栄養膜性の悪性腫瘍では検出されなかった。栄養膜性腫瘍によるリラキシン産生が示唆されるが、他部位からの取り込みの可能性も残る。
pmid-6313179.summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining examined relaxin across normal placenta, hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, endometrium, and several gynecologic carcinomas. Relaxin was found in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta and, for the first time, in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. No relaxin appeared in any nontrophoblastic cancer, including secretory endometrial adenocarcinoma. The authors suggest trophoblastic tumors may synthesize relaxin, though uptake from elsewhere cannot be excluded.

pmid-6313492.summary_ja: 膣転移からの出血を主訴とした妊娠性絨毛性疾患の6例を報告した。臨床像、治療経過、治療への反応を記述している。膣転移は予後不良因子であり、認められた場合は多剤併用の細胞傷害性化学療法を行うべきだと提唱している。本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患のみを対象とした小規模症例報告である。
pmid-6313492.summary_en: Six patients with gestational trophoblastic disease presented with hemorrhage from vaginal metastases. The authors describe clinical features, management, and treatment response. They conclude that vaginal metastasis is a poor prognostic factor and recommend multiagent cytotoxic chemotherapy when it is present. The report is a small case series focused entirely on this disease.

pmid-6314925.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の多発転移により死亡した30歳男性の症例報告。右精巣と精巣上体は主に小型細胞からなる腫瘤に置換されていた。髄管様構造、上衣ロゼット、GFAP陽性のグリア分化を示し、軟骨など奇形腫成分も認められた。精巣原発の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の初めての報告とされる。
pmid-6314925.summary_en: Case report of a 30-year-old man who died of a testicular tumor with widespread metastases. The right testis and epididymis were replaced by a mass composed mainly of small cells. Focal medullary tubules, ependymal rosettes and glial differentiation confirmed by GFAP staining were present, along with cartilage and cellular mesenchyme that established a teratomatous nature. The authors state this is the first reported primitive neuroectodermal tumor of the testis, an unusual histologic variant of testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-6316287.summary_ja: 放射性クロス免疫電気泳動法により、胚細胞腫瘍127例、大腸癌90例、健常者20例の血清β2ミクログロブリンを解析した。がん患者の大半は治療前から異常パターンを示し、健常者では見られなかった。不均一性は両疾患で病期と相関し、一部は予後とも相関した。臨床的意義は不明で、蛋白分解酵素や腫瘍抗原との複合体形成などが想定された。
pmid-6316287.summary_en: Using a sensitive radiocrossed immunoelectrophoresis method, the authors analysed beta-2-microglobulin heterogeneity in sera from 127 patients with germ cell tumors, 90 with colorectal cancer, and 20 healthy controls. Most cancer patients showed abnormal patterns before treatment, while controls did not. Heterogeneity correlated with disease stage in both cancers and somewhat with outcome. Its clinical meaning remained unclear, and possible mechanisms included proteolysis and tumor antigen complex formation.

pmid-6316482.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に残存腫瘍を有した24例に二次手術を行った。完全切除20例のうち18例が無病生存を保った。不完全切除となった胎児性癌の2例は死亡した。腫瘍マーカーが上昇していない場合に、化学療法後の残存腫瘍に対して二次手術を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-6316482.summary_en: Twenty-four patients with residual tumor after intensive chemotherapy for advanced testicular germ cell tumors underwent secondary surgery. Twenty had complete resection, and 18 of them remained disease-free. Among the four incompletely resected patients, two with embryonal carcinoma died despite further treatment. The authors recommend secondary surgery for residual tumor after chemotherapy when tumor markers are not elevated.

pmid-6316483.summary_ja: 病期I・IIの精巣胚細胞腫瘍73例で血清テストステロン、LH、FSHを治療前後に測定した。テストステロンは治療前後で差がなかった。放射線療法と化学療法の併用後はLHが治療終了後も高値のままだった一方、放射線療法単独群では治療前後で同等だった。FSHは治療前から高値で、治療中にさらに上昇した。
pmid-6316483.summary_en: Serum testosterone, LH and FSH were measured in 73 patients with stage I and II germ cell testicular cancer. Samples were taken after unilateral orchiectomy, before radiotherapy or chemotherapy, and again 1 to 3 years after therapy. Testosterone did not change. LH stayed elevated after combined irradiation and chemotherapy but not after radiotherapy alone. FSH was already raised before treatment and rose further during therapy.

pmid-6317135.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍84例を、精巣摘除術後にリンパ節照射や郭清を行わず厳密なフォローアップで管理した。16例（19%）が再発して化学療法を受け、全例が生存している。未分化型悪性奇形腫では再発率が中間型より高く、血管浸潤を伴うとリスクが高まると示唆された。
pmid-6317135.summary_en: Eighty-four patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors underwent orchiectomy followed by close follow-up without node irradiation or dissection. Sixteen (19%) relapsed and received chemotherapy, and all patients are alive. Relapse rates were much higher for undifferentiated malignant teratoma primaries (40.7%) than intermediate ones (6.8%), and vascular invasion appeared to add risk. Pre-orchiectomy serum markers were not prognostic.

pmid-6317265.summary_ja: 精巣上体精巣炎と診断され抗菌薬で一時改善した男性2例で、2か月後の再検査時に精巣のコールドスポットを認めた。両例とも精巣摘除術を受け、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と奇形癌が判明した。経過中のコールドスポットは早期精巣腫瘍の指標となりうると示唆された。
pmid-6317265.summary_en: Two men first treated for presumed epididymo-orchitis had abnormal Tc-99m pertechnetate scrotal images. After antibiotics and a two-month interval, persistent testicular enlargement prompted repeat scans showing a cold spot. Both underwent orchiectomy. One had malignant mixed germ cell tumor and the other teratocarcinoma. The authors suggest that cold spots on follow-up scans may flag early testicular tumor.

pmid-6317395.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の進行転移例55例を対象とした1983年の報告。化学療法を先行し残存病変を後に切除した群では、切除標本で壊死・線維化や成熟奇形腫を示した患者の多くが生存した一方、高悪性度の残存腫瘍を認めた患者の多くは死亡した。先行する外科的減量術の成績は不良であった。遠隔転移例では導入化学療法後の遅延切除が推奨され、転移のない後腹膜bulky病変の治療順序は前向き無作為化試験による検討が必要とされた。
pmid-6317395.summary_en: This 1983 European Urology study reviews 55 patients with advanced metastatic testicular germ cell tumor, comparing chemotherapy followed by delayed resection with primary surgical debulking. Patients who received chemotherapy first and showed necrosis, fibrosis, or mature teratoma on resection mostly remained alive and tumor-free, whereas many with highly malignant residual tumor died. Primary debulking had poor outcomes. The authors recommend induction chemotherapy with delayed resection for distant metastatic disease and call for a randomized trial for retroperitoneal bulky disease without distant metastases.

pmid-6318674.summary_ja: 1983年の研究で、胎盤タンパク質12(PP12)の放射免疫測定法を確立し、正常妊娠および絨毛性腫瘍31例で血清値を測定した。PP12は胞状奇胎および侵入奇胎で著明に高値を示し、奇胎除去後に正常化した。絨毛癌では中等度の上昇を認めた。フォローアップにおける有用性は、hCGやSP1に比べて低いと結論づけられている。
pmid-6318674.summary_en: A 1983 Archives of Gynecology study developed a radioimmunoassay for placental protein 12 (PP12) and measured serum levels in normal pregnancy and in 31 patients with trophoblastic tumours. PP12 was markedly elevated in hydatidiform and invasive moles, fell to normal after mole evacuation, and was moderately raised in choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that PP12 is less useful than hCG and SP1 for monitoring trophoblastic tumours during follow-up.

pmid-6321675.summary_ja: 1983年の研究で、ビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン療法に抵抗性の進行胚細胞腫瘍18例に対し、エトポシドを含むレジメンを投与した。原発性性腺腫瘍12例中5例が完全寛解して無病生存した一方、性腺外腫瘍6例では完全奏効は得られなかった。治療関連死はなかった。性腺腫瘍にはエトポシド含有化学療法が有用であり、性腺外例には代替療法が必要とされた。
pmid-6321675.summary_en: A 1983 Journal of Clinical Oncology study of 18 patients with germ cell cancer refractory to vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin, treated with etoposide-based regimens. Five of 12 patients with primary gonadal tumors achieved complete remission and remained alive without disease, while none of the six extragonadal patients had a complete response. Toxicities included nausea, vomiting, alopecia, and myelosuppression, with no treatment-related deaths. The authors conclude that etoposide-containing chemotherapy is useful for gonadal disease and that alternative therapies are needed for extragonadal tumors.

pmid-6324736.summary_ja: 1972〜1980年に入院した持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍138例の報告。肺転移40例は全例化学療法を受け、35例が生化学的寛解に至った。胸部陰影が遷延した5例は再発リスクが高いとされた。開胸術の治療上・予後予測上の有用性は疑わしいと結論され、hCGを用いた密な長期フォローアップが推奨された。
pmid-6324736.summary_en: A 1983 Australian and New Zealand Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology report on 138 women with persistent gestational trophoblastic tumours admitted between 1972 and 1980, including 40 with pulmonary metastases treated with chemotherapy. Thirty-five reached biochemical remission, and five had persistent chest shadows. Thoracotomy was judged of doubtful value for therapy or prognosis. Patients with persistent shadows had an elevated relapse risk, and close long-term hCG-based follow-up was recommended.

pmid-6337856.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス奇形癌（129/J腹水腫瘍）が多細胞の胚様体から単一細胞型へ自然変換する過程を調べたものです。変換後の腹水中ではプロテアーゼ活性が上昇し、pH至適性と阻害剤感受性からカテプシンDと推定されました。ペプスタチンAを結合させたビーズは単一細胞の細胞間接着を増強し、単一細胞型腫瘍の腹水は胚様培養細胞の塊を分散させ、その作用はペプスタチンAで抑制されました。
pmid-6337856.summary_en: This 1983 study examines a mouse teratocarcinoma (129/J ascites) that spontaneously converts from multicellular embryoid bodies to a rapidly growing single-cell form. The authors found increased ascites protease activity after conversion, tentatively identified as cathepsin D based on pH optimum and inhibitor sensitivity. Pepstatin A-derivatized beads increased single-cell adhesion, and ascites fluid from the single-cell tumor disaggregated embryoid-like cultures, an effect blocked by pepstatin A. The findings suggest a protease contributes to transforming a clustered tumor into a non-adhesive, rapidly growing form.

pmid-6343221.summary_ja: 本論文は小児の性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍を概説したものです。臨床、病理、予後の特徴が多様であるため、一般化は困難とされています。診断時年齢、発生部位、組織像を考慮して症例ごとに評価すべきと述べています。奇形腫形成に関する実験モデルと細胞遺伝学的研究が、分化と腫瘍形成の理解に貢献してきたことも示されています。
pmid-6343221.summary_en: This review considers gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumors in children. The authors argue that these tumors vary widely in clinical, pathologic and prognostic features, so generalizing about their behavior is difficult. Cases should be assessed individually, considering the patient's age at diagnosis, anatomic site and histologic appearance. Experimental models and cytogenetic studies of teratomatous development have improved understanding of differentiation and tumorigenesis in these tumors.

pmid-6343402.summary_ja: 本研究は、レチノイン酸存在下で凝集させたF9胎児性癌細胞を用い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を分泌する臓側内胚葉様の上皮層形成をモデル化したものです。形態学的に3段階を記載し、SSEA-1、血液型抗原、ラミニン、フィブロネクチン、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)などのマーカーを経時的に追跡しています。上皮形成は培養3〜4日目に始まり、AFP分泌速度が7〜8日目の適切な配列と成熟を示すと報告されています。
pmid-6343402.summary_en: The authors use F9 embryonal carcinoma cells aggregated in retinoic acid to model epithelial layer formation, which yields a visceral endoderm layer that secretes alpha-fetoprotein. They describe three morphological phases and track markers including SSEA-1, blood group antigens, laminin, fibronectin, type IV collagen, intermediate filaments and AFP. Epithelium formation begins around days 3 to 4, and the AFP secretion rate indicates proper alignment and maturity by days 7 or 8. The model may help explain similar epithelial processes during embryogenesis.

pmid-6344553.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本189例を対象に、免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法でフェリチン(FER)を検討した研究です。フェリチンはセミノーマの93%、非セミノーマの90%で検出されました。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫の上皮成分も陽性でした。隣接する精細管の上皮内癌(CIS)は、腫瘍の組織型にかかわらず94%の標本で陽性となり、CISがセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の双方と機能的な関係をもつことが示唆されています。
pmid-6344553.summary_en: The authors examined ferritin expression by immunoperoxidase staining in 189 orchidectomy specimens with germ cell tumors. Ferritin was present in 93% of seminomas and 90% of non-seminomas. Epithelial components of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor and teratoma were positive. Carcinoma in situ in adjacent seminiferous tubules stained positive in 94% of specimens regardless of tumor histology, suggesting a functional relationship between CIS and both seminomatous and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-6345230.summary_ja: 羊水過多を呈した胎児の極めてまれな頸部悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。成熟成分と未熟成分を含み、未熟な胎児の肺に転移病変を認めた。出生前の超音波検査所見を記載し、胎児頸部腫瘤の鑑別診断を文献的に考察している。
pmid-6345230.summary_en: A case report of an extremely rare malignant cervical teratoma in a fetus presenting with polyhydramnios. The tumor contained mature and immature components, with metastatic lesions in the lungs of the immature fetus. The authors describe the prenatal ultrasound findings and discuss the differential diagnosis of fetal neck masses, reviewing the relevant literature.

pmid-6347924.summary_ja: 高血圧と5か月続くうっ血性心不全を呈した45歳女性で、左卵管間膜の絨毛癌と診断された。子宮と付属器の摘出直後に大量の肺腫瘍塞栓が生じたと推測される。免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡による微細構造で腫瘍を検討した。心疾患様の症状で発症した絨毛癌の症例である。
pmid-6347924.summary_en: A 45-year-old woman with hypertension and five months of congestive heart failure was found to have a choriocarcinoma of the left mesosalpinx. The probable terminal event was a massive pulmonary tumor embolus shortly after removal of the uterus and adnexae. The tumor was characterized by immunohistochemistry and ultrastructural examination, with illustrated findings. The case shows that extragonadal choriocarcinoma can mimic cardiac disease.

pmid-6348878.summary_ja: 小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍を扱う総説で、胚細胞腫瘍が最も多く、ディスジャーミノーマを除き極めて悪性度が高いとしている。外科的切除後の化学療法と放射線療法の併用で治療成績が向上したと述べ、治療開始時の正確な病期分類の重要性を強調する。
pmid-6348878.summary_en: This review addresses malignant ovarian tumors in childhood, noting that germ cell tumors are the most common and highly malignant, except dysgerminomas. It describes improved outcomes with combined chemotherapy and radiotherapy after surgical resection, and emphasizes exact staging at the start of therapy. The authors recommend a second-look operation after emergency surgery, treatment at pediatric oncology centers, and long-term medical and psychological care.

pmid-6348881.summary_ja: 小児の甲状腺疾患と腫瘍の外科的側面を扱う総説で、奇形腫は絶対的手術適応の一つとされる。正中または外側の頸部奇形腫は診断目的で直ちに手術すべきとしている。小児の甲状腺癌の多くは分化型で治癒率が高い。甲状腺機能亢進症に対する全摘と亜全摘の比較も議論している。
pmid-6348881.summary_en: This pediatric surgery review covers thyroid diseases and tumors, including teratomas, carcinomas, ectopia, and hyperthyroidism. Teratomas and carcinomas are absolute surgical indications, and midline or lateral cervical teratomas require immediate operation for diagnosis. Childhood thyroid carcinoma is mostly differentiated, with high cure rates. The authors discuss total versus subtotal thyroidectomy in hyperthyroidism and note that ectopic thyroid tissue need not be removed surgically.

pmid-6351997.summary_ja: 82歳男性の膀胱原発絨毛癌の症例で、膀胱生検では低分化尿路上皮癌と上皮内癌を認めた。絨毛癌の診断は剖検で確定し、免疫組織化学でhCGの発現を確認した。文献を概観し、この希少腫瘍が上皮由来である可能性を考察している。
pmid-6351997.summary_en: The seventh reported case of primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder is presented, in an 82-year-old man whose initial bladder biopsies showed poorly differentiated urothelial carcinoma and carcinoma in situ. The choriocarcinoma diagnosis was established at autopsy and confirmed by chorionic gonadotropin demonstration using immunoperoxidase staining. The literature is reviewed, and a possible epithelial origin of this rare tumor is discussed.

pmid-6353852.summary_ja: 29歳女性の肝原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の剖検例。初回手術で右前区域に認められた腫瘍は、剖検時には肝のほぼ全体を置換し、腹膜や皮下組織へ進展していた。卵巣など他臓器に腫瘍はなく、肝原発と判断された。免疫染色で腫瘍細胞の細胞質にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の陽性所見が認められ、電顕では基底膜に近接した電子密度の高い物質が確認された。
pmid-6353852.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 29-year-old woman with primary yolk sac tumor of the liver. The tumor first appeared in the right anterior liver segment and at autopsy had nearly replaced the liver, extending to the peritoneum and subcutaneous tissue. No tumor was found in the ovaries, gut, stomach, lung, uterus, or kidneys, supporting a hepatic origin. Histology showed typical yolk sac tumor features. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated cytoplasmic AFP, and electron microscopy showed electron-dense material associated with basement membranes.

pmid-6359796.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の後に肺転移を生じた絨毛癌の症例を報告する細胞診の論文。針吸引生検の標本で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色により栄養膜細胞を確定診断できた。これにより治療前の開胸診断が不要となった。固定・パパニコロウ染色済みの標本にも応用できる染色法を記述し、針生検への他の応用も議論している。
pmid-6359796.summary_en: This cytology report describes a patient with pulmonary metastatic choriocarcinoma following a hydatidiform mole. Trophoblastic cells on a needle aspiration biopsy were definitively identified by an immunoperoxidase stain for human chorionic gonadotropin. This allowed diagnosis without thoracotomy before therapy. The authors also describe an immunoperoxidase method for previously fixed, Papanicolaou-stained needle aspiration specimens and discuss other applications of the technique on needle biopsies.

pmid-6361252.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎を古典型と部分型に分け、発生機序、核型、組織像、悪性化の可能性を整理した総説。古典型は雄性発生由来で多くが46XXまたは46XYであり、母性染色体を含まない。部分型は多くが三倍体で母性染色体を含み、二精子受精由来と考えられている。治療を要する割合は部分型で約2.1%、古典型で約10%と報告されているが、部分型の悪性化の可能性は議論が続いている。
pmid-6361252.summary_en: This review revisits the classification and biology of hydatidiform moles, which divide into classic and partial types. Classic moles arise from androgenetic fertilization, are usually 46XX or 46XY, and contain no maternal chromosomes. Partial moles are typically triploid and retain a maternal chromosomal contribution, often arising from dispermic fertilization. The authors note that about 2.1% of partial moles and 10% of classic moles require treatment, although the malignant potential of partial moles remains debated.

pmid-6402379.summary_ja: 培養絨毛癌細胞を用い、腫瘍プロモーターがホルモン分泌に与える影響を検討した基礎研究。ホルボールエステルとテレオシジンBはいずれもhCG分泌とプロゲステロン産生を促進した。上皮成長因子(EGF)もこれらのホルモン産生を刺激した。両プロモーターは細胞へのEGF結合には顕著な影響を与えなかった。絨毛癌細胞のホルモン調節機構を示す研究である。
pmid-6402379.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how tumor promoters affect hormone secretion by cultured choriocarcinoma cells. Both 12-O-tetradecanoylphorbol-13-acetate and teleocidin B increased hCG secretion and progesterone production. Epidermal growth factor also stimulated these hormones. The two promoters had no marked effect on cellular binding of epidermal growth factor. The findings describe hormonal regulation in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6407599.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の男性86例で、片側の精巣摘除術の直前またはその直後に採取した精液を分析した1983年の研究。平均精子数は対照群より有意に少なく、32例では約2000万/回と著明に低下していた。原因として腫瘍自体、治療、あるいは悪性転化以前の素因が考えられたが、確定はされていない。
pmid-6407599.summary_en: Semen from 86 men with testicular germ cell tumors was analyzed before or soon after unilateral orchiectomy. Mean sperm count was 65.6 million per ejaculate, significantly lower than the control mean of 165.2 million. A subgroup of 32 patients had counts around 20 million, while the others resembled controls. The authors could not determine whether the abnormality arose from the tumor, its treatment, or preceded malignant transformation, possibly acting as an inducing or promoting factor. The study highlights reduced exocrine testicular function in patients with germ cell tumors at diagnosis.

pmid-6408780.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍19例を対象に、根治的精巣摘除術の前に合成GRFに対するLH・FSH応答を検討した1983年の研究。β-hCG陽性例ではエストラジオールが上昇し、基礎FSHと応答は低下していた。β-hCG陰性例では逆に高ゴナドトロピン状態と過剰な応答が見られた。腫瘍によるβ-hCG産生が下垂体・性腺系に影響することが示唆された。
pmid-6408780.summary_en: Nineteen men with malignant germ cell tumors of the testis were studied before radical orchiectomy to examine LH and FSH responses to synthetic GRF. Patients with detectable beta-hCG had increased estradiol, decreased baseline FSH, and reduced GRF-stimulated responses, suggesting hyperestrogenism and inhibited pituitary gonadotropin release. Patients without detectable beta-hCG had normal estradiol and testosterone, but elevated baseline LH and FSH with exaggerated GRF responses. The authors conclude that hypergonadotropic pituitary-gonadal dysfunction occurs in germ cell testicular cancer.

pmid-6409494.summary_ja: 1960年から1978年に標準法で放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ547例の成績を報告した研究。病期の早い448例では5年生存率が94%で、治療時期が新しいほど生存は改善していた。進行例では、IIB期62%、III期51%、IV期13%と生存率は低かった。
pmid-6409494.summary_en: This study reviews radiotherapy outcomes in 547 patients with histologically proven testicular seminoma treated between 1960 and 1978 using a standard method. Among 448 patients with early disease, five-year life-table survival was 94%, and survival improved in later treatment periods. Survival in advanced disease was lower: 62% in stage IIB, 51% in stage III, and 13% in stage IV at five years. The authors discuss the radiotherapeutic management of this tumor.

pmid-6411082.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞において、酵素活性化型阻害剤α-ジフルオロメチルオルニチンによりオルニチン脱炭酸酵素を阻害すると分化が誘導された。分化細胞は形態、生化学的性質、細胞表面抗原の変化により未分化細胞と区別された。細胞内ポリアミン量の変化が分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6411082.summary_en: Murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were induced to differentiate in vitro by inhibiting ornithine decarboxylase with the enzyme-activated inhibitor alpha-difluoromethylornithine. Differentiated cells were distinguished from undifferentiated EC cells by morphology, biochemical properties, and cell surface antigens. The findings suggest that changes in cellular polyamine levels may contribute to EC cell differentiation. This basic research uses a murine EC model relevant to germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6413272.summary_ja: H6胎児性癌細胞の凝集体では、細胞外カルシウム濃度の上昇によりマウス初期胚に類似した圧縮が誘導された。細胞骨格結合薬、レクチン、ツニカマイシン、抗体によりこの圧縮は阻害され、細胞骨格と表面糖鎖の関与が示された。胎児性癌細胞を用いた基礎的細胞生物学研究である。
pmid-6413272.summary_en: Using H6 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell aggregates, the authors show that increasing extracellular calcium induces compaction resembling that of the mouse embryo. Compaction was blocked by cytoskeleton-binding drugs, lectins, tunicamycin, and specific antibodies, indicating dependence on the cytoskeleton and surface glycoconjugates. The work examines mechanisms shared by EC cells and early embryos, which may inform later differentiation. It is basic cell biology research using an EC cell model.

pmid-6413282.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞の接着は、細胞表面のラクトサミノグリカンと表面ガラクトシルトランスフェラーゼの結合によって媒介されることが示された。UDPガラクトース、α-ラクトアルブミン、UDP-ジアルデヒドは接着を阻害し、Ca2+は酵素のタンパク分解を防いだ。主要な基質の見かけの分子量は90Kであった。
pmid-6413282.summary_en: This study examines adhesion of murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells mediated by cell surface lactosaminoglycans binding to surface galactosyltransferase. UDP-galactose, alpha-lactalbumin, and UDP-dialdehyde inhibit adhesion, and calcium protects the enzyme from proteolysis, suggesting it is a Ca2+-dependent adhesion molecule. The principal substrate has an apparent molecular weight of 90K. The work is basic cell biology on EC cells and does not address clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6414228.summary_ja: 血友病Aの患者に発生した原発性悪性奇形腫（肺）の症例報告である。血友病に伴う血胸や偽腫瘍は悪性疾患と鑑別が難しい。肺原発の奇形腫は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であり、出血性素因を持つ患者における稀な部位の胚細胞腫瘍を記録している。
pmid-6414228.summary_en: A patient with hemophilia A and a primary malignant teratoma of the lung is described. The case highlights diagnostic challenges, since hemothorax and pseudotumor in hemophilia can mimic malignant disease. Primary pulmonary teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor, so this report documents a rare site of GCT in a patient with a bleeding disorder. As a single case report from 1983, it offers limited detail on treatment.

pmid-6414700.summary_ja: 難治性悪性腫瘍151例を対象とした第II相試験で、イホスファミドとメスナ併用により全体奏効率は44%であった。精巣奇形腫（精巣がん）は87例中39例で奏効し、完全寛解も含まれた。メスナは出血性膀胱炎を大幅に減少させ、精巣がんに対する抗腫瘍効果を低下させなかった。
pmid-6414700.summary_en: In a phase II study of 151 patients with refractory malignancies, ifosfamide (60 mg/kg/day for 5 days) with mesna uroprotection achieved an overall response rate of 44%. Among subgroups, testicular teratoma (testicular cancer) responded in 39 of 87 patients, including complete remissions. Mesna markedly reduced hemorrhagic cystitis, and its use did not reduce ifosfamide's antitumor activity in testicular cancer. The study spans multiple tumor types, but a major germ cell tumor cohort is central to its results.

pmid-6415187.summary_ja: ウィスター系ラットで胎仔摘出後に卵黄嚢を切開創から露出させ、数週間後に奇形腫を誘発した。腫瘍は卵巣摘出の有無にかかわらず発生し、三胚葉由来の組織を含んだ。DMBAを卵黄嚢に塗布すると卵黄嚢成分を主とする腫瘍が生じた。奇形腫の起源として卵黄嚢が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6415187.summary_en: Experimental teratomas were induced in Wistar rats by leaving the visceral yolk sac hanging through the fetectomy incision. Tumors developed over several weeks, with or without bilateral oophorectomy, and contained derivatives of all three germ layers. DMBA applied to the yolk sac produced neoplasms composed mainly of yolk sac elements. The authors conclude that embryonic and extraembryonic teratomatous tumors may arise from the visceral yolk sac. This animal study is relevant to the origin of teratoma.

pmid-6417074.summary_ja: 片側精巣摘除術と腹部・骨盤放射線療法を受けた精巣腫瘍患者12例を後方視的に検討した。9例でFSHとLHが、1例でテストステロンが基準範囲外であった。対側精巣は照射野外でも散乱線により障害されやすく、半陰嚢への照射で悪化した。遮蔽により対側精巣線量を低減できる。
pmid-6417074.summary_en: This retrospective study measured hormone levels 5 to 20 years after treatment in 12 men with testicular tumors who had unilateral orchiectomy and abdominal or pelvic radiotherapy. Most patients had abnormal FSH and LH levels, and one had abnormal testosterone. Even with the contralateral testis outside the field, damage occurred, mainly from scatter, and was more likely when the hemiscrotum was irradiated. Shielding can reduce contralateral testicular dose. The study highlights long-term endocrine toxicity of radiotherapy in testicular tumor survivors.

pmid-6420984.summary_ja: 6歳女児に発生した極めてまれな原発性心臓腫瘍、成熟型(良性)奇形腫の症例を報告している。臨床像と病理学的特徴を記載し、文献報告例と比較している。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の診断上の注意点を示す症例報告・文献レビューである。小児の心臓胚細胞性腫瘍の鑑別を考慮する必要性を強調している。
pmid-6420984.summary_en: A rare primary cardiac tumour, a mature (benign) teratoma, is described in a 6-year-old girl. The authors report the clinical and pathological features of this extremely uncommon lesion and compare them with cases previously published in the literature. The case report and literature review focus on teratoma arising at an unusual extragonadal site, highlighting diagnostic considerations for cardiac germ cell neoplasms in children.

pmid-6573831.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫3例の腹水細胞診所見を検討している。腺癌と比較し、孤立性またはシート状に配列する細胞が多く、核小体の多発が多いことを示す。このまれな悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を腺癌と鑑別するための細胞学的手がかりとなる。
pmid-6573831.summary_en: Cytomorphologic findings of ascites from three patients with ovarian dysgerminoma are described. Compared with adenocarcinoma, dysgerminoma cells more often lie isolated or in sheet-like arrangements, with fewer cytoplasmic vacuoles, less nuclear membrane thickening, and more frequent multinucleolation. These cytologic features may help distinguish this rare malignant ovarian germ cell tumour from adenocarcinoma in effusion specimens, aiding diagnosis.

pmid-6575159.summary_ja: 下顎骨に生じたまれな悪性奇形腫の症例を報告している。画像所見は含歯性嚢胞に類似していた。外科的切除と二次的再建により、機能および審美性は良好に得られた。顎骨という性腺外部位の悪性胚細胞性腫瘍であり、顎骨病変の鑑別診断として重要である。
pmid-6575159.summary_en: A rare case of malignant teratoma of the mandible is presented. Radiographically the lesion resembled a dentigerous cyst. Treatment consisted of surgical resection followed by secondary reconstruction, which achieved satisfactory functional and aesthetic outcomes. The report highlights a non-gonadal location of a malignant germ cell neoplasm in the jaw and the importance of considering it in the differential diagnosis of jaw lesions.

pmid-6577123.summary_ja: 呼吸器症状と吐血で入院した21歳男性が、転移性絨毛癌と診断された。凝固検査では血小板減少とPT・APTTの延長、フィブリノゲンおよび複数の凝固因子の低下を認め、消費性凝固障害と考えられた。肝転移が原因となった可能性を指摘している。
pmid-6577123.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with respiratory symptoms and haematemesis was diagnosed with metastatic choriocarcinoma. Coagulation studies revealed thrombocytopenia and prolonged PT and APTT, with reduced fibrinogen and factors II, V, VII and X, consistent with consumption coagulopathy. The authors attribute this coagulopathy possibly to hepatic metastasis from the primary tumour. The report underscores the haematological complications that can accompany advanced choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6579478.summary_ja: 精巣と顎部の腫脹を呈した患者で、当初未分化セミノーマと診断された悪性リンパ腫を報告する。両腫瘍の組織学的・超微細構造的な鑑別基準と臨床・疫学的特徴を比較している。顎骨・上顎洞に転移したとされる過去のセミノーマ症例の多くは、実際にはリンパ腫であった可能性を指摘している。
pmid-6579478.summary_en: This report describes a patient with testicular and jaw swelling whose malignant lymphoma was initially misread as anaplastic seminoma. The authors review histologic and ultrastructural criteria distinguishing these two tumors and compare their clinical and epidemiologic features. They reassess previously reported seminoma cases metastatic to the jaws or antrum and suggest that many may actually have been lymphomas, highlighting diagnostic pitfalls in testicular and jaw masses.

pmid-6580799.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマで広範な転移を有する患者の脳脊髄液中に、セミノーマ細胞が検出された症例報告である。精巣外の胚細胞腫瘍による中枢神経系転移を、髄液の細胞診で確認できることを示している。病期診断と治療方針の決定において、髄液細胞診の臨床的有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-6580799.summary_en: A cytologic diagnosis is reported in a patient with testicular seminoma and widespread metastases. Seminoma cells were identified in cerebrospinal fluid, demonstrating central nervous system involvement by metastatic germ cell tumor. The case shows that CSF cytology can establish CNS metastasis from a non-CNS germ cell tumor, which is clinically significant for staging and treatment planning in patients with seminoma.

pmid-6584079.summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株EST-IIとマウス線維芽細胞の細胞質を融合させた細胞質雑種(cybrid)を作製した研究である。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)などのタンパク合成は、当初は核供与細胞の約4分の1にとどまったが、その後増加した。移植腫瘍は組織学的に核供与細胞に類似し、核と細胞質の両方の因子が遺伝子発現に影響することが示唆された。
pmid-6584079.summary_en: Cytoplasmic hybrid (cybrid) cell lines were created by fusing whole rat yolk sac tumor cells (EST-II) with enucleated mouse fibroblast cytoplasts. Synthesis of yolk sac markers such as alpha-fetoprotein and albumin was initially about one-fourth of the nuclear donor but rose over time. Transplanted cybrids produced tumors histologically resembling the donor, and the findings suggest that both nuclear and cytoplasmic factors influence gene expression in these hybrid cells.

pmid-6600544.summary_ja: 高周波リアルタイム超音波検査を92個の精巣に適用した研究である。精巣病変22例のうち、セミノーマ9例と胎児性癌4例が含まれていた。低エコー性の腫瘍と梗塞は類似しやすいものの、精巣内と精巣外の腫瘤は全例で正確に区別された。接触走査と触診の同時併用が、正確な診断に有用であった。
pmid-6600544.summary_en: High-frequency real-time scrotal sonography was evaluated in 92 testes from 48 scans. Among 22 testicular lesions, seminomas and embryonal carcinomas were common, alongside infarcts, atrophic testes, and one torsion. Hypoechoic tumors and infarcts looked similar, but ultrasound correctly separated testicular from extratesticular masses in every case, with pathologic correlation. Simultaneous contact scanning and palpation improved diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-6603906.summary_ja: ヌードマウス内の絨毛癌異種移植片から、新規ヒト絨毛癌細胞株T3M-3を樹立した報告である。宿主由来の線維芽細胞を抗血清で除去し、4年間の継代培養が可能であった。本細胞株はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、プロゲステロン、エストロゲンを大量に分泌し、腫瘍促進剤や上皮成長因子でhCG分泌が増加する。機能解析モデルとして有用である。
pmid-6603906.summary_en: A new human choriocarcinoma cell line, T3M-3, was established from a nude mouse xenograft after removing host fibroblasts with anti-nude mouse spleen antiserum. The line has been propagated for four years, forms tumors on reinoculation, and is hypotriploid. It secretes large amounts of hCG, progesterone, and estrogen, and hCG and progesterone output increases with tumor promoters or EGF. It provides a useful functional model for studying trophoblastic tumor biology.

pmid-6607298.summary_ja: 1983年の報告で、絨毛癌の患者7組の夫婦を対象に抗リンパ球抗体を検討した。血清中のブロッキング活性は全例で認められ、β-hCGが陰性化した後も数か月持続した。寛解中も長く活性が続いた1例は、その後再発した。抗体は夫由来のB細胞表面抗原を標的とするIgGであった。
pmid-6607298.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese study examined anti-lymphocyte antibodies in seven couples with choriocarcinoma. HLA typing, complement-dependent lymphocytotoxicity, and mixed lymphocyte reaction blocking assays were performed. Blocking activity was detected in all patients and often persisted for months after serum beta-hCG normalized. One patient with prolonged blocking activity during remission later relapsed. The antibodies were IgG targeting husband-derived B-lymphocyte surface antigens, suggesting that these antibodies reflect tumour burden in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6614089.summary_ja: 1983年の論文で、性腺芽腫の構造と発生について仮説を提示した。砂粒体の形成や石灰化・硝子化の進行は、未分化性腺の退縮相や性索増殖の終末期の再現ではないかと論じている。胎児・新生児の卵巣髄質の病的構造が性腺芽腫の発生を促すとし、遺伝的制御系の機能異常による病変であり真の腫瘍ではないと述べている。
pmid-6614089.summary_en: This 1983 American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology paper proposes a hypothesis for the development of gonadoblastoma. The authors suggest that psammoma bodies and increasing calcification and hyalinization in these lesions may recapitulate involution of the indifferent gonad and the terminal phase of sex cord proliferation. They further propose that pathologic structures in the fetal and neonatal ovarian medulla predispose to gonadoblastoma. The authors argue that gonadoblastomas arise from dysfunction of a genetic system controlling gonadal maturation and are therefore not true neoplasms.

pmid-6616439.summary_ja: 1983年の細胞遺伝学研究で、精巣のセミノーマ10例、混合型のセミノーマと奇形腫1例、悪性奇形腫1例に共通して小型の標識染色体が認められた。最も予後の良いセミノーマ4例では、この染色体がi(12p)と同定された。悪性精巣腫瘍に特異的な染色体変化の可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-6616439.summary_en: This 1983 cytogenetics study reports a small marker chromosome present in duplicate in ten seminomas, one combined seminoma-teratoma, and one malignant teratoma of the testis. In the four most favorable seminomas, the marker was identified as an isochromosome i(12p). The authors suggest that this chromosomal change may be specific for malignant testicular tumors, although the findings are preliminary given the small sample size.

pmid-6619191.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の組織切片をin situハイブリダイゼーション法で解析し、hCGサブユニットと胎盤性ラクトゲンのmRNAの局在を検討した。絨毛構造を保つ胞状奇胎では両遺伝子が発現し、絨毛癌ではhCGは発現するがhPLはほとんど認められなかった。絨毛形成などの分化の程度がhPL発現と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-6619191.summary_en: This 1983 study used in situ hybridization on tissue sections of hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma to localize messenger RNA for the hCG alpha and beta subunits and placental lactogen. In normal placenta, hPL mRNA appeared only in the syncytiotrophoblast, whereas hCG mRNA was found in cytotrophoblasts and syncytium. Hydatidiform mole, which retains villous structure, expressed both hCG and hPL genes. Choriocarcinoma expressed hCG in syncytial-like areas but little hPL. The authors conclude that villous differentiation is linked to hPL expression, while hCG genes can be active in more disorganized trophoblastic tissue.

pmid-6619783.summary_ja: 出産後7か月で急死した症例の法医学的報告である。急性の非外傷性硬膜下血腫の原因は、くも膜動脈に詰まって破裂させた絨毛癌の単発性腫瘍塞栓と判明した。原発巣は残存していなかった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患由来の腫瘍塞栓が、原発病変を特定できなくても致死的な頭蓋内出血を起こしうることを示す症例である。
pmid-6619783.summary_en: This forensic report describes a sudden death seven months after delivery caused by an acute nontraumatic subdural hematoma. Histological examination identified a solitary tumor embolus of choriocarcinoma that had lodged in and ruptured an arachnoid artery. No residual primary malignancy was found. The case illustrates how a tumor embolus from a gestational choriocarcinoma can cause fatal intracranial bleeding even when no identifiable primary lesion remains.

pmid-6620078.summary_ja: 1974〜1982年に治療した新生児の頚部奇形腫6例を報告している。全例が出生時に大きな頚部腫瘤を呈し、4例は呼吸窮迫のため早期に気管挿管を要した。手術は甲状腺葉切除術で行われ、術中迅速病理で切除断端の正常甲状腺を確認した。迅速な手術により、手術を受けなかった場合の死亡率80%が15%に低下したと述べている。
pmid-6620078.summary_en: This report describes six newborns with cervical teratomas treated at a single center between 1974 and 1982. All presented at birth with large neck masses, and four required early intubation for respiratory distress. Four infants underwent surgery within 24 hours of birth without complications. The tumors were encapsulated and arose from or were adjacent to the thyroid, and were removed by total thyroid lobectomy with frozen-section confirmation of normal margins. The authors note that prompt surgery reduced reported mortality from 80% to 15%.

pmid-6620326.summary_ja: 家系内の表現型女性5例はいずれも46,XYで、性腺胚細胞腫瘍を発症していた。伴性劣性遺伝形式が示唆された。染色体検査でX染色体の異常は認められず、H-Y抗原の力価は男性対照の範囲内であった。H-Y抗原に対する性腺特異的受容体の遺伝子異常が原因である可能性を提唱している。
pmid-6620326.summary_en: This study describes an X-linked recessive form of XY gonadal dysgenesis in a family with five phenotypic females, all of whom developed gonadal germ cell tumors. Cytogenetic analysis of elongated chromosomes showed no X chromosome abnormalities in affected individuals or carriers. H-Y antigen titres were within the male control range, suggesting a defect in the gonad-specific H-Y receptor rather than antigen expression. Dermatoglyphic features resembling those of Turner syndrome were also noted. The authors propose a point mutation or deletion of an X-linked gene as the likely cause.

pmid-6621105.summary_ja: 触診上正常な精巣を有しながら性腺外に腫瘤を呈した胚細胞腫瘍患者6例を検討した。高解像度の精巣超音波検査所見と病理所見を解析した。触診で正常でも潜在性の精巣病変が認められることがあった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者では、潜在性精巣原発の検出に高解像度超音波検査が有用な補助検査になると結論づけている。
pmid-6621105.summary_en: This study reviewed six patients with germ cell tumors who presented with extragonadal masses but clinically normal testes. Their records were matched with high-resolution real-time testicular ultrasonography performed before or around diagnosis. The authors describe the ultrasonographic and pathologic findings, which included occult testicular lesions despite normal palpation. They conclude that high-resolution ultrasonography is a valuable adjuvant test for detecting an occult testicular primary in patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-6623777.summary_ja: 父と息子の両者に精巣テラトカルシノーマが発生した症例を報告する。いずれも悪性の奇形腫性腫瘍であった。家族内で精巣がんが集積した稀な例であり、胚細胞腫瘍の発症に遺伝的な素因が関与している可能性について考察している。1983年の初期の報告として、家族性の精巣腫瘍に関する知見を示している。
pmid-6623777.summary_en: This case report describes two cases of testicular teratocarcinoma occurring in a father and his son. Both patients developed malignant testicular germ cell tumors, and the authors discuss the possible genetic factors underlying this familial occurrence. The report highlights the rare clustering of testicular cancers within one family, suggesting that inherited susceptibility may contribute to germ cell tumor development. As an early 1983 description, it contributes to the literature on familial testicular teratocarcinoma.

pmid-6627211.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対して精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた患者に、17年の無病期間を経て終末回腸への単発転移が生じた症例を報告する。症状は回結腸型腸重積であった。このような晩期かつ単発のセミノーマ転移は極めてまれであり、胚細胞腫瘍の長期フォローアップへの示唆も論じられている。
pmid-6627211.summary_en: This case report describes a metastasis of pure seminoma to the terminal ileum occurring 17 years after the initial diagnosis. The patient had previously been treated for stage I testicular seminoma with orchiectomy and radiotherapy. He presented with ileocolic intussusception caused by a solitary intestinal metastasis. The authors discuss the rarity of such a late, isolated recurrence and its implications for long-term surveillance of germ cell tumor survivors.

pmid-6627239.summary_ja: イホスファミドを含む併用化学療法の効果を、精巣胚細胞腫瘍94例と転移性肉腫70例で検討した研究である。精巣セミノーマ16例中15例が完全寛解(CR)または部分寛解(PR)を得た。化学療法歴のある非セミノーマでは、イホスファミド/エトポシド併用で約30%、イホスファミド/シスプラチン併用で33%の寛解率が示された。奇形腫を含め、初回治療での評価が勧められている。
pmid-6627239.summary_en: This study reports the efficacy of ifosfamide-based combination chemotherapy in 164 patients, including 94 with germ cell tumors of the testis and 70 with metastatic sarcoma. Among testicular patients, 15 of 16 seminoma patients achieved complete or partial remission. Non-seminomatous patients previously treated with chemotherapy showed remission rates of about 30% with ifosfamide/etoposide and 33% with ifosfamide/cisplatin. The authors conclude that ifosfamide is active in sarcomas, seminomas, and teratomas and merits evaluation in first-line regimens.

pmid-6628346.summary_ja: 72歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫が直腸S状結腸と小腸へ穿通し、一部で高分化型扁平上皮癌への悪性転化を伴っていた症例報告である。下痢に毛髪が混じるという症状と、単純X線での歯状構造から疑われた。手術で類皮嚢腫の穿通が確認された。卵巣奇形腫の稀な合併症と、画像検査と内視鏡検査の診断的価値を示す。
pmid-6628346.summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old woman whose ovarian dermoid cyst, with malignant transformation to well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, perforated into the rectosigmoid colon and small intestine. She presented with hair in her diarrhea, and plain film showed teeth-like structures, which led to a suspicion of perforation. Surgery confirmed the perforation, and histopathology showed a dermoid cyst with focal squamous carcinoma invading the bowel wall. The case illustrates a rare complication of mature ovarian teratoma and the diagnostic value of combined imaging and endoscopy.

pmid-6628817.summary_ja: 本報告は、卵巣奇形腫内の甲状腺組織が悪性化する極めてまれな疾患である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例を報告する。悪性と判定するための組織学的基準について文献上の合意がないため、診断の難しさを考察している。治療成績ではなく、診断上の問題点に焦点を当てた論文である。
pmid-6628817.summary_en: This case report describes malignant struma ovarii, a very rare germ cell tumor in which thyroid tissue within an ovarian teratoma becomes malignant. The authors note that diagnosis is difficult and that the literature lacks consensus on the histologic criteria for malignancy. They present a single patient and discuss the diagnostic challenges. The paper is primarily a case-based review of diagnostic problems rather than a treatment study.

pmid-6630661.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマ2例のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を報告する。1例は大動脈瘤様、もう1例は非特異的な腫瘤として発見された。両腫瘍とも境界明瞭で均一な濃度を示し、造影効果は軽度であった。これらの所見から縦隔セミノーマを鑑別に挙げるべきと述べている。
pmid-6630661.summary_en: This paper describes computed tomography findings in two patients with primary mediastinal seminoma. One presented as an aortic aneurysm with coarctation-like symptoms, the other as a nonspecific mass with left diaphragmatic paralysis. Both tumors were large, well demarcated, and homogeneous with density around 30 to 40 Hounsfield units, showing only slight contrast enhancement. The authors suggest these CT features should prompt consideration of primary mediastinal seminoma in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-6632215.summary_ja: 右精巣摘除術の10か月後に左上葉の気管支内腫瘍として再発した39歳男性の症例を報告する。気管支鏡では気管支原性癌に類似していたが、組織学的に精巣からの転移性胎児性癌と診断された。左上葉切除術を受け、術後11か月の時点で生存している。同様の気管支内転移は既報で4例あると述べている。
pmid-6632215.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with metastatic embryonal carcinoma of the testis that presented as an endobronchial tumor in the left upper lobe, ten months after right orchiectomy. Bronchoscopy showed a lesion mimicking bronchogenic carcinoma, and histology confirmed the metastasis. The patient underwent left upper lobectomy and was alive 11 months later. The authors also note that four similar endobronchial metastases had been reported previously.

pmid-6632900.summary_ja: 右精巣摘除術およびコバルト療法を受けた6年後に対側精巣にセミノーマが発生した症例を報告する。対側精巣における早期発見の在り方を問題提起し、新たな腫瘍増大を検出するための反復生検について統一した見解の必要性を指摘している。本報告は新規の治療データではなく、監視戦略に焦点を当てている。
pmid-6632900.summary_en: This paper reports a case of bilateral testicular seminoma occurring six years after right orchiectomy and cobalt radiotherapy. The authors raise the question of early detection of seminoma in the contralateral testis. They call for a consensus on whether repeat biopsies should be performed to detect new tumor growth. The report is brief and focused on surveillance strategy rather than new treatment data.

pmid-6632945.summary_ja: 1930年から1981年にかけてメイヨー・クリニックで治療された良性縦隔奇形腫86例を後方視的に検討した。患者の平均年齢は28歳で、男女比はほぼ同等であった。症状は多くみられたが、36%は無症状であり、22例で石灰化が認められた。外科的切除が最善の診断・治療法である。近年は、無症状で腫瘍が小さく、合併症の少ない患者が増えている。
pmid-6632945.summary_en: This retrospective review examines 86 benign mediastinal teratomas treated at the Mayo Clinic between 1930 and 1981. Patients had a mean age of 28 years and roughly equal sex distribution. Symptoms were common, but 36% were asymptomatic, and calcification was seen in 22 patients. Surgical excision remains the best diagnostic and therapeutic approach. Over time, patients have presented with smaller tumors, more often asymptomatic, and with fewer complications.

pmid-6636405.summary_ja: 5歳児の無痛性で硬い左精巣が定期診察で発見された症例です。左鼠径部からの精巣摘除術が行われ、病理検査で精巣の類皮嚢腫と診断されました。小児の精巣腫瘍は稀であるため、本腫瘍は稀少例とされ、組織学的基準と外科的管理が示されています。
pmid-6636405.summary_en: This report describes a five-year-old boy with a painless, firm left testis found on routine examination. He underwent left inguinal orchiectomy, and pathology revealed a dermoid cyst of the testis. The authors note that this is a rare tumor given the low incidence of testicular tumors in childhood. They present histologic criteria and surgical management and state that this is, in their view, the first well-documented case.

pmid-6637571.summary_ja: CT所見が正常な非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍患者69例でリンパ管造影を評価した研究です。全例で後腹膜リンパ節郭清と顕微鏡検査が行われ、28例に後腹膜転移が確認されました。しかしリンパ管造影陽性は4例のみで、CTが正常な場合の潜在的転移の検出感度は限定的であることが示唆されました。
pmid-6637571.summary_en: This study evaluated lymphography in 69 patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumors whose CT scans appeared normal. All patients underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and microscopic examination. Retroperitoneal metastases were found in 28 patients, but only four of these had a positive lymphogram. The findings suggest that lymphography had limited sensitivity for detecting occult retroperitoneal metastases when CT was normal, which is relevant to staging decisions.

pmid-6643208.summary_ja: 右精巣に胎児性癌を生じた思春期男性の症例報告です。精巣腫瘍は痛みや非典型的症状を伴うことがあり、診断を混乱させる場合があります。本症例では心理的問題の既往と未熟な訴え方のため、重要な手がかりが誤って評価され、診断が遅れました。思春期では精巣腫瘍を念頭に置くべきことが強調されています。
pmid-6643208.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent male with embryonal cell carcinoma of the right testis. Testicular tumors can present with pain or atypical symptoms that may confound diagnosis. In this patient, a history of psychological problems and immature, complaining behavior led clinicians to misjudge important clues in his history, causing diagnostic delay. The report highlights the need to consider testicular tumors in adolescents despite distracting factors.

pmid-6643471.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のアスパラギン結合型糖鎖を解析しました。正常hCGと比べ、97%以上の糖鎖はシアル酸を欠き、正常hCGには見られない三分岐型や特異的な二分岐型糖鎖を含んでいました。フコース化も正常の約2倍でした。腫瘍由来hCGは特有の糖鎖修飾を持つことが示されました。
pmid-6643471.summary_en: This study analyzed asparagine-linked sugar chains of hCG purified from urine of a patient with choriocarcinoma. Compared with normal urinary and placental hCG, choriocarcinoma hCG had more than 97% asialylated sugar chains and contained unusual biantennary and triantennary structures absent from normal hCG. Fucosylation was also increased, about twice normal levels. The findings indicate that tumor-produced hCG has distinct glycosylation, relevant to understanding choriocarcinoma biology and hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-6648405.summary_ja: 本報告は、縦隔奇形腫が原因で突然の心膜穿孔と心タンポナーデを来した1例を記述したものである。幼児の縦隔腫瘤は気管圧迫を来しやすく、年長児での症状は少ないと述べられている。腫瘍は胸部症状や感染を伴うことがある。心膜穿孔は稀だが生命を脅かす合併症である。
pmid-6648405.summary_en: This 1983 Scandinavian Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery report describes a case of sudden pericardial perforation and cardiac tamponade caused by a mediastinal teratoma. The review notes that mediastinal masses in young children typically cause tracheal compression, whereas later-childhood presentations are rarer. Symptoms include pain, pleural perforation, and infection. Pericardial perforation is a rare, life-threatening complication of this extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-6649214.summary_ja: 本報告は、通常は卵巣に見られる単一胚葉性奇形腫の稀な一型である原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍が、精巣に発生した初めての症例を報告したものである。従来、悪性神経外胚葉性腫瘍は卵巣例のみ記載されていた。この稀な組織亜型の記録は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多様性を広げるものである。治療や転帰に関する記載は簡潔である。
pmid-6649214.summary_en: This 1983 Urology report describes the first known case of a primitive neuroectodermal tumor, a rare form of monodermal teratoma usually seen in the ovary, arising in the testis. The authors note that the malignant neuroectodermal tumor was previously described only in ovarian cases. Documenting this unusual histologic variant expands the spectrum of testicular germ cell tumors. The brief report offers no treatment or outcome details.

pmid-6649237.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、肺転移を伴う精巣腫瘍が黄色肉芽腫へと変化した1例を記述したものである。初回治療としてプラチナ、ビンブラスチン、ペプロマイシンによる併用化学療法が行われたが、肺病変は完全には消失しなかった。その後、左上葉の区域切除が施行された。転移巣の組織学的検査で黄色肉芽腫性変化が認められた。
pmid-6649237.summary_en: This 1983 Urology case report describes a testicular tumor with pulmonary metastasis that transformed into xanthogranuloma. Initial treatment was combination chemotherapy with platinum, vinblastine, and peplomycin, which did not fully clear the lung lesion. A segmental left upper lobe resection was then performed. Histology of the metastatic nodule revealed xanthogranulomatous change, an unusual finding in germ cell tumor metastasis.

pmid-6649911.summary_ja: 本論文は、小児の悪性卵巣奇形腫3例の治療成績を報告したものである。全例が腹痛で発症し、腹膜播種を認めた。初回治療として片側卵管卵巣摘出術が行われ、その後、化学療法と全腹腔への放射線療法を組み合わせた積極的な治療が行われた。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では術前の正確な診断は得られなかった。
pmid-6649911.summary_en: This 1983 German pediatric surgery report presents three children treated for malignant ovarian teratoma. All presented with abdominal pain, and peritoneal implants were found in each case. Initial management was unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy followed by an aggressive multimodal regimen of combined chemotherapy (actinomycin, adriamycin, vincristine, cyclophosphamide) and whole-abdomen radiotherapy. Ultrasonography and CT failed to give a precise preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-6652413.summary_ja: 本研究は、病的陰嚢を呈した51例に対し、動的および静的超音波検査を評価したものである。全例で手術が施行された。全例で病変の局在は正しく診断されたが、悪性と良性の鑑別や奇形腫とセミノーマの鑑別は困難であった。著者らは、直接触診を併用した接触走査と水浴による離隔走査の併用を推奨している。
pmid-6652413.summary_en: This 1983 British Journal of Radiology study evaluated dynamic and static ultrasonography in 51 patients with pathological scrotum, all of whom underwent surgery. Ultrasound correctly localized disease in every case, but could not reliably distinguish malignant from benign lesions or a teratoma from a seminoma. The authors recommend combining contact scanning with direct palpation and water-bath stand-off scanning.

pmid-6652448.summary_ja: 本研究は、ロンドン病院で30年間に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を検討したものである。純粋セミノーマの割合は減少し、他の組織型では転移を伴う初診が増加した。病期I悪性奇形腫の再発率は予防的放射線療法の有無にかかわらず同程度であり、精巣摘除術単独の過去の報告より低かった。これらの変化から、専門施設における病期I精巣腫瘍の経過観察方針が正当化されると著者らは述べている。
pmid-6652448.summary_en: This 1983 British Journal of Urology study reviews 30 years of germ cell tumor patients treated at the London Hospital. It shows that pure seminoma incidence fell while metastatic presentation for other histologies rose. Relapse rates in Stage 1 malignant teratoma were similar with or without prophylactic radiotherapy and lower than historical rates after orchiectomy alone. The authors argue these trends justify surveillance for stage I testicular tumors at specialist centres.

pmid-6652449.summary_ja: 本研究は、転移性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後における外科病理学的病期分類と放射線療法を評価したものである。細胞傷害性化学療法を受けた83例中30例が術後の外科的病期分類を必要とし、10例で生存腫瘍が確認された。嚢胞性成熟奇形腫は8例で切除された。転移性純粋セミノーマでは、シスプラチン単剤への感受性を考慮し、退縮が止まるまで手術を遅らせることを推奨している。
pmid-6652449.summary_en: This 1983 British Journal of Urology study evaluates post-chemotherapy surgicopathological staging and radiotherapy in metastatic germ cell tumors. Of 83 patients treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy, 30 required surgical restaging, and viable malignancy was found in ten. Cystic mature teratoma was excised in eight. In metastatic pure seminoma, the authors recommend delaying surgery until regression ceases, given its sensitivity to single-agent cisplatin.

pmid-6652450.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者208例の治療前精液所見を解析し、精子数が1000万/mL超だったのはセミノーマで22%、奇形腫・混合型で29%にとどまった。多剤化学療法後の回復は24%で、ホジキン病では極めて少なかった。凍結保存に適した精液を持つ若年男性は約4分の1で、凍結精液による人工授精で2名の健康な児が誕生した。
pmid-6652450.summary_en: This 1983 study analyzed semen from 208 men with testicular tumors before any treatment, finding sperm counts above 10 million/mL in only about a quarter of seminoma and teratoma/mixed tumor patients. Among 117 men assessed after treatment, 24% of those receiving multidrug chemotherapy recovered counts within three years, and recovery was similar regardless of baseline count. Among Hodgkin's disease patients, post-chemotherapy recovery was rare. Only a quarter of young men produced semen suitable for cryopreservation, and 15 couples underwent artificial insemination with frozen semen, yielding two healthy babies.

pmid-6652946.summary_ja: 15歳の女性は性腺異形成と乳房発育を示し、染色体はidic(Xq-)でY染色体を欠いていたが、性腺芽腫が見つかった。文献的検討では、Y陰性の既報例に乳房発育が共通して認められた。そのため、Yを欠く性腺異形成でも乳房発育があれば厳重な経過観察が必要と論じている。
pmid-6652946.summary_en: A 15-year-old with gonadal dysgenesis, breast development, and an isodicentric X chromosome without a Y chromosome was found to have gonadoblastoma. The authors argue gonadoblastoma can occur without a Y chromosome. A review of previous Y-negative cases found breast development was common among them, suggesting that patients with gonadal dysgenesis and breast development, even lacking Y, warrant close surveillance for gonadal tumors.

pmid-6653292.summary_ja: 直腸側壁から生じた類皮嚢腫の症例を報告している。直腸の嚢胞は稀で、これまでの報告は12例のみである。肛門後部や仙尾部の類皮嚢腫の方が多いことも示した。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫の一型と考えられ、性腺外の奇形腫様病変として位置づけられる。
pmid-6653292.summary_en: This report describes a dermoid cyst arising from the lateral wall of the rectum, a rare site with only 12 previously reported cases of rectal cysts. The authors contrast it with the more common postanal and sacrococcygeal dermoids and review previously recorded rectal cysts. Dermoid cysts are considered mature, benign teratoma variants, placing this extragonadal lesion within the teratoma spectrum. The paper is primarily a case report with literature review, offering a reference for diagnosing and managing rectal cystic lesions.

pmid-6653628.summary_ja: 精巣病変を伴わず後腹膜に原発したセミノーマの症例を報告している。左腎および左副腎などへの転移が認められ、診断は剖検で確定した。セミノーマは精巣外に原発しうることを示し、原発不明の後腹膜腫瘤や播種性病変の鑑別に留意すべきと述べている。
pmid-6653628.summary_en: A case of primary retroperitoneal seminoma is described, with metastases to the left kidney, left adrenal gland, and other organs, and no testicular involvement. The diagnosis was made at autopsy. The paper emphasizes that seminoma can arise primarily outside the testis, which should be considered in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses and disseminated disease of unknown origin.

pmid-6653629.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた表皮嚢腫の症例を報告し、本疾患を概説している。発生起源には統一した見解がないが、多くの著者は単層性奇形腫とみなしている。そのため、純粋な表皮嚢腫であっても治療方針の判断に難しさがあると述べている。
pmid-6653629.summary_en: A patient with an epidermoid cyst of the testis is reported and the entity is reviewed. Histogenesis remains debated, though most authors regard it as a monolayer teratoma. Because of this, even a pure epidermoid cyst poses a therapeutic dilemma, as it requires careful decisions similar to those for other testicular teratomas.

pmid-6654183.summary_ja: 46,XX純粋性腺異形成の42歳女性に、15×17cmの右付属器腫瘤を伴うディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)が発見された。29歳時の生検では卵胞のない卵巣様間質が確認されていた。部分切除と照射後の再手術で完全寛解が確認された。知られる限り、46,XX表現型女性の異形成性性腺に生じた初の症例とされる。
pmid-6654183.summary_en: A 42-year-old woman with 46,XX pure gonadal dysgenesis was found to have a large right adnexal dysgerminoma. Streak gonads had been identified at age 29, and biopsies showed ovarian-type stroma without follicles. After partial resection and linear accelerator irradiation, second-look surgery showed complete remission. The authors note this is, to their knowledge, the first dysgerminoma arising in dysgenetic gonads of a 46,XX phenotypic female, while acknowledging that undetected mosaicism is possible.

pmid-6654184.summary_ja: 化学療法後に悪性未熟卵巣奇形腫が良性の成熟奇形腫へ逆分化した2症例を報告している。文献的検討を行い、この現象の考えられる機序を考察している。化学療法後の組織変化は残存病変の病理評価や予後判定に影響しうるため、臨床上重要である。
pmid-6654184.summary_en: Two cases are reported in which malignant immature ovarian teratomas retroconverted to benign mature teratomas after chemotherapy. The authors review the literature on this phenomenon and discuss possible explanations. This is relevant to germ cell tumor management, because histologic changes after chemotherapy may complicate pathological assessment and risk stratification of residual disease.

pmid-6654989.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌（EC）細胞株PC13と、レチノイン酸で分化させた良性内胚葉様（END）細胞が共培養で互いの増殖を促進することを示した。EC細胞は拡散性の可溶性因子を介して線維芽細胞株も刺激し、END細胞は接触依存性と非依存性の複数機構で低密度のEC細胞増殖を支えた。生体内での奇形癌の増殖・分化にも同様の相互作用が関与すると考えられる。
pmid-6654989.summary_en: Using malignant PC13 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and retinoic acid-derived benign endoderm-like (END) cells, the authors show that the two populations mutually stimulate proliferation in co-culture. EC cells act through diffusible soluble factors that also stimulate fibroblast lines, while END cells support low-density EC growth through a multifactorial mechanism involving both contact-dependent and contact-independent effects. The authors suggest similar interactions may govern teratocarcinoma proliferation and differentiation in vivo.

pmid-6656766.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞を凝集させレチノイン酸で処理すると、神経細胞・星状膠細胞・線維芽細胞に分化することを示した。神経細胞はテタヌス毒素受容体の発現とコリン作動性酵素活性の協調的出現により確認された。神経分化に先立ち胎児性癌表面抗原が減少し細胞体積も縮小した。ポリアミン代謝は関与しないと考えられた。既存の分化誘導薬に反応しない変異株も単離され、レチノイン酸が引き起こすシグナル事象の解明に役立つと期待される。
pmid-6656766.summary_en: The authors show that P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, aggregated and exposed to retinoic acid, differentiate into neurons, astroglia, and fibroblasts. Neurons were confirmed by tetanus toxin receptor expression and coordinated cholinergic enzyme activity. A decrease in an EC surface antigen and cell volume preceded neuron appearance. Various retinoids induced neurogenesis without apparent polyamine involvement. A mutant clone unresponsive to all standard differentiation-inducing drugs was isolated, which may help identify the signaling events triggered by retinoic acid.

pmid-6656767.summary_ja: 多能性の胎児性癌株01A1を凝集させDMSOで処理し、分化を誘導した。心筋細胞は4～5日目、骨格筋細胞は7～8日目に出現し、抗ミオシン抗体による免疫蛍光で定量した。胎児性癌特異的表面抗原により未分化細胞の消失を確認した。筋分化が起こらない変異株D3は、高濃度レチノイン酸でニューロンやグリア細胞を形成した。多能性細胞が横紋筋系譜へ決定される機構の研究モデルとして有用とされる。
pmid-6656767.summary_en: The authors induced differentiation of the pluripotent P19-derived embryonal carcinoma line 01A1 by aggregation and dimethyl sulfoxide treatment. Cardiac muscle appeared within 4 to 5 days and skeletal muscle by 7 to 8 days, quantified by immunofluorescence with anti-myosin antibodies. Loss of undifferentiated cells was confirmed with an EC-specific surface antigen antibody. A mutant line (D3) failed to form muscle but produced neurons and glia under high retinoic acid. The system is proposed as a model for how pluripotent cells commit to striated muscle lineages.

pmid-6662112.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したF9奇形癌細胞のプロテオグリカン組成を解析した。未分化細胞はヒアルロン酸をもたず、ヘパラン・デルマタン・コンドロイチン硫酸もごくわずかであった。分化に伴いヒアルロン酸合成と膜結合型硫酸化プロテオグリカンが3倍に増加した。分化細胞は、ケラタン硫酸に似た新規プロテオグリカンPGM-2も培地中へ分泌した。PGM-2は数種の酵素に抵抗性で、ケラナーゼでのみ分解された。
pmid-6662112.summary_en: Retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells was analyzed by labelling and isolating proteoglycans from membranes and medium. Undifferentiated cells lacked hyaluronic acid and contained minimal heparan, dermatan and chondroitin sulfates. Differentiation increased hyaluronic acid synthesis and membrane-bound sulfated proteoglycans threefold. Differentiated cells also secreted a novel keratan sulfate-like proteoglycan, PGM-2, which resisted several glycosidases but was degraded by keratanase.

pmid-6662607.summary_ja: それまで無症状であった思春期の女児が、左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫による突然の尿閉で受診した。著者らはこれを腫瘍の稀な初発徴候として報告している。尿閉が本疾患の最初の症状となり得ることを示した症例報告であり、系統的な検討ではない。良性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な臨床像として参考になる。
pmid-6662607.summary_en: The authors describe an asymptomatic adolescent girl who presented with sudden urinary retention due to a mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary, reporting this as a rare onset sign of the tumor. As a case report, it documents an uncommon clinical presentation of this benign ovarian germ cell tumor rather than a systematic series. The presentation shows that urinary symptoms can be the first manifestation of such a tumor.

pmid-6663135.summary_ja: F9奇形癌細胞由来の大型糖ペプチド（LGP）に対する血清抗体を、Farr法で測定し悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断への有用性を検討した。ディスジャーミノーマ9例は全て陰性で、それ以外の悪性胚細胞腫瘍14例中9例が陽性であった。良性・他の悪性卵巣腫瘍および正常女性は全て陰性であった。抗LGP抗体の検出は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断に有用と結論された。
pmid-6663135.summary_en: The authors tested whether antibodies in patient sera against large glycopeptides (LGP) from the F9 teratocarcinoma line can diagnose malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, using Farr's assay. All nine dysgerminomas were negative, whereas 9 of 14 other malignant germ cell tumors were positive. No benign or other malignant ovarian tumors or normal women were positive. The authors conclude that detecting anti-LGP antibodies is useful for diagnosing ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-6666374.summary_ja: 小児の大型縦隔奇形腫に対する手術法を報告。正中胸骨切開と側方T字切開を組み合わせた完全正中胸骨切開を3例に適用した。従来の開胸では腫瘍の剥離が困難だったが、この方法で腫瘍全体を直視下に到達でき、縦隔構造に近い内側の剥離も安全に行えた。
pmid-6666374.summary_en: Describes a surgical approach for large mediastinal teratomas in children, using complete median sternotomy with a lateral T-shaped incision. Three pediatric patients were operated on; the first, via standard thoracotomy, had difficult tumor dissection due to limited space against the rigid thoracic cage, whereas the latter two had no difficulty with the sternotomy approach. The technique gives direct visualization of the entire tumor, safer dissection of its medial side near mediastinal structures, and avoids compression of healthy lung in supine positioning.

pmid-6668498.summary_ja: 1970〜1980年にミネソタ大学で治療された病期II非セミノーマ精巣がん82例の成績を報告。後腹膜リンパ節郭清単独や放射線療法併用では再発率が高かった。1976年以降のシスプラチン併用補助化学療法を受けた患者は再発がなく、毒性も軽度であった。
pmid-6668498.summary_en: Reviews outcomes in 82 patients with pathologic stage II nonseminomatous germ cell testicular carcinoma treated at one institution from 1970 to 1980. Relapse rates were high after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection alone or with adjuvant radiotherapy, and after pre-1976 adjuvant chemotherapy. After 1976, cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy was used, and no patient receiving it relapsed, with modest toxicity. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy is effective and safe.

pmid-6668516.summary_ja: 1983年の報告で、胚細胞腫瘍の患者7例が完全寛解後2年以上（45〜87か月）経過して再発した症例を検討した。大半の再発は治療後1年以内に起きていた。サルベージ療法後に5例が生存したが、再寛解の持続性を評価するには追跡期間が短かった。著者らは治癒の判定には5年までのフォローアップ延長が必要と述べている。
pmid-6668516.summary_en: This 1983 J Clin Oncol report describes seven patients with germ-cell tumors who relapsed after more than two years in complete response (45-87 months). Most relapses in this era occurred within the first year, so these late events were notable. Five patients survived after salvage therapy, though follow-up was too short to judge durability. Late-relapsing patients shared no distinguishing features with other chemotherapy-treated patients. The authors recommend extending follow-up to five years before curability can be established.

pmid-6675439.summary_ja: 60歳女性で血尿、排尿痛、頻尿を主訴とした症例である。画像検査と膀胱鏡で膀胱後壁に穿孔した結石を認め、手術で左卵巣類皮嚢腫が膀胱と癒着していた。本例を含め、卵巣類皮嚢腫が膀胱穿孔を来した28例を文献的に集計した。良性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の泌尿器合併症としてまれな病態である。
pmid-6675439.summary_en: This Japanese urology case report describes a 60-year-old woman with hematuria, dysuria, and frequent urination. Imaging and cystoscopy revealed a calculus perforating the bladder wall, and surgery found a left ovarian dermoid cyst adherent to the bladder. The authors combined this case with 27 previously reported cases of ovarian dermoid cyst with bladder perforation, for a total of 28. The report highlights a rare urinary tract complication of a benign ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-6676077.summary_ja: 病期P1の精巣悪性奇形腫中間型89例で胎盤型蛋白の免疫染色を行った。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性の合胞体巨細胞は66%、PP5は47%、SPIは46%に認めた。いずれの蛋白陽性も4年生存と関連しなかった。診断業務上この免疫染色は必須ではないと結論している。
pmid-6676077.summary_en: This Diagnostic Histopathology study examined placental-type proteins in 89 testicular malignant teratoma intermediate tumors at pathological stage P1.
