Syncytial giant cells containing hCG were found in 66%, PP5 in 47%, and SPI in 46%. No association was found between staining for any of these proteins and four-year survival. The authors conclude that immunocytochemistry for these proteins is not a necessary part of a diagnostic service. The paper addresses prognosis and diagnostic utility in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6677107.summary_ja: 21年間に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍105例を検討し、86例が術後放射線療法を受けた。14例に晩期放射線障害を認め、瘻孔、腸管壊死、潰瘍、肺線維症、膀胱炎、リンパ浮腫などがみられ、小児3例では成長障害も生じた。代表的な2症例を提示し考察している。精巣腫瘍の放射線療法の長期的毒性を示した報告である。
pmid-6677107.summary_en: This Japanese urology report reviews 105 patients with germinal testicular tumors treated over 21 years, 86 of whom received postoperative irradiation. Late radiation injury developed in 14 patients, including fistula, bowel necrosis, ulcers, lung fibrosis, cystitis, lymphedema, and growth disturbance in three children. Two representative cases are presented and discussed. The study highlights the long-term toxicity of radiotherapy in testicular germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6677841.summary_ja: 眼窩に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍5例を報告し、いずれも細胞質内にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を認めた。性腺外の卵黄嚢腫瘍と比べて若年で発症し、積極的治療で長期生存が得られうる。急速に進行する眼球突出を呈する小児では、横紋筋肉腫との鑑別にAFPの免疫染色が有用とされる。
pmid-6677841.summary_en: This Ophthalmology paper describes five orbital endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors, a rare extragonadal germ cell neoplasm. All five contained intracytoplasmic alpha-fetoprotein on immunoperoxidase staining of paraffin-embedded tissue. The authors note that orbital cases occur at younger ages than other extragonadal yolk sac tumors and can achieve long-term survival with aggressive treatment. They also emphasize that AFP immunostaining can help distinguish this tumor from rhabdomyosarcoma in children with rapidly progressive proptosis.

pmid-6680224.summary_ja: 進行精巣非セミノーマ患者を対象に、化学療法と放射線療法の順序・間隔が正常組織障害に与える影響を検討した1983年の研究。化学療法後に照射を受けた63例と、照射後に再発に対して化学療法を受けた53例を比較した。放射線照射後2か月以内に薬剤投与を受けた6例すべてで線維化が生じた。
pmid-6680224.summary_en: This 1983 study examines normal tissue damage in advanced testicular non-seminoma patients treated with chemotherapy and radiotherapy. It compares 63 patients who received elective involved-field irradiation after chemotherapy with 53 patients who received chemotherapy for relapse after prior irradiation. Damage varied with treatment sequence and timing. Fibrosis developed in all six patients who received drugs within two months of irradiation, and retroperitoneal irradiation at 35-45 Gy was associated with damage in 0% and 25% of the two groups.

pmid-6681603.summary_ja: 精巣の奇形腫および絨毛癌の若年患者で、数週間続く重篤な腸管出血を呈した症例。出血源は空腸の単発転移と判明し、内視鏡的切除により合併症なく治療された。原因不明の消化管出血では、腫瘍患者の小腸転移を鑑別に考慮すべきと著者らは提言している。
pmid-6681603.summary_en: A case of testicular teratoma with choriocarcinoma is reported in a young patient who presented with several weeks of severe intestinal bleeding. The source was a single metastasis to the jejunum, which was removed endoscopically without complications. The authors suggest that small bowel metastasis should be considered in young patients with neoplasms who have obscure gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Endoscopic resection can serve both a diagnostic and a therapeutic role in such cases.

pmid-6681783.summary_ja: 多能性胎児性癌細胞株OC-15S1と1003を無血清の定義培地で培養し、分化の誘導因子を検討した基礎研究。両細胞株は増殖せず分化し、分化細胞は血清リポ蛋白の添加で生存した。高密度リポ蛋白では壁側内胚葉様細胞が生じ、フィブロネクチンも分化を促進した。
pmid-6681783.summary_en: This study examines two multipotent embryonal carcinoma cell lines, OC-15S1 and 1003, which in defined serum-free medium do not proliferate but irreversibly differentiate. Differentiated cells survive only with added serum lipoproteins, and high-density lipoprotein yields a population of parietal endoderm-like cells that secrete plasminogen activator. Fibronectin also promotes differentiation, suggesting it may directly influence cell fate decisions in early mammalian development.

pmid-6681829.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとHCCM-5を用い、メトトレキサート(MTX)感受性とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を比較した基礎研究。HCCM-5はMTXに感受性が高く、MTXの取り込みが多かった一方、ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素(DHFR)量は約半分であった。耐性の差はMTX輸送とDHFR量の違いに起因すると考察されている。
pmid-6681829.summary_en: This study characterizes two choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo and HCCM-5, comparing their sensitivity to methotrexate (MTX) and their hCG secretion. HCCM-5 was more sensitive to MTX, taking up about four times more drug than BeWo but containing roughly half the dihydrofolate reductase. The authors attribute the difference in resistance to altered MTX transport and intracellular DHFR levels. The findings help explain mechanisms of MTX resistance in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6681830.summary_ja: メトトレキサート(MTX)を抗hCG抗体および胎盤性アルカリフォスファターゼ(PLALP)抗体に結合させ、絨毛癌細胞に対する増殖抑制効果を検討した基礎研究。抗hCG-MTX結合体はhCG産生性のBeWo細胞を、抗PLALP-MTX結合体はPLALP産生性のSCH細胞を選択的に抑制した。特異的免疫化学療法の可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-6681830.summary_en: This study covalently coupled methotrexate to rabbit antibodies against hCG and placental alkaline phosphatase, then tested the conjugates on cultured choriocarcinoma cells. Anti-hCG-MTX inhibited growth of hCG-producing BeWo cells, while anti-PLALP-MTX inhibited PLALP-producing SCH cells, showing target-specific effects. Neither conjugate affected endometrial carcinoma cells. The authors propose specific immunochemotherapy as a possible approach for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6682069.summary_ja: 1964年から1978年に中国で治療された、絨毛癌の脳転移患者34例の報告。化学療法と漢方薬を中心に治療し、一部に開頭術を併用した。7例（20.5%）が12～120か月間寛解を維持し、主な副作用は骨髄抑制であった。
pmid-6682069.summary_en: This series reports 34 patients with cerebral metastases from choriocarcinoma treated in China between 1964 and 1978. Treatment consisted mainly of chemotherapy and Chinese herbs, with craniotomy added selectively. About 20% of patients (7 of 34) remained in remission for 12 to 120 months. Myelosuppression was the main side effect. The report documents long-term survival achievable in a subset of patients with brain metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6682351.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群、甲状腺中毒症、原発性縦隔絨毛癌を併発した患者の症例である。文献レビューにより、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍はクラインフェルター症候群と有意に関連することがわかった。著者らは、異数性の性腺外胚細胞が悪性転化しやすい傾向がある可能性を指摘しているが、根本的な理由は不明である。本症例は、この症候群と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍との間の遺伝的関連の可能性を示している。
pmid-6682351.summary_en: This report describes a patient with Klinefelter syndrome, thyrotoxicosis, and a primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma. A literature review found that extragonadal germ cell tumors appear significantly associated with Klinefelter syndrome. The authors speculate that an aneuploid extragonadal germ cell may have an unusual propensity for malignant transformation, though the underlying reason remains unclear. The case highlights a possible genetic link between this syndrome and extragonadal germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-6682628.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株7種を用い、メトトレキサート(MTX)の増殖およびhCG分泌への影響をin vitroで検討した。hCG高分泌株は増殖が抑制され、低分泌株は耐性を示した。耐性機序として薬剤取り込み低下やジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素の増加が示唆された。MTX感受性はhCG分泌能と関連することが示された。
pmid-6682628.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how methotrexate affects growth and hCG secretion in five gestational and two nongestational human choriocarcinoma cell lines. Responses were heterogeneous. Cell lines secreting high amounts of hCG, including HCCM-5, BeWo, and IMa, were growth-inhibited by continuous low-dose methotrexate, with multinucleated giant cells and increased hCG secretion. Cell lines secreting little hCG were resistant, and impaired drug uptake and increased dihydrofolate reductase contributed to resistance. The findings suggest that hCG secretion level may predict methotrexate sensitivity in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6682918.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の患者6例で、化学療法後も残存した肺結節に対し開胸術を施行した。hCGを腫瘍マーカーとして経過を追跡した。開胸術の主な役割は診断目的であり、治療目的は肺病変がhCG上昇の唯一の原因である場合に限られると結論した。化学療法抵抗性の肺病巣の切除は三次性血行性転移を招く恐れがあり、注意が必要と指摘している。
pmid-6682918.summary_en: This report evaluates thoracotomy in six patients with gestational choriocarcinoma whose pulmonary nodules persisted after repeated chemotherapy over four months. Serum hCG served as the tumor marker for monitoring response, and the patients were followed for a long period. The authors conclude that the most important role of thoracotomy is diagnostic. Therapeutic resection is reserved for cases in which the lung lesion is the only remaining source of elevated hCG. They caution that resecting chemotherapy-unresponsive pulmonary foci may cause tertiary hematogenous metastases.

pmid-6683129.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞JEG-3が分泌し、抗原やマイトジェン刺激によるリンパ球増殖を抑制する免疫抑制因子を解析した。複数のクロマトグラフィーなどにより、約15万～20万Daのタンパク質複合体で、免疫活性を持つ極性脂質を含むことを示した。その性状はT細胞由来のSIFに類似していた。栄養膜性腫瘍の分泌物が、正常な胎盤産物か悪性細胞の機能かを議論している。
pmid-6683129.summary_en: The authors characterized an immunosuppressive factor secreted by cultured human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells, which inhibits lymphocyte proliferation stimulated by antigen or mitogen. Using ion-exchange and exclusion chromatography, organic solvent partitioning, and thin-layer chromatography, they found the factor to be a protein complex of roughly 150,000 to 200,000 Da containing an immunologically active polar lipid. Its properties resemble or may be identical to SIF, a T-cell-derived suppressor lymphokine. The authors discuss whether such trophoblastic tumor secretions reflect normal placental products or functions of malignant cells.

pmid-6683207.summary_ja: WKA系雌ラット8例で、ウイルス接種や化学発がん物質を用いず、胎児摘出のみで絨毛癌を誘発した。株RCHOは同系ラットに10世代以上皮下移植可能だった。組織学的に栄養膜巨細胞と小型好塩基性腫瘍細胞からなり、正常ラット胎盤に類似していた。乳腺刺激・泌乳活性を示し、雄宿主では精巣萎縮を誘導した。
pmid-6683207.summary_en: The authors induced choriocarcinoma in eight WKA female rats by simple fetectomy, without viral inoculation or chemical carcinogens. One line, RCHO, was successfully transplanted subcutaneously into syngeneic rats over more than ten generations. Histologically it consisted of trophoblastic giant cells and small basophilic tumor cells resembling normal rat placenta. RCHO showed marked mammotropic and lactogenic activity in female recipients and caused testicular atrophy in male recipients. The model provides a transplantable, hormonally active choriocarcinoma system for experimental study.

pmid-6683282.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の腎転移に腎周囲出血を伴った症例を、CT所見とともに報告した。腎腫瘍による後腹膜出血は通常、腎細胞癌や血管筋脂肪腫によるため、本例は稀である。CTで血腫の急性性状と腎周囲の被膜外区画への限局が確認された。自然発生的な腎周囲出血の鑑別に絨毛癌転移を考慮すべきと指摘している。
pmid-6683282.summary_en: This case report describes computed tomographic findings of renal metastases from choriocarcinoma accompanied by perinephric hemorrhage. Retroperitoneal hemorrhage from a renal tumor is usually due to renal cell carcinoma or angiomyolipoma, so this presentation is unusual. CT showed the acute nature of the hematoma and its confinement within the extracapsular compartment of the perirenal space. The report suggests that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of spontaneous perinephric hemorrhage, particularly in patients with a history of gestational or germ cell tumors.

pmid-6683294.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株GCH-nu-YSを用い、温熱療法の可能性をin vitroで検討した。37.0～41.2℃の温度勾配下で約2週間培養した。39.2℃以下では増殖は維持され、39.9℃以上で著明に抑制、40.4℃以上では増殖不能で細胞は破壊された。生存と増殖の温度上限を推定し、致死温度では奇怪な細胞を含む形態変化が認められた。
pmid-6683294.summary_en: This in vitro study evaluated the potential of hyperthermic therapy for choriocarcinoma by examining the temperature sensitivity of the GCH-nu-YS clone. Cells were cultured for about two weeks at temperatures from 37.0 to 41.2 °C in a temperature gradient incubator. Proliferation was preserved up to 39.2 °C, inhibited at 39.5 to 39.9 °C, and impossible above 40.4 °C, where cells were destroyed. The authors estimated upper limits for viability and proliferation at about 40.4 to 40.6 °C and 40.1 to 40.2 °C. Morphological changes, including bizarre cells, appeared at lethal temperatures.

pmid-6683326.summary_ja: 父子で精巣腫瘍が発生した症例を報告した。両者ともに精巣セミノーマを発症しており、父子発症は本報告で7例目、同一腫瘍の父子発症は2例目とされる。家族性精巣腫瘍の希少な文献に寄与し、精巣腫瘍患者における家族歴の臨床的重要性を示している。
pmid-6683326.summary_en: This case report describes father-son testicular neoplasia, the seventh such case documented, and only the second instance in which both family members developed identical tumors. Both father and son had testicular seminoma. The report adds to the sparse literature on familial testicular germ cell tumors and highlights the clinical relevance of family history in patients with testicular neoplasms.

pmid-6683365.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の後に発症した絨毛癌で、26歳女性に多発性脳転移と意識障害・右片麻痺が出現した。緊急開頭術で腫瘍5個を完全摘出し、約1週間で頭蓋内圧亢進症状が改善した。その後、放射線化学療法と肺転移の外科的切除を受け、hCG値は正常範囲を維持している。著者らは症候性の脳転移に対する早期の外科的治療を推奨している。
pmid-6683365.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma that followed a hydatidiform mole developed multiple cerebral metastases with consciousness disturbance and hemiparesis. Emergency craniotomy completely removed five tumors, and her neurological symptoms improved within about a week. She then received radiotherapy and chemotherapy, and a metastatic lung nodule was resected. Her hCG levels remain normal and she is functioning well at home. The authors advocate prompt surgical treatment for symptomatic cerebral metastases of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6683658.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞株の多くが、レチノールによりin vitroで分化することが示された。分化は形態、細胞表面抗原、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター分泌の変化で確認された。0.025 µg/mlという低濃度でも効果がみられた。8株中2株のみが応答しなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞様成分である胎児性癌細胞の分化制御を検討した基礎研究である。
pmid-6683658.summary_en: Retinol was found to induce in vitro differentiation of several murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, detected by morphology, surface antigens, and plasminogen activator secretion. Effects were seen at concentrations as low as 0.025 µg/ml. Only two of eight EC lines failed to respond, including a line dying at high retinol doses and a retinoic acid-unresponsive mutant. The study models the differentiation of EC cells, the stem-like component of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6683709.summary_ja: 卵巣由来の非妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株IMaを樹立し、22回以上の継代で性状を解析した。細胞はhCGおよびそのサブユニットを分泌し、ハムスター頬嚢への移植で絨毛癌の組織像を示した。本細胞株は、非妊娠性と妊娠性の絨毛癌細胞の生物学的差異を検討するための有用なモデルとして、新たな研究基盤になると期待される。
pmid-6683709.summary_en: The authors established IMa, a nongestational choriocarcinoma cell line of ovarian origin, and characterized it over more than 22 passages. The cells secreted human chorionic gonadotropin and its subunits and formed choriocarcinoma when transplanted into hamster cheek pouches. The line is proposed as a useful model for comparing biological differences between nongestational and gestational choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6683765.summary_ja: 1957年から1979年に治療された絨毛癌165例のうち111例に肺転移があった。化学療法で治癒せず、新たに定めた基準を満たした患者に肺手術を行い、全例が初回完全寛解に至り、3年生存率は80%であった。著者らは、尿中hCG値が70〜80日間1000 IU/l未満で持続する時点で肺手術を行うことを提唱している。
pmid-6683765.summary_en: Among 165 choriocarcinoma patients treated from 1957 to 1979, 111 had pulmonary metastases. Pulmonary surgery was performed on patients not cured by chemotherapy who met newly established criteria, and all achieved primary complete remission with a 3-year survival of 80%. The authors suggest that lung surgery is appropriate when urinary hCG remains below 1000 IU/L for 70-80 days.

pmid-6684174.summary_ja: 外科的病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣症例138例のうち、12例(9%)が精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の約9か月後に再発し、大半は肺であった。再発例の6例は救済され無病生存を維持している。陰嚢手術歴や原発腫瘍の進展度、肉腫成分は有意なリスク因子ではなかった。胎児性癌では奇形癌より再発率が高い傾向があったが、有意差はなかった。
pmid-6684174.summary_en: In 138 patients with surgical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis, 12 (9%) relapsed on average 9 months after orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, mostly in the lungs. Six of these were salvaged and remain disease-free. Scrotal surgery, extent of primary tumor, and sarcomatous elements were not significant risk factors. Recurrence with embryonal carcinoma was higher than teratocarcinoma but not significant.

pmid-6684188.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の患者54例（精巣39例、性腺外15例）に、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる化学療法の後、腫瘍縮小手術を施行した。精巣原発例の多くは完全寛解に至ったが、性腺外原発例では15例中4例のみが中央値40か月間寛解を維持した。手術時の残存病変は両群で多く見られた。著者らは、本レジメンは精巣腫瘍の大部分を治癒させるが、性腺外原発腫瘍には不十分であると結論づけている。
pmid-6684188.summary_en: Fifty-four patients with disseminated germ cell cancer (39 testicular, 15 extragonadal) received vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin followed by tumor-reductive surgery. Most testicular patients achieved complete remission, while only 4 of 15 extragonadal patients maintained remission for a median of 40 months. Residual disease at surgery was common in both groups. The authors conclude that the regimen cures most testicular disease but is inadequate for primary extragonadal tumors.

pmid-6684416.summary_ja: 21歳以下の245例にみられた奇形腫254個を54年間にわたり検討した。好発部位は仙骨尾骨部と卵巣であった。未熟奇形腫は成熟奇形腫より大きかった。初回手術での完全切除が最も重要な予後因子であり、不完全切除例は全例死亡した。著者らは完全切除を第一選択とし、補助療法は部位と年齢に応じて個別化すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-6684416.summary_en: This 54-year review of 254 teratomas in 245 patients aged 21 or younger found the most common sites were sacrococcygeal and ovarian. Immature tumors were larger than mature ones. Complete surgical resection at initial operation was the most important prognostic factor, and no patient with incomplete resection survived. The authors conclude that complete resection is the treatment of choice and that adjuvant therapy should be individualized by site and age.

pmid-6684500.summary_ja: 1957年から1981年に妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍782例を治療し、69例(8.8%)に中枢神経系転移が生じた。1974年以降は、初診時に中枢神経系病変を有した群の全生存期間(全生存率)が80%、後に発症した群は25%に改善した。髄腔内メトトレキサートによる予防、脳脊髄液と血清のhCG比およびコンピュータ断層撮影による早期発見、全身療法と髄腔内療法の併用が治療成功の要因とされている。
pmid-6684500.summary_en: Among 782 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors treated at Charing Cross Hospital from 1957 to 1981, 69 (8.8%) developed CNS metastases. Overall survival was 49% for patients presenting with CNS disease and 6% for those who developed it later, improving after 1974 to 80% and 25%. Key management elements included intrathecal methotrexate prophylaxis, early detection using CSF/serum hCG ratio and CT, and combined systemic and intrathecal therapy.

pmid-6684670.summary_ja: 本研究は、7種類のヒト絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、メトトレキサート(MTX)に対する感受性と耐性機序をin vitroで検討したものです。MTX感受性の高い株は、耐性株に比べて3H-MTXの取り込みが多く、細胞内のジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素活性が低いことが示されました。薬剤の取り込みと酵素活性が、絨毛癌の化学療法耐性に関わることを示唆しています。
pmid-6684670.summary_en: This 1983 in vitro study examined seven human choriocarcinoma cell lines to determine their sensitivity to methotrexate (MTX) and the mechanisms underlying resistance. Lines with greater MTX sensitivity incorporated more radiolabeled MTX and had lower intracellular dihydrofolate reductase activity than resistant lines. The findings link drug uptake and enzyme levels to chemoresistance in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6684671.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとSCHを用いて、メトトレキサート(MTX)とアクチノマイシンDの細胞傷害性を解析したin vitro研究です。MTX耐性のBeWo株も作製され、薬剤の取り込み低下が確認されました。アクチノマイシンDはMTXより低濃度で強い致死的傷害を与え、シトロボラムファクターはMTXの取り込みを減少させて増殖抑制を妨げました。
pmid-6684671.summary_en: This 1983 in vitro study analyzed the cytotoxicity of methotrexate and actinomycin-D in choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and SCH. It also generated an MTX-resistant BeWo subline with reduced MTX transport. Actinomycin-D was far more potent, and citrovorum factor given early after MTX reduced drug transport and inhibited MTX-induced growth suppression.

pmid-6684899.summary_ja: 本研究は、免疫賦活剤OK-432とPSKが絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1およびGCH-2に直接抗腫瘍作用を示すかをin vitroで検討したものです。両薬剤の増殖抑制効果は非常に弱く、IC50はメトトレキサートやアクチノマイシンDより大幅に高値でした。著者らは、in vivoでの直接的な抗腫瘍効果は臨床的に無視できると考察しています。
pmid-6684899.summary_en: This study tested whether the immunopotentiators OK-432 and PSK have direct antitumor activity against two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, GCH-1 and GCH-2, in vitro. Both agents showed very weak growth inhibition, with IC50 values far higher than those of methotrexate and actinomycin D. Changes in culture-medium hCG paralleled those seen with the chemotherapy drugs. The authors concluded that direct antitumor effects in vivo are likely clinically negligible.

pmid-6684984.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移36例(うち剖検30例)を対象とした臨床病理学的研究です。多くの病変は神経外科的に切除可能でした。1965年のダクチノマイシン導入後、手術を受けた群で6か月以上生存する例が増えました。頭蓋内圧亢進には早期の減圧を行い、その後に多剤化学療法と全脳照射を行うことを推奨しています。
pmid-6684984.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study of 36 patients with choriocarcinoma brain metastases, including autopsy data from 30 cases, found most lesions were neurosurgically resectable. Survival beyond six months after neurologic symptoms improved after dactinomycin became available in 1965, mainly in surgically treated patients. The authors recommend immediate decompression for raised intracranial pressure, followed by multidrug chemotherapy with whole-brain irradiation.

pmid-6685113.summary_ja: 本研究は、8種類のヒト絨毛癌細胞株を、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分泌能に基づいて比較したものです。hCGを高分泌する株では、多核巨細胞や拡張した粗面小胞体が認められ、核DNAは倍数体側に偏っていました。一方、倍加時間とhCG分泌能との間に相関はなく、両者は独立した特徴であることが示されました。
pmid-6685113.summary_en: This study characterized eight human choriocarcinoma cell lines according to hCG secretion. Lines secreting high hCG showed multinucleated syncytiotrophoblast-like cells, abundant dilated rough endoplasmic reticulum, aggregated glycogen, and nuclear DNA shifted toward hyperploidy with S-phase accumulation. Doubling time did not correlate with hCG secretion, indicating that secretory capacity and growth rate are independent features.

pmid-6685427.summary_ja: 本総説は、男性胚細胞腫瘍の治療の変遷をまとめたものです。かつての一律な手術・放射線療法から、組織型、病期、血清腫瘍マーカーに基づく個別化治療へと移行したと述べています。治癒率はセミノーマで約95%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で約80%と報告されています。
pmid-6685427.summary_en: This American Family Physician review summarizes the management of male germ cell tumors. It notes that treatment has shifted from uniform surgery and radiation toward individualized therapy based on histology, stage, and serum tumor markers. The article reports cure rates of about 95 percent for seminomas and 80 percent for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-6685797.summary_ja: 本研究は、初期胚細胞のモデルとして用いられたヒト卵巣奇形癌細胞株PA 1のステロイド代謝を解析したものです。細胞は主にプロゲステロンを代謝し、エストラジオールをエストロンへ変換しました。一方、アンドロゲンからのエストロゲン合成は認められず、未分化な細胞はステロイド産生能を持たないと考察されています。
pmid-6685797.summary_en: This 1983 study examined steroid metabolism in the human ovarian teratocarcinoma line PA 1, used as a model of early embryonic cells. The cells metabolized progesterone mainly to 3β,6α-dihydroxy-5α-pregnan-20-one and converted estradiol to estrone, but did not form estradiol or estrone from androgens. The authors conclude that undifferentiated PA 1 cells are not steroidogenic but can metabolize steroids.

pmid-6687145.summary_ja: 1983年に発表された日本の研究で、1967年から1976年の病理解剖症例報告に記載された精巣悪性腫瘍1,437例を解析した。このうち417例は精巣胚細胞がん、1,027例は続発性腫瘍であった。単一組織型の胚細胞腫瘍369例について、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫、奇形癌、絨毛癌の転移様式を比較したところ、絨毛癌は遠隔転移に有意な差を示した。著者らは、セミノーマ、絨毛癌、胎児性癌と奇形癌・奇形腫の3群への分類を提案している。
pmid-6687145.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese review analyzed 1,437 testicular malignancies from the Annual of Pathological Autopsy Cases in Japan (1967-1976). Of these, 417 were germinal testicular cancers and 1,027 were secondary tumors. Among 369 germ cell tumors with a single histological type, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, teratocarcinoma, and choriocarcinoma were compared by metastatic pattern. Choriocarcinoma differed significantly in distant metastasis. The authors proposed three groups: seminoma, choriocarcinoma, and embryonal carcinoma with teratocarcinoma and teratoma.

pmid-6687285.summary_ja: 縦隔に胎児性横紋筋肉腫と良性奇形腫が併存した症例の報告。全切片で両成分は明瞭に分離していた。肉腫が奇形腫から生じたのではなく、独立に発生した2腫瘍が融合した衝突腫瘍と解釈された。
pmid-6687285.summary_en: This 1983 pediatric pathology report describes a case of mediastinal embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma coexisting with a benign teratoma. Histologic sections showed the two components as distinctly separate throughout the tumor. The authors interpreted this as two independently developing tumors that fused into a collision tumor, rather than a sarcoma arising from within a benign teratoma.

pmid-6688628.summary_ja: 右卵巣の未熟奇形腫の術後にVCR・ACT-D・CPAの多剤化学療法を10クールほど受けた後、左卵巣に嚢胞性腫瘍が出現した。セカンドルック手術で完全な成熟奇形腫と確認された。化学療法は成熟奇形腫の発育に影響せず、成熟成分は細胞傷害薬に抵抗性であると結論づけた。
pmid-6688628.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese gynecology report describes a mature ovarian teratoma that developed in the left ovary during postoperative multidrug chemotherapy for a right immature ovarian teratoma. The left ovary appeared normal at first surgery, but a cystic tumor appeared after ten courses of vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide. Second-look surgery confirmed a fully mature teratoma. The authors concluded that chemotherapy did not affect mature teratoma development, which is resistant to cytotoxic agents.

pmid-6821771.summary_ja: 18か月の男児に発生した心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。CT、核医学、血管造影は術前評価で非特異的だった。確定診断には開胸による切除と組織学的検討が必要であった。切除により長期予後は良好であった。
pmid-6821771.summary_en: This 1983 Canadian surgical report describes an 18-month-old boy with an intrapericardial teratoma successfully treated by surgical resection. The authors note that imaging modalities such as CT, radionuclide scanning, and angiography are nonspecific for preoperative assessment of intrapericardial masses. Definitive diagnosis required thoracotomy and histopathologic examination of the resected specimen. Long-term prognosis was good after complete resection.

pmid-6821773.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の心臓転移を切除しえた初の症例と考えられる報告。精巣摘除術の9年後、32歳男性に右房腫瘍が出現した。6年前に見つかった転移の既往から、粘液腫より転移が疑われた。組織学的に原発と転移巣は一致した。腫瘍切除後の経過は順調であった。
pmid-6821773.summary_en: This 1983 Canadian report describes what the authors believe is the first successfully resected case of embryonal carcinoma of the testis metastasizing to the heart. Nine years after orchiectomy, a 32-year-old man presented with a right atrial tumor. Because of prior testicular cancer and a metastasis found six years earlier, cardiac metastasis was suspected over a myxoma. Histology matched the original embryonal carcinoma and metastasis. The patient recovered smoothly after removal.

pmid-6821820.summary_ja: 両側卵巣に発生し多発転移を来した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の報告。既報の転移例は17例のみである。光顕と電顕で甲状腺の乳頭状・濾胞状混合癌に類似した。甲状腺原発癌を除外する必要があり、電顕は類カルチノイドや漿液性腺癌との鑑別に有用であると結論した。
pmid-6821820.summary_en: This 1983 Cancer report describes malignant struma ovarii involving both ovaries with multiple metastases, a rare entity with only 17 previously reported metastatic cases. Light and electron microscopy resembled mixed papillary and follicular thyroid carcinoma. Ultrastructural features included microvilli, oncocytic change, and colloid. The authors concluded that the diagnosis requires excluding a primary thyroid carcinoma and that electron microscopy helps distinguish it from strumal carcinoid and serous adenocarcinoma.

pmid-6821822.summary_ja: 精巣がん108例中26例で鎖骨上窩リンパ節生検を前向きに施行した研究。生検例の36%に転移を認めた。触診異常例では90%が組織学的に転移陽性であった。触診正常例の転移陽性率は6.3%と低く、精巣がんの病期分類で無差別な生検は不要と結論した。
pmid-6821822.summary_en: This 1983 Cancer study prospectively evaluated supraclavicular node biopsy in staging testicular carcinoma. Of 108 patients undergoing therapy, 26 had supraclavicular biopsy. Metastatic disease was found in 36% of biopsied patients, most of them with abnormal clinical examinations. Among 16 patients with normal examinations, only 6.3% had occult metastases. The authors concluded that routine indiscriminate supraclavicular biopsy is not justified in testicular cancer staging.

pmid-6821841.summary_ja: 脾腫と汎血球減少を呈した22歳女性の症例。脾摘時に見つかった左卵巣腫瘍はディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)と診断された。ゴーシェ病の診断も併せて得られた。腫瘍間質にもゴーシェ細胞の特徴的な細胞質縞模様を示す組織球が出現した。ゴーシェ病と悪性腫瘍の合併は稀である。
pmid-6821841.summary_en: This 1983 Cancer case report describes a 22-year-old woman with splenomegaly and pancytopenia, who was found to have Gaucher's disease. A left ovarian tumor found during splenectomy was diagnosed as dysgerminoma, showing monotonous diffuse proliferation of large round cells. Histiocytes with Gaucher-type cytoplasmic striations also appeared in the tumor stroma. The authors noted that the association between Gaucher's disease and malignant tumors is rare.

pmid-6821870.summary_ja: 1969～1978年に治療されたstage C非セミノーマ性精巣がん25例の肺転移完全切除後の生存を解析した研究。5年生存率は59%であった。腫瘍量が少ないこと、転移巣に成熟奇形腫を含むことなどが予後良好因子であった。肺転移切除を含む集学的治療の有効性を支持した。
pmid-6821870.summary_en: This 1983 Cancer study analyzed survival after complete resection of pulmonary metastases in 25 stage C nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma patients treated from 1969 to 1978. Actuarial survival was 80%, 63%, and 59% at one, two, and five years. Favorable prognostic factors included low tumor burden and the presence of mature teratoma in metastases, along with few mitoses and lack of desmoplasia. The authors supported multimodality therapy that includes pulmonary metastasectomy.

pmid-6822679.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生したと考えられる神経芽細胞腫の症例を報告している。著者らは卵巣の神経腫瘍に関する文献を概説し、このような腫瘍は完全に成熟した奇形腫の悪性転化ではなく、奇形腫内の未熟な神経上皮成分の存在を示すものと考察している。卵巣奇形腫に伴う神経系悪性腫瘍の発生機序を考える上で示唆に富む報告である。
pmid-6822679.summary_en: The authors describe a neuroblastoma that appeared to arise within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. They briefly review the literature on neural tumours of the ovary. They argue that such neoplasms likely reflect immature neuroepithelial components within the teratoma rather than malignant transformation of a fully mature teratoma. The report contributes to understanding the pathogenesis of neural malignancies arising in ovarian teratomas and emphasizes the importance of identifying immature neural elements during pathological evaluation.

pmid-6823354.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ患者の血清乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）値を検討した研究である。治療前には明らかに上昇し、治療後には正常値まで低下したことから、LDHは本疾患の診断と治療における有用な腫瘍マーカーとなりうると述べている。以前の研究では、他の骨盤内腫瘍ではLDHが上昇しないことも示されていた。胚細胞腫瘍の管理に関わるマーカーの報告である。
pmid-6823354.summary_en: The author measured serum lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) in patients with ovarian dysgerminoma. Previous studies had shown LDH elevated in primary ovarian carcinoma but not in other pelvic tumours. In this study, LDH was markedly elevated before treatment and fell to normal levels after treatment, suggesting that LDH may serve as an important tumour marker for diagnosing and monitoring ovarian dysgerminoma. The report is a brief clinical study of a marker relevant to germ cell tumour management.

pmid-6823396.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌で肝転移を有する患者が、全肝照射を併用した全身化学療法中に肝内出血を来した症例を報告している。肝転移例では腫瘍壊死による出血のリスクがあるが、報告が少なくその程度は不明である。放射線療法は出血を完全には防げなかったと述べ、リスク評価と最適な治療法確立のための症例報告を呼びかけている。
pmid-6823396.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma and liver metastases who developed intrahepatic bleeding during systemic chemotherapy combined with whole-liver irradiation. They note that patients with trophoblastic liver metastases are at risk of haemorrhage from tumour necrosis during chemotherapy, but that the risk is poorly defined given few reported cases. Radiotherapy did not fully prevent haemorrhage, and the authors call for further reports to clarify risk and define the role of adjuvant radiation and optimal protocols.

pmid-6823401.summary_ja: 30歳女性と10歳の思春期前女児に生じた、ヒト身体様の部分構造（ホムンクルス）を含む良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の2例を報告している。ホムンクルスは小型の下半身様構造で、発達した骨軟骨性の骨格を有していた。英文文献では、これまでこの胎児様奇形腫は17例しか報告されていないとしている。文献レビューも含む症例報告である。
pmid-6823401.summary_en: The authors describe two benign ovarian cystic teratomas, each containing a partial human body-like structure called a homunculus. One occurred in a 30-year-old woman and the other in a prepubertal 10-year-old girl. Each homunculus resembled the lower half of a miniature body, with buttocks, legs, feet, and a phallus-like midline structure, and contained a well-developed osteocartilaginous skeleton. The paper reviews the literature on these fetiform teratomas, of which only 17 previous cases had been reported in English.

pmid-6824868.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者100例で血清PLAPを二重抗体放射免疫測定法により測定した研究である。原発例の9/21例、再発・転移例の9/12例で上昇し、進行病変での感度は55%であった。治療成功後にはPLAPが低下し、多くの症例で腫瘍量と並行して変動した。セミノーマの新たな腫瘍マーカーとして、またフォローアップに有用と示唆している。
pmid-6824868.summary_en: The authors measured serum placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in 100 patients with seminoma using a specific double antibody radioimmunoassay. PLAP was elevated in 9 of 21 patients with primary tumours and in 9 of 12 with recurrent or metastatic disease, giving an overall sensitivity of 55% for primary and advanced disease. After successful treatment, PLAP levels fell, and in many patients they paralleled tumour burden. The authors suggest PLAP may be a useful new marker for seminomatous disease and for follow-up.

pmid-6825066.summary_ja: 47,XXYのクラインフェルター症候群を有する18歳男性の縦隔胎児性癌について、トリプシン・ギムザ法により腫瘍細胞の染色体を解析した。検討した全30細胞がXXYパターンに追加染色体を伴っていた。腫瘍と赤血球の電気泳動パターンが一致し、同一個体由来であることが示された。腫瘍は減数分裂前の原始胚細胞で発がんが起きたものと結論づけている。
pmid-6825066.summary_en: The authors performed trypsin-Giemsa banding on tumour cells from a mediastinal embryonal cell carcinoma in an 18-year-old male with Klinefelter syndrome (47,XXY). All 30 tumour cells examined showed an XXY pattern with additional chromosomes. Electrophoretic patterns of tumour and red blood cells were identical, confirming the tumour arose from the patient. The authors conclude that this germ cell tumour originated from a primordial germ cell in which oncogenesis occurred before meiosis.

pmid-6825099.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株6種がフィブロネクチンを合成・分泌するかを検討した。2株では合成が認められず、他の株では合成された。細胞膜上にはフィブロネクチンは検出されず、細胞質内には存在した。分泌されたフィブロネクチンは線維芽細胞や血漿由来のものより見かけの分子量が大きく、糖鎖修飾の違いが示唆されている。
pmid-6825099.summary_en: The authors studied fibronectin synthesis and secretion in six human germ cell tumour cell lines, including Tera 1, Tera 2, and PA-1. Two lines, LICR LON HT 39/7 and Tera 1, did not synthesise fibronectin, whereas the others did. Plasma membrane fibronectin was not detected, though cytoplasmic fibronectin was present. Secreted germ cell tumour fibronectin had a higher apparent molecular weight than fibroblast or plasma fibronectin, while peptide maps were similar, suggesting differences in glycosylation.

pmid-6828735.summary_ja: 精巣がん21例を対象に、骨盤部リンパシンチグラフィの有用性を検討した1983年の研究です。非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の病理所見と比較して感度0.89、特異度0.83でした。セミノーマでも他の画像検査とよく一致しました。リンパ節転移の検出に感度の高い方法であると結論づけています。
pmid-6828735.summary_en: This 1983 Radiology study evaluated iliopelvic radionuclide lymphoscintigraphy in 21 patients with testicular cancer, including six with seminoma and 15 with nonseminoma. Normal scans showed symmetric lymphatic uptake, while abnormalities included reduced uptake along lymph node chains. In nonseminomatous germ cell cancer, scintigraphy compared with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection pathology showed a sensitivity of 0.89 and specificity of 0.83. In seminoma, scan findings correlated well with other radiologic tests. The authors conclude that lymphoscintigraphy is a sensitive method for detecting lymph node metastases in testicular cancer.

pmid-6829636.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の除去後738例を長期追跡し、hCG測定に基づくフォローアップの自然経過を検討した1983年の研究です。80.8%が自然退縮し、19.2%は化学療法を要しました。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌を含む治療例はすべて寛解し、4〜18年後も無病でした。安全な管理法として有用性が示されています。
pmid-6829636.summary_en: This 1983 study followed 738 patients with hydatidiform mole after primary evacuation at a trophoblastic disease center, with follow-up hCG testing. Spontaneous regression occurred in 80.8 percent, mostly within 60 days. Chemotherapy was required in 19.2 percent, including invasive mole and choriocarcinoma cases. All treated patients achieved permanent remission, and all patients were disease-free 4 to 18 years later. The authors propose this follow-up regimen as a safe approach to managing patients after molar pregnancy evacuation, providing insight into the natural history of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6830691.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞を尾側と頭側の部位に移植し、解剖学的位置が生着と増殖に与える影響を検討した1983年の研究です。尾側では生着率が高く、頭側では初期腫瘍重量が大きいことが分かりました。確立後の増殖速度は部位によらず同じでした。局所因子は腫瘍の初期生着に影響するものの、増殖には影響しませんでした。
pmid-6830691.summary_en: This 1983 British Journal of Cancer study injected murine embryonal carcinoma cells, the pluripotent stem cells of teratocarcinoma, into caudal and cranial sites on syngeneic mice to test whether anatomical location affects tumor growth. Caudal sites showed higher tumor take rates, while cranial tumors had greater initial weight. Tumors at both sites grew at similar linear rates, and by four weeks the size difference was negligible with no histological differences. Regional factors influenced early establishment but not the growth rate of established tumors.

pmid-6832228.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の胚様体に含まれる胎児性癌細胞の核小体様構造を観察した1983年の研究です。未分化細胞では小さく、分化開始時に有意に拡大しました。間葉系・内皮系へ分化すると、大きさと数が著明に減少しました。胎児性癌細胞の分化過程での役割が示唆されています。
pmid-6832228.summary_en: This 1983 Experimental Cell Research study examined nucleolus-like bodies in embryonal carcinoma cells from embryoid bodies derived from mouse teratocarcinoma. Undifferentiated EC cells contained small nucleolus-like bodies, whose size significantly increased at the onset of differentiation. When cells differentiated into mesenchymal and endothelial cells, these bodies decreased markedly in both size and number. The findings suggest a possible role for nucleolus-like bodies in the differentiation process of embryonal carcinoma cells, although their precise function remains to be determined.

pmid-6832476.summary_ja: F9奇形癌細胞とマウス胸腺細胞のハイブリッドを作製し、生じた腫瘍を解析した1983年の研究です。全クローンが胎児性癌に加え分化組織を含む腫瘍を形成しました。親株のF9細胞では見られなかった多分化能が、胸腺細胞との融合で発現することが示されました。
pmid-6832476.summary_en: This 1983 Developmental Biology study generated hybrids between F9 nullipotent teratocarcinoma cells and mouse thymus cells, then examined the tumors they produced in mice. All seven hybrid clones formed tumors containing differentiated tissues alongside embryonal carcinoma, unlike the parental F9 cells, which formed only embryonal carcinoma. Five clones differentiated into derivatives of all three primitive germ layers. Ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm derivatives were observed in most examined sections. The authors conclude that hybridization with thymus cells restored pluripotency blocked in F9 teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6833581.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた先天性眼窩奇形腫の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と単純X線所見を提示し、この稀な腫瘍の特徴的な画像所見を検討しています。腫瘍進展の評価には術前CTが有用であると強調されています。眼窩は頭蓋外であり、中枢神経原発ではありません。
pmid-6833581.summary_en: This 1983 Journal of Computer Assisted Tomography report describes a neonate with a congenital orbital teratoma. The authors present computed tomography and plain radiographic findings and discuss the characteristic imaging features of this rare tumor. They emphasize the value of preoperative CT in assessing the extent of tumor involvement. Because the orbit is extracranial, the case falls within the scope of non-CNS teratoma. The report serves as a radiological reference for clinicians evaluating similar congenital lesions in newborns and infants.

pmid-6833816.summary_ja: 51歳女性の両側卵巣に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫が、それぞれ独立して悪性化した稀な症例の報告です。右側は扁平上皮癌と小さな腺癌成分、左側は扁平上皮癌でした。円柱上皮からの扁平上皮化生を経て、その場で悪性化したと考えられています。両側は各嚢胞内容物の局所発がん因子により独立して生じたと推察されています。
pmid-6833816.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese obstetrics and gynecology report describes a 51-year-old woman with malignant degeneration arising separately in benign cystic teratomas of both ovaries. The right tumor contained squamous cell carcinoma with a small adenocarcinoma component, while the left tumor was pure squamous cell carcinoma. Histological examination showed squamous metaplasia of columnar epithelium progressing to in situ malignant change in both cysts. The authors suggest that the two malignancies developed independently, likely from local carcinogenic agents within each cyst's contents.

pmid-6834506.summary_ja: 34年間に精巣腫瘍で治療された小児12例を検討した1983年の研究です。良性8例の多くは精巣摘除術で治療され、悪性4例も精巣摘除術に加え、1例で化学療法が追加されました。全例が生存し再発はありませんでした。思春期前の精巣腫瘍は進行が穏やかで、精巣摘除術単独でも治癒が期待できると述べています。
pmid-6834506.summary_en: This 1983 Journal of Urology study reviewed 12 children treated for testicular tumors over 34 years. Eight benign tumors were managed mostly by orchiectomy, with one treated by local excision. Four malignant tumors were treated with orchiectomy, and one boy also received adjunctive chemotherapy. All patients survived with no recurrence after 1.5 to 34 years of follow-up. The authors note that prepubertal testicular tumors are usually less aggressive, so orchiectomy alone offers good cure chances, but close observation is essential because of metastatic potential.

pmid-6834553.summary_ja: 1歳男児が血尿で受診し、膀胱に大きな有茎性腫瘤を認めた。光学顕微鏡・電子顕微鏡および免疫組織化学により卵黄嚢（内胚葉洞）腫瘍と診断された。英文文献で報告された原発性膀胱卵黄嚢腫瘍の初例であり、性腺外に発生する胚細胞腫瘍として小児の膀胱腫瘤の鑑別に重要である。
pmid-6834553.summary_en: A 1-year-old boy presented with hematuria and a large polypoid bladder mass. Light and electron microscopy plus immunohistochemistry established a diagnosis of yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumor. This was the first reported primary yolk sac tumor of the bladder in the English literature. The report shows that germ cell tumor components can arise outside the gonads, which is relevant to the differential diagnosis of bladder masses in children.

pmid-6835174.summary_ja: 25歳男性の右精巣悪性奇形腫に対し精巣摘除と化学療法を行った。病期分類の手術所見は陰性だったが、骨髄への広範な浸潤と高カルシウム血症性腎症を来した。完全寛解後に癌性髄膜炎を発症し、剖検で死因と確認された。非典型的な転移(性)経過を示した症例である。
pmid-6835174.summary_en: A 25-year-old man had a right testicular malignant teratoma treated with orchidectomy and chemotherapy. Surgical staging was negative, and pulmonary metastasis did not occur. However, he developed massive bone marrow involvement with a bleeding tendency and hypercalcemic nephropathy. After complete remission, carcinomatous leptomeningitis developed and was confirmed at autopsy as the cause of death. The report highlights atypical metastatic spread of testicular teratoma despite an excellent chemotherapy response.

pmid-6836221.summary_ja: 18歳男性に、縦隔の悪性奇形腫と芽球期の骨髄増殖性疾患が併存した。リンパ節と脾臓では骨髄様化生がみられ、骨髄とリンパ節には顆粒球系芽球の浸潤があった。骨髄細胞は8番染色体のトリソミーを伴う異数性を示した。両疾患の併存は従来報告がない。
pmid-6836221.summary_en: An 18-year-old male presented with a blastic-phase myeloproliferative disorder and a coexisting mediastinal malignant teratoma. Myeloid metaplasia occurred in lymph nodes and spleen, with granulocytic blast infiltration of marrow and nodes. Bone marrow cells showed aneuploidy with trisomy 8. The authors note that this combination of myeloproliferative disorder and malignant teratoma had not previously been described.

pmid-6836826.summary_ja: 未分化セミノーマ14例を後方視的に解析した。病期分類ごとの予後は古典型セミノーマと同程度であった。組織像の特徴、局所浸潤の頻度、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)β鎖の上昇により古典型と区別される。転移(性)能が高い可能性があり、独立した病理亜型として扱うべきと結論づけている。
pmid-6836826.summary_en: Fourteen patients with anaplastic seminoma were retrospectively analyzed. Stage-for-stage prognosis was similar to that of classic seminoma. Distinguishing features included distinctive histology, frequent local invasion, and elevated serum beta-subunit hCG. The authors suggest a possibly greater metastatic potential and support continued recognition of anaplastic seminoma as a distinct pathologic subtype.

pmid-6841423.summary_ja: 早産中に急性腹症として発症した嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告である。術前には臨床的にも超音波検査でも診断されていなかった。著者らは、このような腫瘍が破局的な合併症を起こしうることを強調する。妊婦の腹部救急では、超音波検査が利用可能であっても従来のX線撮影が依然として必要であると指摘している。
pmid-6841423.summary_en: This case report describes a cystic ovarian teratoma that was not diagnosed before presenting as acute intra-abdominal disease during premature labor. The authors highlight the potentially catastrophic complications of such tumors. They also note that even with ultrasonography available, conventional radiography remains necessary for evaluating abdominal emergencies in pregnant women. The report underscores the need for broad imaging in obstetric patients with acute abdominal presentations.

pmid-6842694.summary_ja: 予後不良な進行セミノーマ(病期B3・C)に対し、放射線療法の前に化学療法を行うプロトコルの成績を報告する。ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドを用い、16例中15例(93.7%)で完全奏効が得られた。著者らは進行セミノーマ全例に放射線療法前化学療法が適応になると結論づけている。症例数が少ない報告である。
pmid-6842694.summary_en: This study reports a protocol using pre-radiation chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide for advanced seminoma, stages B3 and C, where survival had been poor. Of 16 patients treated, 15 (93.7%) achieved a complete response. The authors conclude that pre-radiation chemotherapy should be considered for all patients with advanced seminoma. The series is small, which limits how far the results can be generalized.

pmid-6842717.summary_ja: 病理学的に確認された精巣セミノーマの男性4例が、少なくとも7年間同一地域に居住していた空間的集積を報告する。全員に精巣がんの既知のリスク因子はなかった。当該地域には潜在的発がん物質の発生源が2か所あり、著者らは環境発がん物質への曝露が関与した可能性を示唆している。症例数が少ないため因果関係の判断には限界がある。
pmid-6842717.summary_en: This report describes a tight spatial cluster of four men with pathologically confirmed testicular seminomas who lived in the same neighborhood for at least seven years. None had known risk factors for testicular cancer. The area had two potential sources of carcinogens. The authors suggest that environmental carcinogen exposure may have contributed to these tumors. The small number of cases limits causal inference, but the study raises the question of environmental risk for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6844185.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性奇形腫の患者において、非乾酪性類上皮肉芽腫による縦隔リンパ節腫脹がサルコイドーシス様の所見を呈し、病期分類の検査で診断を難しくした症例を報告する。著者らは、サルコイドーシスと悪性腫瘍の関連が、リンパ節腫脹の診断や予後に関係しうると論じている。胚細胞腫瘍患者の肉芽腫性リンパ節所見は、病期評価を誤らせることがある。
pmid-6844185.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with malignant testicular teratoma whose mediastinal lymphadenopathy was caused by non-caseating epithelioid granulomas, mimicking sarcoidosis. This created diagnostic difficulty during staging investigation. The authors discuss the reported association between sarcoidosis and malignancy, noting its relevance to diagnosing lymphadenopathy and possibly to prognosis. The case shows that granulomatous lymph node findings in germ cell tumor patients may mislead staging assessment.

pmid-6844186.summary_ja: 成人の腎内奇形腫の1例を報告する短報である。腎内奇形腫は極めてまれとされる。性腺外の腎臓に生じた奇形腫であり、胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な発生部位を示す症例である。記述は簡潔で臨床的詳細は限られており、主に珍しい部位での奇形腫の発生を記録する意義がある。
pmid-6844186.summary_en: This brief report presents a case of intrarenal teratoma in an adult. Such tumors are described as extremely rare. Because the teratoma arose in the kidney, outside the gonads, it represents an extragonadal germ cell tumor presentation at an unusual site. The short format offers limited clinical detail, so the report mainly documents an uncommon anatomical location for teratoma.

pmid-6846501.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤型ALPに対する6種のモノクローナル抗体を用い、成人および胎児の精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のALPアイソザイムを検討した。胎盤型ALPはセミノーマと胎児性癌を含む腫瘍の一部で同定され、他の例では胎盤様型が認められた。腫瘍のALPは正常の胚細胞のALPと抗原性が異なる場合があり、腫瘍マーカーとしての意義を示唆する。
pmid-6846501.summary_en: This study uses six monoclonal antibodies against placental alkaline phosphatase to characterize ALP isozymes in adult and fetal testis and in testicular germ cell tumors. Placental ALP appeared in several seminomas and embryonal carcinoma-containing tumors, with placental-like forms in others. One yolk sac carcinoma also expressed placental ALP. The findings show that tumor ALP can differ antigenically from normal germ cell ALP, which may be relevant to tumor marker use.

pmid-6849356.summary_ja: 病理学的に確認された胞状奇胎で子宮を温存した194例を前向きに検討した。化学療法なしでhCG-βが正常化した群と、侵襲性合併症のため化学療法を要した群を比較した。50µg未満のエストロゲンを含む経口避妊薬と子宮内避妊器具は、hCG陽性期間の延長や侵襲性合併症の増加とは関連しなかった。一方、50µgを超える用量では合併症リスクが高く、避妊法の種類よりエストロゲン用量が影響すると示唆された。
pmid-6849356.summary_en: This prospective study followed 194 women with pathologically confirmed molar pregnancy and intact uteri. Women whose beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin normalized without chemotherapy were compared with those who developed invasive postmolar complications requiring chemotherapy. Oral contraceptives containing less than 50 micrograms of estrogen and intrauterine devices did not prolong the hCG-beta positive interval or increase invasive complications. Higher estrogen doses above 50 micrograms were associated with more complications, suggesting that estrogen dose rather than contraceptive type drives risk.

pmid-6854774.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者17例の陰嚢超音波像を病理所見と対比した。セミノーマと悪性リンパ腫は低エコーで均一、境界明瞭であった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍も低エコーだが、嚢胞状構造、音響陰影、実質に及ぶ不整な辺縁を示した。術前の評価や、触知しない精巣内腫瘍の検出、既往者の経過観察に有用である。
pmid-6854774.summary_en: The authors reviewed scrotal sonograms from 17 consecutive patients with testis tumors and correlated findings with histopathology. Seminomas and lymphomas appeared hypoechoic, homogeneous, and sharply demarcated. Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors were also hypoechoic but showed cystic spaces, acoustic shadowing, and irregular margins extending into the parenchyma. Ultrasound helps characterize scrotal masses before surgery, detects tumors in palpable normal testes, and monitors patients with prior testis tumors.

pmid-6854776.summary_ja: 1975年から1978年に診断された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣腫瘍208例を治療した。病期I・IIには後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、多くの病期II症例に補助化学療法を実施した。全体の治癒率は病期Aで96%、病期IIAで94%、病期IIBで83%、病期IIIで35%であった。再発と生存に影響した因子として、診断時病期、原発巣の進展、リンパ節分類、化学療法が挙げられた。
pmid-6854776.summary_en: The authors treated 208 patients with newly diagnosed nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis between 1975 and 1978. Stage I and II patients underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, with most stage II patients receiving adjuvant chemotherapy. Stage III and palpable stage II patients received initial chemotherapy with or without subsequent surgery. Overall cure rates were 96% for stage A, 94% for IIA, 83% for IIB, and 35% for stage III. Stage at diagnosis, primary tumor extent, nodal category, and chemotherapy influenced relapse and survival.

pmid-6854777.summary_ja: 本論文は、1979年までに文献報告された両側精巣腫瘍396例と著者ら自身の18例を総括した研究です。自施設の18例では、組織型が同一だったのは5例（セミノーマ4例、非セミノーマ1例）、異なったのは6例、悪性リンパ腫は7例でした。第2の腫瘍の治療は、発症間隔と組織学的分化度によって決まると述べています。両側性の胚細胞腫瘍の予後は不良ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-6854777.summary_en: This article reviews bilateral testicular tumors, combining 396 literature cases through 1979 with the authors' own 18 patients. In the authors' series, histology matched in five cases (seminoma in four, nonseminoma in one), differed in six, and malignant lymphoma occurred in seven. The authors discuss epidemiology, interval between tumors, histology, diagnosis, therapy and prognosis. Management of the second tumor depends on the interval and its histologic differentiation, while lymphomas require separate considerations. The authors conclude that bilateral germinal cell tumors do not have a poor prognosis.

pmid-6856482.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス奇形癌OTT6050を同系の129/Svマウスの皮下に移植し、エストロゲン、抗エストロゲン薬、卵巣摘出が腫瘍増殖に与える影響を検討しました。エストロゲン投与群は対照群より有意に速く増殖し、生存期間も短縮しました。抗エストロゲン薬は初期にのみ増殖を部分的に抑制しました。組織学的な分化像に群間差はなく、エストロゲンがこの奇形癌の増殖を促進すると結論づけています。
pmid-6856482.summary_en: This study examined how estrogen, antiestrogen and ovariectomy affect the in vivo growth of OTT6050, a mouse teratocarcinoma, transplanted subcutaneously into syngeneic 129/Sv mice. Tumor volume was measured over time. Estrogen-treated groups showed significantly faster growth than controls, with the gap widening over time, though no dose response was seen. Antiestrogen partially inhibited growth only early on, and estrogen-treated or ovariectomized mice had shorter survival than controls. Histology showed no specific differentiation differences between groups. The authors conclude that estrogen stimulates growth of this form of teratocarcinoma.

pmid-6857884.summary_ja: 1969年から1980年に、巨大セミノーマ18例（後腹膜17例、縦隔1例）に放射線療法を行った成績です。15例は縦隔と鎖骨上窩リンパ節への補助照射を受け、1例は補助化学療法を受けました。最終フォローアップ時に18例中17例（94%）が無病生存し、治療関連の重篤な合併症や死亡はありませんでした。
pmid-6857884.summary_en: This report describes 18 patients with bulky seminoma, 17 with retroperitoneal and one with mediastinal disease, treated with radiation therapy between 1969 and 1980. One patient underwent resection of retroperitoneal disease and one resection of mediastinal disease. Fifteen received adjuvant irradiation to the mediastinum and paraclavicular nodes, and one received adjuvant chemotherapy. At last follow-up, 17 of 18 patients (94%) were disease-free, with no treatment-related morbidity or mortality. The results indicate a high disease-free rate with radiation-based treatment for bulky seminoma.

pmid-6859385.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清中に、早期妊娠因子（EPF）様物質（tEPF）が検出されることを報告しています。非セミノーマ11例全例と、セミノーマ10例中5例で検出されました。健常男性、胚細胞腫瘍以外の腫瘍の患者、良性精巣疾患では検出されませんでした。tEPFは既存マーカーで捉えきれない胚細胞腫瘍を検出する、新たな血清マーカーとなりうると述べています。
pmid-6859385.summary_en: This study detected an early pregnancy factor-like substance (tEPF) in sera of patients with testicular germ cell tumors. tEPF, or its free components tEPF-A and tEPF-B, was found in all 11 patients with nonseminomatous tumors and in 5 of 10 with seminoma. It was absent in healthy male controls and in patients with non-germ cell tumors or benign testicular disease. The authors suggest tEPF may serve as an additional serum marker for germ cell tumors and may extend the range of tumors detectable by existing markers.

pmid-6860009.summary_ja: 胎児心エコーで子宮内に疑われた、心膜内の良性奇形腫の新生児例を報告しています。胎児期に診断されたため、心肺症状が出現する前に手術を行えました。腫瘍は完全切除され、術後3か月時点で無症状でした。胎児心エコーが心膜内奇形腫の早期診断に有用であることを示しています。
pmid-6860009.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with an intrapericardial benign teratoma suspected in utero by fetal echocardiography. Early prenatal diagnosis enabled surgical treatment before cardiopulmonary distress developed. The tumor was completely excised, and the infant remained asymptomatic three months after surgery. The report highlights fetal echocardiography as an effective approach for early diagnosis of intrapericardial teratomas in newborns, permitting timely intervention.

pmid-6861115.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の悪性奇形腫が播種し、骨髄に浸潤した1症例の報告です。浸潤した骨髄から、他の染色体異常とともに5q-異常が見つかりました。第二の悪性腫瘍は認められず、この5q-異常は悪性奇形腫細胞に関連していると考えられています。播種性胚細胞腫瘍における細胞遺伝学的所見の報告です。
pmid-6861115.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a highly malignant teratoma originally arising in the mediastinum, in whom infiltrated bone marrow showed a 5q- anomaly along with other chromosome abnormalities. No evidence of a second malignancy was found, suggesting the 5q- anomaly was associated with the malignant teratoma cells. The study links a cytogenetic change to disseminated mediastinal teratoma, providing a genetic observation in a disseminated germ cell tumor. It is a single-case cytogenetic report.

pmid-6861901.summary_ja: マウス線維芽細胞株STOをフィーダー細胞として用いた培養で得られた馴化培地が、胎児性癌（EC）細胞の分化を制御するかを検討したin vitro研究です。フィーダーから細胞を離す操作、またはレチノイン酸処理で誘導されるEC細胞の分化が、この馴化培地により阻害されました。フィーダー由来の分泌因子がEC細胞の未分化状態の維持に関与することを示唆しています。
pmid-6861901.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether medium conditioned by STO mouse fibroblast feeder cells affects embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell differentiation. Feeder cells are used to keep certain EC cells undifferentiated. The authors show that conditioned medium inhibits EC differentiation induced either by removing cells from feeders or, for cells not normally requiring feeders, by retinoic acid treatment. The finding indicates that feeder-derived secreted factors help maintain EC cells in an undifferentiated state.

pmid-6862073.summary_ja: 原発性無月経を呈した思春期女性の症例です。片側の大きな卵巣腫瘍を開腹手術で摘出し、純粋なディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）と診断されました。染色体分析でXY性腺異形成が判明しました。診断、予後、治療法について文献的な検討も行われています。
pmid-6862073.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent with primary amenorrhea and a large unilateral ovarian tumor. Laparotomy and histology revealed a pure dysgerminoma. Further gynecological-endocrinological evaluation and chromosome analysis showed XY gonadal dysgenesis. The report also reviews current approaches to diagnosis, prognosis, and the controversial therapeutic options for this tumor in the setting of gonadal dysgenesis. It highlights the association between dysgerminoma and XY gonadal dysgenesis, which requires careful evaluation and management.

pmid-6862290.summary_ja: 非上皮性卵巣悪性腫瘍20例のエストロゲン受容体（ERc）とプロゲステロン受容体（PRc）を測定した研究です。胚細胞腫瘍9例ではERcが低値で、対側卵巣摘出の影響を受けないという臨床的知見と一致しました。一方、混合中胚葉腫瘍や顆粒膜細胞腫瘍の一部では高いERcが認められ、ホルモン療法の検討が示唆されています。卵黄嚢腫瘍も1例含まれます。
pmid-6862290.summary_en: This study measured estrogen (ERc) and progestin (PRc) receptor proteins in 20 patients with nonepithelial ovarian malignancies, including nine germ cell tumors and one endodermal sinus tumor. Germ cell malignancies had low ERc levels, consistent with clinical observations that their growth is not influenced by removal of the contralateral ovary. Some mixed mesodermal and granulosa cell tumors had high ERc levels, suggesting that hormone-related therapy should be investigated for these malignancies.

pmid-6863318.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト奇形癌細胞株2102Epに存在する糖脂質を解析した。グロボシリーズの糖脂質が複数同定され、その一部はSSEA-3に対するモノクローナル抗体と反応し、特に構造cで反応性が最も強かった。SSEA-1も糖脂質であることと合わせ、細胞表面糖脂質が胚発生における分化抗原として重要な役割を果たすことが示唆された。
pmid-6863318.summary_en: This 1983 study characterized globoseries glycosphingolipids in the cultured human teratocarcinoma cell line 2102Ep. The authors identified a series of globoside-derived structures built by serial addition of galactose, fucose, and sialic acid, which are unusual in human cells. Several of these glycolipids reacted with monoclonal antibody to stage-specific embryonic antigen 3 (SSEA-3), with structure c showing the strongest reactivity. Together with prior SSEA-1 findings, the results suggest that cell-surface glycolipids act as differentiation antigens during embryogenesis.

pmid-6863670.summary_ja: 精巣のセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性腫瘍57例のCT所見を検討した。23例に異常があり、そのうち10例で30HU未満の低吸収性リンパ節転移を認めた。化学療法後の低吸収病変では壊死や残存腫瘍が確認された一方、CT値と臨床的活動性との間に有意な相関はなかった。
pmid-6863670.summary_en: This 1983 study evaluated abdominal and thoracic computed tomography in 57 patients with seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Abnormal scans were found in 23 patients, and 10 of them had lymph node metastases with attenuation below 30 Hounsfield units. Most low-attenuation metastases occurred in seminoma and mixed germ cell tumors. Biopsies from some low-attenuation nodes showed necrosis, cystic spaces, or persistent tumor after chemotherapy. Attenuation did not correlate with clinical activity, so low density alone cannot reliably indicate treatment response.

pmid-6863924.summary_ja: 4種のヒト奇形癌細胞株を標的として、NK細胞および活性化キラー（AK）細胞による細胞傷害を比較した。NK細胞は標的を溶解できなかったが、AK細胞は高い細胞傷害性を示した。AKの標的は全株で共通し、MHCとは無関係で、正常リンパ球にはみられない胎児抗原の可能性が示された。
pmid-6863924.summary_en: This 1983 study examined four human teratocarcinoma cell lines as targets for natural killer (NK) and activated killer (AK) lymphocyte cytotoxicity. NK cells failed to lyse the targets, whereas alloactivated and mitogen-activated AK cells killed them efficiently. Cold target competition showed that the AK-recognized target was shared among all teratocarcinoma lines. It was not MHC-related and was absent from lymphoblastoid cells and normal lymphocytes. The authors suggest that unique fetal antigens on these tumor cells may provide a model for AK target specificity and differentiation.

pmid-6864028.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌などの栄養膜細胞について、顕微分光測光法により核DNA量を測定した。DNAピークの位置と分布範囲は疾患の重症度とよく相関し、主ピーク位置は胞状奇胎からの続発性栄養膜疾患の発生と有意に関連した。組織学的な悪性度分類は続発性疾患の予測には十分でなかった。
pmid-6864028.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese study measured nuclear DNA content of Feulgen-stained trophoblastic cells by microspectrophotometry. Samples came from normal pregnancies, missed abortions, hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and choriocarcinomas. The position of the main DNA peak and the range of distribution correlated with disease severity. The main peak position also significantly predicted secondary trophoblastic disease arising from hydatidiform mole. Histological grading of the mole did not correlate well with secondary disease.

pmid-6864899.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の2例で、残存精巣に2つ目の胚細胞腫瘍が生じた症例を検討した。側副循環や再生したリンパ節によりリンパ流が変化し、転移の評価が困難であった。広範な側副循環がある場合はリンパ節郭清や放射線療法は不適切であり、組織型によらず短期間の化学療法が最も安全な補助療法と考えられている。
pmid-6864899.summary_en: This 1983 J Urol paper describes sequential bilateral germ cell tumors of the testis in two patients after interval retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Altered lymphatic drainage, including collateral circulation and regenerated nodes or vessels, complicated evaluation for metastatic disease. The authors conclude that extensive collateral circulation argues against lymph node dissection or radiation therapy in such patients. A short course of systemic chemotherapy, regardless of histology, appears to be the safest adjunctive treatment.

pmid-6864900.summary_ja: 陰嚢内の悪性精巣腫瘍に捻転を合併した2例を報告した。文献検討では、腹腔内精巣の悪性腫瘍に伴う捻転は複数あるものの、陰嚢内精巣の報告は1例のみであった。捻転と腫瘍の合併は、異形成性性腺の二つの表れである可能性が示唆されている。治療や転帰の詳細は抄録からは分からない。
pmid-6864900.summary_en: This 1983 J Urol report describes two cases of torsion of malignant scrotal testicular tumors. A literature review found several cases of torsion of intra-abdominal testes with malignancy but only one previous scrotal case. The authors suggest that the coexistence of torsion and tumor may reflect two manifestations of a dysplastic gonad, a developmental abnormality. The abstract provides few clinical details, including treatment and outcome. The report is clinically relevant to testicular tumor presentation.

pmid-6866875.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫のうち、ほぼ呼吸上皮のみから構成された非典型的な症例を報告した。通常は複数の組織型を含む本疾患において、単一胚葉性の構成を示した点が特徴である。抄録は極めて簡潔で、患者の年齢、画像所見、治療経過などの詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-6866875.summary_en: This brief 1983 report describes a mature cystic ovarian teratoma composed essentially of respiratory epithelium. The case is an atypical presentation of this common benign germ cell tumor, and the monodermal pattern is its distinguishing feature. The abstract is very brief and gives no details on patient age, imaging, treatment, or follow-up. The case expands the recognized histologic spectrum of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-6868143.summary_ja: 卵巣ストルマ カルチノイドの1症例を報告した論文。甲状腺様のストルマ成分の濾胞はT4免疫反応性を示し、カルチノイド成分は索状構造と銀親和性細胞を呈した。膵ポリペプチドとエンテログルカゴンが局在し、電子顕微鏡で内分泌様顆粒が確認された。両成分の共通前駆細胞が提唱されている。
pmid-6868143.summary_en: A single case of ovarian strumal carcinoid is described. The struma component's follicles contained T4-immunoreactive material, while the carcinoid component showed a trabecular pattern with argyrophil cells. Immunocytochemistry localized pancreatic polypeptide and enteroglucagon to these cells, and electron microscopy revealed small endocrine-type dense granules. The authors propose a common precursor for the thyroid-like and carcinoid components.

pmid-6868144.summary_ja: 父はセミノーマ、息子は奇形癌を発症した父子精巣がんの7例目を報告。両者でHLA52特異性を検査し、共通ハプロタイプA3・B14・Cw8を確認した。HLA抗原と精巣がん感受性の関連を考察している。
pmid-6868144.summary_en: A familial case of testicular malignancy in a father and son is reported, the seventh such father-son pair described. The father had seminoma and the son teratocarcinoma. HLA typing of 52 specificities was performed in both, and they shared the haplotype A3, B14, Cw8. The authors discuss a possible association between HLA antigens and testicular cancer susceptibility.

pmid-6870183.summary_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（上皮内癌）は、精巣異常を伴う不妊男性にみられる精巣の浸潤前病変として総説的に概説されている。セミノーマや胎児性癌へ進展することが多い。電子顕微鏡では胎児期の性腺細胞に類似する異常胚細胞が確認され、細胞間結合を欠く。
pmid-6870183.summary_en: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia, also called carcinoma in situ, is reviewed as a preinvasive lesion of the testis found in infertile men with testicular abnormalities. It often progresses to seminoma or embryonal carcinoma. Light and electron microscopy show abnormal germ cells resembling early-stage gonocytes and prespermatogonia, which lack the intercellular junctions of normal developing germ cells.

pmid-6871135.summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）から生じた悪性変化の24例を報告。良性例より高齢の患者が多く、扁平上皮癌が最多で、腺癌、未分化癌、線維肉腫も認められた。診断後1年未満の生存が75%の症例で、予後不良であった。
pmid-6871135.summary_en: Twenty-four cases of malignant change arising in cystic ovarian teratomas, or dermoid cysts, are reported. Patients were older than those with benign dermoid cysts. Squamous carcinoma was most common, followed by adenocarcinoma, undifferentiated carcinoma, and fibrosarcoma. Survival was under one year in 75% of cases after diagnosis, highlighting the poor prognosis of malignant transformation.

pmid-6872625.summary_ja: 先天性眼窩奇形腫は、正常満期産新生児に片側眼球突出として現れる稀な腫瘍で、通常は眼窩内に限局する。まれに頭蓋内へ進展する。眼科・耳鼻咽喉科・脳神経外科の併用アプローチによる治療経験が報告されている。多科連携が必要である。
pmid-6872625.summary_en: Congenital orbital teratoma is a rare tumor presenting as unilateral proptosis in full-term newborns, typically confined to the orbit. Rare cases extend intracranially. The authors describe a combined ophthalmological, otolaryngological, and neurosurgical approach used to manage this tumor when it extends into the intracranial cavity. Management of this condition demands coordination across several specialties.

pmid-6873095.summary_ja: 原発無月経で受診した46,XX核型の患者にみられた片側性性腺芽腫の症例報告。12歳で乳房発育と副腎恥毛発現が自然に起こった。子宮欠如と対側性腺の奇形腫を認め、ホルモン値は二相性の分泌パターンを示した。内視鏡と生検で診断された。
pmid-6873095.summary_en: A case of unilateral gonadoblastoma is presented in a 46,XX patient with primary amenorrhea. Telarche and adrenarche occurred spontaneously at age 12 without virilization. Endoscopy and biopsy revealed an absent uterus, gonadoblastoma in one gonad, and a teratoma in the contralateral normal-appearing gonad. Serum hormone levels showed a biphasic secretion pattern.

pmid-6873523.summary_ja: マウス胎仔の生殖隆起を32℃または37℃で培養してから成体精巣へ移植し、奇形腫の誘発率を比較した研究です。32℃で培養した生殖隆起では奇形腫の発生率が高く、37℃では低値でした。32℃で10～12日培養すると奇形腫は形成されませんでした。温度による発生状態の違いは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序の理解につながると示唆されています。
pmid-6873523.summary_en: This study examined how culturing mouse genital ridges at different temperatures affects experimental teratoma induction after grafting to adult testes. Ridges cultured at 32°C, which disrupted testicular tubule development and retarded maturation, produced many teratomas, whereas those cultured at 37°C produced few. Ridges cultured 10 to 12 days at 32°C formed no teratomas. The findings suggest temperature-dependent developmental states influence teratocarcinogenesis, offering insight into the origins of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6873524.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の9種類の腫瘍株について、10種の異化酵素活性を20細胞レベルの微量解析で測定した研究です。株ごとに固有の酵素活性パターンが得られ、単一細胞レベルでの腫瘍型の生化学的同定に利用できる可能性が示されました。
pmid-6873524.summary_en: Nine mouse teratocarcinoma-derived tumour lines with different developmental capacities were analyzed for ten catabolic enzyme activities at the 20-cell level. Each line showed a distinct enzyme activity profile. These profiles may help biochemically identify tumor type at the single-cell level, complementing morphological and biological criteria. The lines included rhabdomyosarcoma-, neuroblastoma-, and endodermal tumour-derived lines, as well as multipotential and undifferentiated teratocarcinomas, providing a reference for classifying teratocarcinoma-derived tumors.

pmid-6874683.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を全トランス型レチノイン酸で壁側内胚葉へ分化させ、Ca2+・リン脂質依存性プロテインキナーゼ活性を調べた基礎研究です。未分化細胞ではほぼ活性がなく、分化に伴い可溶性活性が著明に増加しました。胎児性癌の分化過程に関与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-6874683.summary_en: This study examined Ca2+-phospholipid-dependent protein kinase activity in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells and their retinoic acid-induced differentiation into parietal endoderm. Undifferentiated F9 cells showed little or no cytosolic activity, whereas parietal endoderm cells (PYS-2) yielded a partially purified enzyme with Ca2+, Mg2+ and acidic phospholipid requirements. Retinoic acid treatment of F9 cells progressively increased this activity, correlating with differentiation. The kinase appears to be upregulated during embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-6875780.summary_ja: 新生児女児に発生した胃奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍は腹部と胸部にまたがっており、腹胸部に局在した胃奇形腫としては初めての報告とされています。これまでに報告された47例目にあたり、まれな小児の良性腫瘍の臨床像を広げる知見です。
pmid-6875780.summary_en: This report describes a female newborn with an abdominothoracic gastric teratoma, a rare benign tumor, and notes it is the 47th reported case. The lesion extended across both the abdomen and thorax, making it the first documented case with this abdominothoracic localization. The report highlights the unusual anatomical spread of a gastric teratoma in a neonate, expanding the known clinical spectrum of this rare pediatric tumor.

pmid-6876291.summary_ja: 触知しない精巣腫瘍を超音波検査で同定した研究です。大きな後腹膜セミノーマを有する若年男性で、潜在する精巣原発巣を検出しました。簡便な水浴法と一般的な超音波装置で高解像度画像が得られ、患者の受容性も良好でした。臨床的に原発巣が見つからない転移性胚細胞腫瘍の診断に役立つ方法です。
pmid-6876291.summary_en: The authors describe an ultrasound technique that detected an occult testicular primary in a young man with a large retroperitoneal seminoma. A simple water bath system with commonly available ultrasound equipment produced high-resolution scans, and the method was well accepted by patients. The approach offers a practical means to localize an impalpable testicular tumor when the primary cannot be found clinically, aiding the management of metastatic germ cell tumors.

pmid-6876292.summary_ja: 精巣原発の両側胚細胞腫瘍9例を検討した報告です。同時性2例と異時性7例が含まれ、6例は両側セミノーマでした。7例が病期Iで、良好な生存成績につながっています。二次原発の胚細胞腫瘍に対する治療方針も示されています。
pmid-6876292.summary_en: This report reviews nine patients with primary testicular germ cell tumors, including two with simultaneous and seven with successive bilateral tumors. Six had bilateral seminomas, and seven presented at stage I, which contributed to the favorable survival observed. The authors specify and discuss their treatment policy for these patients, who developed second primary germ cell tumors.

pmid-6876393.summary_ja: 左卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の切除後、約3年で左腋窩腫脹と右乳房腫瘍を来した33歳女性の症例です。乳房切除標本では原発性浸潤性乳癌と、転移性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の両方が確認されました。化学療法を行いましたが、7か月後に乳癌で死亡しました。このような症例は世界文献上でも初めての報告とされています。
pmid-6876393.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman had previously undergone resection of a left ovarian dysgerminoma. About three years later she presented with left axillary swelling and a right breast tumor. Mastectomy histology showed both a primary infiltrating breast carcinoma invading the muscle layer and a metastatic ovarian dysgerminoma with well-defined proliferation. Despite chemotherapy, she died of breast cancer seven months later. The authors note this is the only such case reported in the world literature.

pmid-6876402.summary_ja: 21歳男性の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍による上大静脈症候群の症例報告。αフェトプロテイン産生腫瘍で、放射線療法で一時改善したが、手術による完全切除は得られず、術後の再照射も奏効せず発症後5か月で死亡した。放射線療法とシスプラチンの併用による生存改善の可能性を論じている。
pmid-6876402.summary_en: This 1983 case report describes a 21-year-old man with superior vena cava syndrome caused by a large anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor that produced alpha-fetoprotein. Radiotherapy temporarily improved his symptoms, but incomplete surgical resection and postoperative re-irradiation failed, and he died five months after symptom onset. The authors note that mediastinal yolk sac tumors are rare and lethal, and suggest that combining radiotherapy with cisplatin, which was emerging as effective in germ cell tumors, might improve survival.

pmid-6877701.summary_ja: 大型の仙尾部奇形腫による難産の1例の報告。牽出を中止して児の一部を娩出し、緊急帝王切開の準備中に気管挿管と蘇生を行った。児は腹式に娩出され、3年後も正常であった。従来、生存児が得られた例は少ないとされ、出生前の超音波検査による早期発見が予期せぬ難産の回避に役立つと述べている。
pmid-6877701.summary_en: This 1983 case report describes the management of dystocia caused by a large sacrococcygeal teratoma. Extraction was halted and the infant was partially delivered, then intubated and resuscitated while emergency cesarean section was prepared. The infant was delivered abdominally and was normal three years later, despite absent thoracic movement during resuscitation. The authors note that few viable infants have been reported in such cases and that prenatal ultrasonography may allow early detection and prevent unexpected dystocia.

pmid-6878110.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに広範な肉芽腫反応を伴った症例報告である。反応が著明であったため、当初は良性疾患と考えられた。追加の組織を病理学的に検討して初めて正しく診断された。胚細胞腫瘍内の炎症反応が良性疾患に似て診断を遅らせ得ることを示し、十分な組織採取の重要性を示唆している。
pmid-6878110.summary_en: This 1983 report describes a case of testicular seminoma complicated by an extensive granulomatous reaction. The granulomatous response was so florid that a benign process was initially suspected. The correct diagnosis of seminoma was made only after additional tissue was examined histologically. The case highlights how an inflammatory reaction within a germ cell tumor can mimic a benign condition and delay diagnosis, underscoring the importance of thorough histological sampling.

pmid-6879288.summary_ja: 16例の小児卵巣腫瘤の5年間の治療経験を報告。腹痛や腹部腫瘤が主な症状で、超音波検査は10例中9例で病変を正しく同定した。奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマなどが認められ、悪性腫瘍には多剤化学療法が行われ、生存率は94%であった。将来の内分泌・生殖機能を考慮した手術の重要性を強調している。
pmid-6879288.summary_en: This 1983 five-year series describes 16 children aged 8 weeks to 16 years treated for ovarian masses. Abdominal pain or mass was the most common presentation, and ultrasonography correctly localized the lesion in nine of ten cases. Surgery revealed teratomas, endodermal sinus tumors, and dysgerminomas, among other lesions. Malignant tumors received multiagent chemotherapy, and overall survival was 94%. The authors emphasize conservative resection and attention to future endocrine and reproductive function.

pmid-6882018.summary_ja: ターナー症候群様の特徴を示す16歳女児の侵襲性ディスジャーミノーマ症例報告である。核型は45,X/46,X;marのモザイクで、切除後12か月間細胞毒性薬による治療を受けた。複数の組織で核型モザイクが確認された。文献的に、形成異常性生殖腺における細胞遺伝学的所見と悪性増殖・分化の予後を論じている。
pmid-6882018.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with Turner syndrome features and 45,X/46,X;mar mosaicism who underwent removal of an invasive dysgerminoma. She received cytotoxic drugs for 12 months afterward. Karyotype mosaicism was identified in various tissues. The authors review the literature on cytogenetic findings and on the prognosis of malignant growth and differentiation in dysgenetic gonads, highlighting the link between gonadal dysgenesis and dysgerminoma.

pmid-6883052.summary_ja: 精巣に触知可能な原発腫瘍がなく転移を伴う胚細胞悪性腫瘍の男性18例の報告である。全例で腹部リンパ節転移があり、組織型は栄養膜性悪性奇形腫が最多であった(9/18例)。腹痛や全身症状が多く、精巣萎縮や一過性の精巣痛の既往も見られた。精巣組織の検討で、自然退縮、分化、微小原発巣が確認された症例があった。
pmid-6883052.summary_en: This 1983 series describes 18 men with metastatic germ-cell malignancy in whom no primary testicular tumor could be palpated. All had abdominal nodal involvement, and the most common histologic subtype was trophoblastic malignant teratoma (9 of 18). Abdominal pain and systemic symptoms were common presentations, and testicular atrophy or transient pain often preceded diagnosis. Histologic examination of testes in several patients revealed occult primaries, including spontaneous regression, differentiation, or micro-primary tumors.

pmid-6884826.summary_ja: 卵巣の破裂した良性嚢胞性奇形腫を2例報告し、術前に卵巣癌と誤診された経過を示す。手術で奇形腫の穿孔によるびまん性肉芽腫性腹膜炎が判明した。腹腔内癒着や腫瘤が後遺症として多くみられた。根治的手術の前に悪性腫瘍の有無を確定する必要があると指摘している。文献的考察も含まれる。
pmid-6884826.summary_en: This 1983 report describes two cases of ruptured benign cystic teratomas of the ovary that were initially suspected to be ovarian carcinoma. Surgery revealed diffuse granulomatous peritonitis caused by perforation of the teratomas, rather than malignancy. Intra-abdominal adhesions and masses were frequent sequelae. The authors emphasize that malignancy must be confirmed before radical surgery is performed, and they include a literature review.

pmid-6885181.summary_ja: 高プロラクチン血症と下垂体腫瘍を有する25歳男性で、初回の右精巣生検では精子形成障害と精細管壁の肥厚がみられた。5年後に精巣腫大を来し、切除により浸潤性セミノーマと判明した。初回生検標本を再検討すると上皮内癌が認められ、胚細胞の上皮内癌から浸潤性腫瘍への進展を示す症例である。
pmid-6885181.summary_en: A 25-year-old man with hyperprolactinaemia and a pituitary tumour had small, atrophic testes. A right testicular biopsy showed impaired spermatogenesis. Five years later he presented with testicular enlargement, and resection revealed an invasive seminoma alongside a pituitary adenoma. Review of the earlier biopsy identified carcinoma in situ, documenting progression from germ cell carcinoma in situ to invasive seminoma.

pmid-6885186.summary_ja: 129 Sv/Sl マウスにおいて、8か月の長い潜伏期間を経て卵黄嚢癌が発生したことを報告する。原発巣と転移巣は臓側型と壁側型の像を示した。腫瘍は正常、ヘテロ接合型、不妊型の胚の胚外組織に由来しており、これらの卵黄嚢癌は胚細胞由来ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-6885186.summary_en: This study reports yolk-sac carcinoma arising in 129 Sv/Sl mice after a long latent period of eight months. This tumour had not previously been observed in this species after displacement of the visceral yolk sac. The primary tumour and its metastases showed visceral and parietal patterns. Because the tumours developed from extra-embryonic tissue of normal, heterozygous and sterile embryos, the authors conclude that these yolk-sac carcinomas do not derive from germ cells.

pmid-6885301.summary_ja: 若年男性が、心臓に隣接する急速に増大する腫瘤を主訴に受診した。腫瘤は良性の前縦隔奇形腫と診断された。縦隔奇形腫は通常、胸部X線検査で偶発的に発見されることが多いが、本症例は心膜傍部の急速に拡大する腫瘤として発症した点で異例である。
pmid-6885301.summary_en: The report describes an uncommon presentation in a young man, in which a benign anterior mediastinal teratoma appeared as a rapidly expanding paracardial mass rather than being discovered incidentally. Mediastinal teratomas are usually found on chest radiography. This case is notable for its rapid growth and its location adjacent to the heart.

pmid-6886137.summary_ja: X線検査や超音波検査で診断が困難な嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫について、CT所見を報告する。病変は石灰化・骨成分、軟部組織成分、水成分、脂肪成分を含む。脂肪成分における重力依存性の層形成や脂肪-液体レベルは類皮嚢腫に特異的であり、画像診断の補助としてCTが有用であると述べている。
pmid-6886137.summary_en: This report describes computed tomography findings in cystic ovarian teratomas that were difficult to diagnose on radiography and ultrasonography. The heterogeneous lesions contain calcification or bone, soft-tissue solid components, water-density fluid and fatty material. A gravity-dependent layering within a fatty mass or a fat-fluid level is described as a specific finding of dermoid cysts. CT may therefore be a valuable adjunct when conventional imaging is inconclusive.

pmid-6886603.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞を卵割期マウス胚と凝集させ、偽妊娠の子宮へ移植した。胎児への寄与が大きいほど形態異常が多く、胎児期の正常発生には十分な宿主胚細胞が必要であると示唆された。出生個体のキメラ形成は散発的かつ限定的であった。
pmid-6886603.summary_en: Embryonal carcinoma cells were aggregated with cleavage-stage mouse embryos and transferred to pseudopregnant uteri. Midgestation foetuses with large contributions from the carcinoma cells were frequently morphologically abnormal, and the abnormality correlated with the extent of contribution. Live-born animals showed sporadic, limited chimaerism. The authors suggest that large numbers of embryonal carcinoma cells are incompatible with normal development.

pmid-6886610.summary_ja: 8日齢マウス胚の卵筒の各領域を精巣被膜下へ異所性移植し、組織形成能と腫瘍形成能を検討した。前部・遠位部の外胚葉断片は胚内での運命を超える組織形成を示し、後部断片は増殖しなかった。前部由来の胎児性癌の発生頻度は後部より高く、腫瘍形成能に領域差があることが示された。
pmid-6886610.summary_en: The histogenetic and neoplastic potential of regions of the 8th-day mouse embryonic egg cylinder was examined after ectopic transfer beneath the testis capsule. Anterior and distal fragments of embryonic ectoderm produced histogenetic profiles exceeding their assigned embryonic fates, while posterior fragments failed to grow. Anterior slices gave a higher incidence of embryonal carcinoma cells than posterior slices, indicating regional differences in neoplastic potential.

pmid-6887150.summary_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤に対する開腹術で、良性の卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた乳頭状腺癌が発見された。既往に両側嚢胞性奇形腫がある。サイログロブリン免疫染色は良性部と悪性部の双方で陽性であった。コロラド州の15年間の検討では、嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の頻度は0.3%であった。
pmid-6887150.summary_en: A woman developed papillary adenocarcinoma arising within a benign struma ovarii, found at laparotomy for a pelvic mass. She had a prior history of bilateral cystic teratomas. Immunoperoxidase staining for thyroglobulin was positive in both benign and malignant areas. A 15-year review of cystic teratomas in Colorado showed a 0.3% frequency of malignant struma ovarii. The report combines a case description with a literature review.

pmid-6887401.summary_ja: 本研究は単施設の後方視的解析で、病期IIA精巣セミノーマに横隔膜上照射が必要かを検討した。横隔膜下のみ照射したIIA例6例は全例無再発で、病期Iの50例でも縦隔・鎖骨上窩の再発はなかった。横隔膜上照射は病期IIAでは不要な可能性があると結論づけているが、症例数が少ない点が限界である。
pmid-6887401.summary_en: This 1983 retrospective analysis from a single radiation center examined whether supradiaphragmatic radiation is necessary in stage IIA testicular seminoma. Six stage IIA patients received infradiaphragmatic-only treatment and none relapsed, while 50 stage I patients treated below the diaphragm had no mediastinal or supraclavicular failures. The authors conclude that above-diaphragm irradiation may be unnecessary in stage IIA seminoma, a finding limited by the small sample size and the absence of lymphangiography in several patients.

pmid-11894931.summary_ja: PCC4マウス奇形癌幹細胞に、細菌由来のEco.gpt遺伝子を優性選択マーカーとして導入し、安定的に形質転換させた。得られた5株はキサンチン-グアニンホスホリボシルトランスフェラーゼ活性を示し、選択をかけない条件で30世代後も導入配列が保持された。形質転換細胞はマウス体内で胎児性癌と分化組織を含む奇形癌を形成し、発生能を保っていた。
pmid-11894931.summary_en: PCC4 mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells were stably transformed with the bacterial Eco.gpt gene as a dominant selectable marker. Five independent transformed lines expressed xanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase activity, and marker sequences were retained after 30 generations without selection. The transformed cells still formed teratocarcinoma tumors containing embryonal carcinoma and differentiated tissues in mice. The method allows selection of teratocarcinoma stem cells co-transformed with otherwise non-selectable genes.

pmid-37282129.summary_ja: マイカ圧着法と電子顕微鏡を用いて、マウス胚と胎児性癌細胞から押し出されたDNA複合体を観察しました。胚の圧縮過程と、レチノイン酸で誘導された胎児性癌細胞の分化時に、1μm以上の環状DNA複合体が出現しました。これらは発生時の遺伝子再配列の産物である可能性が議論されています。主題は初期胚の分化であり、胎児性癌細胞は分化モデルとして使われています。
pmid-37282129.summary_en: The authors used mica-press adsorption and electron microscopy to examine extruded DNA complexes from mouse embryos and embryonal carcinoma cells. Extrachromosomal circular DNA complexes longer than 1 micrometer appeared during embryo compaction and during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells. The authors propose these molecules may represent products of developmental gene rearrangements in chromosomal DNA. The main focus is early embryonic differentiation, with embryonal carcinoma cells used as a differentiation model.

pmid-6187802.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の内胚葉細胞株PYS-2を用い、細胞周囲マトリックス中の基底膜成分の微細局在を免疫フェリチン法で解析した。ラミニンはマトリックス網と、マトリックスを細胞膜に結ぶ線維に認められた。ヘパリナーゼ感受性のヘパラン硫酸粒子が接着線維の接合部に存在した。細胞はこの経路で基底膜様マトリックスに接着しており、上皮細胞一般の接着機構にも関連する可能性がある。
