pmid-6187802.summary_en: This study uses PYS-2 cells, a teratocarcinoma-derived endodermal line, to define the ultrastructural localization of basement membrane components in their pericellular matrix. Immunoferritin labeling showed laminin in the matrix network and in fibrils attaching the matrix to the cell membrane. Heparinase-sensitive heparan sulfate particles were located at junctions of these attachment fibrils. Type IV collagen was present in the matrix network but not in attachment fibrils. The authors propose that the cells attach to their matrix via laminin-containing fibrils linked to heparan sulfate particles, a mechanism potentially relevant to epithelial attachment generally.

pmid-6188622.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、細胞骨格の変化を免疫蛍光法とイムノブロッティングで解析した。ビンキュリン斑が最初に出現し、その後アクチン線維とビメンチンの再配列が続き、最後にケラチン線維が現れた。ビンキュリン斑が分化機構に重要である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6188622.summary_en: This study used immunofluorescence and immunoblotting to track cytoskeletal changes during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Vinculin-containing plaques appeared first, followed by actin stress fibers and reorganization of vimentin. Keratin fibrils appeared later and were co-expressed with vimentin in many cells. The authors propose that vinculin-containing adhesion plaques may be important in the mechanism of embryonal carcinoma cell differentiation.

pmid-6188625.summary_ja: 奇形腫由来のヒト胎児性癌細胞株に対するホルボールエステルTPAの作用を検討した。TPAにより細胞形態、表面抗原、中間径フィラメント、蛋白合成が変化し、フィブロネクチンの分泌が誘導された。これらの変化は不可逆的で、細胞分裂は停止した。
pmid-6188625.summary_en: This paper examines the effects of the phorbol ester TPA on a clonal human embryonal carcinoma cell line derived from a teratoma. TPA induced flattening, changes in surface antigens including membrane fibronectin and SSEA-1, altered intermediate filaments with prekeratin expression, and altered protein synthesis. Fibronectin secretion was induced. The changes were irreversible, and treated cells stopped dividing but survived for at least three weeks. The analogue TPA-13-myristate did not produce these effects.

pmid-6190691.summary_ja: 多能性マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞PSA-1とF9を、壁側内胚葉様細胞で囲んだ凝集塊で解析し、細胞位置が内胚葉分化を制御するかを検討した。内部に位置するPSA-1細胞は内胚葉を形成せず、外胚葉様細胞へ分化した。レチノイン酸で誘導したF9細胞も、内部配置では内胚葉やAFPを産生しなかった。結果はEC凝集塊における細胞位置依存的な内胚葉分化モデルを支持する。
pmid-6190691.summary_en: Aggregates of pluripotent PSA-1 embryonal carcinoma cells were surrounded by parietal-like endodermal cells to test whether cell position controls endoderm differentiation. Internally located PSA-1 cells did not form endoderm, although they differentiated into ectoderm-like cells. Retinoic acid-induced F9 cells likewise produced no endoderm or AFP when internally positioned. The results support a cell-position model of endodermal differentiation in EC cell aggregates.

pmid-6190817.summary_ja: F9胚様体の外側上皮形成におけるラミニンの役割を検討した。5 μg/mL超の外因性ラミニンはAFP産生と転写を抑制し、基底膜形成と上皮構造を乱した。抗ラミニン抗体も上皮形成とAFP産生を阻害した。内因性ラミニンは基底膜の構築と内胚葉の遺伝子発現に重要であると結論づけられている。
pmid-6190817.summary_en: This study examines laminin's role in forming the outer epithelium of differentiating F9 embryoid bodies. Exogenous laminin above 5 micrograms/ml suppressed AFP production and transcription, and disrupted basement membrane and epithelial organization. Antilaminin antibodies likewise blocked epithelium formation and AFP production. Endogenous laminin is therefore needed for basement membrane assembly and endodermal gene expression.

pmid-6190823.summary_ja: DNA低メチル化を誘導する5-アザシチジンの効果を、マウスEC細胞株PCC4-aza-1とF9で検討した。PCC4-aza-1のみが分化したが、F9は形態変化を示さなかった。両株ともポリオーマウイルスに感受性を獲得し、SV40感受性は分化したPCC4-aza-1細胞に限られた。低メチル化が、これらの形質およびH2抗原発現と関連すると考察している。
pmid-6190823.summary_en: The effects of 5-azacytidine, which induces DNA undermethylation, were examined in murine embryonal carcinoma lines PCC4-aza-1 and F9. Treatment induced morphological differentiation in PCC4-aza-1 cells but not in F9 cells. Both lines became permissive to polyoma virus, while only differentiated PCC4-aza-1 cells became sensitive to SV40. The authors link undermethylation to these traits and to H2 antigen expression.

pmid-6191030.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウスの胎児性癌細胞および着床前胚に特異的に反応するラットモノクローナル抗体5D4を報告している。分化した腫瘍や組織とは反応しない。抗原はプロテアーゼ抵抗性で糖鎖構造に依存し、α結合ガラクトースを含む糖鎖決定基である可能性が示唆される。臨床研究ではなく基礎研究である。
pmid-6191030.summary_en: This 1983 study describes rat monoclonal antibody 5D4, which appears to recognize a cell-surface antigen specific to murine embryonal carcinoma cells and preimplantation embryos but not to differentiated tumor or normal mouse tissues. Biochemical analyses show the antigen resists protease digestion but is sensitive to treatments that alter carbohydrate structure, suggesting a carbohydrate determinant that may include alpha-linked galactose. The work is basic research in murine models rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6192006.summary_ja: 本細胞生物学研究は、DNA合成阻害剤によるF9奇形癌腫細胞の分化誘導を検討した。DNA合成の阻害は細胞表面マーカーを変化させ、RNAおよびタンパク質の新規合成に依存してプラスミノーゲンアクチベーター産生を促進した。DNA合成阻害と分化誘導が密接に関連すると結論している。臨床ではなくマウス細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-6192006.summary_en: This 1983 cell biology study examined differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells induced by inhibitors of DNA synthesis. Inhibiting DNA synthesis altered the cell surface marker F9 and stimulated plasminogen activator production, dependent on de novo RNA and protein synthesis. The authors conclude that DNA synthesis inhibition and differentiation induction are closely linked. The work is laboratory research on a mouse cell line rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6192330.summary_ja: ヒト胎児内胚葉および胚性癌細胞のマーカーであるFC 10.2抗原を解析し、I型血液型鎖が関与することを示した。検体として胎便や卵巣嚢胞糖タンパクなどが用いられた。成人の分化細胞で抗原が消失するのは、追加の糖鎖修飾による抗原のマスキングによると推定している。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、糖鎖・免疫化学的な基礎研究である。
pmid-6192330.summary_en: This 1983 study characterized a marker of human embryonic endoderm and embryonal carcinoma cells, recognized by the hybridoma antibody FC 10.2. Antigenic analyses of meconium, ovarian cyst glycoproteins, and glycolipids indicated that the antigen involves Type 1 blood group chains. The authors propose that the antigen disappears from normal adult differentiated cells because of masking by additional glycosylation or substitutions. Embryonal carcinoma is involved as a source of the marker, but the study is primarily a glycobiology and immunochemistry investigation rather than a clinical study of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6193979.summary_ja: 本研究は、F9奇形癌細胞を長期間レチノイン酸で処理して得られた新規細胞株Dif 5について報告したものである。典型的な壁側内胚葉様細胞と異なり、Dif 5細胞はライヒェルト膜の構成成分を産生し、血清非存在下でも増殖する。αフェトプロテインは合成しないが、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーターを分泌する。壁側と臓側の内胚葉の中間的な分化段階を示す可能性があり、初期胚発生における増殖要件や細胞外マトリックス形成の研究に有用と考えられる。
pmid-6193979.summary_en: This paper describes Dif 5, a new cell line derived from F9 teratocarcinoma cells after prolonged retinoic acid exposure. Unlike typical parietal endoderm-like cells, Dif 5 cells deposit Reichert's membrane components and grow without serum. They do not synthesize alpha-fetoprotein but secrete plasminogen activator and respond to EGF. The authors suggest Dif 5 may represent an intermediate endodermal cell type, useful for studying growth requirements and extracellular matrix formation in early embryonic development.

pmid-6194034.summary_ja: 本研究は、レチノイン酸およびサイクリックAMPにより分化誘導したマウスF9胎児性癌細胞におけるラミニンとエンタクチンの合成を測定したものである。未分化細胞のラミニン合成は極めて低かったが、6日間の誘導後には15〜20倍に増加した。ラミニンB2鎖はB1鎖より多く合成されたが、余剰のB2鎖は分泌型ラミニンに組み込まれなかった。未分化細胞では細胞質に淡い染色と短い線維状のラミニンが認められた。
pmid-6194034.summary_en: This study measured laminin and entactin synthesis in murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells during differentiation induced by retinoic acid and cyclic AMP. Undifferentiated cells produced very low laminin levels, which rose 15- to 20-fold after six days of induction. Synthesis of laminin B2 chains exceeded B1 chains, but the excess B2 was not assembled into secreted laminin. Immunofluorescence showed faint cytoplasmic staining and short laminin fibrils between undifferentiated cells.

pmid-6194903.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞に対する細胞傷害性抗体（モノクローナル抗体ECMA-3および抗F9血清）が認識する抗原の分子的性質を検討した。両抗体はF9細胞の高分子量多糖類を沈降させた。この多糖類はプロナーゼ消化後も抗体の細胞傷害活性を阻害し、抗原決定基は糖鎖部分にあることが示された。この多糖類群はF9細胞の多糖類の中では少数派の成分である。
pmid-6194903.summary_en: This study examines the molecular nature of antigens recognized by cytotoxic antibodies raised against F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, both a monoclonal antibody (ECMA-3) and a conventional anti-F9 serum. Both antibodies precipitated a class of high-molecular-weight polysaccharides from F9 cell lysates. The polysaccharides were labeled mainly by galactose and fucose, resisted pronase digestion, and still inhibited antibody cytotoxicity after proteolysis, indicating that the antigenic determinants reside on the carbohydrate portion. This polysaccharide class is only a minor component of F9 cell polysaccharides.

pmid-6197967.summary_ja: マウスの胎児性癌細胞株と分化細胞株を用いて、I、i、SSEA-1抗原の担体を検討した。主な担体は高分子量の糖タンパク質で、糖脂質ではないことが示された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱った研究ではなく、細胞分化抗原の基礎研究である。
pmid-6197967.summary_en: This biochemical study investigated the carriers of carbohydrate differentiation antigens I, i, and SSEA-1 in mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines and their differentiated derivatives. Using Western blotting, immunoprecipitation, and thin layer chromatography immunostaining, the authors found that high-molecular-weight glycoproteins were the major carriers. These glycoproteins were polydisperse and sensitive to endo-beta-galactosidase digestion. Only the I antigen was detected on minor glycolipids. The findings suggest glycoproteins, not glycolipids, carry these antigens in teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6226313.summary_ja: 基底膜成分を分泌するマウス胎児性癌細胞株M1536-B3が産生するヘパラン硫酸プロテオグリカンを解析した研究。大きさや鎖長、電荷密度の異なる3種類が、基底膜・細胞表面・培養液のそれぞれに分布していた。硫酸化パターンは類似しており、プロテオグリカンの局在化機構を研究するモデルとして有用とされた。
pmid-6226313.summary_en: This study characterized heparan sulfate proteoglycans produced by the murine embryonal carcinoma line M1536-B3, which secretes the basement membrane components laminin and entactin. Three distinct heparan sulfate proteoglycans were identified by size, chain length, and charge density, and they localized to the basement membrane, cell surface, and culture medium. Their sulfation patterns were similar despite differing sizes and locations, making this cell line a useful model for studying proteoglycan targeting.

pmid-6303570.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株数種におけるレチノイン酸およびレチノール結合タンパク質の活性を測定した。活性は株により大きく異なったが、分化能との明確な相関は認められなかった。分化した誘導体の結合活性は表現型を反映し、腫瘍原性の変化とは対応しなかった。他の因子やレチノイド非依存的経路の関与が示唆された。
pmid-6303570.summary_en: This study measured cellular retinoic acid and retinol binding protein activities in several murine embryonal carcinoma lines and their differentiated derivatives. Binding activity varied widely among lines but did not clearly correlate with differentiation propensity in tumor form or in vitro. Differentiated derivatives showed higher, lower, or similar binding levels, reflecting their phenotype rather than tumorigenic status. The authors suggest other factors or retinoid-independent pathways may modulate differentiation.

pmid-6305950.summary_ja: レチノイン酸とジブチリル環状AMPで処理したマウス胎児性癌F9細胞は、基底膜成分であるラミニンとエンタクチンを合成・分泌するようになった。その出現に伴い形態変化と細胞表面への沈着が認められ、フィブロネクチン合成は減少した。ラミニンの合成亢進は転写レベルで制御されていた。
pmid-6305950.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells treated with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP began synthesizing and secreting the basal lamina components laminin and entactin. Morphological changes and deposition at the cell surface and junctions accompanied their appearance. Fibronectin synthesis decreased, and laminin and entactin formed a complex. Enhanced laminin synthesis was transcriptionally regulated, as induced cells contained translatable GP-2 mRNA absent in uninduced cells.

pmid-6307509.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株Nulli-SCC1の分化誘導に対する5種のアロチノイドの効果を検討した。Ro-13-7410とRo-14-9572が強い分化誘導作用を示し、その活性は細胞性レチノイン酸結合タンパク質への競合と相関した。レチノイドと同じ機序で胎児性癌細胞の分化を促進すると結論づけている。
pmid-6307509.summary_en: Five arotinoids were tested for their ability to induce differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma Nulli-SCC1 cells, relative to all-trans and 13-cis retinoic acid. Ro-13-7410 and Ro-14-9572 were potent inducers, while ethyl sulfone and terminal-group-lacking analogs were largely inactive. Activity correlated with competition for cellular retinoic acid-binding protein. The authors conclude arotinoids and retinoids act through the same mechanism to promote embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-6315485.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞F9の分化に伴うフコース転移酵素活性の変化を調べた基礎研究。レチノイン酸とジブチリル環状AMPで壁側内胚葉細胞へ分化させると活性は低下し、壁側内胚葉細胞株PYS-2ではほぼ発現が見られなかった。活性変化は分化に伴う細胞表面の変化と相関した。ヒト患者や臨床データは含まれない。
pmid-6315485.summary_en: Basic research on fucosyltransferase activity in murine teratocarcinoma stem cells (F9), a model related to embryonal carcinoma. Enzyme activity fell when F9 cells were induced with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP to become parietal endoderm cells. The PYS-2 parietal endoderm line barely expressed the enzyme. The changes correlated with cell-surface alterations during differentiation. No human patients or clinical data are included.

pmid-6340100.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウスF9胎児性癌細胞とフロイント完全アジュバントでマウスとモルモットを免疫したところ、精子形成が有意に抑制され、精子細胞に対する抗体が出現したことを報告しています。卵黄嚢腫瘍由来のPYS-2細胞では効果がありませんでした。吸収実験でF9と精子細胞の抗原が類似することが示され、F9の癌胎児性抗原が精子分化抗原に相当し、胚細胞の分化に関与すると考えられています。
pmid-6340100.summary_en: The authors immunized mice and guinea pigs with mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma cells and Freund's complete adjuvant, finding significant inhibition of spermatogenesis and antibodies against spermatogenic cells. Immunization with PYS-2 cells, a yolk sac tumor line, was ineffective. Absorption experiments showed shared antigens between F9 cells and spermatogenic cells. The results support the view that oncofetal F9 antigens correspond to spermatogenic differentiation antigens and play a role in germ cell differentiation. The work is basic immunology rather than clinical tumor research.

pmid-6341577.summary_ja: 本研究は、PC13胎児性癌を免疫原として作製されたモノクローナル抗体2C5の分布を、着床後マウス胚と成体マウスで検討したものです。奇形癌幹細胞のin vitro分化で反応性は低下しました。胚の内胚葉、ラトケ嚢、原始胚細胞に発現する一方、成体では胸腺、下垂体、女性生殖管に限られました。系統に依存しない発現の意味を考察しており、臨床腫瘍研究ではなく基礎発生免疫学の報告です。
pmid-6341577.summary_en: The authors studied monoclonal antibody 2C5, raised against PC13 embryonal carcinoma cells, in post-implantation mouse embryos and adult mice. Reactivity decreased when teratocarcinoma stem cells differentiated in vitro. The antibody stained embryonic and extraembryonic endoderm, Rathke's pouch, and primordial germ cells, while adult expression was limited to the thymus, pituitary and female reproductive tract. The authors discuss whether this apparently non-lineage-related expression reflects shared antigens. This is basic developmental immunology rather than clinical tumor research.

pmid-6403560.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞株PSA-1から、アフィジコリンまたはアラビノフラノシルシトシンに耐性を示す変異株を分離し、初期特性を解析した1983年の研究。多段階選択法により、アフィジコリンに高度耐性を示す安定株を得る方法が提示された。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、胚様がん（奇形癌）モデルを用いた基礎的な細胞遺伝学の研究である。
pmid-6403560.summary_en: This study isolated drug-resistant mutants from a feeder-dependent mouse teratocarcinoma line, PSA-1, which can chimerize host blastocysts. Mutants were selected for resistance to aphidicolin or arabinofuranosyl cytosine, and most were resistant to both. Growth traits, deoxynucleoside sensitivities, and mutagen sensitivities varied. A multistep selection protocol produced stable mutants highly resistant to aphidicolin, which the authors recommend for identifying candidate mutator strains of multipotent teratocarcinomas. The work is basic mammalian cell genetics using an embryonal carcinoma model rather than clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-6406515.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞株Nulliにおける細胞間接着の機構を調べた1983年の基礎研究。二価陽イオン依存性の系と、フコース・マンノース特異的な細胞表面レクチンによる系の二つが同定された。両者の阻害を同時に行うと再凝集は完全に阻止された。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍への直接の臨床的知見は含まれない。
pmid-6406515.summary_en: This paper examines intercellular adhesion in teratocarcinoma stem cells of the Nulli line. Two additive systems were identified: a divalent cation-dependent mechanism (Ca2+ or Mg2+) and a cell-surface fucan/mannan-specific lectin mechanism. Reaggregation was partially inhibited by removing divalent cations or by lectin inhibitors such as fucoidan, and was completely blocked when both conditions were combined. The findings are basic cell biology in an embryonal carcinoma-like model, with no direct clinical focus on human germ cell tumors.

pmid-6576786.summary_ja: 2種の胎児性癌細胞株において、レチノールがレチノイン酸と同様に分化を誘導することを示している。細胞質のレチノール結合蛋白量と分化誘導効果との間に相関は認められなかった。ミクロソーム画分ではレチニルリン酸へのマンノシル転移が起こり、これが細胞表面変化の機序となる可能性を提唱している。
pmid-6576786.summary_en: Retinol, like retinoic acid, is shown to induce differentiation in two embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Cytosolic retinol-binding protein levels did not correlate with differentiation efficacy, whereas microsomal fractions catalyse mannosyl transfer from GDP-mannose to retinyl phosphate. The authors propose that formation of mannosyl retinyl phosphate is a constitutive mechanism by which retinoids trigger early cell surface changes during embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-6615832.summary_ja: 1983年の報告で、胎児性癌細胞株C17-S1 1003とその間葉系由来細胞の細胞表面タンパク質を比較した。未分化な胎児性癌細胞と分化した誘導体で標識パターンが異なり、一部のコンカナバリンA結合タンパク質は分化細胞では脱離後にのみ標識可能になった。臨床的な腫瘍学ではなく細胞生物学の研究である。
pmid-6615832.summary_en: This 1983 Biochimica et Biophysica Acta study compared cell-surface proteins of the embryonal carcinoma line C17-S1 1003 with its mesenchymal derivatives. Surface proteins were radioiodinated and analyzed by two-dimensional gel electrophoresis. Patterns differed between undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells and their derivatives, notably in proteins labeled on attached cells. Two concanavalin A-binding proteins were common to all lines but became accessible for labeling only after detachment in differentiated cells. The work is cell biology on an embryonal carcinoma model rather than clinical oncology.

pmid-6641706.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞に由来する雑種細胞を用い、ヒトMHCクラスI遺伝子の発現を解析した基礎研究です。HLA-A,B,Cの転写は非EC型雑種細胞と同程度か若干低いレベルで継続しましたが、適切には制御されていませんでした。HLA-DRαの転写は検出されませんでした。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではありません。
pmid-6641706.summary_en: This study examined human-mouse hybrid cells with an embryonal carcinoma phenotype, derived from a mouse EC background carrying a human MHC-containing X/6 translocation chromosome. Northern blot analysis showed that human HLA-A, B, and C transcripts continued to be expressed at levels similar to or slightly lower than non-EC hybrids, though not appropriately regulated. HLA-DR alpha transcripts were absent. The work is basic MHC regulation research using EC cells as a model system.

pmid-6643422.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞からin vitroおよび皮下腫瘍として得られた高分子糖ペプチドの構造を解析した生化学研究です。糖鎖はガラクトース残基で高度に分岐し、GlcNAc-Galの二糖が主要な構造単位でした。成人細胞のラクトサミノグリカンに類似した構造が示唆されています。臨床的な腫瘍管理を扱う研究ではありません。
pmid-6643422.summary_en: This biochemical study characterized high-molecular-weight glycopeptides from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells grown in vitro and as subcutaneous tumors. The glycans were highly branched at galactose residues, with the GlcNAc-Gal disaccharide as the major structural unit. In vivo tumor glycans showed additional substitution patterns. The authors conclude the core structure resembles lactosaminoglycans in adult cells. The work uses EC cells as a source of material for structural glycobiology rather than addressing clinical tumor management.

pmid-6663285.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株を誘導剤で処理すると放出されるレトロウイルス様粒子を検討した1983年の研究。電子顕微鏡観察とショ糖密度勾配で1.16 g/mlに分画され、C型レトロウイルスに近いことが示された。粒子の微細構造解析が主題で、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床や治療に関する内容はない。
pmid-6663285.summary_en: This 1983 study examines retrovirus-like particles released by human teratocarcinoma cell lines after induction with agents known to trigger animal retrovirus synthesis. Electron microscopy and sucrose gradient banding at 1.16 g/ml show the particles resemble type C retroviruses. The authors describe their structural organization using negative staining and fine-structure analysis. The work is primarily virological, with germ cell tumor-derived lines serving as the source of particles rather than as a clinical subject. Relevance to germ cell tumor biology or management is indirect.

pmid-6667513.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9に取り込まれた放射性ガラクトースの細胞内局在を電子顕微鏡オートラジオグラフィーで調べた短報。標識の56%が細胞膜上に認められた。細胞生物学的な研究で、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍や治療には触れていない。
pmid-6667513.summary_en: Electron microscopic autoradiography was used to map where radioactive galactose incorporated into F9 embryonal carcinoma cells localizes. Fifty-six percent of the label was found on the plasma membrane. This is a short cell biology report using a murine embryonal carcinoma line as a model system for glycosylation and membrane biology. It does not address clinical germ cell tumors, patients, or treatment, so its relevance to the site is indirect.

pmid-6667675.summary_ja: ヒト卵巣奇形癌細胞株PA1に対して作製されたモノクローナル抗体75.12の認識抗原を解析。Y（iso-Leb）糖鎖抗原は一部のマウス胎児性癌細胞株に発現し、レチノイン酸による分化で消失した。炭水化物抗原の発生段階による制御を示す基礎研究で、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍は扱わない。
pmid-6667675.summary_en: Describes monoclonal antibody 75.12, raised against the human ovarian teratocarcinoma line PA1, which recognizes a Y (iso-Leb) glycan antigen. The antigen is expressed on some mouse embryonal carcinoma lines and is lost upon retinoic acid-induced differentiation, paralleling morphological change. Findings support developmental regulation of carbohydrate antigens and differing differentiation states among EC lines. This is an antigen and differentiation study using EC cells as models rather than a clinical germ cell tumor report.

pmid-6683588.summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍由来のプロテオグリカンは、フィブロネクチンやI型コラーゲン基質への腫瘍細胞の接着を抑制した。その効果は可逆的で、付着初期に最も顕著であった。著者らは、このような作用が間質マトリックスとの相互作用を弱めることで腫瘍浸潤を促進しうると提案している。本研究は卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞を材料とした基礎的な細胞接着研究であり、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の治療に直結するものではない。
pmid-6683588.summary_en: A chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan purified from a rat yolk sac tumor was found to reduce adhesion of tumor cells to fibronectin- or type I collagen-coated substrata, without affecting attachment to type IV collagen. The effect was reversible and most prominent in early attachment. The authors propose that such proteoglycans could promote tumor invasion by weakening interactions with interstitial matrix while preserving basement membrane attachment. The work is basic cell biology using yolk sac tumor cells as a source.

pmid-6685050.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス胎児性癌細胞株PSA4TG12の分化培養から6種類の細胞株(EB細胞株)を単離したものです。一部は異数体で、EB26/1株は脂肪分化を示し、マウス体内で多系統の組織を含む腫瘍を形成しました。発生過程の遺伝子発現制御を研究するための基盤として提示されています。
pmid-6685050.summary_en: This study isolated six cell lines (EB lines) from differentiating cultures of the mouse embryonal carcinoma line PSA4TG12. Some lines were aneuploid, and EB26/1 underwent adipogenesis and formed mixed-tissue tumours in mice. EB28/5 produced tumours resembling yolk sac carcinoma without endodermal markers. The lines represent distinct subsets of the ancestral genome and serve as tools for studying developmental gene regulation.

pmid-6686281.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4と、ヒト染色体を1本または少数保持するヒト細胞との体細胞ハイブリッドを作製したものです。全ハイブリッドは胎児性癌の表現型を維持し、レチノイン酸による分化で壁側内胚葉様の細胞株が得られました。発生における遺伝子発現制御を研究する系として提示されています。
pmid-6686281.summary_en: This study constructed somatic cell hybrids between the mouse embryonal carcinoma line PCC4 and human cells, each retaining one or a few human chromosomes. All hybrids kept the EC phenotype and formed tumours in nude mice. Retinoic acid induced differentiation, yielding lines resembling parietal endoderm, and two hybrids stably kept their human chromosome, providing a system to study developmental gene regulation.

pmid-6827653.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞株を用い、粒子産生の有無によるintracisternal A粒子特異的RNAの発現とDNAメチル化を解析した1983年の研究です。メチル化と発現の間に相関が認められ、一部の遺伝子のみが転写活性を持つことが示唆されました。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、レトロエレメントの基礎研究です。
pmid-6827653.summary_en: This 1983 study examined two intracisternal A-particle-specific RNA species and DNA methylation in murine teratocarcinoma cell lines, some of which produce particles and others of which do not. The researchers found an apparent direct correlation between DNA methylation and RNA expression. Analysis of excised intracisternal A particle genes in a particle-rich line (PCC6) detected some undermethylated sequences. The findings support the idea that only a few of these genes are transcriptionally active. The work concerns retroelement biology, using teratocarcinoma lines as experimental material rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-6840224.summary_ja: マウス6日・7日胚と奇形癌OTT6050の胚様体におけるレクチン受容体の分布を比較した基礎研究である。FBPは内側の細胞、DBAは内胚葉、PNAは全胚葉に結合した。培養により露出した幹細胞がDBA受容体を発現した。糖鎖末端構造が分化の方向を反映すると考察している。
pmid-6840224.summary_en: This study compares lectin receptor distribution (FBP, PNA, DBA) in germ layers of 6- and 7-day mouse embryos with embryoid bodies from the teratocarcinoma OTT6050 grown in vivo. FBP labeled inner cells, DBA labeled endoderm, and PNA labeled all layers. In vitro culture exposed stem cells that expressed DBA receptors. The authors propose that altered terminal carbohydrate structures reflect the direction of differentiation.

pmid-6847688.summary_ja: 胚細胞由来のヒト奇形癌細胞株HT-E(833K)から、新規の中性糖脂質2種とグロボシド系列のガングリオシド3種を単離した。α-フコシダーゼやノイラミニダーゼ処理で構造を確認し、暫定的な構造を提案した。クロマトグラフィーや抗体反応性も用いて解析された。臨床的な腫瘍挙動や患者管理は扱っておらず、基礎的な糖脂質解析にとどまる。
pmid-6847688.summary_en: Researchers isolated several novel glycosphingolipids from the human teratocarcinoma cell line HT-E (833K), a germ cell-derived line. Two neutral glycolipids incorporate radiolabeled fucose, and three new gangliosides belong to the globoside series. Enzymatic treatments with alpha-fucosidase and neuraminidase converted some of these to globoside, allowing tentative structures to be proposed from chromatography, exoglycosidase digestion, and antibody reactivity. The work is a biochemical characterization of cell glycolipids and does not examine clinical tumor behavior or patient management.

pmid-6851790.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞と分化した内胚葉細胞の相互作用を調べるため、フローソーティング法を開発した。シトカラシンB処理で作製した倍数性の異なる細胞株と、Hoechst 33342による染色を利用して細胞を分離した。共培養24日後も、奇形癌細胞は内胚葉型のタンパク質パターンへ分化しなかった。臨床的な内容を含まない方法論的な報告である。
pmid-6851790.summary_en: The authors developed a flow sorting method to study cell-cell interactions between mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells and differentiated endoderm cells. They produced pseudotetraploid endoderm lines using cytochalasin B and Hoechst 33342 staining, enabling reisolation of teratocarcinoma cells with about 95-97% purity after cocultivation. Two-dimensional protein analysis showed that the teratocarcinoma cells were not induced to differentiate during 24 days of coculture. The paper is primarily a methodological report with no clinical component.

pmid-6853605.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞PC13の無血清培養に必要な条件を検討した。トランスフェリン、HDL、LDLを添加した培地で、5%ウシ胎児血清と同等の増殖が得られた。クローン増殖にはフィーダー細胞が必要だった。PC13細胞は外来性の増殖因子を絶対的には必要としないことが示された。臨床的内容を含まない基礎的な細胞培養研究である。
pmid-6853605.summary_en: The study defines conditions for serum-free culture of PC13 murine embryonal carcinoma cells. A medium of DMEM and MCDB104 supplemented with transferrin, high-density lipoprotein, and low-density lipoprotein supported growth comparable to 5% fetal calf serum. These lipoproteins appeared to replace insulin-related mitogens. Clonal growth required feeder cell monolayers. The results indicate PC13 cells do not absolutely require exogenous mitogens. The work is a basic cell culture study without clinical content.

pmid-6873195.summary_ja: 多能性胎児性癌細胞株311をレチノイン酸で処理し、分化に伴う細胞表面マーカーの初期変化を検討した研究。凝集素受容体は、PNA、LTA、WGAの順に失われることが示された。各受容体の変化は互いに独立して進行する。分化の経時的解析である。
pmid-6873195.summary_en: Pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cell line 311 is treated with retinoic acid to study early changes in cell-surface markers during differentiation. Cells losing peanut agglutinin, Lotus, or wheat germ agglutinin receptors increase over time, following the order PNA, LTA, then WGA. F9 antigen and LTA receptor changes occur independently of PNA status, indicating that each receptor changes on its own.

pmid-6885928.summary_ja: マウス肝細胞の Ca2+依存性細胞間接着系を解析し、奇形癌幹細胞のものと比較した。両細胞の凝集は、肝臓抗体と奇形癌由来の単クローン抗体により同様に阻害された。接着には分子量124,000と104,000の2種の表面タンパク質が関与し、両細胞で分子構成は同一と結論づけている。
pmid-6885928.summary_en: This study characterises calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion systems in mouse hepatocytes and compares them with those of teratocarcinoma stem cells. Antibodies raised against liver tissue and a monoclonal antibody against teratocarcinoma adhesion molecules both inhibited aggregation of both cell types. Two surface protein classes of 124,000 and 104,000 molecular weight were involved in both. The authors conclude that the adhesion molecules are identical in these two cell types.

pmid-6120755.summary_ja: 1934〜1976年に治療された停留精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者137例を検討した報告。矯正の有無で5年生存率に差はなく、セミノーマは胚細胞癌より予後が良好だった。矯正後に発生した腫瘍の多くは胚細胞癌であったため、片側の停留精巣には精巣摘除術を推奨し、長期的な経過観察を提唱している。
pmid-6120755.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study reviewed 137 patients with cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1934 to 1976. Five-year survival was similar in corrected and uncorrected cryptorchid patients (61% versus 63%), and higher in pure seminoma (79%) than in germinal carcinomas (50%). Most five-year survivors received radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Because tumors arising after orchiopexy were mostly germinal carcinomas, the authors recommend orchiectomy for unilateral cryptorchidism and long-term periodic observation.

pmid-6126483.summary_ja: 変異誘発によりPNA耐性のマウス胎児性癌細胞株を単離した研究。耐性は安定で劣性形質であり、PNA受容体の欠損が示唆された。全クローンが同系マウスで奇形癌を形成し、細胞表面構造が変化しても分化能は保たれていた。胚細胞腫瘍の基礎研究モデルとしての意義がある。
pmid-6126483.summary_en: This 1982 J Cell Physiol study isolated peanut agglutinin (PNA)-resistant variants of mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells after mutagenesis. The resistant phenotype was stable and recessive, consistent with deficient PNA receptors, and showed reduced SSEA-1 antibody binding. All eight clones formed well-differentiated teratocarcinomas in syngeneic mice. Despite altered surface markers, the variants still differentiated and sorted with endodermal cells into embryoid bodies, supporting their use as models of germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6126625.summary_ja: 1982年のLancet誌に掲載された研究で、臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性53例を対象に、転移が明らかになるまで精巣摘除術のみで経過観察した。17%が再発し、多くは6か月以内であり、全例が化学療法で救済された。再発率は胎児性癌(42.8%)で畸形癌(3.4%)より著しく高かった。放射線療法を併用した精巣摘除術の歴史的コホート(再発25.8%)と比較し、著者らはルーチンの郭清や所属リンパ節照射は正当化されない可能性を示唆している。
pmid-6126625.summary_en: A 1982 Lancet study followed 53 men with clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who received orchidectomy alone, with surveillance until metastases were evident. Seventeen percent relapsed, mostly within six months, and all were salvaged with chemotherapy. Relapse was far higher in embryonal carcinoma (42.8%) than in teratocarcinoma (3.4%). Compared with a historical orchidectomy-plus-radiotherapy cohort (25.8% relapse), the authors suggest routine lymphadenectomy or nodal irradiation may be unjustifiable.

pmid-6127155.summary_ja: 停留精巣に伴う泌尿生殖器異常の広がりを概説し、精巣がんの高いリスクとの関連を検討した総説。精巣異形成が停留精巣の発がんに関与する可能性を提唱している。精巣がんの特徴と、早期の精巣固定術を支持する根拠も整理されている。
pmid-6127155.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer review describes the spectrum of genitourinary abnormalities in cryptorchidism, with emphasis on testicular carcinoma, the most important complication. The authors propose that testicular dysgenesis may underlie carcinogenesis in the cryptorchid testis. They summarize the characteristics of testis cancer arising in cryptorchid testes and the evidence supporting early orchiopexy. The review frames cryptorchidism as a risk condition that warrants early intervention.

pmid-6128995.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの症例対照研究で、出生後の危険因子を検討した報告。停留精巣と乳児期鼠径ヘルニアとの既知の関連が確認された。さらに自転車競技と乗馬との関連が見出され、出生後の明確な危険因子と精巣がんとの初の関連とされる。
pmid-6128995.summary_en: A 1982 British Journal of Cancer case-control study examined postnatal risk factors for testicular seminoma. Previously recognized associations with cryptorchidism and infantile inguinal hernia were confirmed. New associations were found with cycling and horse-riding, which the authors describe as the first relationships between testicular cancer and well-defined postnatal risk factors. The study highlights exposures occurring after birth rather than only congenital factors.

pmid-6129027.summary_ja: 片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者250例の対側精巣生検を検討し、上皮内癌を5.2%に認めた。萎縮精巣や停留精巣の既往を有する群で発見率が高く、ハイリスク群の選択的スクリーニングの意義が示された。経過観察中に2例が第二の癌を発症した。
pmid-6129027.summary_en: A 1982 BMJ study analyzed 250 contralateral testis biopsies from men with unilateral germ cell testicular cancer for carcinoma in situ. Changes were found in 13 patients (5.2%). Patients with an atrophic contralateral testis or a history of cryptorchidism were at higher risk, and screening these groups would have detected 85% of cases. Because the natural course of carcinoma in situ is unknown, patients are being reevaluated frequently, and two developed a second cancer.

pmid-6130162.summary_ja: 1982年のJ Urol誌に掲載された研究で、停留精巣の男性130例を対象に、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のスクリーニングとして血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)とそのアイソザイムを測定した。臨床的に明らかな腫瘍は1例のみで、無症状の病変は生検により3例で確認された。これらの4例ではLDHとアイソザイムは正常値であったが、腫瘍のない3例では上昇がみられた。著者らは、LDHとそのアイソザイムは無症状の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の検出に感度が低いと結論づけている。
pmid-6130162.summary_en: A 1982 J Urol study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and its isoenzymes in 130 men with maldescended testes to screen for testicular germ cell neoplasia. Only one clinically evident tumor was found, and subclinical lesions were identified by biopsy in three men. These four patients had normal LDH and isoenzyme values, while three men without neoplasia had elevated levels. The authors conclude that LDH and its isoenzymes are not sensitive for detecting subclinical testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6152898.summary_ja: 1982年のAmerican Journal of Pathologyの研究で、マウスの段階特異的胚抗原に対するモノクローナル抗体を用いて、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍における局在を検討した。SSEA-1は卵黄嚢癌成分に検出されたが胚性癌細胞には検出されず、SSEA-3はヒト胚性癌細胞に検出された。両抗原は胎児精巣の胚細胞に存在し、成人の精細管には存在しなかった。ヒト胚性癌細胞はマウス細胞より未熟な胚細胞に対応するとの知見が示され、腫瘍の組織発生の理解に寄与するとしている。
pmid-6152898.summary_en: A 1982 American Journal of Pathology study used monoclonal antibodies against murine stage-specific embryonic antigens to localize them in human testicular germ cell tumors. SSEA-1 was detected on yolk sac carcinoma components but not on embryonal carcinoma cells, whereas SSEA-3 was detected on human embryonal carcinoma cells. Both antigens were present on fetal testicular germ cells but absent from adult seminiferous tubules. The findings suggest human embryonal carcinoma cells correspond to a less mature embryonic cell than murine cells, informing the possible histogenesis of these tumors.

pmid-6172177.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例に対し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤を腹部手術で切除したところ、66%が完全寛解に至った。術前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の高値は予後不良を示し、CTは3例で偽陰性だった。残存腫瘤の切除は組織型の確認と寛解達成に有用で、予後不良と考えられた患者6例も長期寛解を得たと結論している。
pmid-6172177.summary_en: This 1982 Br J Surg study reviews 21 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumours (20 teratoma, 1 seminoma) who underwent abdominal surgery to remove residual masses after sequential chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 66 percent, and histological maturation or necrosis occurred in 57 percent. Patients with raised preoperative hCG or AFP had a poor prognosis, and CT gave false-negative results in three patients. The authors advocate resecting residual masses to determine histology and achieve remission, which benefited six patients with poor prognosis.

pmid-6172191.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者5例の新鮮な腫瘍組織を用い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のin vitro合成を放射性同位元素の取り込みと免疫沈降により検証した。合成の所見は免疫細胞化学染色と相関した。腫瘍自体がこれらの血清腫瘍マーカーを産生することを示した基礎的研究である。
pmid-6172191.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study examined in vitro synthesis of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in fresh testicular cancer tissue from five patients. Using 14C-leucine and 14C-lysine incorporation, radioimmunoassay, and immunoprecipitation, the authors showed that the tumour tissue actively synthesised AFP and hCG. The synthesis correlated with immunocytochemical staining of the cancer cells, suggesting that these tumours directly produce the serum markers measured clinically.

pmid-6173110.summary_ja: 免疫不全マウスに移植した胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植片を超微細構造で解析し、原発のヒト腫瘍と比較した。同じ組織型の腫瘍間や同一腫瘍内でも分化の程度に幅があった。セミノーマと卵黄嚢癌の中間、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢癌の中間の特徴を示す細胞が認められ、その組織発生への示唆が論じられている。
pmid-6173110.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study describes the ultrastructure of xenografts established in immunosuppressed mice from three embryonal cell carcinomas, two yolk sac carcinomas, and one alphafetoprotein-producing seminoma-like tumour. The xenografts were compared with the original human germ cell tumours. Ultrastructural differentiation varied between tumours of the same histological type and within individual tumours. Cells with features intermediate between seminoma and yolk sac carcinoma, and between embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma, were identified, and their implications for histogenesis are discussed.

pmid-6173901.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍、大腸癌、乳癌を対象に、微小残存病変の検出に用いる腫瘍マーカーの方法を概説した総説である。体液中の腫瘍マーカー測定は臨床的価値が限られると結論し、放射免疫検出法や免疫細胞化学などの代替法を批判的に検討している。
pmid-6173901.summary_en: This 1982 review in Recent Results in Cancer Research surveys tumour marker methods for detecting minimal residual disease in human germ cell, colorectal, and breast neoplasms. The authors conclude that measuring tumour markers in body fluids has limited clinical value. They critically appraise alternative approaches, including radioimmunodetection and immunocytochemistry, for identifying small amounts of residual tumour.

pmid-6174137.summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍59例を対象とした予後因子の検討である。放射線療法後の再発は、原発腫瘍の局所進展と、精巣摘除後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の低下速度に関連した。紹介時の血清マーカー高値そのものは予後因子ではなかった。胎児性癌は奇形癌より局所浸潤しやすかった。
pmid-6174137.summary_en: This 1982 Br J Cancer study examined prognostic factors in 59 men with clinical Stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours of the testis treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital. Fourteen relapsed after radiotherapy, and 45 remained disease-free. The local extent of the primary tumour and the rate of decline of serum AFP and beta-hCG after orchidectomy were significantly associated with relapse. Initial serum marker levels and tissue-associated hCG were not prognostic. Embryonal carcinoma was more often locally invasive than teratocarcinoma.

pmid-6174138.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍22例と悪性奇形腫11例の化学療法中に、循環免疫複合体(CIC)を連続測定した研究である。CICは一部の症例で病勢と相関したが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)より感度・特異度が低かった。寛解中にもCIC上昇がみられ、現行の測定法は腫瘍マーカーとして臨床的価値に乏しいと結論している。
pmid-6174138.summary_en: This 1982 Br J Cancer study measured circulating immune complexes (CIC) serially during chemotherapy in 22 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumours and 11 with malignant teratoma. CIC levels correlated with disease status early in treatment in some patients, but CIC assays were less sensitive and less specific than hCG and AFP. Several patients in sustained complete remission had raised CIC levels. The authors conclude that current CIC measurements lack clinical value as tumour markers in these diseases.

pmid-6174649.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫由来のHOTC 3細胞と絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を含む婦人科腫瘍由来の培養細胞5種で、各種マーカー物質を比較した研究である。hCG-βはBeWo細胞から培地へ漏出したが、HOTC 3細胞からは漏出しなかった。AFPは5種すべてで検出されなかった。細胞の生物学的機能を反映し、腫瘍マーカーとしての臨床応用を示唆している。
pmid-6174649.summary_en: This 1982 Japanese study compares intracellular and secreted marker substances in five human cultured cell lines from gynaecologic tumours, including an ovarian malignant teratoma line (HOTC 3) and a choriocarcinoma line (BeWo). LDH activity was highest in BeWo, HOC-21 and HOTC 3 cells. hCG-beta was detected in BeWo and HOTC 3 cells but leaked into the medium only from BeWo cells. AFP was undetectable in all five lines, and plasminogen activator was absent from the teratoma and choriocarcinoma lines.

pmid-6174850.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対しビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン併用化学療法を受けた12例全例で血清ナトリウムが低下し、4例は重篤な症状を呈した。水分処理能の障害も確認され、主に高用量ビンブラスチンが原因と考えられた。本レジメンでは低ナトリウム血症の監視と、症状がある場合の水分制限や高張食塩水投与が推奨される。
pmid-6174850.summary_en: Twelve patients receiving high-dose vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin for metastatic germ cell tumors all developed falling serum sodium after chemotherapy, and four had severe symptoms. Eight showed hypoosmolality and five had abnormal water load tests, indicating impaired water handling. The authors attribute the hyponatremia mainly to high-dose vinblastine and recommend monitoring for hyponatremia in patients on this regimen, with water restriction or hypertonic saline when symptomatic.

pmid-6176191.summary_ja: 婦人科悪性疾患におけるオンコフェタル蛋白を文献と自験データから検討した研究である。臨床的モニタリングに有用なのは、内胚葉性腫瘍のAFPと胚細胞腫瘍のhCGのみと結論づけている。CEAや胎盤性蛋白などその他のマーカーは、この目的には有用性が示されなかった。
pmid-6176191.summary_en: This review and measurement study examines several oncodevelopmental proteins, including AFP, CEA, hCG, and placental proteins, in gynecological malignancies and relates them to clinical data. The authors conclude that only AFP in endodermal tumors and hCG in germ cell tumors are useful for clinical monitoring. Other markers were not found to be clinically useful for this purpose. Germ cell tumors are a key focus of the conclusion, with tumor marker monitoring as the central theme.

pmid-6176314.summary_ja: AFPとhCGを産生した卵巣多胚芽腫の1例である。hCG上昇により思春期早発症様の症状を呈した。手術とVAC療法後、5か月時点で再発やAFPの再上昇はなかった。免疫染色ではAFPは卵黄嚢細胞、hCGは合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在し、電子顕微鏡では胚様体の細胞接合と表面被覆の特徴が明らかになった。
pmid-6176314.summary_en: A woman with ovarian polyembryoma producing AFP and hCG presented with pseudoprecocious puberty due to elevated hCG. After surgery and VAC chemotherapy, she had no recurrence and no re-elevation of serum AFP at five months. Immunoperoxidase staining localized AFP to yolk sac cells and hCG to syncytiotrophoblastic cells within embryoid bodies. Electron microscopy characterized cell junctions and surface coats, suggesting the thick deposit is related to AFP.

pmid-6176589.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の培養系におけるホルモン産生をレチノイン酸などで調節した研究である。レチノイン酸は通常分泌されないPSβGを誘導し、hCGとhCGα産生を増加させた。cAMP調節物質との併用で相乗効果を示した。レチノイド処理により、PSβGとhCGの産生が持続的に増加する安定した表現型変化が生じた。
pmid-6176589.summary_en: Choriocarcinoma cells in culture were studied for hormone production. Retinoic acid induced the normally absent pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein and increased hCG and hCG alpha, and it acted synergistically with cAMP modulators. Passage in retinoic acid produced a stable altered phenotype with elevated PSβG and hCG. The cells remained responsive to cAMP agents, while BrdUrd strongly suppressed hCG and hCG alpha production. The findings show that retinoids can reprogram choriocarcinoma hormone secretion in vitro.

pmid-6176923.summary_ja: 再発・持続性の胚細胞腫瘍4例にビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシンを投与した。全例で奏効し、2例は完全奏効でセカンドルック開腹術後も無病であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例は一過性の奏効のみで、6か月以内に再発し死亡した。
pmid-6176923.summary_en: Four patients with recurrent or persistent germ cell tumors received vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin. All achieved clinical response, and two attained complete response, remaining disease-free after second-look laparotomy. One had a mixed germ cell tumor that persisted as dysgerminoma after primary chemotherapy, and one had pure dysgerminoma. Patients with endodermal sinus tumor had only transient responses, with recurrence and death within six months.

pmid-6177295.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し化学療法を受けた男性4例で、一過性の女性化乳房を認めた。血清ホルモン測定でライディッヒ細胞と胚上皮への毒性とエストラジオール上昇が示された。良性の所見であり、不要な検査や治療を避けるため、その認識が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-6177295.summary_en: Four men with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer developed transient gynecomastia during combination chemotherapy. Serum hormone measurements showed toxic effects on Leydig cells and germinal epithelium, with elevated estradiol even without tumor. The authors suggest Leydig cell dysfunction or refeeding after weight loss as causes. They emphasize recognizing this benign condition to avoid unnecessary investigation and treatment.

pmid-6177391.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の約半数は後腹膜転移を有するため、精巣摘除術後の追加治療が重要である。病期AおよびBの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清術は治療効果と正確な病期分類の両面で有用である。化学療法の進歩によりその役割は再検討されているが、72例のレビューから依然重要と結論づけている。
pmid-6177391.summary_en: Half of testicular tumor patients present with retroperitoneal metastases, supporting retroperitoneal treatment after orchiectomy. Lymphadenectomy remains valuable in stage A and B nonseminomatous germ cell tumors for therapeutic benefit and accurate staging, since clinical staging is imprecise. Effective modern chemotherapy has prompted reassessment of its role. A review of 72 cases over ten years at McGill University hospitals supports its continued importance, and indications for retroperitoneal dissection are discussed.

pmid-6177438.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある32歳男性が、喀血・嗄声と肺門部腫瘤を呈した。ビンブラスチン系療法では嗄声が残存したが、VP16-213・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンへの変更でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が正常化し、麻痺も回復した。7か月間完全寛解が続き、このレジメンの有用性が示唆された。
pmid-6177438.summary_en: A 32-year-old man treated for a non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor developed hemoptysis, hoarseness, and a left hilar mass with elevated AFP and beta-hCG. Despite vinblastine-based therapy plus cisplatin and mediastinal radiotherapy, hoarseness persisted. After AFP rose again, VP16-213 with bleomycin and cisplatin normalized AFP and resolved hoarseness, with complete remission for seven months. The authors suggest this regimen has useful activity against testicular NSGCT.

pmid-6177670.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍121例の予後を評価した。臨床的リンパ節転移と原発巣のT分類が予後因子で、肺再発が転帰を規定した。T1・T2かつリンパ管造影陰性の低リスク群は肺再発9%で、いずれも治癒可能であった。悪性奇形腫中間型は未分化型より好ましい症例が多く、腫瘍マーカーの活用が待機的化学療法の対象選別に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-6177670.summary_en: This study of 121 patients with malignant teratoma intermediate or undifferentiated testicular non-seminoma assessed prognosis after radiation-based management. Clinical nodal involvement and primary T category were key prognostic factors, with pulmonary relapse determining outcome. Low-risk patients with T1 or T2 primaries and negative lymphangiography had 9% pulmonary relapse, all curable. Intermediate histology had more favorable patients. Tumor markers and vascular invasion might identify unfavorable patients who could benefit from elective chemotherapy.

pmid-6178198.summary_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の減量手術の役割を概説した論文です。残存悪性組織の完全切除が長期無病生存の改善に必要とされ、化学療法中の病勢進行は手術の禁忌とされます。切除不完全例や術後の腫瘍マーカー高値は予後不良因子であり、術前の高値例には追加の化学療法が推奨されています。
pmid-6178198.summary_en: This review examines the role of cytoreductive surgery in advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated with chemotherapy. The authors state that complete resection of residual malignancy is needed to improve long-term disease-free survival. Surgery is generally recommended after three to four cycles of an optimal chemotherapy regimen. Progressive disease during chemotherapy is a contraindication to surgery. Residual malignant tissue is found in up to one third of patients with residual disease. Incomplete resection and elevated tumor markers after surgery indicate poor prognosis.

pmid-6178393.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞がん22例に、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、アクチノマイシンDの併用化学療法を行った報告である。73%が完全寛解に達し、1例は残存病変を完全切除した。病変の範囲と不良な全身状態が有意な不良因子であった。無病状態に達した患者は生存利益があり、大半が無病で生存していた。著者らは、多くの患者が治癒しうると述べ、大病変例の最適治療と維持療法の役割にはさらなる検討が必要としている。
pmid-6178393.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 22 patients with advanced germ cell carcinoma treated with a combination of cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin, and actinomycin D. Complete remission was achieved in 73 percent of patients, and one patient had complete resection of residual disease. Extent of disease and poor performance status were the only significant adverse pretreatment factors. Prior therapy did not affect the chance of complete remission but increased hematologic toxicity. Patients who became disease-free had a significant survival advantage, and most were alive and disease-free at follow-up.

pmid-6178494.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の男児に発生した縦隔奇形癌の症例を報告し、その後の急性白血病による死亡を記述した論文です。あわせて、小児の原発性悪性腫瘍治療後に生じる二次性白血病の文献的検討を行っています。二次性白血病の治療反応は不良で、生存期間中央値は約4か月でした。
pmid-6178494.summary_en: The authors report a child with Klinefelter syndrome who developed a mediastinal teratocarcinoma that produced gonadotropin. The child seemed to survive the tumor but died of acute leukemia two years later. This prompted a review of secondary leukemias in children after chemotherapy or radiotherapy for another primary malignancy. These leukemias responded poorly to treatment, with a median survival of about four months. The authors note that secondary leukemias may become more common as children survive longer after potentially leukemogenic therapy, and recommend close monitoring.

pmid-6178590.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の男性38例を対象に、ブレオマイシン化学療法中の肺機能検査の有用性を検討した論文です。ブレオマイシン90mg投与後にDLcoのみ有意に低下し、晩期の検査値に有意な変化はみられませんでした。総投与量が360mg以下であれば、特別な危険因子がない限り定期検査は不要と結論づけています。
pmid-6178590.summary_en: This study evaluated whether routine pulmonary function tests can detect bleomycin lung toxicity in 38 men treated for metastatic testicular teratoma with up to four courses of chemotherapy. Tests were performed before each course and repeated 2 to 5 years later in 10 disease-free survivors. Only the carbon monoxide diffusing capacity fell after the first 90 mg of bleomycin. Late values did not change significantly. The authors conclude that routine tests are unnecessary when the total bleomycin dose is 360 mg or less, unless particular risk factors are present.

pmid-6179592.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形癌の21歳男性の症例報告で、血清中のAFP、hCG、CEAの変動と組織内局在を検討しています。改変VAC療法後にAFPとhCGは有意に低下し、CEAは徐々に上昇しました。未熟な腺組織にこれら3種の抗原が同一腺内に存在することが示されています。
pmid-6179592.summary_en: The authors report a 21-year-old man with mediastinal teratocarcinoma and high serum levels of AFP, hCG, and CEA. After modified VAC chemotherapy, AFP and hCG fell significantly, while CEA rose gradually. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma combined with teratoma. Immunoperoxidase staining detected AFP, hCG, and CEA in the immature glandular tissue of the teratoma, and the markers were found within the same glands on serial sections. Tumor tissue contained high levels of AFP, beta-hCG, and CEA.

pmid-6181407.summary_ja: ヒト腫瘍細胞株21種におけるHLA-ABC抗原の発現を検討した論文です。絨毛癌2株は抗体に全く反応せず、HLA-ABC重鎖の合成欠損がその原因とされました。この欠損は、妊娠時の栄養膜と同様に腫瘍をT細胞による攻撃から守る可能性があると考察されています。
pmid-6181407.summary_en: The authors tested 21 human tumor and other cell lines for HLA-ABC antigen expression. Two choriocarcinoma lines showed no detectable reaction with monoclonal antibodies, and several other lines showed reduced expression. In choriocarcinoma and one breast tumor line, beta-2 microglobulin was expressed but little or no HLA-A, B, or C polypeptide was synthesized. Other negative lines lacked surface HLA-ABC because beta-2 microglobulin was not made. The authors suggest this loss may protect tumors from T-cell attack, similar to the protection of trophoblast during pregnancy.

pmid-6181679.summary_ja: 転移性胎児性癌の30歳男性が、ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン併用化学療法中に高血圧を発症した。治療終了3か月後に加速性高血圧が生じ、カプトプリルで血圧は正常化した。腎生検では細動脈の狭窄と血栓が認められ、薬剤性腎血管性高血圧が示唆される。
pmid-6181679.summary_en: A 30-year-old man with metastatic embryonal carcinoma developed hypertension during vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin chemotherapy. Three months after treatment ended, accelerated hypertension occurred. Nitroprusside failed, but captopril normalized his blood pressure. Renal biopsy showed onion-skin narrowing of interlobular arteries and fibrin thrombosis of afferent arterioles, suggesting drug-induced renovascular hypertension. The case highlights a possible late toxicity of standard germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

pmid-6181870.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍37例に導入化学療法を施行し、36例でAFP/hCGが正常化した。治療初期にマーカー値の一過性上昇が多くみられ、大量転移病変と相関した。AFPおよびhCGの半減期算出は胚細胞腫瘍の管理に有用とされる。
pmid-6181870.summary_en: Thirty-seven patients with germ cell cancers and elevated AFP and/or hCG received induction chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin. Markers normalized in 36 patients. Most patients showed a transient rise in AFP or hCG early in therapy, which correlated with large-volume metastatic disease. Patients with relapsed or refractory disease showed prolonged AFP half-life later in treatment. The authors recommend AFP and hCG half-life calculations for managing germ cell cancer patients.

pmid-6182048.summary_ja: 抗血清を用いてマウス奇形癌およびEC細胞の中間径フィラメント発現を解析した。胚様体の内部細胞は発現を欠き、外側細胞はサイトケラチンを発現した。レチノイン酸による分化誘導後の発現パターンは細胞株ごとに異なり、EC細胞株は胚発生の分化研究に有用と示された。
pmid-6182048.summary_en: This study used intermediate filament class-specific antisera to characterize differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma cells. Inner cells of embryoid bodies lacked all intermediate filament types, while outer cells expressed cytokeratin, resembling the blastocyst. Twelve EC lines expressed vimentin. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation produced line-dependent patterns of cytokeratin, vimentin, GFAP, and neurofilament expression, supporting EC lines as models of embryonic differentiation.

pmid-6182056.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫28例の表面超微細構造を検討し、形態と分類・生物学的挙動との関連を評価した。扁平上皮は異常な角化を示し、呼吸上皮には微絨毛細胞と線毛細胞が認められた。超微細構造は嚢胞腺腫との鑑別に有用で、判定困難な病変の同定にも役立った。
pmid-6182056.summary_en: The surface ultrastructure of 28 cystic ovarian teratomas was examined to relate morphology to tumor classification and biological behavior. Squamous epithelium showed abnormal maturation and keratinization, while respiratory epithelium contained microvillous and ciliated cells. Heaped squamous cells in onion-like arrangements appeared even in histologically regular lesions. Ultrastructural features distinguished teratomas from cystadenomas and helped identify indeterminate lesions and areas of malignant potential.

pmid-6182554.summary_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト精巣胎児性癌からAFP mRNAを部分精製し、cDNAをクローニングした。5つの陽性クローンのうち最大のpHAF2は、AFP mRNAの3'末端に対応していた。
pmid-6182554.summary_en: Messenger RNA for human alpha-fetoprotein was partially purified from a human testicular embryonal carcinoma propagated in nude mice. Complementary DNA was synthesized, inserted into pBR322, and screened in E. coli, yielding five positive clones. The largest clone, pHAF2 (900 nucleotides), corresponded to the 3' end of AFP mRNA and had a restriction map distinct from previously reported mouse AFP cDNA clones.

pmid-6182739.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍4例で硝子様小体を検討した。小体は糖蛋白性で、多くが細胞質内でAFP陽性であった。電子顕微鏡では、内臓型細胞のAFP陽性高電子密度小体と、壁側型細胞由来のAFP陰性線維状小体の2型が認められた。
pmid-6182739.summary_en: Four yolk sac tumors of the testis and ovary were examined by histochemistry, immunohistochemistry, and electron microscopy to characterize hyaline globules. The globules were glycoprotein-positive, and most intracytoplasmic globules were AFP-positive. Electron microscopy revealed two types: electron-dense AFP-positive globules in visceral-type cells, and filamentous, basement-membrane-like AFP-negative globules in parietal-type cells.

pmid-6182973.summary_ja: 未治療の転移性精巣セミノーマ85例を報告した。病期IIの再発率は転移巣の大きさに伴い上昇し、IIAで9.4%、IICで39.1%であった。横隔膜下放射線療法を受けた13例では横隔膜上の初回再発はなかった。病期IIA・IIBには放射線療法、病期IICには化学療法を先行させる方針が提案された。
pmid-6182973.summary_en: Clinical details of 85 men with previously untreated metastatic seminoma are reviewed. In stage II disease, relapse rates rose with metastasis size, from 9.4% in IIA to 39.1% in IIC. None of 13 stage II patients treated with infradiaphragmatic irradiation had a supradiaphragmatic first relapse. The authors propose irradiation for IIA and IIB, initial chemotherapy for IIC, and initial chemotherapy with individualized radiotherapy for stage III and IV disease.

pmid-6183226.summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説した。最も有効な化学療法はシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン併用療法である。生存率は病期Iで約100%、病期IIで90%、病期IIIで60%とされる。低病期セミノーマは依然として放射線療法が行われる。
pmid-6183226.summary_en: This review summarizes management of adult testicular germ cell tumors. Cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin is the most active regimen, with etoposide as an alternative. Surgery provides definitive cure in low-stage disease and debulking after chemotherapy in advanced stages. Survival is about 100% in stage I, 90% in stage II, and 60% in stage III. Low-stage seminoma is still treated with radiotherapy, and chemotherapy appears to improve survival in advanced seminoma.

pmid-6183426.summary_ja: 1982年の予備報告。卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍の女性8例に、シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・ビンブラスチン(PVB)併用化学療法を実施した。8例中7例で完全寛解が得られ、全例が3〜33か月後も生存し健康であった。PVBは女性の胚細胞腫瘍に対し、精巣奇形腫と同程度に有効と考えられると結論づけている。
pmid-6183426.summary_en: This 1982 preliminary report describes eight women with ovarian yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumour treated with combination chemotherapy of cisplatin, bleomycin and vinblastine (PVB). Seven of eight achieved complete remission, and all seven were alive and well 3 to 33 months later. The authors compare these results with their earlier experience and published reports. They conclude that the PVB regimen is likely as effective for female germ cell tumours as for testicular teratoma.

pmid-6183455.summary_ja: 1982年の泌尿器科研究。非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期B患者25例に、高用量ビンブラスチンと持続静注ブレオマイシンによる補助化学療法を行った。再発は2例(8%)で、いずれもシスプラチンを含む追加化学療法で無病となった。25例中24例(96%)が15か月から7年以上無病で経過した。
pmid-6183455.summary_en: This 1982 urology study reports adjuvant chemotherapy with high-dose vinblastine and continuous-infusion bleomycin in 25 men with stage B nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Two patients (8%) relapsed after adjuvant therapy, and both became disease-free after further chemotherapy including cisplatin. Twenty-four of 25 (96%) remained disease-free for 15 months to over 7 years. One patient died after a second primary embryonal carcinoma developed in the remaining testis.

pmid-6183459.summary_ja: 1968〜1979年に治療された乳児期の精巣胎児性癌19例の報告。精巣摘除術と化学療法(メトトレキサート等)を受けた10例は全例無病で、手術のみやリンパ節郭清を受けた例では死亡例がみられた。卵黄嚢成分を持つ腫瘍は血行性転移をきたしやすい。病期Aでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清は不要とし、AFPの測定が治療モニタリングに有用とする。
pmid-6183459.summary_en: This 1982 report reviews 19 infants with embryonal carcinoma of the testis treated between 1968 and 1979. Patients given orchiectomy plus methotrexate, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide all remained disease-free, whereas several patients managed with surgery alone or with lymphadenectomy died. Infantile tumours with yolk sac elements showed haematogenous spread even when nodes were negative. The authors argue that infantile embryonal carcinoma differs from the adult type, that retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy is unnecessary in clinical stage A, and that AFP levels help monitor treatment.

pmid-6183656.summary_ja: 妊娠24週の超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が疑われた症例の報告。羊水および母体血清のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇し、羊水のゲル電気泳動でアセチルコリンエステラーゼのバンドが認められた。25週で分娩が始まり、染色体正常の男児で胎児体重の約4分の3に相当する腫瘍が確認された。
pmid-6183656.summary_en: This 1982 case report describes a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma suspected by ultrasound at 24 weeks' gestation. Amniotic fluid and maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein were markedly elevated, and amniotic fluid gel electrophoresis showed an acetylcholinesterase band. Labour began at 25 weeks, and the chromosomally normal male fetus was found to have a tumour equal to three-quarters of its weight.

pmid-6184488.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌腫由来のヒト細胞株5種で、電子顕微鏡によりレトロウイルス様粒子が確認された。誘導処理により粒子産生と培養上清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)量が増加し、合胞体栄養膜様細胞が粒子産生に関与する可能性が示された。粒子の起源や発症への関与、患者血清抗体反応の診断マーカーとしての可能性が論じられている。
pmid-6184488.summary_en: This 1982 study examines human testicular teratocarcinoma cell lines for retrovirus-like particles. Electron microscopy detected such particles in all five cell lines studied. Virus induction increased particle production and chorionic gonadotropin levels in the culture medium, suggesting that syncytial trophoblast-like cells within the tumours produce the particles. The authors discuss whether the particles are endogenous or exogenous, their role in pathogenesis, and the potential of serum antibody reactivity as a diagnostic marker.

pmid-6185697.summary_ja: 進行精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍(病期III等)の男性31例(評価可能25例)に、5剤併用の1年間化学療法を実施した。完全寛解率は92%で、中央値27か月超の追跡で80%が無病であった。微小転移例や奇形腫成分のない例は化学療法単独で良好で、進行例や奇形腫成分例は併用療法で利益を得た。主な重篤な毒性は骨髄抑制であった。
pmid-6185697.summary_en: This 1982 report describes a one-year regimen of vinblastine, actinomycin D, bleomycin, cyclophosphamide and cisplatin in 31 men with stage III or bulky stage II malignant testicular germ cell tumours, 25 of them evaluable. Complete remission occurred in 92%, and 80% remained disease-free at a median follow-up of over 27 months. Patients with minimal metastases or no teratoma in the primary tumour responded well to chemotherapy alone, while those with advanced disease and teratoma benefited from combined treatment. Myelosuppression was the main serious toxicity.

pmid-6186497.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対しビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンを併用した化学療法では、早期に一過性の血小板減少症がしばしば生じた。著者らは、この作用が血小板生存期間の短縮によることを示した。関連文献のレビューから、薬剤の相乗作用が原因である可能性を提唱している。本報告は化学療法に伴う血液毒性の理解に寄与するものである。
pmid-6186497.summary_en: This 1982 study examines thrombocytopenia after vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin chemotherapy for testicular teratoma. Patients often developed early, transient low platelet counts. The authors show that this effect is due to reduced platelet survival. The relevant literature is reviewed, and they propose that the phenomenon may be attributable to drug synergism.

pmid-6187574.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣がん15例が、導入化学療法後の残存腫瘍に対して外科的切除を受けた。縦隔・肺転移では9例中7例、後腹膜転移では6例中2例が完全寛解に至った。AFP高値例は寛解が得られず、成熟・未熟奇形腫や壊死の切除例で寛解が得られた一方、胎児性癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む例では寛解が少なかった。
pmid-6187574.summary_en: Fifteen patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular cancer underwent surgical resection of residual tumor after induction chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 7 of 9 with mediastinal or pulmonary metastases and 2 of 6 with retroperitoneal metastases. Patients with high AFP failed to achieve remission. Resection of mature or immature teratoma or necrosis yielded remission, whereas embryonal carcinoma or yolk sac tumor components did not. Most patients in remission stayed disease-free during follow-up.

pmid-6191698.summary_ja: 1950〜1977年の日本における精巣腫瘍死亡率の推移と、シスプラチン(CDDP)を用いた化学療法の副作用を報告している。消化器症状、骨髄抑制、腎毒性が多くみられた。病期IIおよびIIIの精巣がんでは、50%生存期間が1965〜1974年の6か月から1975年以降は18か月へと改善し、VAB療法やPVB療法の導入が一因とされた。
pmid-6191698.summary_en: This Japanese study reviews testicular neoplasm mortality from 1950 to 1977 and reports toxicity of cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 47 urogenital cancer patients. Gastrointestinal symptoms, marrow suppression and nephrotoxicity were common. In patients with stage II or III testicular cancer, the 50% survival time improved from 6 months (1965-1974) to 18 months after 1975, which was attributed to VAB or PVB regimens.

pmid-6191704.summary_ja: 高リスク絨毛癌でメトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、アルキル化剤の併用療法を行い、寛解率は約70%であった。低リスク例では100%であった。難治例に対しては、四剤併用、CHAMOMA法、シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・ビンブラスチン療法、超大量メトトレキサート療法、MTXを含まない併用療法などを検討した。最後の療法はヌードマウスを用いた化学療法の実験データに基づき設計された。
pmid-6191704.summary_en: Combination chemotherapy with methotrexate, actinomycin D and an alkylating agent achieved about 70% remission in high-risk choriocarcinoma patients refractory to prior regimens, versus 100% in low-risk patients. For refractory cases, the authors tested quadritherapy, the CHAMOMA protocol, cisplatin-bleomycin-vinblastine, ultra-high-dose methotrexate, and an MTX-free combination. The last regimen was designed from chemotherapy experiments in nude mice.

pmid-6203740.summary_ja: 胎児性癌クローン細胞株1003は、培地組成を変えることで異なる発生経路へ誘導される。血清含有培地では大部分の細胞が未分化を保ち、無血清培地では神経上皮細胞からニューロンへ分化する。血清再添加では間葉系細胞になる。ビメンチンやニューロフィラメント蛋白質の発現変化を指標に、各分化段階の特徴を解析した。
pmid-6203740.summary_en: The 1003 embryonal carcinoma clonal cell line was driven along different developmental pathways by changing the culture medium. In serum-containing medium most cells stayed undifferentiated, whereas serum-free medium induced neuroepithelial cells, then neurons, and re-adding serum induced mesenchymal cells. Changes in vimentin, neurofilament proteins and the ECMA 7 embryonic antigen were used to characterize each differentiation stage.

pmid-6203868.summary_ja: 転移を有する精巣胚細胞腫瘍39例にビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンを投与し、8例が完全寛解に至った。完全寛解の予測因子は腫瘍容積とパフォーマンス・ステータスであった。Cox比例ハザードモデルでは、原発巣のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、パフォーマンス・ステータス、完全寛解が生存に有意な影響を与え、層別化治療への応用が期待される。
pmid-6203868.summary_en: Thirty-nine patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors received vinblastine and bleomycin, and 8 achieved complete remission. Stepwise discriminant analysis found that tumor volume and performance status predicted complete remission. Cox multivariate analysis showed that primary tumor hCG, serum LDH, performance status and complete remission significantly affected survival, suggesting these factors may help guide differentiated treatment.

pmid-6213157.summary_ja: 純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ56例の自然経過を報告している。リンパ管造影、腹腔鏡検査、腹腔細胞診で病期分類を行った。5年無再発生存率は病期IA〜ICで91%、後腹膜病変を伴う病期IIIで74%、腹膜病変を伴う病期IIIでは24%であった。
pmid-6213157.summary_en: This report describes 56 patients with pure dysgerminoma, staged by lymphography, peritoneoscopy and peritoneal cytology. Most patients had Stage IA disease. Five-year relapse-free survival was 91% for Stage IA to IC, 74% for Stage III retroperitoneal disease, and 24% for peritoneal involvement. Diaphragmatic inspection was always negative, and lymphography changed the stage in about a third of patients.

pmid-6274499.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移12例に対し全脳照射と全身化学療法を施行した。単発病変例の平均生存期間は29.9か月、多発例は13.7か月であった。単発例の一部で髄膜癌腫症を来し、脳脊髄液中に悪性細胞が認められた。
pmid-6274499.summary_en: Twelve patients with brain metastases from germ cell tumors were treated with whole brain irradiation and systemic chemotherapy. Patients with a single brain lesion had a mean survival of 29.9 months, versus 13.7 months for those with multiple lesions, suggesting that chemosensitive tumors improve outcomes. Meningeal carcinomatosis developed in two patients initially treated for a single metastasis, and cerebrospinal fluid cytology showed malignant cells.

pmid-6275705.summary_ja: 絨毛癌429例と侵入奇胎441例の胸部X線写真を解析し、肺転移の頻度はそれぞれ85.1%、65.0%であった。連続撮影や肺動脈造影を病理所見と対比した。各種の転移陰影は同一病変の経時的変化を示すと結論づけている。
pmid-6275705.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed chest radiographs from 429 choriocarcinoma and 441 invasive mole cases, finding pulmonary metastases in 85.1% and 65.0% of patients, respectively. Serial films in 27 cases, along with postmortem and surgical pulmonary arteriography, were used to correlate radiographic patterns with pathology. The authors conclude that the various forms of metastatic shadows represent different evolutionary stages of the same lesion.

pmid-6277194.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後にhCG値が持続的に高値を示す非転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断基準を検討した。4施設のデータでは26%に診断され、化学療法前の時代の絨毛癌頻度16%と比較された。綿密なフォローアップ下では3〜4週間のプラトー確認が妥当と提案している。
pmid-6277194.summary_en: The authors address when to diagnose nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after hydatidiform mole, since chemotherapy is typically started after a three-value hCG plateau over two weeks. Data from four US centers show NMGTN diagnosed in 26% of cases, compared with a 16% choriocarcinoma frequency in the prechemotherapy era. They argue that a 3- to 4-week plateau may be justified before treatment in closely followed patients.

pmid-6277363.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎31例、侵入奇胎1例、絨毛癌10例の血清を対象に、hCG、SP1、PP5を放射免疫測定した。SP1とhCGは病勢モニタリングに有用であった。PP5は胞状奇胎で検出され絨毛癌では検出されず、悪性栄養膜細胞の浸潤活性との関連が示唆された。
pmid-6277363.summary_en: Serum hCG, pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1), and placental protein 5 (PP5) were measured by radioimmunoassay in samples from 31 patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, or choriocarcinoma (228 samples in total). Both SP1 and hCG were useful for monitoring disease. PP5 was present in hydatidiform mole but absent in choriocarcinoma, supporting its association with the invasive activity of malignant trophoblast.

pmid-6277473.summary_ja: 蛍光マイクロスフェアで標識した胎児性癌細胞を胚盤胞に注入し、腫瘍形成の制御機構を検討した。非分化性胎児性癌株の一部は50%水準で制御され、多分化能を持つ未分化株はほぼ完全に制御された。壁側卵黄嚢癌細胞は制御されなかった。各腫瘍に対応する胚発生の場が制御を担うという仮説が提唱された。
pmid-6277473.summary_en: Using fluorescent microsphere-labeled cells injected into blastocysts, the authors examined how the blastocyst regulates tumor formation by different cell lines. Some nullipotent embryonal carcinoma lines were controlled at about 50%, others were not controlled, and a multipotent undifferentiated line was almost completely controlled. Parietal yolk sac carcinoma cells were not controlled, leading to a hypothesis that each carcinoma may be regulated by a corresponding embryonic field.

pmid-6279271.summary_ja: メイヨークリニックにおける原発性前縦隔セミノーマ21例（純粋型17例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍4例）の後方視的検討。純粋型では9例が無病生存、8例が転移性疾患で死亡した。35歳超、発熱、上大静脈症候群、鎖骨上・頸部リンパ節腫大、肺門病変などが進行の危険因子と考えられ、予後との関連が示唆された。
pmid-6279271.summary_en: This Mayo Clinic review of primary anterior mediastinal germ cell tumors includes 17 patients with pure seminoma and four with mixed germ cell tumors containing seminoma. Among pure seminoma patients, nine remained disease-free and eight died of metastatic disease. Of the mixed tumor patients, two died. Poor prognosis was associated with age over 35, fever, superior vena cava syndrome, supraclavicular or cervical adenopathy, and hilar disease on radiographs, suggesting these features indicate more aggressive progression.

pmid-6279284.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4azalを用い、レチノイン酸とジメチルアセトアミドによる分化誘導を生体内で検討した。腫瘍内または全身投与により神経上皮様・腺様への分化が誘導され、増殖抑制と生存期間の延長が得られた。18例中4例では良性奇形腫へ完全に転換し長期生存が得られた。胚細胞腫瘍の前臨床モデルとして分化療法の可能性を示す。
pmid-6279284.summary_en: Murine PCC4azal embryonal carcinoma tumors grown subcutaneously in mice were treated with retinoic acid dissolved in dimethylacetamide, given intratumorally or systemically. Treatment induced substantial differentiation into neuroepithelial and glandular structures, slowing growth, reducing mitoses and necrosis, and prolonging host survival. In four of 18 treated animals, tumors fully converted into benign teratomas, yielding long-term survival. The study shows that chemical induction of differentiation can reverse malignant germ cell phenotypes in vivo, offering a preclinical model relevant to germ cell tumor therapy.

pmid-6280859.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者145例のHLA-A、-B、-C、-DR抗原発現を解析した研究。純粋型セミノーマ群ではAw33、B5、DR5、DRw6が、胎児性癌を含む群ではA3、B7が増加していた一方、DR3は全群で減少した。多重比較補正後は有意差はなかった。罹患兄弟3組はHLAハプロタイプを少なくとも1つ共有していた。
pmid-6280859.summary_en: This study analyzed HLA-A, -B, -C, and -DR antigen expression in 145 Caucasian patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including 18 with pure seminoma and others with nonseminomatous tumors containing embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, choriocarcinoma, or yolk sac components. Frequencies of several HLA antigens increased in specific histologic subgroups, including Aw33, B5, DR5, and DRw6 in pure seminoma and A3 and B7 in embryonal carcinoma, while DR3 decreased across groups. Differences were not statistically significant after correction. Three affected brothers shared at least one HLA haplotype, the significance of which remains unclear.

pmid-6281156.summary_ja: 子宮摘出術を施行された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍4例の臨床病理学的検討。1例はネフローゼ症候群と播種性血管内凝固を呈し、術後に改善した。2例は子宮外へ進展し、うち1例は化学療法にもかかわらず転移性疾患で死亡した。絨毛癌に有効なレジメンに抵抗性を示し、血清β-hCG値は比較的低かった。全摘出とβ-hCGモニタリングの重要性を強調している。
pmid-6281156.summary_en: Four patients with placental-site trophoblastic tumour, also called trophoblastic pseudotumour, were treated with hysterectomy. One patient had nephrotic syndrome with disseminated intravascular coagulation that resolved after surgery. Two tumors extended beyond the uterus, and one patient died with widespread metastases despite intensive chemotherapy. Tumors showed infiltrative behavior resistant to choriocarcinoma regimens and relatively low serum hCG. Histology lacked bilaminar structure. The authors emphasize serum hCG monitoring and complete surgical excision and argue that the name pseudotumour is inappropriate.

pmid-6281754.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍組織におけるPP5（胎盤タンパク質5）の免疫組織化学的検出を検討した報告。胞状奇胎15例全例、破壊性奇胎6例中2例、絨毛癌7例中1例で陽性だった。生物学的役割は不明だが、プラスミン不活性化との関連から、胎盤の浸潤性制御に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6281754.summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining was used to detect placental protein 5 (PP5) in tissue from trophoblastic tumours. PP5 was present in all 15 hydatidiform moles, in two of six destructive moles, and in one of seven choriocarcinomas. Although its biological role remains unclear, its association with plasmin inactivation suggests PP5 may help control placental invasiveness. This brief report describes PP5 expression across the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum.

pmid-6282486.summary_ja: 従来の化学療法に抵抗性または再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍11例に、VP16-213、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシンによるサルベージ療法を施行した。完全奏効1例、部分奏効10例（うち4例は手術で良性奇形腫）が得られ、4例は18か月以上生存した。難治例への真のサルベージ療法となる可能性が示され、初回治療への組み入れも支持されている。
pmid-6282486.summary_en: Eleven patients with recurrent or refractory nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, unresponsive to conventional chemotherapy, received salvage therapy with VP16-213, cisplatin, and adriamycin. One complete response and ten partial responses were observed, four of which were benign teratomas at surgery. Four patients survived beyond 18 months. The authors suggest the regimen may offer true salvage for refractory patients and recommend incorporating VP16-213 into initial treatment regimens for germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-6282922.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎組織の膜標本を用いてβアドレナリン受容体を解析した研究。栄養膜細胞はβ1受容体のみを発現し、アデニル酸シクラーゼと共役していた。β2受容体は非栄養膜成分に存在すると考えられた。受容体量は倍数性や絨毛癌への進展とは関連しなかった。胎盤代謝におけるカテコラミン調節を示唆する。
pmid-6282922.summary_en: Human hydatidiform mole tissue was examined for beta-adrenergic receptors using membrane binding assays. Trophoblastic cells expressed only beta1-adrenergic receptors coupled to adenylate cyclase, with binding characteristics matching the beta1 subtype and metoprolol selectivity. Beta2 receptors likely reside on nontrophoblastic stromal or endothelial cells. Receptor levels did not vary by ploidy, fetal presence, or progression toward choriocarcinoma. Choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JEG-3 lacked specific binding. The findings support catecholamine regulation of placental metabolism.

pmid-6283625.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍84例に対するミトラマイシン単剤療法の成績を検討。進行例では強力な化学療法より生存率が低く、進行期には推奨されない。一方、低病期例の生存率は、補助化学療法なしで両側リンパ節郭清を受けた既報より良好だった。低病期例の補助療法としてのみ使用すべきとされる。
pmid-6283625.summary_en: This study evaluated single-agent mithramycin in 84 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis across stages. Survival with advanced disease was lower than with more intensive chemotherapy, so mithramycin is not recommended for advanced stages. In contrast, patients with low-stage disease had better survival than historical series treated with bilateral lymphadenectomy without adjuvant chemotherapy. Most patients underwent unilateral gland dissection preserving sexual function. The authors suggest single-drug therapy be used only as adjuvant treatment in low-stage disease.

pmid-6284333.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者154例の剖検例を検討した研究である。明らかな純粋セミノーマの44%に非セミノーマ成分の転移が認められた。主な遠隔転移部位は肺、肝、脳、骨で、死因は肺転移による呼吸不全が最多であった。白金製剤導入の前後で転移パターンに明確な差はみられなかった。
pmid-6284333.summary_en: This autopsy review of 154 patients with testicular germ cell tumors found that 44% of those with apparently pure seminoma had evidence of nonseminomatous metastases. Lung, liver, brain, and bone were the most common distant metastatic sites, with brain metastases frequent in choriocarcinoma and bone metastases in seminoma. Brain, liver, and bone involvement typically appeared late and accompanied other sites. Respiratory failure from lung metastases was the leading cause of death. Retroperitoneal recurrence after lymph node dissection mainly occurred in patients with prior retroperitoneal nodal disease. Outcomes did not clearly differ before and after platinum-based regimens.

pmid-6287843.summary_ja: 非転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対し、メトトレキサート単独とメトトレキサート–ホリナート交互投与を後方視的に比較した研究である。メトトレキサート抵抗性は単独群7.7%、ホリナート併用群27.5%で、併用群の寛解導入効果が劣った。最終的には全例が寛解した。単独療法は毒性が強く、ホリナート併用は毒性を減らすものの、寛解導入の有効性は低下すると結論づけられた。
pmid-6287843.summary_en: This retrospective comparison of methotrexate alone versus methotrexate alternated with folinic acid in nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic disease included 39 and 29 patients, respectively. Methotrexate-resistant disease occurred in 7.7% of the single-agent group and 27.5% of the folinic acid group. All patients ultimately achieved remission. Methotrexate alone was more toxic, while the folinic acid regimen was less toxic but less effective at inducing remission.

pmid-6288220.summary_ja: 化学療法で奏効した転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の患者6例に、増大する孤立性腫瘤が出現した。切除標本はいずれも悪性組織を含まない成熟奇形腫であり、growing teratoma syndrome と呼ばれる病態が示された。全例が追加治療なしで5〜108か月無病生存していた。化学療法後の良性腫瘤の増大を認識すれば、外科的救済が可能となる。
pmid-6288220.summary_en: Six patients with metastatic mixed germ cell tumors who responded to chemotherapy developed enlarging solitary masses. Each mass was resected and proved to be mature teratoma without malignant histology, a phenomenon described as growing teratoma syndrome. Two masses enlarged from expansile cysts and four were solid. All remained disease-free without further therapy at follow-up of 5 to 108 months. Recognizing this benign enlargement after chemotherapy allows surgical salvage rather than unnecessary further treatment.

pmid-6288936.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患352例を対象に、治療前のhCG値と先行妊娠終了から治療開始までの期間が治療反応を予測するかを検討した。転移性と非転移性を合わせた解析では、両因子ともハイリスク患者を同定できた。転移性絨毛癌では両因子とも予後への有意な影響はなく、転移部位や先行妊娠の種類がより重要と考えられた。
pmid-6288936.summary_en: This 1982 study of 352 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease assessed whether pretreatment hCG titer and the interval from antecedent pregnancy to treatment predict response to therapy. Across metastatic and nonmetastatic disease combined, both factors reliably identified high-risk patients. In metastatic disease alone, predictive strength differed. In metastatic choriocarcinoma, neither factor significantly affected outcome, suggesting that metastatic site and antecedent pregnancy matter more for prognosis.

pmid-6289049.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植モデルで、LDHアイソザイムを検討した研究である。腫瘍組織と嚢胞液でLDH-1活性が高く、血清LDH-1は腫瘍体積と強く相関した。血清LDH-1が腫瘍由来であることを示し、腫瘍量を反映するマーカーとしての有用性を支持する。
pmid-6289049.summary_en: This study examined lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) isoenzymes in athymic mice bearing xenografts of a human testicular germ cell tumor. LDH-1 activity was high in tumor tissue and cystic fluid, and histochemistry showed LDH in all tumor cells. Serum LDH-1 correlated closely with tumor volume, indicating that circulating LDH-1 originated from the xenografted tumor. The findings support LDH-1 as a serum marker reflecting germ cell tumor burden in an experimental model.

pmid-6289207.summary_ja: 1962~1978年に同センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患359例の治療成績を報告している。全体の寛解率は92%で、転移のない症例は100%、転移性疾患では83%であった。転移性疾患の治療反応を規定する5因子を同定し、化学療法が主体であった。
pmid-6289207.summary_en: This report summarizes treatment outcomes for 359 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease, including choriocarcinoma and invasive mole, treated at the Brewer Trophoblastic Disease Center from 1962 to 1978. Overall remission was 92%, with 100% for nonmetastatic and 83% for metastatic disease. Five factors, including histology, pretreatment hCG level, metastatic sites, antecedent pregnancy type, and prior chemotherapy, predicted response in metastatic disease. Chemotherapy was the mainstay, with adjuvant surgery and radiation used selectively. Relapse from remission was also analyzed.

pmid-6289666.summary_ja: 1962~1979年に同センターを受診した妊娠性絨毛性疾患399例のうち死亡した48例を解析した。全例が転移性絨毛癌であった。死因は出血と肺不全が主で、治療失敗は進行病変、初期治療の不足、無効な化学療法に起因した。二次化学療法や補助手術は生存率を改善しなかった。
pmid-6289666.summary_en: This analysis examined 48 deaths among 399 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease referred to the Brewer Center from 1962 to 1979. All fatal cases had metastatic choriocarcinoma. Most patients had elevated pretreatment hCG or delayed treatment, and many had metastases to liver, brain, or peritoneum at presentation. The main causes of death were hemorrhage and pulmonary insufficiency. Treatment failure was attributed to extensive disease, inadequate initial treatment, and ineffective chemotherapy. Secondary chemotherapy, non-brain radiation, and adjuvant surgery did not improve survival.

pmid-6289667.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学でPP5を妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に局在させ、血清PP5をラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。PP5は高分化型を含む多くの腫瘍で検出された。持続性疾患では血清PP5の検出頻度と濃度はhCGより低かった。高PP5値の1例で血管内凝固を伴った。
pmid-6289667.summary_en: This study localized placental protein 5 (PP5) by immunoperoxidase staining in gestational trophoblastic tumors and measured serum PP5 by radioimmunoassay. PP5 was present in a high proportion of tumors, especially well-differentiated ones. In patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, serum PP5 was detected less often and at lower levels than hCG. One case with high PP5 showed concurrent intravascular coagulation, the only clinically significant finding.

pmid-6289668.summary_ja: 胎盤蛋白12(PP12)のラジオイムノアッセイを確立し、羊水、臍帯血、正常妊娠・非妊娠者および妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者の血清で測定した。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で高値を示したが、hCGとの相関はなかった。このため、PP12は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の適切なマーカーではないと結論づけた。
pmid-6289668.summary_en: This study developed a radioimmunoassay for placental protein 12 (PP12) and measured its levels in amniotic fluid, cord blood, serum of pregnant and nonpregnant individuals, and patients with trophoblastic disease. Serum PP12 peaked at 22-23 weeks of pregnancy. Elevated levels in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma did not correlate with hCG. The authors concluded that PP12 is not a suitable marker for trophoblastic disease, though normal pregnancy values provide a reference.

pmid-6289770.summary_ja: 67歳男性の縦隔原発胎児性癌と絨毛癌の症例を報告している。既報で最高齢の症例とされる。縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の診断には精巣原発の除外が必要であることを強調し、予後不良である点を指摘した。
